article_content: Xi Jinping has taken center stage as China's paramount leader. This week, the National People's Congress confirmed Xi as state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, making him the Communist Party chief, head of state, and commander-in-chief. This marks the official transfer of power from Hu Jintao, who led China for a decade, to the 59-year-old Xi, who was announced as the country's likely leader last November. Earlier, many believed Xi might be a weaker leader because, unlike Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao, he was not hand-picked by Deng Xiaoping. Experts also thought Xi would take years to solidify his position as his predecessors still held sway. Instead, Xi is quickly consolidating power. Over the past four months, he has taken actions setting himself apart from previous leaders, suggesting possible change ahead. Xi has told officials to reduce displays of privilege, avoid lavish banquets, and prioritize substance over empty talk. In his closing speech at the National People's Congress, he pledged to 'always listen to the voices of the people and respond to their expectations' and vowed to achieve the 'Chinese dream of great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.' After becoming Party leader, Xi’s first trip outside Beijing was to Shenzhen, a symbol of China’s economic reforms. Shenzhen’s rapid transformation is linked to Xi’s father, Xi Zhongxun, who helped launch China’s Special Economic Zones. Analysts say it's still too soon to judge what legacy Xi will leave, but early events are already testing him. One challenge came when staff at the Southern Weekly newspaper protested after censors changed an editorial calling for stronger rule of law. This sparked public support for press freedom, putting Xi’s leadership in the spotlight. A compromise ended the immediate conflict, but not all were satisfied. Professor Jean-Pierre Cabestan of Hong Kong Baptist University observed that Xi has brought a new leadership style, but hasn't yet detailed significant new reforms. 'He's willing to fight corruption, but with existing methods,' Cabestan said. 'China's foreign policy is more assertive but not fundamentally different.' Some National People's Congress delegates remain hopeful. Cai Shijie, CEO of Xin Chang'an Group, noted that Xi is aware of ordinary people's needs and hopes his administration will support private enterprises, which often face obstacles compared to state-owned companies. Huang Youyi, a senior editor at a state-run publisher, appreciates Xi's background, pointing to shared experiences in the countryside. He describes Xi’s team as confident and capable but acknowledges the major challenges ahead. The government confronts urgent issues: slowing economic growth, rising unemployment, income disparity, corruption, environmental problems, and growing nationalism. With China facing both domestic and international tensions, analysts warn Xi cannot delay major decisions. China-watcher Robert Lawrence Kuhn asserts that Xi has surprising credibility and political capital. How Xi deals with China’s problems will set the direction for its 1.3 billion people and influence the world.

Sa siyifye transfè ofisyèl pouvwa a soti nan men Hu Jintao, ki te dirije Lachin pandan dis lane, bay Xi, ki gen 59 an, e ki te deja anonse kòm lidè potansyèl peyi a depi novanm pase. Anvan sa, anpil moun te kwè Xi t ap pi fèb kòm lidè paske, kontrèman ak Jiang Zemin ak Hu Jintao, li pa t chwazi dirèk pa Deng Xiaoping. Espè yo te panse Xi t ap pran plizyè ane pou pran kontwòl paske ansyen lidè yo te toujou gen enfliyans. Men, Xi ap rapidman ranfòse pouvwa li. Pandan kat dènye mwa yo, li pran aksyon ki mete l apa ak lidè anvan yo, sa ki ka vle di chanjman ap vini. Xi te mande responsab yo pou bese ekspozisyon privilèj, evite fèt depans ak mete aksan sou esansyèl olye de pale vid. Nan dènye diskou li devan Kongrè Pèp la, li pwomèt pou 'toujou koute vwa pèp la epi reponn atant yo', epi li fè sèman pou reyalize 'Rèv Chinwa pou ranfòse nasyon an.' Apre li tounen chèf Pati a, premye vwayaj li deyò Beijing se te Shenzhen, ki se senbòl refòm ekonomik Lachin. Chanjman rapid Shenzhen soti nan ti vilaj pou rive gwo vil la gen rapò ak papa Xi, Xi Zhongxun, ki ede kreye Zòn Espesyal Ekonomik yo. Espesyalis yo di li twò bonè pou konnen kisa Xi pral kite kòm eritaj, men premye evenman yo deja ap teste li. Youn nan defi li, se te lè anplwaye jounal Southern Weekly te pwoteste apre sansè chanje yon editoryal ki t ap mande plis sipò pou lwa. Sa lakoz anpil sipò piblik pou libète laprès, mete lidèchip Xi anba limyè. Yo jwenn yon konpwomi ki mete fen kriz la, men pa tout moun ki satisfè. Pwofesè Jean-Pierre Cabestan nan Inivèsite Batis Hong Kong obsève ke Xi pote yon nouvo stil lidèchip, men li poko bay detay sou gwo refòm. 'Li pare pou goumen kont koripsyon, men ak metòd ki egziste deja,' selon Cabestan. 'Politik etranjè Lachin vin pi fèm men li pa chanje fondamantalman.' Gen delegasyon Kongrè Pèp la ki toujou optimis. Cai Shijie, PDG Xin Chang'an Group, di Xi konprann bezwen moun òdinè yo epi li espere administrasyon li ap sipòte antrepriz prive yo, ki souvan blòke pa biznis leta yo. Huang Youyi, editè an chèf nan yon editoryal leta, renmen eksperyans Xi, montre tan li te pase nan zòn riral. Li dekri ekip Xi a kòm konfyans ak efikas, men li rekonèt gwo defi sou wout yo. Gouvènman an ap fè fas ak kesyon prese: kwasans ekonomik ki ralanti, ogmantasyon chomaj, diferans rich-pòv, koripsyon, pwoblèm anviwònman, ak nasyonalis ki ogmante. Avèk Lachin ap jere tansyon andedan ak deyò, analis yo avèti Xi pa ka ret tann pou pran gwo desizyon. Eksper Robert Lawrence Kuhn di Xi gen kredibilite ak kapital politik tou nèf. Jan Xi ap jere pwoblèm yo ap detèmine avni 1.3 milya moun epi enfliyanse mond lan.

article_content: The National Universities Commission (NUC) in Nigeria now recognizes 147 private universities operating across all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. Demand for private university education has surged as frequent strikes and insufficient funding persist in public universities. From January 1 to June 27, 2023, 37 private universities received provisional licences from the NUC, marking notable growth in the sector. Well-known examples include Babcock University in Ogun State, Madonna University in Anambra State, and Covenant University in Ogun State, among many others. The full list shows a diverse range of private institutions available to Nigerian students nationwide. Altogether, this trend reflects how private universities are increasingly responding to students’ educational needs amidst ongoing challenges in the public system.
translated_content: Komisyon Nasyonal Inivèsite (NUC) Nijerya kounye a rekonèt 147 inivèsite prive ki ap fonksyone nan tout 36 eta yo ak Teritwa Kapital Federal la. Demand pou edikasyon inivèsite prive ap ogmante paske inivèsite piblik yo soufri ak grèv souvan ak mank finansman. Ant 1ye janvye ak 27 jen 2023, 37 inivèsite prive te jwenn lisans pwovizwa pa NUC, sa ki montre yon kwasans enpòtan nan sektè a. Pami egzanp ki pi popilè gen Babcock University nan Ogun State, Madonna University nan Anambra State, ak Covenant University nan Ogun State tou, ansanm ak anpil lòt ankò. Lis la demontre yon divèsite inivèsite prive elèv Nijeryen kapab chwazi tout kote peyi a. Fenomen sa a montre jan inivèsite prive yo pran plis plas pou reponn ak bezwen edikatif jèn yo, pandan inivèsite piblik toujou ap fè fas ak difikilte.

article_content: The United States imposed new sanctions on Thursday against Zala Aero, a Russian manufacturer of lightweight drones that has hindered Ukraine’s counteroffensive. The Department of State announced these sanctions to further target companies supporting Russia’s war effort in Ukraine. Zala Aero produces the Lancet drone, which has been effective on the battlefield. Since the Russian invasion last year, the US has implemented numerous sanctions, including restricting Russia’s energy imports, freezing billions of dollars of assets belonging to Russian oligarchs, and excluding Russian banks from the SWIFT global banking system. It is not immediately clear what specific impact the sanctions against Zala Aero will have, and the US State Department did not respond to a request for comment. In February, the Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control blacklisted Russian arms dealer Igor Zimenkov and related companies for their role in supporting Russia’s military-industrial complex through intermediaries. These sanctions prohibit Zimenkov and these companies from doing business with the US. Lancet drones are a type of loitering munition, carrying explosive payloads that can hover over their targets before striking. Some, including the State Department, have referred to these as 'suicide' or 'kamikaze' drones. The Lancet-3M, the latest model, weighs about 26.5 pounds including its payload, and measures under 6 feet long, according to The Wall Street Journal. Samuel Bendett, a Russian military technology expert at the Center for a New American Security, told Reuters the cost to produce each drone is about $35,000. Despite their small size, Lancet drones have proven effective against some Ukrainian weapons and defense systems, complicating Ukraine’s efforts to advance. Online videos claim to show Lancet drones destroying an IRIS-T air-defense system donated by Germany and a Leopard tank. James Patton Rogers, a drone expert at the Cornell Tech Policy Institute and University of Southern Denmark, told Insider that Lancet drones work best against older tanks and is skeptical of their impact on more modern vehicles. 'I wouldn’t believe all the hype, especially regarding attacks on advanced tanks and armored vehicles,' he said. However, Patton Rogers noted the Lancet remains a significant challenge for Ukrainian forces but is 'by no means a war-winning weapon.' A circulating online video appears to show a Lancet drone dropping explosives on a Ukrainian MiG-29 fighter jet on an airbase tarmac, reportedly from about 50 miles away—twice the drone’s previously believed range. A Ukrainian officer stationed in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region told The Wall Street Journal, 'They are a serious problem,' as Ukraine progresses with its counteroffensive. Ukrainian forces are trying to defend against Lancet drones, at times building wooden decoy tanks to misdirect them. Lieutenant Commander Oleksandr Afanasyev told Insider that one decoy was constructed from empty boxes of 155 mm shells. Zala Aero did not respond to a request for comment sent over the weekend.

Sanksyon sa yo entèdi Zimenkov ak konpayi sa yo fè biznis ak Etazini. Drone Lancet yo se yon kalite minisyon ki ka veye epi atake objektif yo ak chay eksplozif. Gen plizyè moun, tankou Depatman Deta a, ki rele yo 'drone swisid' oswa 'kamikaze'. Samuel Bendett, yon ekspè sou teknoloji militè Ris nan Center for a New American Security, di Reuters chak drone koute anviwon $35,000 pou fabrike. Malgre ti dimansyon yo, drone Lancet yo deja montre efikasite kont kèk zam ak sistèm defans Ikrèn, sa rann avansman Ikrèn difisil. Gen videyo sou entènèt ki pretann drone Lancet detwi yon sistèm defans IRIS-T Almay te bay ak yon tank Leopard. Men, Patton Rogers rekonèt drone Lancet yo toujou yon gwo tèt chaje pou fòs Ikrèn men 'li pa vle di lavi a chanje nan lagè a.' Yon videyo sou entènèt ta montre yon drone Lancet lage eksplozif sou yon avyon de gè MiG-29 Ikrèn ki te sou beton ayewopò a, yo di atak la soti anviwon 80 kilomèt lwen—double distans yo te panse drone lan te ka rive. Lyeutenan Kòmandan Oleksandr Afanasyev di Insider ke youn nan fo tank sa yo te konstwi ak bwat vid kokiy 155 mm. Zala Aero pa reponn demann pou kòmantè ki te voye ba yo pandan fen semèn lan.

article_content: As the National Football League continues to address the aftermath of the Richie Incognito/Jonathan Martin bullying controversy, a former player has come forward to say he also experienced harassment from teammates during his professional football career—led by former Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Donovan McNabb. Shawn Andrews, a former NFL offensive lineman, played alongside McNabb for six years in Philadelphia from 2004 to 2009. By the end of his time with the Eagles, Andrews says he suffered from persistent rumors about his sexuality and ongoing harassment, which drove him to consider suicide. Andrews, who is married and has a son, J.J., described the bullying as severe enough that he skipped training camp before the 2008 season to seek professional help for depression. '[McNabb] was a significant part of it—he contributed greatly to my issues there. While "bully" is a strong term, he was degrading and spread rumors about me. It has bothered me that I haven't really spoken about it,' Andrews told syncweekly.com. Andrews said he was unsure why he became a target, but suggested it might have been his hairstyle or his choice of shoes, such as Vans, which drew negative attention. His brother, Stacy Andrews, also a former NFL lineman, noted that having a different style led to teasing from other players. Andrews recalled thinking about harming himself due to the relentless harassment. 'At one point, I thought about flipping my car. I didn't want to use a gun; I guess I was afraid. But these kinds of thoughts crossed my mind,' he said. 'I was at my breaking point, but I was also afraid to talk to someone. The first person I confided in was a psychiatrist.' After missing training camp, Andrews asked coach Andy Reid for a chance to address the team and apologize for his absence. Andrews said he was nervous but felt it was necessary to explain himself. However, he noticed McNabb rolling his eyes during his speech, which made him feel even more isolated. Andrews described the Eagles’ locker room as lacking camaraderie and being dominated by cliques and immature behavior, with McNabb wanting to be the center of attention. He also attributed player immaturity to rumors about his sexuality, explaining that being labeled as gay in the NFL can be dangerous. After his release from the Eagles due to injuries, Andrews joined the New York Giants, where he had a much more positive experience. He recounted feeling appreciated by quarterback Eli Manning and said the Giants’ organization was supportive, making his time there one of the best in his career.
translated_content: Pandan Lig Nasyonal Foutbòl la (NFL) ap kontinye reponn a eskandal entimidasyon Richie Incognito/Jonathan Martin lan, yon ansyen jwè NFL fè konnen li te sibi asèlman tou pandan karyè li—epi se ansyen kotebak Philadelphia Eagles la, Donovan McNabb, ki te kòmanse sa. Shawn Andrews, yon ansyen liy ofansif, te jwe ak McNabb pandan sis ane nan Philadelphia, depi 2004 rive 2009. Rive nan fen eksperyans li ak Eagles yo, Andrews di li te viktim rimè sou seksyalite li ansanm ak asèlman kontinyèl, ki mennen l rive panse sou swisid. Andrews, ki marye epi ki gen yon pitit gason, J.J., te di asèlman an te telman grav li te rate kan sezon anvan 2008 la pou l te chèche èd kont depresyon. "McNabb te vrèman enpòtan nan sa—li te mete anpil pwoblèm sou mwen. Menm si ‘bully’ (asèlè) se yon mo lou, li te kritike m e li te simaye rimè sou mwen. Sa toujou deranje m paske mwen pa t pale sou sa anvan," se sa Andrews di syncweekly.com. Andrews di li pa twò konprann poukisa li te vin yon sib, men li panse sa ka gen rapò ak jan li t ap abiye oswa soulye Vans li te mete. Frè li Stacy Andrews, ki te jwe NFL tou, di fason pa yo mete yo nan group ta ka koz lòt jwè ap pase yo nan betiz. Andrews te fè konnen li te konn gen move panse poutèt asèlman an. "Gen yon fwa, mwen te panse sou vire machin mwen. Mwen pa t vle sèvi ak zam, petèt paske mwen te pè. Men panse sa yo te pase nan tèt mwen," li di. "Mwen te bouke, men mwen te gen krent pou m pale ak moun. Premye moun mwen te pale ak te yon sikyat." Apre li rate kan antrènman, Andrews te mande antrenè Andy Reid pou li ka adrese ekip la epi eskize l pou absans li. Li te santi l nève men li te jwenn li nesesè pou pale. Men li remake McNabb t ap vire je lè l t ap pale, ki fè l santi l plis izole. Andrews dekri vestyè Eagles la kòm pa gen bon relasyon—gen klik e chaje ak konpòtman enmatir, kote McNabb toujou vle tout je sou li. Li ajoute rimè sou seksyalite li se pitit enmatirite jwè yo e di yo bay etikèt ou kòm omoseksyèl nan NFL ka danjre. Lè Eagles yo lage l akoz blesi, Andrews te ale ak New York Giants kote li di eksperyans li te pi pozitif. Li di kotebak Eli Manning te fè l santi l apresye epi li jwenn tout ekip Giants yo te soutni l, se te youn nan pi bèl moman karyè li.

article_content: Britney Spears and Jason Trawick have ended their engagement, as confirmed by sources. Having started their relationship in May 2010 and becoming engaged in December 2011, the pair reportedly evolved from romantic partners to friends, with reports that they had begun living more separately. Both Spears and Trawick issued statements expressing ongoing respect and affection for each other, emphasizing their intent to stay close friends despite the breakup. Spears' representative stated that the decision to break up was mutual and mature. Jason Trawick, formerly Spears’ manager and co-conservator, has stepped away from both roles, while her father, Jamie Spears, continues as conservator. Reports indicate Trawick has also moved out of the home he shared with Britney. Sources have suggested that differing views on having more children and professional priorities contributed to the breakup. Britney reportedly wanted to have more kids, while Jason was hesitant. Trawick’s wish to pursue other business ventures also reportedly played a part. On the same day as the breakup news, Spears announced she is stepping down from her judging role on The X Factor, saying she wants to return to working on her music. Spears' team is currently in talks for her to headline a residency in Las Vegas, following the path of stars like Celine Dion and Cher at Caesars Palace. There is also discussion of her joining a TV sitcom, which her representatives feel would be a good professional fit for her. Although some in the media and on The X Factor team expressed disappointment with Spears’ impact on the show and its ratings, her management is optimistic about future projects. Insiders believe her potential Las Vegas residency could be extremely lucrative, possibly surpassing similar past deals by other artists. Overall, Spears and Trawick’s separation appears amicable, with both focusing on their individual careers and new opportunities.

Gen sous ki fè konnen opinyon diferan sou gen plis pitit ak chanjman pwofesyonèl kontribye nan separasyon an. Britney te vle fè plis pitit, men Jason pa t dakò. Trawick te swaf pou nouvo opòtinite biznis, epi sa te ka lakoz diferans ak Spears, dapre sous yo. On Thursday, Nigeria’s Federal Government urgently called on the international community to help address the worsening humanitarian crisis in Benue State. Dr. Betta Edu, Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Alleviation, visited the Ichwa camp in Makurdi—one of 13 official sites for internally displaced persons (IDPs) across the state.

Deeply moved by the difficult situation facing camp residents, Dr. Edu gave assurances that the government would reach out to international donor agencies to secure support for returning people to their homes. She stressed the need for immediate international intervention, stating that federal efforts alone were insufficient to resolve such a pressing situation.

Dr. Edu also announced the start of construction on cluster settlements for IDPs, with groundwork already begun in Mbagwen, within Makurdi Local Government Area. She described this as an important step toward restoring normalcy for people uprooted by years of violence.

The Minister highlighted President Bola Tinubu’s commitment to working with Benue State Governor Hyacinth Alia to ensure displaced families can safely resettle. In his remarks, Governor Alia noted that violent attacks forcing the displacement of thousands had started as early as 2010 and intensified in 2016. He thanked President Tinubu for honoring his pledge to restore people to their ancestral lands and urged residents to remain patient while government programs roll out.

These efforts, the government says, are part of a broader plan to improve food security and alleviate poverty in the state.

article_content: A summer filled with wildfires across Canada occurred alongside news about global deforestation, the rapid loss of Antarctic ice, and the depletion of Swiss glaciers. Then, in mid-October, the United States Fish and Wildlife Service officially removed 21 species from the Endangered Species Act due to extinction. This stream of grim news about the escalating ecological crisis can leave people feeling overwhelmed, grief-stricken, and even paralyzed with fear. It's natural to seek relief and hope, often by looking for positive news. But what if the grief you are experiencing is itself a kind of good news? As university educators and researchers with interests in community health and outdoor experiences, we explore the challenges of both ecological and human loss. Rather than hiding from death, dying, grief, and mourning, we embrace these feelings—blurring the boundaries between human and ecological grief in our teaching and community work—as a means to build collective resilience. Ecological grief may often be imagined as a private, solitary emotion, reflecting an individual view of human experience. However, grief can become transformative when it shifts from personal sorrow to a shared, collective space. In Canada, National Grief and Bereavement Day falls on the third Tuesday in November. It's an opportunity to recognize that experiencing grief collectively and actively mourning can ease the isolation of loss. Leaning into ecological grief with collective mourning can remind us of our interconnectedness with one another and the planet. In this space, we find mutual support and resilience. In a society that often avoids grief and where health and psychological professions stress the individual over the community, we need a collective, relational approach to ecological grief. Much of our language reinforces the false divide between humans and nature, further fragmenting human experience. Research shows that regional biodiversity losses shape many everyday aspects of human life. Nicole Redvers, director of Indigenous Planetary Health at Western University's Schulich School of Medicine and Dentistry, suggests that patient and planetary health, as well as individual and collective experiences of ecological grief, are ultimately inseparable. Even the term 'ecological grief,' while helpful, can subtly suggest separateness, as if humans are apart from their environments rather than an integral part of them. Jennifer Atkinson, professor of environmental humanities at the University of Washington, points out that framing ecological grief as individual rather than social can foster disenfranchised grief—a loss felt personally but not publicly acknowledged. Social and health psychologist Weronika Kalwak and ecological emotions researcher Vanessa Weihgold urge that ecological grief should be seen as emerging from environmental and social factors, not just individual emotions. This reframes ecological grief from individual resilience, typical of modern Western societies, to a more community-focused approach. Next time grief arises, consider allowing it in. Let it remind you that you are a part of this world. Public mourning can be a powerful response. Our research highlights how the natural world, in all its harshness and beauty, teaches us to grieve both individually and together. Although grief may seem isolating, public mourning for ecological losses can foster solidarity, comfort, and moral courage for change. Public mourning can also be a political act—demonstrating what matters. Let grief signal the loss of valued life. Let it lead to visible, collective mourning, to the honoring of losses, and to remembering what we value. Notice how you may try to avoid this process, such as by acting too quickly. The grief you feel is part of a collective, interconnected experience, matching the losses experienced in the Anthropocene. Mourning together moves us beyond numbness and fear and into confronting natural patterns of loss—some of which humanity has accelerated. Through these difficult lessons and with collective support, we can find inspiration, resilience, and strength to face ongoing losses and effect needed change. The good news is that grief changes us, and in turn, we must change as well. This article is republished from The Conversation under a Creative Commons license. Read the original article at https://phys.org/news/2023-11-good-news-story-ecological-crisis.html.
translated_content: Yon sezon lete ak anpil dife forè atravè Kanada te rive ansanm ak nouvèl sou disparisyon forè atravè mond lan, pèt rapid glas Antatik ak glasi Swis kap fonn. Apre sa, nan mitan Oktòb, Sèvis Pwason ak Bèt Sovaj Etazini te retire 21 espès nan Lwa sou Espès an Danje paske yo vin disparèt. Tout nouvèl tris sa yo sou kriz ekolojik ki ap grandi ka fè moun santi yo akable, chagren, epi pafwa pè jiskaske yo pa ka bouje. Li natirèl pou chèche rekonfò ak espwa, pafwa nan chèche bon nouvèl. Men, e si chagren w ap santi a se menm esansyèlman yon bon nouvèl? Kòm pwofesè inivèsite ak chèchè ki enterese nan sante kominotè ak aktivite deyò, nou eksplore defi pèt imen ak ekolojik ansanm. Olye nou kache devan lanmò, chagren ak dèy, nou akeyi santiman sa yo—melanje limit ant chagren imen ak ekolojik nan ansèyman nou ak travay kominotè—kòm yon chemen pou konstwi rezilyans ansanm. Chagren ekolojik souvan imajine kòm yon santiman prive, endividyèl, men li ka transfòme nou lè li vin yon eksperyans pataje ak kominote a. Nan Kanada, twazyèm madi Novanm se Jou Nasyonal Dèy ak Chagren. Se moman pou rekonèt ke viv chagren ansanm ak fè dèy an piblik ka ede soulaje solitid pèt la. Akeyi chagren ekolojik ansanm ak dèy kolektif ka raple nou koneksyon youn ak lòt ak ak planèt la, kote n'ap jwenn sipò mityèl ak rezilyans. Nan yon sosyete ki souvan evite pale de chagren epi kote sante ak sikològ mete aksan sou endividyèl olye kominote, nou bezwen yon apwòch kolektif pou chagren ekolojik. Anpil nan fason nou pale ranfòse ide ke moun ak lanati yo separe, e sa fragmante eksperyans imen. Rechèch kote pèt biodivèsite afekte lavi imanitè chak jou. Nicole Redvers, direktè Sante Planèt Endijèn nan Western University, di ke sante pasyan ak planèt, ansanm ak eksperyans endividyèl ak kolektif chagren ekolojik, finalman entèseparab. Menm tèm 'chagren ekolojik', malgre li itil, ka fè kwè ke moun se pa pati nan anviwònman yo, olye pou nou wè ke n ap viv ladan l. Jennifer Atkinson, pwofesè imanitè anviwònman nan University of Washington, montre ke si nou trete chagren ekolojik kòm yon pwen de vi endividyèl olye kolektif, sa ka mennen nan chagren ki pa rekonèt piblikman. Psikològ sosyal ak sante Weronika Kalwak ansanm ak rechèch sou emosyon ekolojik Vanessa Weihgold ankouraje nou wè chagren ekolojik kòm yon eksperyans relasyonèl ki soti nan faktè sosyal ak anviwònman, pa sèlman emosyon pèsonèl. Sa mete chagren ekolojik soti nan ide rezilyans endividyèl yo a pi plis sou kominote. Pwochen fwa ou santi chagren, akeyi li. Fè li vin raple ou ke ou fè pati mond lan. Dèy piblik se yon repons pwisan. Rechèch nou montre kijan lanati, ak difikilte ak bèlte li yo, aprann nou fè dèy solo oubyen ansanm. Menm si chagren ka sanble izole, dèy piblik pou pèt ekolojik ka bay inyon, rekonfò, ak kouraj moral pou chanje bagay yo. Dèy piblik kapab tou yon jès politik—ki montre sa ki enpòtan. Kite chagren fè nou konprann lavi ki gen valè ap pèdi. Se pou sa mennen nou pran dèy kolektif an piblik, onore pèt sa yo, epi sonje sa nou apresye. Fè atansyon kijan w ka evite pwosesis sa a, tankou lè ou prese aji. Chagren ou ap viv lan se yon eksperyans kolektif, konekte ak pèt ki fèt nan Antwoposèn la. Fè dèy ansanm ede nou depase sa ki pa fè sans ak kè sote, epi fè fas ak reyalite sik natirèl pèt la—kèk ladan yo akselere pa moun. Atravè leson difisil sa yo ak sipò kolektif, nou ka jwenn enspirasyon, rezilyans, ak fòs pou afronte pèt kap kontinye epi chanje sa ki nesesè. Bon nouvèl la se chagren chanje nou, epi nou dwe chanje tou. Atik sa a repibliye nan The Conversation anba lisans Creative Commons. Li atik orijinal la sou https://phys.org/news/2023-11-good-news-story-ecological-crisis.html.

article_content: Liberia’s presidential election is a tight contest, with incumbent George Weah and opposition leader Joseph Boakai running neck and neck as provisional results continue to come in. With 73% of votes counted from the October 10 poll, Weah leads slightly with 43.8% over Boakai’s 43.54%. If neither surpasses 50%, a run-off is scheduled for November 7. In the last election in 2017, Weah defeated Boakai in a run-off with a strong margin, taking 61.5% of the vote against Boakai’s 38.5%. This time, Boakai is outperforming his earlier results, showing a tighter race. By Sunday, 4,295 of the 5,890 polling stations had submitted results. Liberia’s National Elections Commission is expected to announce final results within 15 days of the vote. More than 2.4 million Liberians registered to vote, including many who have never voted before, having been born after the devastating civil wars that ended in 2003. Besides the presidential race, voters are also choosing members of the legislature. Election monitors, both domestic and international, reported a peaceful process and high voter turnout, although some technical and logistical hiccups were noted. Ecowas, the regional bloc, cautioned the public and political players against claiming early victories or pressuring the elections body, stressing that any attempt to stir unrest could lead to consequences. Liberia is still healing from past conflicts that claimed about 250,000 lives. Boakai, at 78, is seen as making his last challenge for the presidency, campaigning under the slogan 'Rescue' and criticizing Weah’s handling of the country. Weah, 57, responds by pointing to his track record, such as instituting free tuition for university students. According to Jefferson Koijee, secretary-general of the ruling Coalition for Democratic Change, President Weah is committed to maintaining peace and will respect the final results, regardless of outcome.

Avèk 73% vòt konte soti nan eleksyon 10 Oktòb la, Weah mennen ak 43.8% kont 43.54% pou Boakai. Si pèsonn pa soti ak plis pase 50% vòt yo, y ap fè yon dezyèm tou le 7 novanm. Nan eleksyon 2017 yo, se Weah ki te ranpòte laviktwa kont Boakai ak 61.5% vwa, pandan Boakai te fè 38.5%. Ane sa, Boakai ap fè plis pwogrè epi kous la pi sere. Dimanch, se te 4,295 sou 5,890 biwo vòt ki te remèt rezilta yo deja. Komisyon Elektoral Nasyonal Oubarye a ap gen 15 jou apre kontaj final la pou anonse rezilta yo. Plis pase 2.4 milyon moun anrejistre pou vote, majorite se jèn ki pa janm patisipe nan eleksyon paske yo te fèt apre lagè sivil 1989–2003 la. Moun yo ap vote tou pou depite ak senatè. Obsèvatè eleksyon lokal ak entènasyonal di eleksyon an te fèt nan lapè ak anpil patisipasyon, men te gen kèk reta ak pwoblèm teknik. Ecowas, blòk rejyonal la, mande tout moun rete kalm, pa deklare viktwa twò bonè ni mete presyon sou Komisyon Elektoral la, epi raple nenpòt moun ki ta eseye chofe dezòd ap gen konsekans. Oubarye toujou ap soti nan blese lagè ki te koute prensipalman 250,000 lavi. Boakai, 78 ka dènye fwa l ap eseye prezidans lan, li mennen kanpay 'Rescue' epi li kritike jesyon Weah. Pou Weah, ki gen 57 lane, li mete aksan sou aksyon li fè tankou mete inivèsite gratis. article_content: Official figures released yesterday have revealed the increasing extent of the UK’s dependence on foreign energy sources. According to a Department for Energy and Climate Change report, imports of coal, oil, and gas reached a record high in 2012. At the same time, domestic energy production fell by more than 10% due to a significant decline in output from the North Sea. In 2012, the UK imported 173 million tons of oil equivalent—a unit measuring energy potential across all fuel types—which is 7.1% higher than the previous year and the highest level ever recorded. Meanwhile, British energy exports dropped 5% to 80 million tons, the lowest level since 1989. Overall, 43% of the energy used in the UK last year was sourced from abroad—the highest share since 1976, just before the country's North Sea oil boom. Energy analyst Angelos Anastasiou from Cantor Fitzgerald commented, 'We are approaching a crisis scenario. We need new generating capacity, and most likely we’ll see more gas-fired power stations built. However, current economic returns make them uneconomical to construct.' Anastasiou also noted that the decline in North Sea oil and gas production is unlikely to change, adding to the difficulty of the situation. The vulnerability of the UK's domestic energy supply was underscored last week when, amid plunging temperatures and increased demand for heating, only 36 hours of domestic gas reserves remained.

On the day of the Cricket World Cup final between India and Australia, sales soared across India for food, drinks, and related businesses. Despite India’s loss, quick-service restaurants, bars, and delivery platforms reported record-breaking sales driven by the nationwide excitement. Early in the game, platforms such as Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and Blinkit neared their highest-ever daily order volumes, with popular items including pizza, burgers, snacks, and even puja flowers.

Aadit Palicha, CEO of Zepto, noted a surge in orders and highlighted an unexpected spike in puja flower sales during the match, speculating that fans were turning to religious rituals as India’s situation became uncertain. Albinder Dhindsa, CEO of Blinkit, observed that order rates dipped briefly during each over but rebounded during ad breaks, demonstrating how viewer engagement affected ordering patterns.

Major snack and beverage companies also saw their sales multiply four to five times compared to an average Sunday. Restaurants, such as McDonald’s India North and East, anticipated a 10-15% rise in delivery sales, while Virat Kohli’s One8 Commune in Mumbai was fully booked. Speciality Restaurants reported its highest-value lunch takeaway orders of the year. Swiggy stated that food deliveries in the evening surpassed previous records set during New Year’s Eve and Diwali. Other establishments, like Daryaganj Hospitality and Impresario Entertainment & Hospitality, reported notable increases in deliveries and order volumes, crediting the surge to communal viewing of the match.

(Originally published November 19, 2023)

article_content: The Duchess of Cambridge is frequently celebrated for her influence on British fashion, and her recent nine-day journey through Asia and the South Pacific highlighted her commitment to showcasing designers from the UK. Her outfits throughout the trip featured names like Jaeger, Alexander McQueen, Jonathan Saunders, and Zara, while she also added a touch of global flair by choosing a creation by Nepalese designer Prabal Gurung. To mark the end of the tour, Kate opted for a colorful floral silk dress designed by Project D London, which she wore while traveling from Tuvalu to Brisbane. Project D London is a brand that launched in 2010, founded by Tabitha Somerset Webb and Dannii Minogue. The duo, inspired by their friendship and shared love of elegant fashion, aimed to craft beautiful and wearable dresses that flatter women. Kate’s selection was especially meaningful as Project D London is a collaboration between British and Australian designers. In Tuvalu, she accessorized the dress with a floral garland and gracefully handled windy moments as she waved to onlookers. Her sister, Pippa Middleton, is also a supporter of Project D, having worn one of the brand’s silk printed dresses to Wimbledon that summer. Lauren Stevenson, PR director at My-Wardrobe.com, noted that women are drawn to Project D for its sophisticated yet modern style, which resonates with people like the young royals. Although the brand’s founders have not spoken publicly about Kate’s endorsement, those close to them report their excitement at seeing the Duchess wear their design. Project D London is quickly gaining recognition for making women look and feel elegant, embracing feminine silhouettes inspired by legendary style icons.

Pandan tout vwayaj la, li te mete rad soti nan mak tankou Jaeger, Alexander McQueen, Jonathan Saunders, ak Zara, epi li te ajoute yon manyen entènasyonal ak yon kreyasyon Nepalè ki siyen Prabal Gurung. Pou mete fen ak kado vwayaj la, Kate te chwazi mete yon rad swa flè kolore ki soti Project D London, pandan li t ap vwayaje soti Tuvalu rive Brisbane. article_content:
Plain cigarette packaging in Australia is being credited as a major factor behind recent declines in smoking rates, earning praise as a 'vaccine' in the fight against cancer. Since its introduction, Australia has set an example for other nations considering similar public health measures. According to the National Drug Strategy Household Survey, daily smoking rates in Australia fell from 15.1% in 2010 to 12.8% in 2013. The survey also found that the average age of trying a cigarette for the first time rose from 14 to 16 years in that period. Professor Simon Chapman of the University of Sydney described plain packaging as a significant intervention against lung cancer, according to the Sydney Morning Herald.

Despite claims from tobacco companies that plain packaging increased cigarette sales due to price competition, health experts maintain the survey demonstrates the effectiveness of the policy. Australia is leading the world, with several countries, including New Zealand, Britain, and Ireland, considering or debating plain packaging laws. France and India are also contemplating similar policies.

The recent survey involved close to 24,000 participants from July to December last year, just before a 12.5% tobacco tax was introduced. Professor Chapman emphasized it was important that the survey concluded before the tax took effect to isolate the impact of plain packaging laws. He noted, 'The only major change in the 12 months prior was the plain-packaging legislation.'

Smoking rates in Australia have fallen by 50% since 1991, reflecting a broader downward trend. Mike Daube, president of the Australian Council on Smoking and Health, described these results as the most promising in his 40-year health policy career. Daube believes that Australia could surpass its target of reducing adult smoking rates below 10% by 2018, set by the National Preventative Health Taskforce. He noted that if smoking rates fall below 10%, the pace of decline could accelerate further, as smoking becomes increasingly socially unacceptable.

While plain packaging is recognized as a crucial factor, Daube also cited tax increases, media campaigns, and bipartisan political support as contributing to reduced smoking rates. Geoff Neideck from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare confirmed that the survey results are part of a long-term trend, with smoking rates halved since 1991. Neideck added that plain packaging should be considered alongside other factors such as changing attitudes and rising cigarette costs. Since 2000, the average price of a packet of cigarettes in Australia has steadily increased.

Anbalaj sigarèt san mak ann Ostrali ap resevwa lwanj kòm yon faktè kle dèyè dènye diminisyon to moun k ap fimen, yo rele li menmsi yon 'vaksen' nan batay kont kansè. Depi yo te mete l sou mache a, Ostrali tounen egzanp pou lòt peyi k ap panse ak mezi sante piblik sa a. Dapre Sondaj Nasyonal Estrateji Dwòg, to moun k ap fimen chak jou desann soti 15.1% an 2010 pou vin 12.8% an 2013. Sondaj la montre tou laj mwayèn lè moun fimen premye sigarèt ogmante soti 14 pou rive 16 lane. Pwofesè Simon Chapman, inivèsite Sydney, dekri anbalaj san mak tankou yon aksyon enpòtan kont kansè poumon, dapre Sydney Morning Herald.

Malgre konpayi tabak yo di anbalaj senp lan ogmante vant sigarèt paske pri yo konpetisyon, ekspè sante yo kwè rezilta sondaj la pwouve se efikasite plan sa a. Ostrali ap mache an premye, ak plizyè peyi tankou New Zeland, Grann Bretay, ak Iland k ap konsidere oswa ap pase lwa anbalaj san mak. Lafrans ak End ap reflechi pou suiv menm egzanp lan.

Sondaj la te enkli prèske 24,000 moun soti jiyè rive desanm ane pase, anvan yo mete yon nouvo taks 12.5% sou tabak. Pwofesè Chapman te ensiste enpòtans pou yo fè sondaj la anvan taks la te antre ann aplikasyon pou wè sèlman efè lwa anbalaj la. Li di, 'Sèl gwo chanjman ki te fèt pandan 12 mwa anvan sa, se te lwa anbalaj san mak la.'

To moun k ap fimen an Ostrali bese pa 50% depi 1991, sa ki montre yon gwo chanjman. Mike Daube, prezidan Konsèy Ostralyen sou Fimen ak Sante, di rezilta sa yo se pi bon li janm wè pandan 40 ane nan politik sante. Li kwè Ostrali ka desann pi ba pase objektif 10% granmoun k ap fimen anvan 2018. Si to fimen tonbe anba 10%, li panse ap gen yon bès pi rapid paske fimen ap vin pi pa aksepte sosyalman.

Pandan yo rekonèt anbalaj san mak kòm youn nan eleman kle yo, Daube mansyone ogmantasyon taks, kanpay medya, ak apwòch politik ki makonnen tou kòm faktè ki ede bese to fimen yo. Geoff Neideck, nan Enstiti Ostralyen pou Sante ak Byennèt, konfime rezilta sondaj la mache ak tandans depi lontan kote to fimen desann mwatye depi 1991. Li ajoute anbalaj san mak dwe gade ansanm ak lòt chanjman tankou atitid sosyete ak ogmantasyon pri sigarèt depi lane 2000.

article_content: A commercial cargo ship, the Captain Maslov, operated by a Russian company and owned by a Cypriot firm, came under attack from pirates off the Somali coast late Thursday. The Russian Transportation Ministry reported that the pirates used machine guns and grenade launchers, igniting a fire on board as the ship sailed from Sri Lanka to Kenya. Despite being attacked about 300 miles from Somalia, all 17 Russian crew members managed to extinguish the fire and avoided injury. The Captain Maslov was able to escape by maneuvering away from the pirates and continued its voyage to Mombasa, Kenya. Russian authorities, including the Foreign Ministry, Federal Security Service, and Defense Ministry, were quickly alerted, as were rescue centers in the Seychelles and Kenya. The Russian warship Neustrashimy was also informed about the event. Separately, in the Gulf of Aden, Russian and British naval forces stopped pirates from seizing the Danish ship MV Powerful. According to the British Ministry of Defense, two suspected pirates died in an exchange of gunfire with the crew of the HMS Cumberland, and a Yemeni national died later from injuries, despite receiving medical care. CNN’s Maxim Tkachenko contributed to this report.

Ministè Transpò Ris la rapòte ke pirat yo te itilize zam ak lans-grenad, sa ki lakòz yon dife sou bato a pandan li tap vwayaje soti Sri Lanka pou Kenya. Malgre atak la ki te fèt apeprè 300 mil lwen kòt Somali, tout 17 manm ekipaj Ris yo te kapab etenn dife a epi pa gen okenn viktim. Captain Maslov te ka sove ak efikasite lè li manevwe e li kontinye wout li pou Mombasa, Kenya. Otorite Ris yo, tankou Ministè Afè Etranjè, Sèvis Sekirite Federal ak Ministè Defans lan, te resevwa nouvèl la rapidman. Sant sekou nan Seychelles ak Kenya, ansanm ak batiman lagè Ris Neustrashimy, te enfòme tou. Nan yon lòt ensidan apa nan Gòlf Aden, fòs naval Ris ak Britanik te anpeche pirat pran kontwòl sou bato Danwa MV Powerful. Selon Ministè Defans Britanik, de pirat sispèk mouri nan echanj kout zam ak ekipaj HMS Cumberland la, epi yon sitwayen Yemeni te mouri pita, malgre li te resevwa swen medikal. Maxim Tkachenko nan CNN te ede ekri rapò sa a.

article_content: A Secret Service agent assigned to protect Naomi Biden, President Joe Biden's eldest granddaughter, fired a shot at people trying to break into a government vehicle late Sunday night in Washington, DC. This took place in Georgetown near Naomi Biden's home, though she was not at the scene. Secret Service officials reported agents saw three individuals breaking the window of an unattended government car. When the suspects tried to run away, an agent fired at them, but it appears none were injured. The group fled in a red car and law enforcement is searching for them. Both the DC Metropolitan Police Department and the Secret Service are currently investigating the incident. Officials have stated that there was never any direct threat to people being protected, and there is no indication the suspects knew the car was part of a security detail. Naomi Biden, 29, is the daughter of Hunter Biden and Kathleen Buhle. News reports referenced anonymous official sources.

article_content: Britain’s wealthiest are now splurging on lavish beauty treatments, with some spending as much as £29,000 each year on facial therapies that contain gold and diamonds. A documentary on BBC2 recently spotlighted this trend, though experts are quick to highlight the lack of scientific evidence supporting the beauty benefits of these precious materials. At London’s Oro Gold clinic, patrons can experience 24-carat gold facials that blend gold flakes with ingredients like aloe vera and vitamins. A session costs £256, and regular monthly appointments can total £28,800 a year. The clinic also sells masks with gold and sea algae for £1,398, and diamond masks at £1,000 each. On 'The Super-Rich And Us,' presenter Jacques Peretti tried a gold facial at Oro Gold. Therapists claim clients may undergo up to 12 treatments per month. Oro Gold maintains that gold and diamonds, featured in many luxury skincare products, can rejuvenate and moisturize while reducing wrinkles. However, dermatologists like Dr. Adam Friedmann from Harley Street cast doubt, saying gold and diamonds are unreactive and unlikely to benefit the skin. Beauty therapist Lisa Harris echoes this, insisting gold and diamonds don’t penetrate the skin and crediting other mask ingredients for any improvements. Despite the luxurious branding, health professionals believe these costly treatments are more about image than scientifically-backed skincare.

Malgre lidèchip mak liksye a, ekspè swen sante kwè ke tretman sa yo se plis maketing pase syans.

Taiwan’s two main opposition parties, the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP), have agreed to launch a joint campaign for January’s presidential election. This partnership raises the odds of a government in Taipei that may be more open to engagement with China.

At a meeting on Wednesday, leaders from both parties discussed how to select their presidential candidate, deciding to review public and internal party polls to determine which nominee will head the campaign. KMT candidate Hou Yu-ih, TPP’s Ko Wen-je, KMT Chairman Eric Chu, and former president Ma Ying-jeou all took part, agreeing that experts nominated by each party would jointly assess poll results. If the margin between the two leading candidates is within the margin of error, Hou will be chosen as the presidential nominee. The final decision is set to be announced Saturday, with the two parties pledging to form a joint government if victorious.

The development comes as U.S. President Joe Biden and Chinese leader Xi Jinping prepare for a summit in San Francisco, highlighting Taiwan’s pivotal role in the strained U.S.-China relationship. Political analysts, such as National Taiwan University’s Wang Yeh-lih, say a unified opposition increases the likelihood of reduced tensions across the Taiwan Strait and a renewed openness to talks with Beijing.

The ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), represented by Vice President Lai Ching-te, currently leads in most opinion polls. However, the united opposition could pose a strong challenge. Lai’s campaign criticized the KMT-TPP deal, claiming it disregards the parties’ visions for Taiwan.

China considers Taiwan part of its territory and severed direct communication with Taipei after President Tsai Ing-wen took office in 2016, due to her rejection of Beijing’s stance. The U.S. has reaffirmed its commitment to helping Taiwan defend itself against any potential attack and has been working to boost Taiwan’s defenses.

Recent polls by TVBS put Lai at 33% support, Ko at 24%, and Hou at 22%, with independent candidate and Foxconn founder Terry Gou at 8%. The newly formed KMT-TPP alliance could exclude Gou from a coordinated strategy, though his spokesperson said Gou is still open to discussions with Ko’s team. Candidates must register for the election by November 24, ahead of the January vote.

Nan reyinyon Mèkredi a, chèf 2 pati yo te diskite kijan pou chwazi kandida pou prezidans lan epi dakò pou itilize sondaj piblik ak entè-pati pou deside kiyès ki prale nan eleksyon an. KMT gen Hou Yu-ih kòm kandida, TPP gen Ko Wen-je, epi Eric Chu (Prezidan KMT) ak ansyen prezidan Ma Ying-jeou te toupatou. Chak pati ap chwazi yon ekspè pou verifye rezilta sondaj yo ansanm. Si diferans lan pa depase limit erè sondaj la, se Hou ki prale; y ap bay rezilta final la Samdi, epi si yo ranpòte eleksyon an, y ap mete yon gouvènman ansanm.

Akò sa a rive menm lè Prezidan Etazini Joe Biden ak lidè Chinwa Xi Jinping pral rankontre nan San Francisco, sa mete aksan sou wòl Taiwan nan relasyon Etazini ak Lachin ki deja pa fasil. Dapre analis Wang Yeh-lih (UNivèsite Nasyonal Taiwan), kanpay opozisyon an ka diminye tansyon ant 2 bò Taiwan Strait la epi pèmèt plis dyalòg ak Beijing.

Pati k ap dirije a, Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), ki gen Vis Prezidan Lai Ching-te kòm kandida li, ap mennen nan plizyè sondaj deja. Men, alyans opozisyon sa a ka mete plis konpetisyon. Kanpay Lai kritike akò KMT-TPP a, di li pa konsidere vizyon chak pati pou Taiwan.

Lachin toujou konsidere Taiwan kòm tè pa li epi depiwel Tsai Ing-wen te vin prezidan an 2016, yo mete fen ak kominikasyon dirèk ak Taipei paske li pa t aksepte prensip Beijing lan. Etazini deklare li kontinye ede Taiwan defann tèt li kont tout agresyon epi li ap kontinye ranfòse sekirite zile a.

Dapre dènye sondaj TVBS, Lai gen 33% sipò, Ko 24%, Hou 22% epi Tèry Gou (fondatè Foxconn) 8%. Nouvo alyans KMT-TPP la ka mete Gou sou kote, men purtwòl li di li pare pou li pale ak ekip Ko a. Kandida yo ka enskri jiska 24 Novanm anvan eleksyon janvye a.

article_content:
Police have issued a strong public warning after several preventable search and rescue operations. On the Sunshine Coast, a man was charged with public nuisance after he and a young boy, riding a blow-up toboggan in fast-moving floodwaters, needed rescue. Two boys feared swept away in Queensland's floodwaters were found safe and well after an urgent search.

Just after Cyclone Marcia made landfall as a category five storm, some locals took advantage of the hazardous conditions: youths were seen boogie boarding in flooded parks, and surfers braved rough seas at Snapper Rocks, Gold Coast. Risky behavior persisted despite safety warnings.

A 15-year-old boy was rescued after clinging to a tree in the flood-swollen South Pine River, between Eatons Hill and Bunya, around 7pm on Saturday. Emergency services responded to reports that the boy was unable to return to shore. With torchlight and an inflatable rescue boat, Queensland Fire and Emergency Services crew brought him back safely, and paramedics treated him at the scene.

Police continue to urge the public not to enter or play in floodwaters. Also on Saturday, a 40-year-old man and a child were rescued after tobogganing in a Woodford waterway; neither was injured. This was one of two rescues on the Sunshine Coast following local flooding from heavy rainfall caused by Cyclone Marcia.

The cyclone devastated the Queensland coastline, uprooting trees, flooding homes, and leaving thousands without power. Melanie Cobb was among those affected, finding her childhood teddy bear among the debris at her grandmother’s home.

Police also report that three underage boys allegedly stole 11 bottles of liquor from a damaged store in Yeppoon after the cyclone. Authorities warn of severe penalties for such actions.

In summary, police emphasize the dangers of floodwaters and urge everyone to take warnings seriously to prevent avoidable risks.

Polis lanse yon avètisman strik pou piblik la aprè plizyè operasyon sekou ak rechèch ki te ka evite. Nan Sunshine Coast, yo akize yon gason pou dezòd piblik aprè li menm ak yon ti gason te fo sekou, paske yo te monte toboggan gonfle nan dlo k ap koule vit. De ti gason ki te pè inondasyon nan Queensland te pote yo ale jwenn yo an sekirite aprè yon rechèch rapid.

Jis aprè Siklòn Marcia frape kòm kategori senk, kèk moun pa t pran prekosyon: jèn te fè boogie board nan pak inonde, epi djèp ap monte vag nan Snapper Rocks, Gold Coast, malgre lanmè move. Aktivite riske te kontinye malgre avètisman sekirite yo.

Yo sove yon ti gason 15 an ki te kenbe yon pye bwa nan rivyè South Pine ki debòde, ant Eatons Hill ak Bunya, anviron 7è aswè samdi. Sèvis ijans yo te reponn apre yo te resevwa rapò ke li pa t ka retounen sou tè. Avèk limyè flach ak yon bato sekou gonfle, ekip Sèvis Ponpye ak Ijans Queensland te sove li epi paramedik yo te pran swen li sou plas la.

Polis kontinye avèti popilasyon an pou yo pa rantre oswa jwe nan dlo inondasyon. Samdi a menm, yo sove yon gason 40 an ak yon timoun aprè yo te fè toboggan nan yon rivyè rapid nan Woodford; pesonn pa t blese. Sa a te youn nan de sekou kote sou Sunshine Coast akoz inondasyon lokal ki koze pa lapli san rete apre Siklòn Marcia.

Siklòn nan devaste kòt Queensland, dechèpiy pye bwa, inonde kay epi kite plizyè milye moun san kouran. Melanie Cobb pami viktim yo; li jwenn toutou li pandan l ap netwaye debri lakay grann li.

Polis di tou twa jèn gason ki poko gen laj te swadizan vòlè 11 boutèy likè nan yon magazen domaje nan Yeppoon aprè siklòn nan. Otorite yo avèti gwo pinisyon kapab tonbe sou yo.

An rezime, polis souliyen danje dlo inondasyon epi ankouraje tout moun respekte avètisman pou evite ris ki pa nesesè.
post_content: Intense rescues in Queensland: Cyclone Marcia left destruction, but some still braved floodwaters & rough surf! Police warn to stay safe and out of flood zones. #CycloneMarcia #Queensland #StaySafe
translated_post: Sekou entans ann Queensland: Siklòn Marcia devaste zòn nan, men moun toujou ap pran risk nan inondasyon ak lanmè! Polis mande tout moun rete vijilan. #SiklònMarcia #Sekirite #Queensland

article_content: India and South Africa are set to compete in a pivotal ODI World Cup match at Eden Gardens in Kolkata. With the top spot in the league at stake, India enters the match unbeaten, heightening anticipation. The contest recalls the 2011 World Cup, when India suffered its only loss in the tournament to South Africa. Robin Peterson's late heroics then secured a win for South Africa, even as Sachin Tendulkar scored a century. Virat Kohli and Ravichandran Ashwin are the only two players from India's 2011 squad returning for this match. Kohli is also on the verge of equaling the record for 49 ODI hundreds. Led by Rohit Sharma, India has an opportunity to replicate Australia's undefeated World Cup run in 2007. Taking a win here would ensure India's lead ahead of their final group match against the Netherlands. While sports fans recognize the unpredictability inherent in cricket, expectations remain high as India eyes another deep tournament run. Match specifics: The 36th match of the 2023 ODI World Cup, India versus South Africa, is scheduled for November 5 at 2:00 PM IST at Eden Gardens. Catch it live on Disney Hotstar and Star Sports Networks. Likely lineups: India: Rohit Sharma (c), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul (wk), Suryakumar Yadav, Ravindra Jadeja, Mohammed Shami, Jasprit Bumrah, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Siraj. South Africa: Quinton de Kock (wk), Temba Bavuma (c), Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Marco Jansen, Gerald Coetzee, Keshav Maharaj, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi.

Match sa raple tout moun Coupe du Monde 2011 kote Endyen te pèdi sèl match yo kont Lafrik di Sid. Robin Peterson te jwe yon gwo wòl nan viktwa sa, menm si Sachin Tendulkar te frape yon santèn. Malgre tout moun konnen kijan espò ka chaje ak sipriz, espwa rete wo pou Endyen yo ap eseye ale pi lwen nan konpetisyon an. article_content: The world-famous tourist destination Gulmarg in Jammu and Kashmir witnessed its first snowfall of the season on Friday. The Machil sector of Kupwara also received fresh snowfall on the same day. Gulmarg is renowned for its stunning scenery during the snowfall season and its lupine flower blooms, which usually occur from mid-June to the end of July. During winter, visitors often create snow sculptures to showcase their creativity. Gulmarg is not only celebrated for its picturesque beauty but also for winter sports and skiing, making it a major destination for tourists and sports enthusiasts. In February 2022, Gulmarg saw the opening of the world’s largest igloo cafe, captivating tourists. In 2023, a glass igloo restaurant was developed by a private company. Other popular tourist sites include St Mary's Church, Maharaja Palace, Maharani Temple, and the Gulmarg Gondola. Elsewhere in economic news, India’s industrial growth dropped in September 2023 to 5.8%, down from a 14-month high of 10.3% in August, partly due to seasonal factors and excess rainfall affecting output. Ranjan Pai, chairman of Manipal Education and Medical Group, invested ₹1,400 crore (about $168 million) in Aakash Institute, a subsidiary of Byju’s. New graduates are playing an important role in manufacturing companies, contributing to digital transformation efforts, according to JSW Group's chief human resources officer Dilip Pattanayak.

Gulmarg se yon kote ki renome pou bèl peyizaj li pandan sezon nèj la epi pou flè lupin ki fleri sòti nan mitan jen rive nan fen jiyè. Pandan sezon ivè, vizitè yo souvan fè eskilti ak nèj pou montre kreyativite yo. Gulmarg pa sèlman bèl, li tounen tou yon plas popilè pou espò sezon fredi ak ski, sa ki atire touris ak moun ki renmen espò. Nan fevriye 2022, yo te ouvri pi gwo kafe igloo mond lan nan Gulmarg epi sa te atire anpil touris. An 2023, yon konpayi prive mete yon restoran igloo an vè. Lòt plas vizit popilè yo se Legliz St. Mary, Palè Maharaja, Tanp Maharani, ak Goudola Gulmarg la. Nan nouvèl ekonomi, kwasans endistriyèl peyi End te bese nan mwa septanm 2023 a 5.8%, desann soti nan pi gwo nivo an 14 mwa ki te 10.3% nan mwa out, sa sida pa chanjman sezon ak lapli anplis ki te afekte pwodiksyon an. Ranjan Pai, prezidan Manipal Education and Medical Group, envesti ₹1,400 crore (anviwon $168 milyon) nan Aakash Institute, ki se yon branch Byju’s. Nouvo diplome yo jwe yon wòl enpòtan nan konpayi fabrikasyon yo, ede ak transfòmasyon dijital, dapre chèf resous imen JSW Group, Dilip Pattanayak.

Director of Public Prosecutions Keir Starmer QC defended the decision to prosecute Michael Le Vell for child abuse charges in a session before the Home Affairs Select Committee. Starmer explained to Members of Parliament that the decision to proceed met the correct legal standards and that it would have been wrong not to bring the case forward when evidence warranted it. Michael Le Vell, a Coronation Street actor for 30 years, was acquitted this week of charges including child abuse and rape, which allegedly occurred over a nine-year period. After his acquittal, Le Vell described the ordeal as devastating, stating that his life had been destroyed by false accusations. He reportedly considered suicide during the process. Le Vell's relatives and colleagues have criticized the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), claiming the case should not have gone to court, and suggested the prosecution was part of a wider pursuit of celebrities following the Jimmy Savile scandal.

Starmer rejected these claims, stating, 'There is a safeguard in our system: it is not just permissible but the judge's duty to stop a case if there is no case to answer. This didn't happen here, so the jury rightfully considered the evidence before acquitting Mr. Le Vell.' He argued that the outcome of an acquittal does not mean a trial should not have taken place if evidence warranted a prosecution. During the committee hearing, Keith Vaz MP noted the unique damage to the reputations of public figures accused in high-profile cases, and pressed on the media notoriety suffered even after acquittal. Starmer responded that revealing a defendant's identity in such cases sometimes prompts other victims to come forward, strengthening the case.

Kevin Kennedy, a Coronation Street colleague, expressed disappointment that the case was pursued and suggested that anonymity should apply to both the accuser and the accused. The Ministry of Justice reiterated that it has no plans to change the law to grant anonymity to people accused of sexual offences until conviction. In 2011, Nazir Afzal, Crown Chief Prosecutor for the North-West, had initially decided not to charge Le Vell, but that decision was overturned by Alison Levitt QC after the emergence of new evidence. Both Afzal and Starmer denied that there has been a 'witch-hunt' targeting celebrities, emphasizing that charges are brought based on evidence.

Following his acquittal, Michael Le Vell was photographed at his home after celebrating with his family. He is now reportedly in discussions with ITV about returning to his role on Coronation Street.

Starmer esplike palmantè yo ke tout pwosedi legal yo te swiv, epi li ta tounen yon mal si yo pa t mennen ka a devan jistis lè gen ase prèv. Michael Le Vell, aktè Coronation Street depi 30 lane, te jwenn akwitman semèn sa a sou akizasyon abi ak vyòl sou timoun ki ta sipoze fèt pandan nèf ane. Apre akwitman sa a, Le Vell di eksperyans lan te kraze lavi li, li te prèske panse mete fen nan lavi li. Fanmi ak kolèg li yo kritike Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), yo kwè pa t dwe gen pwosè e yo panse se te yon kanpay kont selebrite apre eskandal Jimmy Savile la.

Kevin Kennedy, kolèg Le Vell sou Coronation Street, di li dezapwente paske ka a te pouswiv; li panse anonymat la ta dwe pou toulede pati. article_content: Every summer across the U.S., dramatic migrations and unique animal behaviors transform the landscape for wildlife watchers. From caribou trekking across Alaska's Arctic tundra to orcas trailing salmon in Washington's San Juan Islands, these natural events draw visitors hoping for a glimpse. Here are seven of the best destinations in the U.S. to witness these natural wonders. 1. Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, Alaska: Covering 19 million acres, this isolated preserve is called the last truly wild place in America. The Beaufort Sea's coastal plain is the summer home for more than 123,000 Porcupine caribou, and also hosts grizzly bears, wolves, muskoxen, polar bears, and vast flocks of migratory birds. Most areas are reachable only by plane, so experienced guides are advised. 2. San Juan Islands, Washington: Between Washington’s mainland and Vancouver Island, 178 islands make up this region, famous for orca sightings from late spring through summer, as the whales pursue salmon runs. Responsible tour operators—like those approved by the Pacific Whale Watching Association, as recommended by The Whale Museum—help minimize disturbance. Sea lions, harbor seals, porpoises, and sometimes gray whales can also be seen, along with beautiful hiking opportunities. 3. Glacier National Park, Montana: Featuring over a million acres of glacial and mountainous terrain, this park is a haven for wildlife like elk, bighorn sheep, moose, wolves, and grizzlies. Animals migrate between elevations depending on the season; summer is a great time to spot bighorn sheep on rocky slopes and elk in the valleys. 4. Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming: Home to the only wild bison herd to survive since prehistoric times, Yellowstone’s bison herds are commonly seen along park roads in summer. Two main herds migrate within the park, and drivers should always be alert for crossing animals. 5. Carlsbad Caverns, New Mexico: Summer evenings at Carlsbad Caverns National Park feature the breathtaking sight of hundreds of thousands of Brazilian (Mexican) free-tailed bats erupting from the caves at dusk. July and August are peak months. Arriving before dawn lets visitors see them return after their night hunt. 6. Nesting Sea Turtles, Florida: Florida’s coastlines are critically important for threatened and endangered turtles like the loggerhead, leatherback, and green turtle. Females come ashore between May and July to lay eggs, and after about two months, hatchlings dash to the ocean. Organized turtle walks, managed by groups such as Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge, help ensure both turtles and visitors stay safe—avoid disturbing nests, digging, or using artificial light. 7. Assateague and Chincoteague Islands (Virginia & Maryland): Wild ponies—descendants of 17th-century settlers’ animals—roam the beaches and marshes on these barrier islands, which are also major bird migration stopovers along the Atlantic Flyway. Besides ponies, visitors might spot deer, foxes, otters, dolphins, and many birds while hiking, kayaking, or boating. Tips for wildlife enthusiasts: Learn about the species you hope to see, follow safety advice, and always keep a respectful distance—no matter how cute the animal looks. Responsible viewing protects both wildlife and people. Got a favorite wildlife watching spot? Let others know!

article_content: Yes To Life (YTL), a charity supported by celebrities such as Jerry Hall and Jerome Flynn, is under fire for promoting intravenous Vitamin C as a cancer treatment. Doctors associated with YTL reportedly charge patients—including those with terminal illnesses—up to £3,000 for the therapy, even though there is no scientific proof it works against cancer. The YTL website presents Vitamin C therapy as a solution for a range of conditions, while medical experts argue these claims have no foundation. Calls have been made for the Charity Commission to investigate, with at least one expert filing a complaint with the Advertising Standards Authority. Actress Maureen Lipman, once quoted endorsing YTL online, asked for her statement to be removed after discovering the site implied Vitamin C cures cancer—a claim she disavows. Cancer specialist Agamemnon Epenetos has called the claims inaccurate, pointing out that comprehensive studies offer no supporting evidence. The charity describes itself as helping cancer patients by combining complementary, alternative, and conventional treatments. Celebrity endorsements on the site wish the charity well, but the website also makes specific claims for Vitamin C—saying it can destroy cancer cells safely, strengthen collagen to block cancer’s spread, and be used at any cancer stage. Experts caution that these statements, along with pricey, advertised treatments, may breach laws such as The Cancer Act, which outlaws false cancer cure promotions. Professor Edzard Ernst criticized the exploitation of vulnerable patients, saying there’s no solid proof Vitamin C injections affect cancer. Doctors offering these treatments on YTL’s site include Dr. Michael Wetzler, previously investigated by the General Medical Council (GMC) over a vaccine issue, and Dr. Julian Kenyon, facing a GMC hearing for misleading patients regarding other cancer remedies. Both did not comment for the story. The Charity Commission previously found YTL’s provision of links to alternative treatments acceptable, despite their lack of scientific backing. Founder Robin Daly insists YTL only provides information to those interested. Efforts to get feedback from Jerry Hall's and Jerome Flynn's representatives went unanswered.

Dòktè ki asosye ak YTL yo ap chaje pasyan—menm sa ki gen kansè grav—jiska £3,000 pou terapi a, menm si pa gen okenn prèv syantifik li efikas kont kansè. Sit entènèt YTL la prezante Vitamin C tankou yon solisyon pou plizyè maladi, men ekspè medikal di reklamasyon sa yo pa gen okenn baz. Plizyè moun mande pou Charity Commission mennen ankèt, epi gen omwen yon ekspè ki deja pote plent bay Advertising Standards Authority. Aktris Maureen Lipman, ki te deja site sou sit la kòm bay sipò, te mande pou deklarasyon li a retire apre li te wè sit la fè kwè Vitamin C ka geri kansè—yon reklamasyon li pa dakò ak li. Espesyalis kansè Agamemnon Epenetos di reklamasyon sa yo pa kòrèk e li mete aksan sou fatke gwo etid pa montre lèzay terapi sa a mache. Òganizasyon charitab la di li ede pasyan kansè yo lè l konbine tretman konplemantè, altènatif, ak medsin tradisyonèl. Gen vedèt sou sit la ki swete òganizasyon an siksè, men yo mete reklamasyon tou ke Vitamin C ka detwi selil kansè san danje, ranfòse kolagen pou bloke pwopagasyon kansè, epi kapab itilize nan tout etap kansè. Ekspè yo avèti ke deklarasyon sa yo ansanm ak tretman ki koute chè yo ka vyole lwa tankou Cancer Act, ki entèdi fo pwomosyon sou tretman kansè. Pwofesè Edzard Ernst denonse eksplwatasyon pasyan frajil yo, e li di pa gen okenn prèv serye Vitamin C bay rezilta sou kansè. Doktè ki patisipe nan sa a sou sit YTL la enkli Dr Michael Wetzler, ki te deja fè fas ak General Medical Council (GMC) sou yon erè vaksin, ak Dr Julian Kenyon, ki gen yon odyans GMC k ap vini sou zafè fo enfòmasyon bay pasyan sou lòt terapi kansè. Fondatè Robin Daly ensiste YTL sèlman pataje enfòmasyon pou moun ki enterese. Ese pou jwenn repons bò kote reprezantan Jerry Hall ak Jerome Flynn pa bay okenn rezilta.

article_content:
Scientists have discovered evidence of flu viruses in bats for the first time, raising concerns about potential risks to humans. According to U.S. health officials, genetic fragments of a previously unknown virus were found in yellow-shouldered bats in Guatemala. While flu viruses are commonly seen in humans, birds, pigs, and other mammals, this marks the first documentation in bats.

Ruben Donis, a scientist at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and co-author of the study, noted, 'Most people were fairly convinced we had already discovered flu in all possible animals.' Researchers believe some bats may have contracted flu centuries ago, and the virus mutated within the bat population into this new form.

However, scientists have not been able to grow the new virus in chicken eggs or human cell cultures, standard methods for studying flu strains, making it unclear whether or how efficiently it spreads. Still, experts warn that if the bat virus were to mix with common types of influenza, it could mutate into a form more dangerous to humans—a scenario similar to the one depicted in the film 'Contagion.'

The research, published online in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, involved collecting over 300 bats in Guatemala between 2009 and 2010. The original goal was to study rabies, but researchers screened the bats for other pathogens and discovered the new flu virus in their intestines. The yellow-shouldered bats, which eat fruits and insects, do not bite people but could theoretically leave traces of the virus on produce that humans might consume.

While some speculate the virus could infect humans, Richard Fulton, a bird disease expert at Michigan State University, cautioned that more proof is needed. He pointed out that only a segment of genetic material has been found, not a complete, viable virus. Work continues to study the virus further, including attempts to infect healthy bats. Donis noted that some viruses are discovered by genetic sequencing but are difficult to grow in laboratories, such as hepatitis C.

Ruben Donis, yon syantis nan Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) e ko-otè etid la, di: "Pifò moun te panse nou te deja jwenn grip nan tout bèt posib." Rechèchè yo panse kèk malfini te trape grip depi syèk pase epi viris la te vin evolye nan mitan yo pou bay nouvo varyete sa a.

Men, syantis yo poko ka fè nouvo viris la grandi ni nan ze poul ni nan kilti selil imen, k ap sèvi abityèlman pou etidye grip. Sa fè li pa klè si oswa kouman li ka gaye. Malgre kèk ap panse viris la ta ka enfekte moun, Richard Fulton, yon ekspè sou maladi zwazo nan Michigan State University, di plis prèv nesesè. article_content: Javier Milei, a 53-year-old economist known for his right-wing outsider status, achieved a decisive victory in Argentina’s presidential election. The large margin, while not unexpected considering widespread frustration with economic instability—such as 143% annual inflation and 40% poverty—surprised many observers. Milei captured nearly 56% of votes against Sergio Massa’s 44%, prevailing in 20 of 23 provinces, including Buenos Aires. Nicknamed 'El Loco' by critics, Milei ran on sweeping economic reforms. He pledged to slash bureaucracy, abolish the central bank to stop inflation fueled by money printing, and replace the peso with the US dollar. Another key promise is to privatize large state firms, particularly YPF, Argentina’s leading energy company. He emphasized, though, that YPF would need to be restructured and strengthened before privatization. Stock markets welcomed his plans: YPF shares on the NYSE jumped 39% in response to his victory. Argentina, possessing the world’s second-largest shale gas reserves and the vast Vaca Muerta deposit, may see more private investment as Milei aims to deregulate the energy industry, cut state spending, and boost exports. Pipeline upgrades have already increased energy shipments and, according to government data, the country could shift from a $5 billion deficit in 2022 to a $4 billion surplus in 2024. By 2030, surpluses could rise to $20 billion if trends continue. Lithium is a vital part of Milei’s strategy. Argentina holds the planet’s second-largest lithium reserves, and production is expected to double by 2024 with new mining projects. Milei supports expanding private sector activity to tap into global demand for batteries and clean tech. Despite a strong electoral mandate, Milei faces political hurdles. His party controls only a few seats in Congress, so passing reforms will require cooperation with opponents he criticized during the campaign—potentially slowing progress. Regarding international affairs, especially the contested Falkland Islands, Milei maintains Argentina’s claim but has adopted a less confrontational tone. His praise for Margaret Thatcher stirred controversy, though he indicates openness to dialogue over economic development. Milei is skeptical about climate change and has proposed reducing the government’s environmental role, possibly shutting down the environment ministry. Still, he is open to private investment in renewable energy projects. In summary, Milei’s platform promises major change and new opportunities, particularly in energy and mining. However, the extent of reforms will depend heavily on his ability to work within Argentina’s political system.
translated_content: Javier Milei, yon ekonomis 53 lane ki rekonèt kòm yon moun dwat ak andeyò sistèm nan, gen yon gwo viktwa nan eleksyon prezidansyèl Ajantin lan. article_content: Nippon Life India Asset Management has entered the private credit market, joining Centrum and Avendus in capitalizing on increased demand following tightened lending norms by banks and mutual funds. Nippon Life India Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) plans to raise ₹1,000 crore, with an option to expand by another ₹1,000 crore through a green shoe option. The fund has already invested ₹100 crore in two deals and has three more upcoming investments. According to Ashish Chuglani, head of alternate investments, the strategy is to invest in 10-12 securities in the 'BBB' to 'A' rating range, mainly for non-bank end uses, and aims for returns of 14-15%. Nippon is attracting capital from high net-worth individuals and family offices to address the financing gap created as mutual funds withdraw. This transition is partly due to promoters' need for growth capital and exits by private equity from India's public markets, leading to stabilized stressed assets requiring private credit. Nippon Life India AIF typically considers investments between ₹50 crore and ₹100 crore per deal, with average maturities of 2.5 to 3 years and an amortizing principal component. At the same time, the IPO market is experiencing a significant surge, with recent launches such as Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery being fully subscribed within hours of opening. Elsewhere, IndiGo is reportedly planning to introduce premium seating, better meal options, and a loyalty program by the end of 2024 to attract business travelers and compete with Air India on international routes. Additionally, since the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) was enacted, creditors have withdrawn over 26,000 insolvency cases involving defaults totaling ₹9.33 lakh crore before their applications were admitted by the adjudicating authority.
translated_content: Nippon Life India Asset Management antre nan mache kredi prive a, ansanm ak Centrum ak Avendus, pou pwofite demann ki ogmante apre bank ak fon mityèl sere règ prèt la. Nippon Life India Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) ap chèche ranmase ₹1,000 crore, ak posiblite pou ogmante pa yon lòt ₹1,000 crore gras ak opsyon 'green shoe'. Fon an deja envesti ₹100 crore nan de kontra epi li gen twa lòt envestisman sou wout. Dapre Ashish Chuglani, chèf envestisman altènatif la, estrateji a se mete kòb nan 10-12 sekirite ki klase ant 'BBB' ak 'A', sitou pou itilizasyon pa bank, kote y ap vize yon retou 14% a 15%. Nippon ap chèche kapital nan men gwo envestisè ak family offices pou ranpli espas finansman an kòm fon mityèl ap retire kò yo. Chanjman sa a fèt an pati akoz pwopriyetè biznis yo bezwen kapital kwasans epi kapital prive ap sòti nan mache piblik peyi Zend, sa ki kreye plis byen ki estab men ki bezwen kredi prive. Nippon Life India AIF tipikman konsidere envestisman ant ₹50 crore ak ₹100 crore chak kontra, ak echans mwayèn 2.5 a 3 ane ak yon prensipal amòtize. An menm tan, mache IPO a ap pran anpil elan, ak lansman resan tankou Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, ak Gandhar Oil Refinery ki jwenn tout souskripsyon yo fini nan kèk èdtan apre ouvèti. Lòt kote, yo di IndiGo ap planifye mete plas prim, pi bon manje, ak yon pwogram lwayote anvan fen 2024 pou atire vwayajè biznis epi konkirans ak Air India sou wout entènasyonal. Anplis, depi Kòd Ensòlvans ak Fayit (IBC) te antre an vigè, kreyansye yo retire plis pase 26,000 ka ensòlvans ki te gen defo totalize ₹9.33 lakh crore anvan aplikasyon yo te admèt devan otorite jijman an.
