article_content: Images returned from NASA's Cassini spacecraft have revealed meteors hitting Saturn's rings for the first time. Saturn is now the only location besides Earth, the Moon, and Jupiter where scientists have observed direct impacts as they occur. The meteoroids, measuring from one centimeter to several meters across, break apart upon striking the rings, scattering into debris and forming clouds, according to NASA scientists. These impacts help scientists understand how planetary systems, including our own, were formed. Saturn's rings act as sensitive detectors of surrounding phenomena, including impacts from outside the Saturnian system. Researchers spent years identifying the tracks left by nine different meteors in 2005, 2009, and 2012. Results from Cassini have also helped scientists study Saturn’s interior structure and the orbits of its moons. For example, a ripple seen in the innermost rings, spanning about 12,000 miles, points to a major meteoroid impact in 1983. The Cassini probe detected meteoroids similar in size to one that entered Earth's atmosphere over Russia in February 2013. According to Cassini project scientist Linda Spilker, the current impact rates for small particles at Saturn are comparable to those at Earth, which is impressive considering how different their environments are. Observing meteorite impacts was particularly successful during the Saturnian equinox in summer 2009, when sunlight hit the rings at a shallow angle, making the debris clouds especially visible in Cassini's images. Lead author Matt Tiscareno of Cornell University noted that though tiny impacts were expected, their size, frequency, and visually dramatic shearing clouds came as a surprise. Sunlight at the equinox helped make these features visible. Jeff Cuzzi, co-author and NASA Ames Research Center scientist, said that understanding how often outside material bombards the rings is crucial to evaluating their age and composition. Recent analyses have detected new impactors that were previously too small to observe. The Cassini-Huygens mission is a joint project of NASA, the European Space Agency, and the Italian Space Agency. NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory manages the mission, with the imaging team including scientists from the U.S., England, France, and Germany. The Space Science Institute in Boulder, Colorado, hosts the imaging operations. Details are published in Science.
translated_content: Imaj ki sòti nan sond espasyal Cassini NASA voye tounen montre premye fwa syantis obsève meteyorit frape bag Satèn yo. Satèn se kounye a sèl plas, apa Latè, Lalin, ak Jipitè, kote syantis ka wè enpak an dirèk. Meteyorit yo, ki mezire soti nan yon santimèt rive plizyè mèt, kraze dè yo frape bag yo epi gaye dériyè ki fòme nwaj, dapre syantis NASA. Enpak sa yo ede syantis konprann kijan sistèm planèt yo, entèn ak lòt, te fòme. Bag Satèn yo fè sèvis kòm detektè sansib pou fenomèn ki bò kote, enkli enpak ki sòti deyò sistèm Satèn nan. Rechèchè yo te pase plizyè ane ap idantifye tras nèf meteyorit ki frape nan ane 2005, 2009, ak 2012. Rezilta sond Cassini a ede syantis etidye estrikti enteryè Satèn ak òbit lalin li yo. Pa egzanp, yon ond ki parèt nan bag enteryè yo, ki koule sou apeprè 12,000 mil, endike yon gwo enpak meteyorit an 1983. Sond Cassini a detekte meteyorit ki gen menm gwosè ak youn ki te antre nan atmosfè Latè sou Larisi nan fevriye 2013. Dapre syantis Linda Spilker sou pwojè Cassini, frekans enpak ti patikil sou Satèn preske menm jan ak sa sou Latè, menm si anviwònman yo diferan anpil. Obsèvasyon enpak meteyorit te pi siksè pandan ekinòks Satèn lan pandan ete 2009, lè solèy la te bay yon kote sou bag yo ak yon ang ba, fè nwaj dériyè yo pi vizib sou imaj Cassini yo. Matt Tiscareno, chèf otè a nan Cornell University, eksplike ke menm si yo te atann ti enpak yo, gwosè, kantite, ak bèl nwaj yo te bay sipriz. Limyè solèy la pandan ekinòks la te ede mete sa yo byen klè. Jeff Cuzzi, ko-otè ak syantis NASA Ames Research Center, di ke konprann konbyen fwa materyèl ekstèn frape bag yo esansyèl pou evalye laj ak konpozisyon yo. Dènye analiz yo dekouvri nouvo meteyorit ki te twò piti pou detekte anvan. Misyon Cassini-Huygens se yon kolaborasyon ant NASA, Ajans Espas Ewopeyen an, ak Ajans Espas Itali a. NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory jere misyon an; ekip imaj la gen syantis ki soti nan Etazini, Angletè, Lafrans, ak Almay. Space Science Institute nan Boulder, Colorado, kontwole operasyon imaj la. Detay yo pibliye nan jounal Science.

article_content: Ola Aina has been selected as Nottingham Forest’s Player of the Month for September, having received 40% of the votes cast on the club’s official website. The 26-year-old defender, who signed on a free transfer from Torino last summer, has quickly become a standout presence in the squad. In September, he played three matches, taking over the honor from August winner Taiwo Awoniyi, and contributed to Steve Cooper’s team earning four points—including a notable 1-0 win at Chelsea and a 1-1 draw with Burnley. Aina also featured in the match against Manchester City. Following the award announcement, he thanked fans for their support via Instagram. Despite this achievement, Aina missed the most recent match versus Brentford due to a muscle injury. Manager Steve Cooper remarked it’s still uncertain if Aina will return for the upcoming game at Crystal Palace. Regardless, Aina has been included in Nigeria’s squad for the October friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique in Portugal.

Aina ede ekip Steve Cooper lan pran kat pwen—pami sa yo, yo bat Chelsea 1-0 epi fè match nul 1-1 kont Burnley. Li te patisipe tou nan match yo te pèdi kont Manchester City. FIFA, soccer's global governing body, believes the 2018 World Cup can serve as a catalyst for social change in Russia, despite controversial anti-gay statements from the head of the organizing committee. On Tuesday, FIFA told CNN it was seeking clarification about newly adopted Russian laws that 'prohibit propaganda on non-traditional sexual relations' around minors. The legislation also bans symbols such as rainbow flags, sparking calls for boycotts of both the 2014 Sochi Winter Olympics and the 2018 World Cup.

Alexey Sorokin, CEO of the World Cup organizing committee, defended the laws, asserting they are meant to prevent active promotion of homosexuality, not to target homosexual individuals. Speaking to World Football Insider, Sorokin stated, 'It is designed against active propaganda of homosexuality, not against homosexuality itself. That is a big difference.' He added, 'Would you like a World Cup where naked people are running around displaying their homosexuality? The answer to that is quite obvious.'

Sorokin asserted, 'The Olympics and World Cup are not stages for various views—not for Nazis, not for any other ways of life. It should be about football and nothing else.'

FIFA emphasized that its statutes maintain 'zero tolerance against discrimination based, among other things, on sexual orientation,' and expressed confidence that the 2018 hosts would provide visitors and fans with a warm welcome. 'FIFA is firmly convinced that staging the World Cup can help unite people and have a positive social impact,' the organization added.

Meanwhile, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is under pressure to respond ahead of the next year's Winter Games. The IOC has publicly opposed any calls for a boycott but told CNN it is monitoring developments in Russia. 'This legislation has just passed into law, and it remains to be seen how it will be implemented, particularly for the Games in Sochi,' an IOC spokesperson said. 'To that end, the IOC has received assurances from the highest level of government in Russia that the legislation will not affect those attending or participating in the Games.'

Russia secured the right to host the 2018 World Cup in a December 2010 vote and pledged to build 13 new stadiums as part of a plan costing nearly $5 billion. Additional billions will be spent to improve infrastructure for the expected influx of tourists and football fans during the tournament.

FIFA, ki se kò ki jere foutbòl sou plan mondyal, kwè Koup di Mond 2018 la ka bay opòtinite pou chanjman sosyal nan Larisi, malgre deklarasyon anti-omoseksyèl ki sòti bò kote tèt komite òganizatè a. Madi, FIFA te di CNN, lap chèche plis eksplikasyon sou nouvo lwa Larisi yo ki "entèdi pwopagann sou relasyon seksyèl ki pa tradisyonèl" devan timoun yo. Lwa sa yo entèdi senbòl tankou drapo lakansyèl la, sa ki fè gen apèl pou boikote tou de Je Zimè Sochi 2014 la ak Koup di Mond 2018 lan.

Alexey Sorokin, PDG komite òganizasyon Koup di Mond la, te defann lwa yo epi li di lwa a fèt pou limite pwopagann aktif sou omoseksyalite, li pa vize moun omoseksyèl yo dirèkteman. Nan World Football Insider, Sorokin deklare: "Lwa a fèt kont pwopagann aktif omoseksyalite, pa kont omoseksyalite li menm. Sa se yon diferans enpòtan." Li ajoute: "Èske w ta vle yon Koup di Mond kote moun ap mache toutouni pou montre omoseksyalite yo? Repons lan klè."

Sorokin kontinye: "Je Zimè ak Koup di Mond lan pa fèt pou tout kalite ekspresyon—ni pou Nazi, ni pou lòt stil vi. Li ta dwe sèlman sou foutbòl."

FIFA mete aksan sou règleman li yo ki mande 'zèro tolerans pou diskriminasyon, kit sou oryantasyon seksyèl oswa lòt bagay', epi li eksprime konfyans ke otorite 2018 yo ap resevwa tout vizitè ak fanatik yo ak anpil chalè. "FIFA kwè fòtman ke òganizate Koup di Mond lan ka ede mete moun ansanm epi gen enpak sosyal pozitif," òganizasyon an ajoute.

An menm tan an, Komite Olimpik Entènasyonal (IOC) anba presyon pou reponn avan Je Zimè ane pwochèn yo. IOC inisiste li kont apèl pou boikote, men di CNN ke li ap siveye devlopman yo nan Larisi. "Lwa sa a fèk pase, e nou pa konnen kijan li ap aplike, espesyalman pandan Je yo ap fèt nan Sochi," dapre yon pòtpawòl IOC. "Pou sa, IOC resevwa garanti nan pi wo nivo leta Larisi ke lwa sa pap afekte moun k ap vini oswa k ap patisipe nan Je yo."

Larisi te jwin dwa òganize Koup di Mond 2018 apre yon vòt nan desanm 2010, epi pwomèt pou konstwi 13 nouvo estad nan yon plan ki koute prèske $5 milya. Plizyè milya ankò ap depanse pou amelyore enfrastrikti pou touris ak fanatik foutbòl ki ap vini pou konpetisyon an.

article_content: Ten major Indian trade unions, excluding the Bhartiya Mazdoor Sangh, have come together to urge the government to accelerate rescue operations at the Silkyara tunnel collapse site in Uttarakhand, where 41 workers are still trapped. They have collectively asked for a thorough probe covering all phases of the tunnel project, pointing to potential lapses in safety. These unions have also reiterated their call to repeal the Code on Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions, 2020, arguing that it undermines current worker protections. They are pressing the government to ratify key ILO international labor standards on health and safety, which were declared fundamental in 2022. Additionally, the unions want all four controversial labor codes withdrawn and are asking the authorities to organize the Indian Labour Conference soon to address workers’ issues. According to Road Transport and Highways Secretary Anurag Jain, officials hope to rescue the trapped workers in about 72 hours if horizontal drilling, which has resumed, is successful. The Silkyara tunnel, part of a broader project to improve pilgrimage routes in Uttarakhand, collapsed on November 12. Managed by NHIDCL, the 4.5 km tunnel is being built at a cost of Rs 1,383 crore. In a separate development, Indian tax authorities have uncovered around ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by businesses selling on platforms like Instagram and Facebook, sending notices to numerous brands. The GST department has also issued over 20,000 notices since 2022, pushing companies to review their tax liabilities before finalizing business deals. In other news, Nawaz Modi, estranged wife of Raymond CEO Gautam Singhania, has accused him of assaulting her and their daughter.

Yo mande yon ankèt fouye tout etap pwojè tinèl la, paske yo kwè te gen neglijans sou sekirite. Nan lòt nouvèl, otorite fiskal peyi Lend dekouvri anviwon 10 mil crore rupi evazyon taks pa biznis k ap vann sou Instagram ak Facebook, epi yo voye avi bay anpil mak. article_content: Gelu Duminică, a renowned Roma activist and sociology professor in Romania, has dedicated his career to confronting deep-seated stereotypes and fighting for Roma inclusion. His journey is shaped by personal and communal trauma, including the Romani Holocaust in which much of his family was deported—only his father survived. Growing up in poverty and experiencing discrimination firsthand, Duminică became the first in his community to attend high school thanks to his mother's insistence. He later earned a degree in sociology and social work from the University of Bucharest and now serves as executive director of 'Agenția Împreună', an NGO promoting Roma social inclusion. Throughout his life, Duminică has witnessed and endured interethnic violence, especially in the 1990s and early 2000s, and has spoken out against systemic discriminatory practices, such as job postings explicitly excluding Roma people. He played a key role in altering the Romanian dictionary's definition of the terms 'gypsy' and 'Roma' to recognize their pejorative usage and discourage stereotype perpetuation. Despite some progress, the Roma community in Romania continues to face significant challenges: official census data may undercount the population due to fear of stigma, and many Roma children are still deprived of education. Discrimination in public spaces, schools, and employment remains an issue, though Duminică notes gradual improvements in societal attitudes and legal protections. Civil society organizations and improved media coverage have contributed positively, but Duminică emphasizes the ongoing lack of political and religious leadership representing Roma interests. He rejects the label 'activist,' explaining that his motivation lies in seeking a better life for himself, his family, and his fellow citizens, rooted in shared human values rather than ethnicity alone. He advocates for more inclusive education that recognises the complex, often harmful narratives about Roma handed down through culture. Duminică stresses the need for strong values and authentic leaders to foster further change. As a professor, he finds purpose in emotionally engaging students and broadening their understanding of Roma history and culture. He describes moving classroom moments when students rise for the Roma anthem, symbolizing a shift toward greater empathy and respect. Duminică remains hopeful, acknowledging Romania has changed for the better since the fall of communism but insisting real progress depends on personal responsibility and collective action, not waiting for others to take the lead.
translated_content: Gelu Duminică, yon aktivis epi pwofesè sosyoloji Roma ki renome nan Woumani, dedye lavi li pou konbat stereotip ki anrasinen e pote lajistis pou enklizyon Roma yo. Istwa li make pa blesi pèsonèl ak komen, tankou Olocòs Roma a kote anpil nan fanmi li te depòte — sèl papa li te tounen vivan. Li te leve nan povrete ak soufri diskriminasyon, epi li te premye nan zòn li ki te ale lekòl segondè, mèsi ak devouman manman li. Plis ta, li fini ak diplòm sosyoloji ak travay sosyal nan Inivèsite Bucharest epi li jere ONG 'Agenția Împreună,' ki ankouraje enklizyon sosyal pou Roma yo. Pandan lavi li, Duminică wè ak pase atravè vyolans ant etnik, espesyalman nan ane 1990 ak kòmansman 2000 yo, epi li denonse pratik diskriminasyon sistematik tankou anons djòb ki ekspreklizyon pou Roma yo. Li te ede chanje definisyon diksyonè a pou tèm 'gitan' ak 'Roma' pou montre aspè peyojoratif epi dekouraje stereotip. Malgre kèk pwogrè, kominote Roma yo ann Woumani ap kontinye fè fas ak gwo defi: resansman ofisyèl ka pa kouvri tout moun paske pè stigmatizasyon, epi anpil timoun Roma toujou pa gen aksè ak edikasyon. Diskriminasyon toujou ap fèt nan espas piblik, lekòl ak nan travay, men Duminică remake gen chanjman pozitif nan atitid ak pwoteksyon legal. Òganizasyon sosyete sivil ansanm ak prezans medya ki pi ekilibre pote lòt avan, men Duminică di toujou manke lidèchip politik oswa relijye pou Roma yo. Li refize etikèt 'aktivis', li fè konnen li motive pa dezi pou amelyore lavi pou li, fanmi li ak tout sosyete a, baze sou valè imen pito pase sou etnisite. Li defann edikasyon pi enklizif, ki rekonèt istwa souvan negatif sou Roma yo ke kilti a repete. Duminică ensiste sou enpòtans lidèveritab ak valè vre pou voye chanjman pi lwen. Kòm pwofesè, li jwenn satisfaksyon nan enkli elèv yo ak emosyon ak elaji vizyon yo sou istwa ak kilti Roma. Li dekri moman senbolik kote elèv yo leve pou im Roma yo – siy yon ogmantasyon respè ak konpreyansyon. Duminică rete gen espwa, li rekonèt Woumani amelyore apre kominism, men li kwè chanjman reyèl depann de responsabilite pèsonèl ak aksyon kolektif, pa janm rete tann lòt moun fè premye pa a.

article_content: A 75-year-old man assisted in detaining a shoplifting suspect at a Pennsylvania mall by tackling him and warning he would restrain him further if he attempted to escape. Charlie Burton, of Fombell, was a vendor at the Washington Crown Center mall during a gun show when he observed a police officer struggling with the suspect, 29-year-old Jonathan Fekete Jr. Police reported that Fekete was trying to evade authorities after stealing $200 worth of clothing from a Macy's store on Saturday. Burton recounted that he quickly helped by grabbing the suspect's arms and forcing him to the ground, saying, 'He started yelling that his arm hurt, and I told him to stop struggling or I would need to get tougher.' Describing the incident to the Observer-Reporter, Burton said, 'It happened so fast. I just grabbed his arm and twisted it to assist the security guard, who was holding his other arm. The suspect was very strong, and it took both of us to restrain him. He kept asking me to stop twisting his arm.' State Senator Camera Bartolotta, who attended the gun show, complimented Burton on social media, referring to him as 'Super Charlie' and commenting on the suspect's decision to steal in a mall full of sportsmen. The suspect, Jonathan Fekete Jr., remains in jail, with court records showing no attorney listed for him. Authorities stated he also has an outstanding Pennsylvania warrant connected to a previous drug charge in Allegheny County. Burton explained that his primary concern was protecting the officer, stating, 'My wife asked if I was crazy, but I would have felt terrible if the officer had been injured.'
translated_content: Yon nonm 75-zan ede arete yon sispèk vòl nan yon sant komèsyal Pennsylvani lè li te balanse l atè epi avèti l li t ap mete plis presyon sou li si li te eseye sove. Charlie Burton, ki soti Fombell, te yon machann nan sant komèsyal Washington Crown Center pandan te gen yon ekspozisyon zam, lè li remake yon polisye ap lite ak sispèk la, Jonathan Fekete Jr., ki gen 29 an. Polis yo fè konnen Fekete t ap eseye sove apre l te pran rad ki vo $200 nan Macy’s samdi. Burton fè konnen li reponn rapid, li kenbe ponyèt sispèk la epi mete l atè, li di: 'Li te kòmanse rele jan bra l te fè l mal, mwen di l sispann lite, sinon m ap bezwen pi sevè.' Lè l ap pale ak Observer-Reporter, Burton di: 'Tout bagay te pase vit. Mwen jis kenbe bra li epi peze l pou ede ajan sekirite a ki te kenbe lòt bra li. Sispèk la te fò anpil, nou te bezwen tou de pou imobilize l. Li t ap mande m sispann tounen bra li.' Senatè Eta Camera Bartolotta, ki te nan ekspozisyon zam nan, felicite Burton sou rezo sosyal yo, li rele l 'Super Charlie' epi li fè blag sou sispèk la ki chwazi vòlè nan yon sant komèsyal ki plen espò. Sispèk la, Jonathan Fekete Jr., toujou nan prizon. Dokiman tribinal yo montre pa gen avoka pou li. Otorite yo di li gen yon manda arestasyon an Pennsylvani pou yon ansyen chaj dwòg nan Konte Allegheny. Burton eksplike bagay ki te pi enpòtan pou li, se te ede pwoteje polisye a. Li di: 'Madanm mwen mande m si m t ap fou, men m t ap santi m mal si polisye a te viktim.'

article_content: Sylvia Frankton, a 100-year-old great-grandmother from Holbeach, Lincolnshire, celebrated her milestone birthday by riding a Segway around an obstacle course, surrounded by her family. Known for her love of speed—she was once caught driving 40mph in a 30mph zone—Sylvia was excited to try out the two-wheeled machine for her centenary. Her entire family, including her 17 great-grandchildren and five grandchildren, gathered for the occasion. The Segway was originally hired for the younger family members, but Sylvia insisted on taking a turn herself. Sylvia, who moved from Hartley, Kent, to Holbeach 17 years ago to be near her daughter, found using the Segway surprisingly easy. 'I've never even seen a Segway before, but as soon as I did, I wanted to try it,' she shared. 'My legs aren’t what they used to be, so it was wonderful just having to lean with the handles. If I’d known I could have gone again, I wouldn’t have gotten off!' Her daughter, Janet Dougill, 71, organized the party to ensure everyone was entertained. 'We hired a company to arrange activities for all ages, but seeing mum on the Segway—with no one holding her—was a real surprise for everyone,' Janet said. 'She truly loved it, and we are so proud of her.' While Sylvia’s birthday was officially on Tuesday, the party took place on Sunday so all could enjoy the beautiful weather outdoors. The celebration was filled with joy and admiration for Sylvia’s adventurous spirit.
translated_content: Sylvia Frankton, yon granmè ki gen 100 an soti Holbeach, Lincolnshire, te selebre anivèsè a monte yon Segway epi pase nan yon chimen obstak devan tout fanmi li. Sylvia renmen vitès—li te menm pran pa lapolis ap kondwi 40mph nan zòn 30mph—epi li te monte machin de wou a ak anpil eksitasyon pou sentyèm li. Tout fanmi li, ak ladan 17 gran-pitit pitit ak 5 pitit pitit, te rasanble pou okazyon an. Segway la te anplwaye pou jèn yo, men Sylvia te vle fè pa li tou. Sylvia te deplase soti Hartley, Kent, pou li viv Holbeach 17 ane de sa epi pwoche bò pitit fi li. Li te sezi kijan li te fasil pou monte Segway la. 'M pa t janm wè Segway anvan, men dèske m wè li, mwen te vle eseye', li di. 'Janm mwen difisil pou mache kounya, konsa panche ak manch yo te bèl. Si m te konnen m te ka fè l ankò, m pa t ap desann!' Pitit fi li, Janet Dougill, 71 an, te òganize fèt la konsa tout moun ka amize yo. 'Nou te pran yon konpayi pou mete aktivite pou tout laj, men lè mwen te wè manman m ap monte Segway la san pèsonn pa kenbe l, tout moun te sezi,' Janet di. 'Li te vrèman renmen li, epi nou tout fyè de li.' Menm si anivèsè Sylvia a se te madi, fèt la fèt dimanch pou tout moun te ka pwofite bèl tan an deyò. Se te yon selebrasyon chaje ak kè kontan ak admirasyon pou lespri avanturyè Sylvia.

article_content: In July, a tornado hit a Pfizer facility in Rocky Mount, North Carolina, disrupting production at a plant that supplies about a quarter of Pfizer’s sterile injectable medicines for the U.S. Pharmacists and healthcare leaders, such as Jason Chou of Ochsner Health in New Orleans, are increasingly mindful of how world events can impact the supply of medications. Following the recent Hamas attack on Israel, Chou’s team evaluated whether disruptions might threaten supplies of both drug ingredients and essential packaging. As members of the End Drug Shortages Alliance, they try to stay ahead of potential shortages, maintaining enough stock to withstand disruptions—whether from global events or natural disasters like the tornado that struck the Pfizer plant. The American Society of Health System Pharmacists (ASHP) reports there were 243 drug shortages as of November 1. Although this number has improved since summer’s near-record highs, many remaining shortages involve critical generic injectable medications. Some shortages have had serious effects on cancer care, including a lack of key chemotherapy drugs like cisplatin and carboplatin. Emergency rooms have also struggled with shortages of essential crash cart drugs, such as painkillers, overdose treatments, and even basic saline IV bags. These shortages often delay or complicate patient care. At Stoughton Hospital in Wisconsin, pharmacy manager Pauline Cass reported that patients scheduled for joint pain relief injections faced delays because of a lack of needed steroid vials. A survey by the ECRI Institute found that shortages have compromised patient care, forcing medical workers to use less effective drugs, pause treatments, or, in some cases, make errors. Around a quarter of respondents reported at least one medical error linked to a shortage in the past six months. Hospitals face rising costs, paying more for drugs purchased outside regular contracts, and are spending extra on staff overtime to manage shortages. Chris Laman from Columbia Memorial Hospital in Oregon notes that off-contract alternatives can cost double or triple the usual price. Healthcare workers are affected on a personal level too. Jeffrey Chow, an outpatient pharmacy manager, described a procedure where a numbing agent was missing epinephrine due to shortages, causing more bleeding than usual. While shortages have become an ongoing challenge in healthcare, individual experiences like these reveal their direct and distressing impact on patient care and safety.
translated_content: Nan mwa Jiyè, yon tònad te frape yon faktori Pfizer ki nan Rocky Mount, North Carolina, ki te entèwonp pwodiksyon nan yon plant ki pwodwi anviwon yon ka nan medikaman enjeksyon esteril Pfizer yo itilize Ozetazini. Famasyen ak lidè swen sante, tankou Jason Chou ki travay Ochsner Health New Orleans, vin pi konsyan kijan evenman mondyal ka afekte apwovizyònman ak medikaman. Apre dènye atak Hamas sou Izrayèl, ekip Chou te kontwole si sa ka afekte engredyan oswa materyèl anbalaj medikaman yo. Antanke manm End Drug Shortages Alliance, yo ap eseye predi ak evite mank, sa ki pouse yo kenbe ase stock pou fè fas ak tout kalite kriz – soti nan tònad tankou sa nan plant Pfizer la rive evènman entènasyonal. Dapre American Society of Health System Pharmacists (ASHP), te gen 243 mank medikaman aktyèl selon done 1 novanm. Malgre gen plis pwogrè depi sezon lete a kote te gen nivo rekò prèske, anpil nan mank ki rete afekte medikaman jenerik enjeksyon ki esansyèl. Gen mank grav nan tretman kansè, espesyalman chemioterapi tankou cisplatin ak carboplatin. Sal ijans yo konn rankontre mank grav tou pou crash cart: medikaman doulè, tretman kont surdoz ak menm sak saline IV senp. Mank sa yo konn lakoz reta oswa konplike swen pasyan yo. Nan Stoughton Hospital Wisconsin, manadjè famasi Pauline Cass di pasyan ki gen randevou pou piki steroid kont doulè soufri reta paske manke flakon ki nesesè. Yon sondaj pa ECRI Institute montre mank pwodwi sa yo fè swen pasyan diminye: pafwa yo oblije bay medikaman mwens efikas, retade tretman oswa menm fè erè medikal. Yon ka moun ki reponn di yo te temwen omwen yon erè medikal akòz mank medikaman nan sis dènye mwa yo. Lopital yo oblije depanse plis ap achte medikaman pa kontrat ki pi chè, epi peye plis lè siplemantè pou anplwaye kap chèche altènatif. Chris Laman nan Columbia Memorial Hospital Oregon di yo wè pri altènatif la ka double oswa triple kou nòmal la. Travayè swen sante yo santi presyon an tou. Jeffrey Chow, manadjè famasi ekstèn, viv yon eksperyans kote li te manke epinefrin pandan yon ti pwosedi, sa lakoz li te senyen plis pase nòmal. Malgre sa vin nòmal nan sistèm nan, eksperyans pèsonèl sa yo clearly montre jan sa afekte pasyan ak sekirite yo dirèkteman.

article_content: Gary Bromige, 25, from South Norwood, has been charged after PC Andrew Duncan, a Metropolitan Police officer, died following a suspected hit-and-run in Sutton, South London. Bromige is due to appear at South Western Magistrates' Court in Battersea, accused of causing death by dangerous driving and failing to stop at the scene. PC Andrew Duncan, 47, suffered fatal injuries in the early hours of Friday on the A217 Reigate Avenue in Sutton while conducting a speed check with a colleague. He was reportedly struck while attempting to pull over a fast-moving VW Golf. Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Bernard Hogan-Howe paid tribute to PC Duncan, calling him hard-working and brave, and highlighting his service as a Scout volunteer. Mayor of London Boris Johnson and Shadow Home Secretary Yvette Cooper also offered their condolences. PC Duncan had served with the Metropolitan Police since 1990, working in Battersea, the territorial support group, and Hammersmith and Fulham, before joining the traffic team ten years ago. He is survived by his wife and two children. Police are urging anyone with information about the incident to call 020 8941 9011.

Bromige gen pou l parèt devan Tribinal Majistra South Western nan Battersea, akize pou koze lanmò ak kondwit danjere epi paske li pa t rete sou sèn nan. PC Andrew Duncan, ki gen 47 an, te sibi blesi grav trè bonè Vandredi sou A217 Reigate Avenue nan Sutton pandan l t ap kontwole vitès ak yon kolèg. Yo di li te frape pandan li t ap eseye fe yon VW Golf ki t ap kouri vit rale sou kote. Komisyonè Polis Met la, Sir Bernard Hogan-Howe, salye PC Duncan kòm yon moun travayè ak kouraj, epi li ensiste sou angajman li kòm volontè Scout. Majistra Lond lan, Boris Johnson, ansanm ak Shadow Home Secretary Yvette Cooper, tou te fè kondoleyans yo. PC Duncan te sèvi ak Polis Met la depi 1990, li te travay nan Battersea, Gwoup Sipò Teritoryal la, ak Hammersmith ak Fulham, anvan li te antre nan ekip trafik la dis ane sa yo. Li kite dèyè madanm li ak de pitit. Polis la ap mande tout moun ki ta gen enfòmasyon sou aksidan an pou rele 020 8941 9011.

article_content: One year after the devastating explosion at a fertilizer plant in West, Texas, families are still coping with loss, community rebuilding, and emotional recovery. Becky Calvin, the widow of firefighter Perry Calvin, shared her journey of facing pregnancy alone after her husband's death. 'People said I was strong, but I didn't feel strong—I had to go on because of my two kids and being pregnant,' Becky said. Perry Calvin, a farmer and volunteer firefighter with departments in Navarro Mills and Mertens, rushed to the scene with other responders when the fire escalated. Tragically, he was one of 12 volunteer firefighters among the 15 people who lost their lives on April 17. The blast also injured more than 200 people and caused widespread destruction to homes, schools, and roads. Becky, two months pregnant at the time, delivered her daughter, Presley Wreanne, seven months after Perry’s passing. The family keeps Perry's memory alive, especially for their sons Preston and Wyatt. 'I hated that he wasn’t here to see his daughter, especially since he really wanted a girl, but having another part of him was special,' Becky said. The Calvin family continued their tradition of using 'P' and 'W' initials for their children. Presley’s middle name, Wreanne, was a name Becky and Perry had chosen together. Becky recalled the moment she worried about Perry when he didn’t respond to her texts that night—a stark change from their usual communication. The community of West has worked to move forward, focusing on rebuilding with about 70 new homes underway and new schools and a nursing home nearing completion. The recovery fund, bolstered by $3.6 million in donations, has faced delays due to paperwork and regulations, but progress is evident. City Secretary Joey Pustejovsky, the usual go-to for community efforts, also died in the blast, leaving a gap deeply felt in the ongoing recovery. Mayor Tommy Muska continues to monitor the emotional impact on the city’s 2,800 residents, acknowledging the persistent effects of post-traumatic stress among survivors. Holly Harris, widow of Dallas Fire-Rescue Captain Kenneth Luckey Harris, shared similar feelings of loss and the determination to move forward. Like Becky, she chooses not to dwell on the questions about the cause of the fire or what could have been done differently. 'We're going to try to make everything a happy situation and get on with our lives,' she said.
translated_content: Yon ane apre eksplozyon devastatè ki te pase nan yon faktori angrè nan West, Texas, fanmi yo kontinye ap lite ak pèt, rekonstriksyon kominote a, ak retablisman emosyonèl. Becky Calvin, madanm ponpye volontè Perry Calvin, pataje vwayaj li ap fè jere gwosès li pou kont li apre lanmò mari li. 'Moun te di m fò, men mwen pa te santi m fò—m te oblije kontinye pou de pitit mwen yo epi paske m te ansent,' Becky di. Perry Calvin, ki te fèmye e ponpye volontè ak depatman Navarro Mills ak Mertens, te kouri al ede sou plas la lè dife a te agrave. Malerezman, li te youn nan 12 ponpye volontè pami 15 moun ki pèdi lavi yo 17 avril la. Eksplozyon an te blese plis pase 200 moun epi kraze anpil kay, lekòl ak wout. Becky, ki te de mwa ansent nan moman sa, te akouche pitit fi li, Presley Wreanne, sèt mwa apre lanmò Perry. Fanmi an kontinye mete memwa Perry vivan, sitou pou pitit gason yo, Preston ak Wyatt. 'Mwen te regrèt li pa t la pou wè pitit fi li, sitou paske li te vle yon ti fi, men gen yon lòt pati de li se te espesyal,' Becky di. Fanmi Calvin lan kontinye tradisyon yo, kote yo bay timoun yo non ki kòmanse ak 'P' ak 'W.' Non Presley a se Wreanne kòm dezyèm non, yon non Becky ak Perry te chwazi ansanm. Becky sonje moman li te kòmanse enkyete pou Perry lè li pa te reponn teks li aswè sa—yon bagay ki pa te nòmal. Kominote West la ap eseye avanse, mete aksan sou rebati ak anviwon 70 nouvo kay an konstriksyon epi nouvo lekòl ak kay retret ki pa lwen fini. Fon rekiperasyon an, ki te resevwa $3.6 milyon dola nan don, ap pran reta akòz pwoblèm papye ak regilasyon federal, men yo fè pwogrè. Sekretè Vil la, Joey Pustejovsky, ki te toujou ede kominote a, tou pèdi lavi li nan eksplozyon an, sa kite yon twou nan mouvman rekiperasyon an. Majistra West la, Tommy Muska, ap kontinye siveye enpak emosyonèl eksplozyon an sou 2,800 moun nan vil la, li rekonèt anpil moun toujou ap soufri ak estrès post-traumatik. Holly Harris, madanm Dallas Fire-Rescue Captain Kenneth Luckey Harris, ki tou mouri nan eksplozyon an, pataje santiman pèt ak detèminasyon pou avanse. Tankou Becky, li chwazi pa rete sou kesyon sou kòz dife a oswa sa yo te ka fè diferan. 'Nou chwazi ap eseye fè tout bagay vin pozitif epi kontinye ak lavi nou,' li di.
post_content: One year after the tragic West, TX fertilizer blast, families are finding hope while rebuilding and honoring loved ones lost. Becky Calvin’s story of strength through grief and new life is inspiring! 💪❤️ #WestStrong #TexasResilience

article_content: Renowned actor Peter White, best known for his roles in the ABC soap opera 'All My Children' and the original stage production of 'The Boys in the Band,' has passed away at the age of 86. His death was confirmed by his 'All My Children' castmate Kathleen Noone. White died from melanoma at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday. With a career spanning more than four decades, White was widely recognized for his portrayal of Linc Tyler on 'All My Children.' He also played a significant role in the original stage production and film adaptation of 'The Boys in the Band,' where he portrayed Alan McCarthy, a key character in the groundbreaking drama that advanced LGBTQ+ representation in American theater. The play, which debuted off-Broadway in 1968, was a milestone for LGBTQ+ representation, challenging the norms of the era. White appeared in numerous television series and films, including the TV show 'Love Is a Many-Splendored Thing,' 'Cannon,' 'Hill Street Blues,' 'The Jeffersons,' and 'The West Wing.' He also acted in movies such as 'Dave' (1993), 'Mother' (1996), 'Armageddon' (1998), and 'First Daughter' (2004). His versatility as an actor earned him recognition across various entertainment mediums. Beyond his professional achievements, Peter White was also known as a mentor, having served as an acting coach for aspiring performers. Lanmò li te konfime pa ansyen kòlèg li sou 'All My Children', Kathleen Noone. White mouri akòz yon melanòm lakay li nan Los Angeles, mèkredi. article_content: Mountain Top University (MTU) in Ogun State has emphasized the importance of disruptive technology in driving entrepreneurship and wealth creation. At the fifth MTU International Conference on Entrepreneurship, themed ‘Entrepreneurship, Disruptive Technology and Wealth Management: A Panacea to an Innovative Economy,’ key speakers advocated for students and stakeholders to embrace digital advancements. Vice-Chancellor Prof. Elijah Ayolabi described disruptive technology as innovative progress that can significantly transform existing industries, markets, and societal practices. He noted that such technologies often emerge unexpectedly, challenging traditional methods and introducing new approaches that can revolutionize entire sectors. "Disruptive technology has greatly enhanced entrepreneurship," said Prof. Ayolabi. "Now, anyone can engage in business and generate legitimate wealth from their own home. In today’s world, wealth creation and entrepreneurship are deeply intertwined with disruptive technology." The keynote speaker, Dr. Aderemi Oseni—Executive Chairman of Step Development Limited and Chairman of the House Committee on FERMA—urged students to stay abreast of digital trends. He called on them to develop the right skills and attitudes in digital technology, terming it essential for accessing opportunities, economic prosperity, and making a lasting impact. Dr. Oseni encouraged the university to translate the potential of disruptive technologies into practical initiatives, recommending the establishment of an 'MTU Entrepreneurship Incubation Endowment Fund' to support digital entrepreneurship and wealth creation among students. Dr. Pat Erigbe, Acting Director of CEDI, highlighted the conference's focus on equipping youths to address societal problems through innovation and entrepreneurship, underlining disruptive technology as key to sustainable development. Dr. Nelly Ndukwe, Deputy Director of LOC, added that effective wealth management relies on using technology in business, and stressed the connection between wealth creation, entrepreneurship, and technology management.

Pandan senkyèm Konferans Entènasyonal la sou Antreprenarya nan MTU, ki te gen kòm tèm: ‘Antreprenarya, Teknoloji Deranje ak Jesyon Richès: Yon Panse pou yon Ekonomi Inovatè’, oratè prensipal yo ankouraje etidyan ak patisipan yo pou yo adopte avansman dijital yo. Pwofesè Elijah Ayolabi, Vis-Rektè a, dekri teknoloji deranje kòm avansman inovatè ki ka transfòme endistri, mache, ak pratik sosyete yo an anpil fason. Li fè remake teknoloji sa yo souvan parèt san avètisman, yo defye metòd tradisyonèl yo epi pote nouvo apwòch ki ka revolisyone tout sektè. "Teknoloji deranje bay gwo plis nan antreprenarya," Pwof. Ayolabi deklare. "Kounye a, nenpot moun ka mete biznis sou pye epi fòme richès sòti lakay li. Jodi a, kreyasyon richès ak antreprenarya mache men nan men ak teknoloji deranje." Oratè prensipal la, Dr Aderemi Oseni—Prezidan Step Development Limited epi Prezidan Komite Chanm Depite FERMA—ankouraje etidyan yo pou yo rete sou branch ak dènye tandans dijital yo. Li mande yo devlope kapasite ak bon atitid nan domèn teknoloji dijital, paske li se pòt pou jwenn opòtinite, pwosperite ekonomik, ak kite tras dirab. Dr. Oseni egzòte inivèsite a pou mete tout potansyèl teknoloji deranje yo an aksyon, epi li sijere pou kreye ‘Fonds Ankibasyon Antreprenarya MTU’ pou ofri sipò pou antreprenarya dijital ak kreyasyon richès pami etidyan yo. Dr. Pat Erigbe, Direktè an chaj CEDI, mete aksan sou objektif konferans lan ki se ekipe jèn yo pou atake pwoblèm sosyal yo atravè inovasyon ak antreprenarya, epi li souliye valè kle teknoloji deranje pou devlopman dirab. Dr. Nelly Ndukwe, Vis-Direktè LOC, ajoute ke bon jan jesyon richès depann de itilizasyon teknoloji nan biznis, e li ensiste sou koneksyon ki genyen ant kreyasyon richès, antreprenarya, ak jesyon teknoloji.

A historic mini-mansion in Joliet, Illinois, once owned by barbed wire inventor and Civil War veteran Hiram Scutt, has garnered attention both for its haunted reputation and its surprisingly low $159,000 price tag. Built in 1882, the home is rumored to harbor the spirits of children, with paranormal investigators identifying the third-floor 'doll room' as a site of frequent eerie occurrences such as voices and unexplained touches.

The property’s past includes several tragic incidents. In 2004, 19-year-old Steven Jenkins was fatally shot during a party, and in 2007, Seth Magosky, a John Wilkes Booth impersonator, died suddenly at age 39 only six months after purchasing the residence. 

Despite these incidents and its haunted reputation, realtor Maria Cronin insists the low price reflects the significant renovations required, not supernatural influences. At a recent open house, 175 people visited—many seeking paranormal experiences rather than property ownership.

Originally known as ‘Barb Villa’, the mansion has served as a girls’ school and a boarding house for women under various owners, including Daniel Watson and more recently Brian Kearney, who rented out rooms. Spiritualist Edward Shanahan and groups like the Illinois Paranormal Research Association have reported notable activity, supplying video evidence of their encounters.

Cronin hopes a new owner will convert the mansion into a bed and breakfast, continuing its unique legacy in Joliet.
translated_content:
Yon mini-mansyon istorik nan Joliet, Illinois, ki te pou envantè fil fè rache ak ansyen sòlda Gè Sivil la, Hiram Scutt, ap atire anpil atansyon akòz repitasyon li kòm kay ki gen fantom ak pri li ki etone anpil: sèlman $159,000. Mansyon an, ki te bati an 1882, gen move repitasyon kòm gen lespri timoun k ap vin vizite li, epi envestigatè paranormal idantifye "chanm poupée" sou twazyèm etaj la kòm kote ki pi chaje ak aktivite etranj tankou tande vwa oswa santi ou manyen pa yon bagay ou pa wè.

Gen divès evenman tris nan istwa kay la. An 2004, Steven Jenkins, yon jenn gason 19 an, te jwenn lanmò li anba bal pandan yon fèt. An 2007, Seth Magosky, ki te konn imite John Wilkes Booth, te mouri toudenkou a laj 39 an, sèlman sis mwa apre li te achte mansyon an.

Malgre evènman sa yo ak repitasyon pou fantom, ajan imobilye Maria Cronin fè konnen pri a ba paske gen anpil travay renovasyon pou fèt, se pa paske kay la prezime gen lespri. Dènye ouvè kay la te rasanble 175 moun—pifò se moun k ap chèche eksperyans paranormal olye de achte kay la.

Mansyon sa a te rele "Barb Villa" e li te sèvi kòm lekòl pou tifi ak lojman pou fi ki vin travay nan vil la, sou men plizyè pwopriyetè tankou Daniel Watson ak Brian Kearney, ki te konn lwe chanm ladan. Espiwalis Edward Shanahan ak Illinois Paranormal Research Association di yo temwen anpil aktivite etranj epi prezante videyo kòm prèv eksperyans yo.

Cronin swete nouvo pwopriyetè a ap tounen mansyon an an bed and breakfast pou kontinye istwa espesyal li nan Joliet.

According to legal experts, the nationality of each passenger may dramatically impact the compensation paid to families of the 239 people who died in the MH370 crash. Public liability lawyers highlight a significant disparity between what is likely to be offered to relatives of Western passengers and those from Asian countries. American aviation crash attorney Floyd Wisner told CNBC that families from China, Malaysia, and Indonesia will likely receive lower payouts due to more limited approaches to damages in their legal systems. 'They might assess these cases and conclude that a Chinese life is worth less than an American life,' Wisner remarked, adding that this would be unfair and could cause widespread dissatisfaction.

Under the Montreal Convention, relatives of victims from signatory countries are entitled to approximately $176,000 USD in compensation without needing to prove fault. After that, further claims can be pursued in the plaintiff's primary residence, the flight's destination, where the ticket was purchased, where the carrier is domiciled, or its main place of business.

However, Wisner warned that any major differences in payouts based on nationality could spark international uproar. He estimated that the airline may pay between $500 million and $750 million in damages, and noted it probably has about $1 billion in liability insurance.

Terry Rolfe, head of American aviation practice at Integro Insurance Brokers, told CNBC that American victims could receive $8–10 million per passenger in compensation via U.S. courts, while Chinese families might receive less than $1 million per passenger. Most MH370 passengers were Asian, but their relatives are expected to get lower compensation because of the legal systems in their home countries.

Australian public liability lawyer Barrie Woollacott noted that in non-common law countries like China, where 154 of MH370's passengers were from, the compensation could be minimal due to a 'restrained view of damages.' He explained that perceptions of loss differ between Asian and Western countries, which can affect both the process and amount of compensation.

By contrast, in countries like Australia, there is no cap on compensation, and if someone alleges the airline was at fault, the burden shifts to the airline to prove otherwise. In such cases, those impacted could claim unlimited compensation. If the airline is not found negligent, then victims would be entitled only to sums outlined under the Montreal Convention.

Allianz, the primary reinsurer of the missing flight, has reportedly started paying claims, setting aside $110 million USD and providing hardship payments to families. Malaysia Airlines is waiting for more details on what happened during the flight before finalizing broader compensation. Authorities believe the plane turned back from its intended route from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing on March 8, 2014, crashing into the southern Indian Ocean about eight hours later.
translated_content:
Dapre avoka legal yo, nasyonalite chak moun ki te sou vòl MH370 a ka detèmine kantite kach lajan ke fanmi yo pral resevwa apre trajedi a kote 239 moun mouri. Avoka respè piblik mete aksan sou diferans ki genyen ant sa yo ka peye fanmi pasaje oksidantal yo ak sa yo ka ofri fanmi ki soti nan peyi Azyatik yo. Avoka ameriken Floyd Wisner di CNBC, fanmi ki soti Lachin, Malezi ak Endonezi ap jwenn pi piti konpansasyon paske sistèm legal la limite kantite domaj yo rekonèt. Li di: "Yo ka evalye dosye sa yo epi deside lavi yon Chinwa pa gen menm valè ak yon Ameriken. Sa pa jis e li ka lakòz gwo dezakò." 

Dapre Konvansyon Monreyal la, fanmi viktim ki soti nan peyi ki siyen li yo ka touche anviwon $176,000 USD san fòsman pwouve kilpabilite. Fanmi yo ka fè lòt reklamasyon kote yo rete, vòl la prale, kote tikè a achte, kote konpayi an anrejistre, oswa kote biwo prensipal la ye.

Wisner avèti si konpansasyon an varye sitou sou nasyonalite, sa ap fè scandale entènasyonal. Li estime konpayi aviòn an gen ant $500–$750 milyon pou peye e asirans la ta ka rive $1 milya USD.

Terry Rolfe soti Integro Insurance Brokers di ameriken ka touche $8-10 milyon pou chak viktim nan tribinal Etazini, pandan fanmi Chinwa yo ka touche mwens pase $1 milyon pa moun. Pifò pasaje MH370 yo se Azyatik e fanmi yo atann yo a mwens konpansasyon akòz lwa nan peyi yo.

Avoka australyen Barrie Woollacott presize ke nan peyi san lwa komen tankou Lachin, kote 154 pasaje te soti, yo ka peye ti kras paske yo gen vizyon limite sou domaj. Li eksplike fason pèdi trete diferan nan peyi Azyatik ak sa yo nan oksidant, sa ki afekte kantite konpansasyon an.

Nan peyi tankou Ostrali, pa gen plafon sou rekonpans, epi si gen moun ki akize konpayi aviòn an, se konpayi a pou pwouve li pa fòtif. Fanmi yo ka reklame pa gen limit. Si pa gen fòt, se sèlman kantite Konvansyon Monreyal la ki respekte.

Allianz se pi gwo re-asirè MH370 epi li deja kòmanse peye, mete $110 milyon sou kote ak bay fanmi yo lajan asistans. Malaysia Airlines ap tann plis enfòmasyon sou sak te pase pandan vòl la anvan li peye tout konpansasyon yo. Yo kwè avyon an te devye de vwa orijinal soti nan Kuala Lumpur pou ale Beijing, 8 mas 2014, epi li te kraze nan sid Oseyan Endyen apre anviwon uit èdtan.

article_content: With the World Cup quarter-final against New Zealand fast approaching, a remarkable milestone for Ireland has gone largely unnoticed. Andy Farrell's squad enters Saturday's clash at the Stade de France riding a 17-match unbeaten streak, stretching back to their first test win over New Zealand last July—a run that also includes a Six Nations Grand Slam. Victory over the All Blacks on Saturday would see Ireland equal the top-tier international record of 18 consecutive wins, held jointly by New Zealand (2015-2016) and England (2015-2017). Despite this, Ireland has kept their focus squarely on performance. "To be honest, no, it's never spoken about in our sort of circles," assistant coach Mike Catt told reporters. "Things like world rankings and records don't really come into the equation. It's about delivering a performance we can be proud of." Ireland, still seeking their first-ever World Cup knockout victory and hungry to keep their dream of lifting the Webb Ellis Cup alive, have not let the pursuit of records distract them. Historical context adds intrigue: Ireland famously snapped New Zealand's record win streak with a 40-29 victory in Chicago in 2016—their first ever against the All Blacks. England's own run ended in Dublin a year later when Ireland denied them a Grand Slam. However, even with a victory this weekend, Ireland would still trail the overall world record for consecutive international wins, set by Cyprus with 24 victories from 2008 to 2014.
translated_content: Avèk kwatye final Koup Mondyal la kont New Zeland ap vini, yon bèl akonplisman pou Iland pase prèske san obsèvasyon. Ekip Andy Farrell a ap jwe Samdi nan Stade de France ak yon seri 17 viktwa youn apre lòt, depi premye tès yo te genyen kont New Zeland an jiyè pase—ki enkli tou yon Grand Chelem Six Nations. Si Iland bat All Blacks yo Samdi, y ap egalize rekò viktwa siperyè a ak 18 soulye, menm jan ak New Zeland (2015-2016) ak Angletè (2015-2017). Sepandan, Iland rete konsantre sou bay yon gwo pèfòmans. "Pou di verite, non, nou pa janm pale de sa nan gwoup pa nou an," asistan antrenè Mike Catt di jounalis. "Bagay konsa tankou klasman mondyal, rekò, sa yo pa kont pou nou. Sa ki enpòtan se prezante yon bon pèfòmans pou nou fyè." Iland poko janm ranpòte yon viktwa eliminasyon nan Koup Mondyal la, epi yo swaf reyisi leve Webb Ellis Cup la, men rèv rekò a pa deranje yo. Yon ti rapèl istwa: Iland te kraze seri viktwa New Zeland nan ak yon viktwa 40-29 nan Chicago an 2016, premye fwa yo bat All Blacks yo. Seri Angletè a te fini nan Dublin lè Iland te anpeche yo pran Grand Chelem lan. article_content: Aung San Suu Kyi, leader of the National League for Democracy (NLD), announced a major win for her party and the people of Myanmar, with unofficial results suggesting victory in all contested seats during the recent by-elections. Speaking to exhilarated supporters at the NLD’s Yangon headquarters, Suu Kyi emphasized that the outcome signified the people's growing involvement in Myanmar’s politics, describing the event as a milestone for democracy and urging all parties to unite for reconciliation. Supporters filled the streets, celebrating the NLD’s announcement that Suu Kyi had secured a parliamentary seat in the Kawhmu area, something many had once thought impossible. Now 66 years old and a former Nobel Peace Prize recipient, Suu Kyi overcame two opponents despite years under house arrest. The NLD also claimed wins in Naypyitaw, the capital city, though official confirmation from Myanmar’s Election Commission and the military-backed ruling Union Solidarity and Development Party (USDP) was still pending. This by-election decided only 45 out of 664 seats in the national parliament, leaving the military-backed party in control. Nevertheless, the results fueled public enthusiasm for democratic reforms. NLD supporters, many dressed in party colors, gathered to celebrate. Myanmar’s past is marked by decades of military rule, economic difficulties, and repression. Recent government steps under President Thein Sein – including releasing political prisoners and holding peace talks – have raised hopes, even as skepticism about voting irregularities remains. International bodies like the EU and US have signaled potential easing of sanctions if the election process proves credible and fair. Suu Kyi acknowledged irregularities, including issues with voter rolls and ballot papers, but reaffirmed her party’s commitment to the people’s aspirations. Residents in places like Wah Thin Kha, though facing poverty, voiced hope that Suu Kyi will be able to bring about true change. These historic elections are seen as an important test of Myanmar’s journey towards democracy, with Suu Kyi’s role in parliament symbolizing the country’s evolving political landscape.
translated_content: Aung San Suu Kyi, lidè National League for Democracy (NLD), anonse yon gwo viktwa pou pati li ak pèp Myanmar, ak rezilta pa-ofisyèl ki montre yo ranpòte tout plas yo te patisipe ladan yo nan by-eleksyon resan an. Pandan li t ap pale ak sipòtè k ap selebre nan katye jeneral NLD nan Yangon, Suu Kyi mete aksan sou rezilta a kòm siy ke pèp la ap vin pi angaje nan politik Myanmar. Li dekri evènman an kòm yon etap enpòtan pou demokrasi e li ankouraje tout pati pou inifye pou rekonsilyasyon. Sipòtè yo te anvayi lari yo pou selebre nouvèl NLD a, kote Suu Kyi ranpòte yon plas nan Palman pou Kawhmu, yon bagay anpil te panse ki pa t ka rive. Kounye a li gen 66 an, pri Nobèl Lapè a bat de opozan li menm apre li te pase prèske 20 ane anba arestasyon lakay. NLD a te deklare yo kapab genyen tou 4 plas nan kapital la, Naypyitaw, men konfimasyon ofisyèl la pa t fin soti de Komisyon Elektoral Myanmar ni pati militè ki sou pouvwa a, Union Solidarity and Development Party (USDP). By-eleksyon sa a sèlman te ranpli 45 nan 664 plas Palman nasyonal la, kidonk pouvwa a toujou bò kote pati militè a. Men, viktwa yo bay popilasyon an plis espwa pou refòm demokratik. Anpil sipòtè NLD te mete rad pati a epi te rasanble pou fete. Myanmar gen yon istwa ki make pa règ militè, difikilte ekonomik ak repwesyon. Dènye efò gouvènman an, sou lidèchip Prezidan Thein Sein, te mete soti prizonye politik epi antre nan negosyasyon lapè, sa ki simen espwa pandan gen saspèk toujou sou iregilarite vòt yo. Inyon Ewopeyen an ak Etazini vle retire sanksyon si eleksyon yo kredib e onèt. Suu Kyi te pale de kèk iregilarite tankou non elektè ki pa t nan lis oubyen papye vòt ki pa t an règ, men li di pati li ap kontinye travay paske se sa pèp la vle. Moun nan kote tankou Wah Thin Kha, menm nan mizè, toujou kwè Suu Kyi ap pote chanjman vre. Eleksyon istorik sa yo se yon gwo tès sou avni demokrasi Myanmar, kote wòl Suu Kyi nan Palman an se yon senbòl chanjman politik peyi a.
post_content: Big news from Myanmar: Aung San Suu Kyi and her NLD party claim a landslide win in historic elections! While just a few seats changed hands, people are celebrating a new hope for democracy. Official results still pending. #Myanmar #SuuKyi #Change
translated_post: Gwo nouvèl Myanmar: Aung San Suu Kyi ak pati NLD li ranpòte tout plas yo! Pèp la ap fete ak anpil espwa pou demokrasi, menm si pouvwa toujou nan men militè yo. Rezilta ofisyèl poko soti. #Myanmar #SuuKyi #Chanjman

After plans for an opposition alliance broke down in a public disagreement, Taiwan’s main opposition parties have each entered the 2024 presidential election separately. The Kuomintang (KMT) confirmed on Friday that Hou Yu-ih will run for president, with Jaw Shaw-kong, a well-known television host, as his vice presidential pick. Their official candidacy was filed ahead of the January 13 vote.

At the same time, Ko Wen-je, head of the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP), submitted his nomination with legislator Wu Hsin-ying as his running mate. Terry Gou, the billionaire from Foxconn who tried to mediate and unify the opposition, is now expected to drop out of the race, but has a few hours left to change his mind.

The fallout from the alliance talks led to a tense press conference, marked by public arguments among Ko, Gou, and Hou. Weeks of discussions on a joint ticket ended abruptly, leaving both the KMT and TPP—who favor improved relations with China—running campaigns against the incumbent Democratic Progressive Party (DPP). The DPP, aiming for a historic third term, is represented by Vice President Lai Ching-te, who has led in recent polls.

With just over seven weeks to go, opposition leaders believe their new running mate choices might broaden their appeal. Ko highlighted that Wu Hsin-ying’s overseas education and experience balance his own connection to Taiwan.
translated_content:
Apre plan pati opozisyon prensipal Taiwan yo pou mete tèt yo ansanm te kraze akòz dezakò piblik, chak pati kounye a ap patisipe separeman nan eleksyon prezidansyèl 2024 lan. Kuomintang (KMT) te konfime Vandredi ke Hou Yu-ih ap kandida pou prezidan, ansanm ak Jaw Shaw-kong, yon animatè televizyon popilè, kòm kandida vis-prezidan li. Yo deja soumèt dokiman ofisyèl yo pou eleksyon 13 janvye a.

An menm tan, Ko Wen-je, dirijan Pati Pèp Taiwan (TPP), depoze kandidati li avèk depite Wu Hsin-ying kòm kandida vis-prezidan li. Terry Gou, milyadè Foxconn ki te eseye rasanble opozisyon an, ka retire li, men li gen kèk èdtan ankò pou deside.

Kriz la apre negosyasyon alyans yo lakoz te gen yon konferans pou laprès difisil kote Ko, Gou, ak Hou te gen echanj vivan. Plizyè semèn diskisyon te fini bridsoukou, kite KMT ak TPP—ki vle gen bon jan relasyon ak Lachin—kounye a ap fè kanpay kont Pati Pwogresis Demokratik la (DPP). DPP a, ki vize yon twazyèm manda istwa, reprezante pa Vis-Prezidan Lai Ching-te, ki ap mennen sondaj yo.

Avèk plis pase sèt semèn pou eleksyon an, lidè opozisyon yo kwè nouvo kolaboratè sou tikè yo ka ede atire plis sipò. Ko mete aksan sou ke eksperyans entènasyonal Wu Hsin-ying konplete pwòp relasyon li ak Taiwan.
post_content: Taiwan’s opposition parties are now running solo after their alliance fell apart! KMT’s Hou Yu-ih & TPP’s Ko Wen-je filed for the 2024 election, hoping their running mates will boost their chances. DPP’s Lai Ching-te still leads. Who will win? #TaiwanElection #Politics
translated_post: Alyans pati opozisyon Taiwan yo kraze! Kounye a KMT ak TPP gen pwòp kandida pa yo pou 2024. Yo chwazi nouvo vis kandida pou atire plis sipò, men DPP ak Lai Ching-te toujou ap mennen. Kilès ki pral ranpòte? #EleksonTaiwan #Politik

article_content:
Tiger Woods will make his return to competitive golf next week after being sidelined for most of 2014 following back surgery in March to repair a pinched nerve. Woods is set to play at his own Quicken Loans National event at Congressional Country Club as he prepares for the third major of the season, the British Open.

“After a lot of therapy, I have recovered well and will be supporting my foundation next week at the Quicken Loans National,” Woods shared on Facebook. “I've just started to hit full shots, but it's time to take the next step. I might be a bit rusty, but I want to play myself back into competitive shape. I’m excited for the challenge ahead.”

A 14-time major champion, Woods missed The Masters in April and the U.S. Open in June while recovering from surgery. The 38-year-old’s last major victory came at the 2008 U.S. Open, and he has now missed six majors due to injury. His recent absence from Augusta marked the first time he missed The Masters since making his debut there in 1995.

Still stuck on 14 major titles since 2008, Woods has two chances this season to close the gap on Jack Nicklaus’ record of 18 major championships. The British Open, held at Hoylake in northwest England, starts on July 17.

Rory McIlroy, meanwhile, missed the cut at the Irish Open days after announcing he would compete for Ireland—not Great Britain—at the 2016 Olympics in Rio. Despite being the highest-ranked golfer in the field at No. 6, McIlroy struggled after an opening round of 3-over-par 74. Even with a 2-under 69 on Friday, he failed to reach the weekend. Needing an eagle on the last hole to make the cut, he made only a birdie.

"It's very frustrating," McIlroy told the European Tour’s website. "To make six birdies and an eagle and shoot just two under means there were a lot of mistakes and wasteful shots. I just need to tighten it all up and become more consistent, especially around the greens. I’ve got a couple weeks off now to work on my game, play some links golf, and get ready for the Scottish Open and the British Open."

Finland's Mikko Ilonen leads the Irish Open by two shots.
translated_content:
Tiger Woods ap retounen jwe gòlf konpetitif semèn pwochèn, aprè li te pase pi fò ane 2014 deyò akoz operasyon do an mas pou repare yon nè ki te pri. Woods ap patisipe nan pwòp tounwa li, Quicken Loans National nan Congressional Country Club, pandan lap prepare pou twazyèm gwo tounwa sezon an, British Open.

"Aprè anpil terapi, mwen retabli byen epi m ap vin sipòte fondasyon mwen semèn pwochèn nan Quicken Loans National," Woods pataje sou Facebook. "Mwen fèk kòmanse frape boul ak tout fòs, men li lè pou m pran pwochen etap la. M ap ka yon ti jan anwo, men mwen vle jwe poum reprann fòm konpetitif mwen. Mwen eksite pou defi ki ap vini."

Kòm yon jwè ki gen 14 tit majò, Woods rate The Masters nan mwa avril ak U.S. Open nan mwa jen pandan li tap refè apre operasyon. Dènye viktwa majò li se te US Open 2008, e li rate sis gwo tounwa paske li blese. Absans li nan Augusta se te premye fwa depi li te kòmanse la kòm amatè an 1995 li pa t patisipe.

Woods toujou gen 14 tit majò depi 2008, e li gen de lòt chans sezon sa a pou l pwoche sou rekò Jack Nicklaus ki se 18 tit. British Open ap fèt Hoylake, nan nòdwès Angletè, ap kòmanse 17 jiyè.

Nan lòt nouvèl, Rory McIlroy rate koupe Irish Open la, kèk jou apre li te anonse li pral reprezante Iland (pa Grann Bretay) nan Je Olenpik 2016 nan Rio. Menm si li te pi wo klase nan konpetisyon an, kòm nimewo 6, McIlroy te gen difikilte apre premye wonn 74 (3 sou par). Menm ak yon dezyèm jou 69, 2 anba par, li pa t rive antre nan semifinal yo. Li te bezwen fè eagle sou dènye twou a pou pase, men li te fè birdie sèlman.

"Sa fristran anpil," McIlroy te di sou sit entènèt European Tour la. "Fè sis birdies ak yon eagle epi fini sèlman de anba par vle di te gen anpil erè ak frap gaspiye. Fòk mwen ajiste jwèt mwen epi vin pi konsistan, sitou bò green yo. Mwen gen kèk semèn repo pou travay sou jwèt mwen, jwe kèk teren links, epi pare pou Scottish Open ak British Open."

Mikko Ilonen, jwè gòlf Fenlann nan, ap mennen Irish Open la ak de pwen avans.
post_content: Tiger Woods is BACK after back surgery! He’s set to play the Quicken Loans National, kicking off his comeback and eyes on the British Open 👀⛳ Meanwhile, Rory McIlroy just missed the Irish Open cut. Major season heats up! #TigerReturns #GolfNews
translated_post: Tiger Woods ap tounen sou teren gòlf la apre operasyon do! Lap jwe Quicken Loans National epi prepare pou British Open la. Pandan sa, Rory McIlroy rate Irish Open la. Sezon gwo tounwa yo cho! #TigerRetounen #NouvèlGolf

Baldur’s Gate 3 claimed the 'Ultimate Game of the Year' award at this year’s Golden Joystick Awards, taking home a total of seven accolades. Other major winners included Final Fantasy XIV, Starfield, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Alan Wake 2, and Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty, each honored in various categories.

Critics have praised Alan Wake 2, and while it secured only a single win at the Golden Joysticks, its strong critical reception makes it a formidable contender for top honors at The Game Awards, which rely heavily on critic votes. However, given Baldur’s Gate 3’s impressive sweep, it appears to be the frontrunner for this year’s Game of the Year titles on many lists.

Looking back at past Golden Joystick GOTY winners: Elden Ring won in 2022, Resident Evil Village in 2021, The Last of Us Part II in 2020, Resident Evil 2 in 2019, Fortnite in 2018, and Breath of the Wild in 2017—demonstrating a trend of spotlighting acclaimed franchises.

With the upcoming Game Awards and other end-of-year lists, expectations are high that Baldur’s Gate 3 will continue its winning streak.
translated_content:
Baldur’s Gate 3 te ranpòte prim 'Ultimate Game of the Year' nan Golden Joystick Awards ane sa a, ak yon total sèt prim. Lòt gwo gayan yo enkli Final Fantasy XIV, Starfield, The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Alan Wake 2, ak Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty, chak nan diferan kategori.

Kritik yo bay Alan Wake 2 anpil lwanj, e menm si li sèlman te ranpòte yon sèl prim nan Golden Joystick Awards yo, bonjan opinyon kritik fè l tounen yon gwo kandida pou pi gwo prim nan The Game Awards, kote kritik yo gen anpil enfliyans. Sepandan, ak bèl rezilta Baldur’s Gate 3 la, li parèt kòm pi gwo favorite pou tit 'Game of the Year' ane sa a sou plizyè lis.

Si nou gade tounen sou dènye gayan prim GOTY Golden Joystick yo: Elden Ring an 2022, Resident Evil Village an 2021, The Last of Us Part II an 2020, Resident Evil 2 an 2019, Fortnite an 2018, ak Breath of the Wild an 2017—sa montre franchiz sa yo toujou resevwa anpil rekonesans.

Avèk The Game Awards ak lòt klasman fen ane ki pral soti, anpil espwa pou Baldur’s Gate 3 kontinye mennen!

article_content: For the second time in a week, New York police—joined by officers from across the country—laid to rest one of their own on Sunday. Once again, a silent protest occurred as some officers turned their backs on Mayor Bill de Blasio during the funeral service for Officer Wenjian Liu. This gesture of dissent had also been seen at the funeral of Officer Rafael Ramos, who was killed alongside his patrol partner, Officer Liu, as they sat in their squad car. During Liu’s funeral, fewer officers appeared to turn their backs on the mayor than at Ramos’s service. Before the event, Police Commissioner William Bratton encouraged officers to remain respectful. Some officers accused the mayor of fueling anti-police sentiment due to his support of protests against police brutality. Large-scale protests had erupted after the death of Eric Garner, an African-American man, during a confrontation with NYPD officers in July. Pat Lynch, president of the Patrolmen’s Benevolent Association, criticized the mayor, saying his office is tarnished by the deaths of Ramos and Liu. Despite tensions, Bratton reminded officers that funerals should focus on honoring the deceased. He said that earlier protests reflected poorly on the NYPD and detracted from honoring Officer Ramos’s memory. At Officer Liu’s wake, no protests greeted the mayor; some officers even saluted de Blasio upon his arrival. During Sunday’s service, Wenjian Liu was remembered as a devoted family man, dedicated officer, enthusiastic fisherman, and someone who exemplified the best values of America. Liu emigrated from Canton, China, at age 12 with his parents. His family recalled that his first American souvenir was a Statue of Liberty sticker. From a young age, he valued law and order and aspired to be an officer. His wife, Pei Xia Chen, addressed mourners at Brooklyn’s Aievoli Funeral Home, describing Liu’s dedication to his work and the responsibilities it brought. She remembered his respect for the law and professionalism as an officer. The couple had been married only two months when Liu was killed on December 20 while sitting in his patrol car beside Officer Ramos. Both men were targeted because of their roles as police officers; their killer had posted intentions against police online. In the aftermath of the murders, Mayor de Blasio called the crime an attack on all New Yorkers. At the funeral, he praised Liu and Ramos for representing the city’s highest values. Ramos, who saw his work as a form of ministry, was named an honorary NYPD chaplain after his death. He is survived by his wife, Maritza, and his sons, Justin and Jaden. Liu, though trained as an accountant, served as a police officer for seven years, often using his Chinese-language skills to help the community. Commissioner Bratton described Liu as empathetic and attentive to those in need. At Ramos’s funeral, both officers were posthumously promoted to detective, first grade. De Blasio highlighted Liu’s love for family and generosity, noting that he rarely took time off and shared his fishing catches with loved ones. The mayor described Liu as brave and compassionate. Liu 'walked a path of courage, sacrifice, and kindness,' the mayor said. 'This city stands a little taller today because of him.' FBI Director James Comey spoke about the motivations and risks faced by police officers and their commitment to improving lives. Moving tributes from Liu’s family drew tears, with his father expressing gratitude in Cantonese and Pei Xia Chen calling Liu 'an amazing man.' Liu’s wake included Buddhist chants and traditional ceremonies and was attended by officers of many backgrounds. Ramos, of Puerto Rican descent, was honored at a large Protestant service in Queens. Governor Andrew Cuomo commented on becoming an NYPD officer as a symbol of pride and assimilation. Cuomo could not attend Liu’s funeral due to his father’s recent death. After the service, Pat Lynch noted officers had a right to express dissatisfaction, but clarified that any back-turning was done respectfully outside the church. Following the funeral, officers from around the country participated in a procession with Liu’s body through the city, demonstrating solidarity.
translated_content: Pou dezyèm fwa nan yon semèn, lapolis New York ansanm ak polisye soti toupatou Ozetazini te antere youn nan yo Dimanch. Yon lòt fwa ankò, kèk polis te vire do bay Majistra Bill de Blasio pandan fineray Ofisye Wenjian Liu a. Manfestasyon sa a te fèt tou nan fineray Ofisye Rafael Ramos, ki te mouri ak patnè patwouy li, Ofisye Liu, pandan yo te chita nan machin yo. Pandan fineray Liu a, te gen mwens polisye ki vire do bay majistra a pase sa te gen nan fineray Ramos la. Anvan evenman an, Komisyonè Polis William Bratton te mande polisye yo pou yo fè respè. Gen kèk polisye ki akize majistra a dèske li ankouraje santiman anti-polis akoz li te sipòte manifestasyon kont britalite lapolis. Gwo manifestasyon te eklate apre lanmò Eric Garner, yon nonm Afriken-Ameriken, te mouri pandan yon konfwontasyon ak NYPD nan jiyè. Pat Lynch, prezidan Sendika Byennèt Polisye yo, te kritike majistra a, li di biwo li make ak lanmò Ramos ak Liu. Malgre tout tansyon sa yo, Bratton te raple ajan yo ke fineray yo dwe konsantre pou onore moun ki mouri. Li di pwotestasyon anvan te bay NYPD move imaj epi detounen onè ki te dwe bay memwa Ofisye Ramos. Nan veye Ofisye Liu a, pa t gen pwotestasyon kont majistra a; kèk polisye menm te salye de Blasio lè li te rive. Pandan sèvis Dimanch lan, Wenjian Liu te sonje kòm yon papa familyal devwe, yon polisye dyanm, yon moun ki renmen lapèch epi ki montre pi bon valè Amerik la. Liu te emigre soti Canton, Lachin, nan laj 12 an ak paran li yo. Fanmi li rakonte premye souvni Ameriken li a te yon etikèt Statue of Liberty. Depi li te pitit, li te valè lwa ak lòd epi li te toujou vle vin yon polisye. Madanm li, Pei Xia Chen, te pale devan moun ki te rasanble nan Funeral Home Aievoli nan Brooklyn, kote li te mete aksan sou devouman Liu ak responsabilite li te genyen. Li sonje jan li te gen respè pou lalwa ak pwofesyonalis li kòm polisye. Koup la te marye sèlman de mwa lè Liu te mouri 20 desanm pandan li te chita nan machin patwouy ak Ofisye Ramos. Toude te vize paske yo se polisye; moun ki te asasinen yo te deja poste entansyon l kont polis sou entènèt. Apre asasina yo, Majistra de Blasio te deklare krim lan se te yon atak sou tout New Yorkè. Pandan fineray la, li te fè lwanj Liu ak Ramos kòm reprezantan pi gwo valè vil la. Ramos, ki te konsidere travay li kòm ministè, te bay onè chaplèn NYPD apre lanmò li. Li kite dèyè madanm li, Maritza, ak pitit gason li yo, Justin ak Jaden. Liu, ki te fè etid nan kontabilite, te rive sèvi kom polisye pandan sèt ane, epi li te konn sèvi ak kapasite li nan lang Chinwa pou ede kominote a. Komisyonè Bratton te dekri Liu kòm yon moun ki gen anpil kè sansib ak atansyon pou moun ki nan bezwen. Nan fineray Ramos, toude te resevwa tit detektif premye klas, apre lanmò yo. De Blasio mete aksan sou renmen Liu te genyen pou fanmi li ak jenerozite li, li te fè konnen li pa t konn pran anpil repo epi li te konn pataje lapèch li ak moun li renmen. Majistra a dekri Liu kòm yon moun kouraj ak konpasyon. Liu 'te mache sou yon chimen kouraj, sakrifis, ak bonte,' majistra a di. 'Vil sa a kenbe tèt pi wo jodi a gras a li.' Direktè FBI a, James Comey, te pale de motivasyon ak risk polisye yo pran ak devouman yo pou amelyore lavi moun. Temwayaj fanmi Liu yo te fè anpil moun kriye, papa li te remèsye li an chinwa, madanm li Pei Xia Chen te rele Liu 'yon nonm ekstraòdinè.' Veye Liu te gen chante boudis ak seremoni tradisyonèl, ak anpil polisye ki soti nan diferan orijin. Ramos, ki gen rasin Puerto Rican, te onore nan yon gwo sèvis pwotestan nan Queens. Gouvènè Andrew Cuomo te pale de fyète ak asimilasyon le w vin yon ajan NYPD. Cuomo pa t ka ale nan fineray Liu akoz lanmò papa li dènyèman. Apre sèvis la, Pat Lynch te di polisye yo gen dwa eksprime mekontantman yo men li presize ke vire do a fèt ak anpil respè, deyò legliz la. Apre fineray la, polis soti tout kote te patisipe nan pwosesyon ak kò Liu nan vil la, ki te fè wè inite ak solidarite.
post_content: Officers and thousands came together in NYC for Officer Liu’s funeral. Emotions ran high, some police turned their backs on the mayor—unity, respect, and heartbreak. #NYPD #UnityInBlue #LiuFarewell
translated_post: Fineray Ofisye Liu mete anpil moun ansanm pou rann li omaj. Kèk polis vire do bay majistra a, anpil emosyon ak solidarite nan vil la. #NYPD #SendikaPolis #Solidarite

article_content:
In support of the Movember campaign, former Daily Mail Head of Sport Bryan Cooney, himself a prostate cancer survivor, interviewed Scotland and Manchester United legend Denis Law, who also battled the disease. Law candidly shares his journey, recalling his 2003 diagnosis, which came after persistent abdominal pain and at the urging of his concerned wife. After weeks of waiting following biopsies, Law received the news in a doctor’s office—a moment so overwhelming he fainted. He reflects on the ordeal with a mix of humor and honesty, noting that while his football career was marked by toughness, the cancer diagnosis left him shaken. 

Law discusses the difficult decisions that followed, preferring surgery to other treatments. He openly addresses the emotional and physical impacts, emphasizing the stigma men often feel about discussing health struggles. Throughout the interview, Law underscores the importance of perspective, the value of family, and the encouragement he found in knowing he was not alone. 

Both Law and Cooney use their experiences to motivate men to participate in Movember and take charge of their health. The article closes with Law’s hopeful outlook, wishing for continued good health as he manages his condition.

A streaker interrupted a university rugby match by running naked onto the pitch and tackling an opposition player. The incident occurred near the end of a game between Newcastle University and Northumbria at Kingston Park. The unidentified man, unclothed, aligned himself with the Northumbria team and tackled a Newcastle player, prompting loud applause from the crowd. As the prankster executed the tackle, players from both teams began fighting, allowing the streaker to make a quick escape without getting caught in the scuffle.

Tongan international rugby player Willis Koloofai remarked, 'I've played a lot of rugby, but I've never seen anything like this before. The man had about four minutes on the pitch to do whatever he wanted! The stadium atmosphere, already intense because of the university rivalry, became even more electrified and entertaining when he ran on. He lined up like Northumbria’s 16th man and made a textbook tackle on the Newcastle player as the ball came toward him.'

A spectator who filmed the incident said he had never witnessed anything similar, noting the fight that broke out between the teams and the humor in Northumbria’s unexpected extra defender. Some fans were surprised by the lack of security response during the event. Play eventually resumed, with Northumbria winning 29-10 and continuing their strong record against Newcastle.

article_content: Baby Beatrix, who did not breathe for the first 23 minutes after birth, was saved by a determined doctor at Princess Alexandra Hospital in Harlow, Essex. Charlotte Richards, her mother, feared the worst as a team of 15 medical staff worked to revive her newborn daughter. Normally, after 20 minutes without response, doctors would stop resuscitation efforts, but a consultant encouraged one final attempt, seeing a resemblance to his own child. At that moment, Beatrix began to breathe. Weighing 6lb 2oz, Beatrix had suffered perinatal asphyxia following a placental bleed—a condition that can lead to oxygen deprivation and risk of brain damage. After being resuscitated, she spent two and a half hours in intensive care and was later transferred to St Thomas’ Hospital in London for specialized care, including 72 hours in a cooling blanket to lower her core temperature and minimize brain damage risk. Four days after birth, her parents, Charlotte (24) and Lloyd Richards (39), were able to hold her for the first time. An MRI scan brought relief, showing no sign of brain damage. Now, at home in Bishop’s Stortford, Hertfordshire, Beatrix is healthy and her family is grateful. The Richards family, who also have a three-year-old daughter named Isabella, are raising funds to thank Harlow hospital for their care. For the first days, Charlotte and Lloyd had limited time with Beatrix and were told to take photos in case she did not survive. Charlotte’s mother is also battling cancer, but the family remains hopeful and strong.
translated_content: Ti bebe Beatrix, ki pa t respire pandan 23 premye minit apre nesans li, te sove grasa detèminasyon yon doktè nan Princess Alexandra Hospital nan Harlow, Essex. Nòmalman, dapre 20 minit san repons, doktè yo ta sispann eseye resisite, men yon konsiltan te ankouraje yon dènye tantativ paske li te wè li sanble ak pitit fi pa li. Se lè sa Beatrix te kòmanse respire. Beatrix, ki te peze 6 liv 2 ons, te viktim asfiksi perinatal aprè yon senyen plasenta—kondisyon sa ka lakòz mank oksijèn epi domaje sèvo a. Apre li fin resisite, yo mete l nan swen entansif pandan de èdimil epi transfere li St Thomas’ Hospital nan Lond pou swen espesyal, ki te enkli 72 èdtan ak yon dra refwadisman pou diminye tanperati kò li epi limite risk domaj nan sèvo. Kat jou aprè nesans li, paran li Charlotte (24 an) ak Lloyd Richards (39 an) te finalman ka kenbe l pou premye fwa. Yon MRI te konfime pa te gen domaj nan sèvo. Kounya, lakay li nan Bishop’s Stortford, Hertfordshire, Beatrix anfòm ak fanmi an rekonesan anpil. Fanmi Richards la, ki gen yon lòt pitit fi twa zan ki rele Isabella, ap ranmase lajan pou remèsye lopital Harlow. Pandan premye jou yo, Charlotte ak Lloyd te gen ti moman ak Beatrix epi doktè yo te di yo pran foto nan ka li pa ta siviv. Manman Charlotte ap goumen ak kansè tou, men fanmi an kenbe lespwa.
