article_content: Romania will make nine changes to their lineup and introduce a new captain for their final Rugby World Cup match against Tonga in Lille on Sunday. After enduring a difficult tournament filled with heavy losses, the Romanian squad is eager to finish on a better note. Currently at the bottom of Pool B, Romania have conceded a staggering 242 points while only managing to score eight across three games—having lost 84-0 to Scotland, 76-0 to South Africa, and 82-8 to Ireland. These results place them near the bottom of nearly every tournament statistic, including an average of 49 missed tackles per match—a number they hope to reduce against the physical Tongan team. Head coach Eugen Apjok has handed the captaincy to hooker Ovidiu Cojocaru, who missed the match against Scotland and will be leading the side for the first time in his 34th international test. The previous captain, number eight Cristi Chirica, is absent from the lineup, replaced by Andre Gorin. Lock Adrian Motoc retains his spot and continues his streak as the only Romanian player to have played every tournament minute so far. Scrumhalf Florin Surugiu earns his first tournament start in France and is set to equal Mihai Macovei as Romania’s third most-capped player with 104 appearances, trailing only Catalin Fercu (109) and Florin Vlaicu (129). Backs Alexandre Bucur and Mihai Graure, two recent additions to the team, will be available off the bench. With both Romania and Tonga having lost all their matches and yet to pick up a bonus point, Sunday’s fixture will determine who finishes last in their pool. Romania lineup: 1-Alexandru Savin, 2-Ovidiu Cojocaru (captain), 3-Alexandru Gordas, 4-Adrian Motoc, 5-Marius Iftimiciuc, 6-Vlad Neculau, 7-Cristi Boboc, 8-Andre Gorin, 9-Florin Surugiu, 10-Alin Conache, 11-Taliauli Sikuea, 12-Fonovai Tangimana, 13-Tevita Manumua, 14-Nicholas Onutu, 15-Marius Simionescu. Replacements: 16-Robert Irimescu, 17-Iulian Hartig, 18-Costel Burtila, 19-Florian Rosu, 20-Damian Stratila, 21-Gabriel Rupanu, 22-Alexandru Bucur, 23-Mihai Graure.

article_content: Facebook experienced a sudden outage that lasted around 20 minutes this afternoon, leaving millions unable to access their accounts. The company responded promptly, stating it was looking into the problem. During the downtime, Twitter was flooded with user complaints and jokes, propelling #facebookdown into the trending topics. Brands like Denny’s used the moment for playful engagement, inviting people to socialize in person instead. The disruption began at about 3:45 p.m. According to Down Detector, many reported the issue, although Facebook’s developer status page did not display any problems. Service was restored after about 20 minutes, but not before Twitter users circulated a flurry of memes and parodies. Online, shirts poking fun at the incident also appeared. This wasn’t the first recent outage; Facebook also went down in early August and mid-June. Financially, the outage could be costly—the company’s latest quarterly revenue was $2.91 billion, averaging roughly $22,454 per minute. That means a 20-minute outage might have cost nearly $500,000. Facebook’s stock decreased by 1.1% that day, though shares were already lower before the service interruption.

Pandan tan sa, Twitter te plen ak plent itilizatè yo ak blag, ki te fè #facebookdown vin tounen youn nan sijè ki te ap flannen anpil. Mak tankou Denny’s pa t rate okazyon an, yo envite moun rankontre fas a fas pito. Pan an te kòmanse kòmsadwa a 3:45 apremidi. Down Detector te montre anpil moun te leve vwa yo, men sou paj estati devlopè Facebook la, pa t gen anyen ki parèt. Sèvis la retounen 20 minit apre, men anvan sa, moun yo te gentan fè anpil blag ak mim sou Twitter. Gen menm mayo sou entènèt ki t ap fè gajab ak evènman an. Sa pa premye fwa Facebook jwenn gwo pan konsa; yo te gentan fè eksperyans ak sa nan kòmansman out ak nan mitan jen. Sa ka vin chè pou konpayi an—dènye rapò finansye a montre Facebook touche $2.91 milya pa trimès, oswa apeprè $22,454 chak minit. Sa vle di yon pan 20 minit ka koute prèske $500,000. Jou sa a, aksyon Facebook te bese 1.1%, men valè yo te gentan ba anvan pan sa a.

According to new research, including carrots and other Vitamin A-rich foods in your diet might help control prostate cancer. A team at the University of York, led by Professor Norman Maitland, discovered that retinoic acid—a compound derived from Vitamin A—reduces the ability of prostate cancer cells to spread. Foods such as carrots, sweet potatoes, and leafy greens like kale are great sources of Vitamin A.

Professor Maitland emphasized that prostate cancer is much more treatable when it remains in the prostate gland. While this research highlights prevention rather than a cure, boosting Vitamin A intake could help prevent the disease from becoming more aggressive. The study found that two genes typically shut down in malignant prostate cancer stem cells can be reactivated with retinoic acid, which may limit the cancer's severity.

Low levels of Vitamin A in men’s blood have long been related to increased prostate cancer risk, although the reasons were previously unclear. This study provides new understanding of how diet, especially Vitamin A, might influence cancer’s progression at the cellular level.

Every year, about 41,000 men are diagnosed with prostate cancer in the UK, and over 10,000 die from it. This research strengthens the idea that nutrition plays a crucial role in resisting cancer.

Kawòt, pòmdetè dous, ak fèy vèt tankou kale se bon sous Vitamin A.

Etid la montre de jen ki etenn nan selil souch kansè pwostat kapab relanse ak asid retinoik, sa ki kapab redwi agresivite kansè a.

Depi kèk tan, syantis remake gason ki gen ti kantite Vitamin A gen plis chans gen kansè pwostat, men yo pa t konn rezon an. Koulye a, etid la pote plis klarifikasyon sou kijan Vitamin A soti nan manje ta ka jwe yon wòl enpòtan.

article_content: Aretha Franklin’s sons have been granted ownership of her former homes, following the discovery and validation of a 2014 handwritten will found between her couch cushions. This decision, reached by a jury after some debate about the will’s legibility and authenticity, came four months after the document was ruled valid despite being difficult to read. Notably, Franklin signed the will with a smiley face inside the letter 'A.' The 2014 will supersedes a previous handwritten will from 2010 that was found in Franklin’s Detroit home in 2019. According to Judge Jennifer Callaghan, the 2014 document reflects Franklin’s apparent wish for her youngest son, Kecalf Franklin, to oversee her estate. He and his children have now been awarded the star’s gated Detroit mansion, valued at $1.1 million in 2018 and likely worth even more today. A lawyer described the property as the 'crown jewel' of Franklin’s real estate holdings. Another son, Ted White II, who preferred the 2010 will, was assigned a different Detroit property. However, this house was sold by the estate for $300,000 prior to the discovery of the competing wills, and Ted's lawyer has requested the proceeds from that sale. Under the 2014 will, a third son, Edward Franklin, was awarded another property. Franklin’s fourth home, also estimated to be worth more than $1 million, is expected to be sold with proceeds to be split among all four sons, as the 2014 will does not specify a recipient. Franklin died of pancreatic cancer in August 2018. At the time, it was widely assumed she had not prepared a will to determine how her estimated $6 million estate—comprising real estate, cash, valuable gold records, furs, and music copyrights—should be divided. Nine months later, her niece and then-estate executor, Sabrina Owens, discovered two separate sets of handwritten documents in Franklin’s Detroit home. The 2010 version was found locked in a desk drawer among contracts and other papers, while the 2014 version was found in a spiral notebook beneath her living room sofa cushions. All four of Franklin’s sons agreed the 2010 will was valid, but debate centered on whether Franklin had actually signed the 2014 document. Both documents indicated Franklin’s wish for her sons to split income from her music and copyrights, but their directives on property division differed. The 2014 document allocated the $1.1 million home to Kecalf, whereas the earlier will divided assets more equally. Kecalf testified that his mother often conducted business from her couch, so finding a will there was unsurprising to him. Ted, Franklin’s touring guitarist, argued she would have written a will in a more conventional manner and pointed out that the 2010 will was stored securely. Ultimately, the jury decided the 2014 document should take precedence, reaching their decision in less than an hour. Franklin’s eldest son, Clarence—who lives in assisted housing and has a guardian—did not participate in the dispute but will receive a portion of the estate through a pretrial agreement. The division of Franklin’s music assets remains unresolved, with further court proceedings scheduled. Aretha Franklin remains celebrated as one of soul and R&B’s most influential voices, with iconic hits such as 'Respect,' 'I Say A Little Prayer,' 'Rock Steady,' and 'Think.'

article_content:
Leadership and management are essential concepts within any organization, yet they are often used interchangeably and misunderstood. Understanding the differences between these roles is crucial for anyone aiming for career advancement.

Leaders are responsible for setting the vision and long-term direction of a company. Their main job is to develop strategies, anticipate industry trends, and keep the organization focused on its overarching goals. Rather than managing everyday details, leaders concentrate on the bigger picture, ensuring the business adapts to external changes. Effective leaders clearly communicate their vision, inspire teams, and rally both internal and external partners towards common objectives. They also establish the core values and ethical standards that inform company policies, which are then implemented by managers.

Managers, on the other hand, handle the operational side of an organization. They are charged with organizing teams, planning projects, and ensuring work aligns with the broader vision. Managers are responsible for hiring, training, performance evaluations, and making sure resources like budgets and tools are used effectively. They may oversee several departments and are focused on meeting deadlines and achieving day-to-day targets.

There is often overlap between these roles, especially in smaller companies or non-profits, where leaders might take on management tasks and managers may need to think strategically. While both roles benefit from overlapping skills, each comes with different priorities. Pursuing either path means emphasizing the relevant skill set without neglecting the other, which also helps prevent burnout.

For leadership roles, important skills include strong communication, transparency, strategic thinking, decisiveness, creativity, negotiation, and the ability to nurture other leaders. Managers require many of the same qualities but with a focus on team management, organization, workflow optimization, active listening, delegation, and relationship building.

Regardless of your career ambitions, developing both leadership and management skills will help you progress, become a sought-after candidate, and drive positive change in your organization and the wider business world.

Lidèchip ak jesyon se de konsèp kle nan nenpòt òganizasyon, men souvan moun konn melanje yo oubyen itilize yonn nan plas lòt la. Konprann diferans ki genyen ant de wòl sa yo enpòtan anpil pou nenpòt moun ki swete avanse nan karyè li.

Yo mete tou valè debaz ak estanda etik ki ap gide politik konpayi an, epi se manadjè ki mete yo an aplikasyon.

Manadjè yo, pa bò kote pa yo, pran swen aspè operasyonèl òganizasyon an. Yo òganize ekip yo, planifye pwojè yo, epi asire travay la fèt jan vizyon an mande l. Manadjè responsab pou anplwaye moun, fòme yo, evalye pèfòmans, epi byen jere resous tankou bidjè ak zouti. Yo ka sipèvize plizyè depatman epi asire dat limit ak objektif chak jou respekte.

Gen plizyè fwa kote wòl yo kwaze, sitou nan ti biznis oswa òganizasyon pa gen anpil mwayen, kote lidè ka fè travay manadjè epi manadjè oblije reflechi estratejikman. Menmsi wòl yo ka gen kèk kapasite ki sanble, chak wòl gen pwòp priyorite pa yo. Manadjè yo bezwen anpil menm kalite sa yo, men plis mete aksan sou jesyon ekip, òganizasyon, amelyore workflow, ekout aktif, delege travay, epi bati bon relasyon.

Kèlkeswa objektif ou, devlope kapasite lidèchip ak jesyon ap ede w avanse, atire menm plis opòtinite, epi fè gwo chanjman pozitif nan òganizasyon w ak sosyete a.

article_content: Thandie Newton, a renowned British actress, spent her childhood in Penzance where her mixed-race family often endured intense racism. Despite her shining performances on screen, Newton remembers growing up with regular reminders to stay under the radar in an attempt to avoid verbal abuse. Her father, Nick—who is white and British—did his best to shield the family, while her mother Nyasha, originally from Zimbabwe, encouraged a low-profile approach to prevent attracting negative attention. Newton recalls how she and her brother Jamie, both the only black children in their community, were regularly singled out as outsiders. At her Catholic-run school, teachers made it clear they had never had a black student before, and the school criticized her traditional cornrow hairstyle. Some locals went as far as shouting racist insults on the street. Once, an elderly woman yelled, ‘Get back to the jungle where you belong.’ Although the Cornish seaside environment was physically beautiful, Newton says the town was stuck in outdated racial views, making day-to-day life difficult. Even as a happy and successful student, she noticed that her achievements could sometimes provoke jealousy or resentment due to her race. Born in London and spending her early years in Zambia, Newton’s transition to life in rural England in the 1970s was profound. She now reflects that the experience would make for a compelling sitcom—if only there had been more humor in those moments.
translated_content: Thandie Newton, yon aktris Britanik popilè, te pase anfans li nan Penzance kote fanmi milat li te souvan sibi rasis sevè. Malgre siksè li sou ekran an, Newton sonje jan yo toujou konseye l pou l pa twò atire atansyon pou evite jouman. Papa li, Nick — ki se yon Britanik blan — te toujou ap chèche pwoteje fanmi an, pandan manman li, Nyasha, ki soti Zimbabwe, te ankouraje yo pou yo evite fè twòp bri pou pa atire mechanste. Newton sonje li menm ak frè li Jamie, ki te sèl timoun nwa kote yo t ap viv la, te toujou wè yo kòm moun pa yo. Nan lekòl katolik la, pwofesè yo te di yo pa janm gen elèv nwa anvan, e lekòl la te kritike jan li konn mete cheve li an nat. Gen kèk moun ki te konn rele sou lari a ak mo rasis. Gen yon madanm aje ki te rele: 'Retounen nan jeng kote ou soti.' Malgre bèlte bò lanmè Cornish la, Newton di vil la te kenbe ide rasyal ki pat avanse, sa ki te rann lavi chak jou difisil. Menm si li te yon elèv k ap reyisi ak kè kontan, pafwa li remake siksè li t ap pwovoke jalouzi ak mekontantman akoz koulè po li. Newton te fèt Lond epi te viv premye ane li nan Zambie. Chanjman pou al viv andeyò Angletè nan ane 1970 yo te frape l. Kounye a li wè eksperyans lan t ap bon pou fè sitcom, si sèlman ta gen plis imè nan moman sa yo.

article_content: Few games make movement as fun as Marvel’s Spider-Man 2. With fluid swinging mechanics and dynamic wingsuits, the expanded New York cityscape becomes a true playground for Spider-Man. However, the addition of new areas means traveling across the map can be time-consuming. While traversal is enjoyable, players completing sidequests or collecting items may sometimes prefer to skip the journey. Spider-Man 2 utilizes the PlayStation 5's SSD for near-instant fast travel, but unlocking this feature requires some effort. Fast travel is initially locked and must be earned separately for each borough. Each area has a completion meter that fills as you complete various activities—such as sidequests, photo-ops, Marko’s Memories, and battling crime. Reaching certain completion milestones grants rewards, like Rare Tech Parts. Notably, reaching approximately 50% completion unlocks fast travel in that borough. This process must be repeated for every section of the map. Once fast travel is available in an area, simply open the map, select your destination, and hold down the Triangle button. The game will instantly zoom in and place Spider-Man at your chosen spot, letting you immediately swing or glide through the city.
translated_content: Pa gen anpil jwèt ki fasilite deplasman epi bay plezi tankou Marvel’s Spider-Man 2. Avèk mouvman rapid ak winguit modèn yo, vil New York ki elaji a pwàn tounen yon jwèt pou Spider-Man. Men, paske kat la vin pi gwo ak nouvo zòn, deplase soti yon bò pou ale lòt bò ka tounen yon ti kal bay. Menm si li bèl pou vwayaje, lè w ap fè misyon segondè oswa ranmase objè, pafwa ou ta pito sote vwayaj la. Spider-Man 2 sèvi ak SSD PlayStation 5 la pou pèmèt vwayaj rapid prèske imedyat, men ou dwe travay pou debloke opsyon sa a. Okòmansman, fast travel la bloke e chak katye bezwen debloke separe. Chak zòn gen yon ba pwogrè ki ogmante lè ou fè aktivite—tankou misyon segondè, foto, Marko’s Memories, oswa bay oubyen anpeche krim. Chak nouvo etap ba sa a bay rekonpans tankou Rare Tech Parts. Lè ou rive apeprè 50% konplet, ou debloke vwayaj rapid pou zòn sa a. Ou dwe fè menm jan an pou chak lòt katye sou kat la. Lè ou debloke fast travel nan yon zòn, ouvri kat la, chwazi kote w oswa vle ale, epi kenbe bouton Triangle lan. Jwèt la ap mennen w la san pèdi tan, epi Spider-Man ap parèt pare pou l balanse oubyen glise nan vil la!
post_content: Swinging through NYC is a blast in Spider-Man 2, but fast travel saves time when you need it! Hit 50% in each borough to unlock it and zip anywhere. Love the PS5 speed! 🕷️🕸️ #SpiderMan2 #GamingTips

article_content: Robert Curtis, a 47-year-old former millionaire, died by suicide at Kingsbury station on London's Jubilee Line after grappling with financial ruin, an inquest heard. Once at the helm of a luxury property business and enjoying an opulent lifestyle, Curtis' fortunes declined sharply as his companies failed during the recession. By November, when he took his life, he was staying at a budget hotel in Whetstone and carrying just over £25. Friends and testimony at the North London Coroner's Court described Curtis as suffering from depression, compounded by the earlier suicide of his close friend Paul Castle. Toxicology reports revealed he had used cocaine and the painkiller codeine before his death, though he was not under the drug’s influence at the time. A train driver recounted how Curtis stepped purposefully onto the tracks as the southbound train approached. Police found a brief note on Curtis that read 'I love you mum and dad' alongside a photograph for his young daughter, marked with a message of love. Coroner Andrew Walker summarized that Curtis died from multiple injuries consistent with the train impact, confirming the act as suicide. The jury echoed this conclusion, noting deep sadness over the circumstances leading to his death.
translated_content: Robert Curtis, yon ansyen milyonè 47 zan, te mete fen nan lavi li nan estasyon Kingsbury sou Jubilee Line Lond lan apre li te ap konbat gwo difikilte finansye, selon sa yon ankèt te tande. Li te fè pati tèt yon biznis lokasyon kay liksye epi li te jwi yon vi rich, men fòtin li te tonbe rapidman apre konpayi li yo te fè fayit pandan resesyon an. Nan mwa Novanm lè li mouri, li tap rete nan yon otèl bon mache nan Whetstone epi li te gen jis £25 sou li. Zanmi li ak temwayaj nan Tribinal Kòwònè Nò Lond lan te di Curtis te ap soufri depresyon, sa ki te vin pi grav apre swisid zanmi pwòch li Paul Castle. Rapò toksikoloji a te montre li te pran kokayin ak kodein anvan li te mouri, men li pa t anba efè dwòg yo nan moman an. Chofè tren an te eksplike kijan Curtis te mache dirèkteman sou ray tren an pandan ke tren an t ap apwoche platfòm lan. Polis te jwenn yon ti nòt sou Curtis kote li te ekri 'Mwen renmen ou manman ak papa' ansanm ak yon foto l ak pitit fi li ki te gen yon mesaj lanmou sou do l. Kòwònè Andrew Walker te presize ke Curtis te mouri ak plizyè blesi grav ki konsistan ak enpak tren an, sa ki konfime se te yon swisid. Jiri a te dakò ak sa epi yo te eksprime gwo tristès pou sikonstans ki te mennen ak lapenn lan.

The Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB) have opened a liaison office in Padova, Italy, which aims to serve IPOB members both in Europe and globally. IPOB spokesperson Emma Powerful confirmed the new office’s launch, noting that it is part of the movement’s increasing efforts to restore Biafra’s independence through a referendum.

Powerful explained that the Italian office will act as an official contact point for IPOB members worldwide and as a base for diplomatic activities. He also stressed that, under the leadership of Mazi Nnamdi Kanu, IPOB seeks to connect with Biafrans and supporters of Biafra’s independence from around the world.

By setting up liaison offices in various countries, IPOB hopes to foster Biafran culture, promote economic opportunities, encourage trade and investment, and further economic development for Biafrans. These offices serve as communication hubs and diplomatic points for IPOB’s broader mission to reestablish the Biafran nation.

Powerful reaffirmed IPOB's strong determination for Biafran sovereignty, stating that the leadership is strategically preparing for the push toward independence and remains resolute in their cause.
translated_content:
Òganizasyon Moun Natif Natal Biafra (IPOB) louvri yon biwo lyen nan Padova, Itali, pou sèvi tout manm li yo ann Ewòp epi atravè mond lan. Pòtpawòl IPOB la, Emma Powerful, konfime lansman nouvo biwo sa a, li deklare ke se yon etap nan efò k ap ogmante pou retabli endepandans Biafra atravè yon referandòm.

Daprè Powerful, biwo Itali a pral sèvi kòm pwen kontak ofisyèl pou tout manm IPOB atravè lemond e li pral sèvi kòm baz pou angajman diplomatik yo. Li mete aksan sou sa tou, anba lidèchip Mazi Nnamdi Kanu, IPOB ap chèche konekte ak Biafran ak tout moun ki sipòte endepandans Biafra atravè lemond.

Lè IPOB ap louvri biwo lyen nan diferan peyi, objektif la se pou devlope kilti Biafran, bay plis opòtinite ekonomik, ankouraje komès ak envestisman, epi amelyore devlòpman ekonomik pou pèp Biafran. Biwo sa yo sèvi kòm sant kominikasyon ak pwen diplomatik pou gwo misyon IPOB pou relanse nasyon Biafran an.

Powerful konfime ankò detèminasyon IPOB pou souverènte Biafran, li di lidèchip la ap prepare estratejikman pou demaj pou endepandans epi yo rete fiks sou objektif sa a.

Police have launched an investigation after £60,000 worth of damaged banknotes were found floating in a river in Lincolnshire. On October 25, a dog walker spotted the cash in South Drove Drain near Spalding town centre. Lincolnshire Police retrieved the money and gave an initial estimate of £60,000. Detectives are now working with the Bank of England to verify the money’s authenticity and arrange a precise count.

A significant portion of the notes suffered water damage, although some remain in decent condition. The police are conducting a forensic examination and have obtained a seizure order from the local Magistrates’ Court as part of their investigation into the money’s origin.

Legally, anyone who discovers money must report it to the police. Failing to do so may result in a charge of ‘theft by finding.’ If unclaimed after 28 days, the finder may have a right to claim the money, provided they follow the correct process. However, police do not permit claimants to keep items that store personal data, such as mobile phones or laptops.

Detective Constable Steve Hull of Spalding CID urged anyone with information regarding the ownership of the money to come forward. The cash will remain in police custody until the investigation concludes. Should a lawful owner not be identified, the money may be subject to a court forfeiture order. Evidence of ownership will be required if a claimant comes forward.
translated_content:
Lapolis ap mennen yon ankèt apre yo te dekouvri bilten bank ki domaje, vo 60,000 liv, k ap flote nan yon rivyè nan Lincolnshire. Sou 25 Oktòb, yon moun ki t ap mennen chen li dekouvri lajan an nan South Drove Drain, toupre sant vil Spalding. Lapolis Lincolnshire te rekipere lajan an epi estime premye montan an a 60,000 liv. Detektiv yo ap travay kounye a avèk Bank of England pou verifye otantisite lajan an epi fè yon kontaj egzak.

Yon gwo pati nan bilten yo domaje akòz kontak ak dlo a, men gen kèk ki toujou an bon eta. Lapolis ap fè yon analiz forènsik epi li resevwa yon lòd sezi nan men tribinal majistra a kòm pati nan ankèt sou orijin lajan an.

Dapre lalwa, nenpòt moun ki jwenn lajan dwe rapòte l bay lapolis. Si yo pa fè sa, yo ka akize w pou "vòl pa dekouvèt". Si pèsonn pa reklame lajan an apre 28 jou, moun ki te jwenn li a ka reklame li, si li swiv tout pwosesis yo. Men, lapolis pa pèmèt moun yo kenbe atik ki genyen done pèsonèl tankou telefòn oswa òdinatè.

Detektif Steve Hull, nan sèvis envestigasyon Spalding, mande nenpòt moun ki gen enfòmasyon sou pwopriyetè lajan an pou kontakte li. Lajan an ap rete lakay lapolis jiskaske ankèt la fini. Si pa genyen okenn moun ki pwouve ke li se pwopriyetè lejitim lajan an, li ka sijè a yon lòd konfiskasyon nan tribinal la. Y ap mande prèv sou pwopriyetè a si yon moun vini reklame li.

article_content: Amy Ratnett, a 29-year-old from Trowbridge, Wiltshire, had overcome her struggles with self-harm and was actively supporting others with mental health issues. Nevertheless, Amy sadly died after a night of heavy drinking while taking multiple prescription medications. The inquest found that Amy traveled to Reading, Berkshire, to visit her friend Fay Trezise, where they drank cocktails and vodka together. After being put to bed by her friend, Amy was found unresponsive the next morning, and paramedics later confirmed her death. Known for her openness, Amy had shared her experiences with self-harm in interviews and through her blog, using her story to raise awareness and encourage others to avoid similar risks. The inquest confirmed that Amy was taking medications including fluoxetine, olanzapine, zopiclone, and diazepam. The coroner ruled that the fatal combination of alcohol and these drugs caused her organs to fail in her sleep, recording a verdict of misadventure. Her father, Paul Ratnett, said Amy wanted to feel normal. Although she had made notable progress, the combination of substances turned out to be deadly. After the inquest, her parents, Paul and Diane, declined to comment.
translated_content: Amy Ratnett, yon jèn fi 29 an ki te soti Trowbridge, Wiltshire, te konbat blese tèt li e li t ap sipòte lòt moun ki gen difikilte mantal. Malerezman, Amy pèdi lavi li apre li te pase yon nuit ap bwè anpil alkòl pandan li t ap pran medikaman plizyè kalite. Rapò ankèt la montre Amy te ale vizite zanmi li Fay Trezise nan Reading, Berkshire, kote yo te bwè cocktail ak vodka ansanm. Apre Fay te mete l kouche, li te jwenn Amy san konesans nan demen maten an, epi medsen ijans yo konfime li te mouri. Amy te vin rekonèt paske li te dekri eksperyans li ak blese tèt li an piblik, ni nan entèvyou, ni sou blog li. Li te itilize istwa pa li pou sansibilize ak ankouraje lòt moun pa fè menm erè yo. Ankèt la konfime Amy t ap pran fluoxetine, olanzapine, zopiclone, ak diazepam. Kòronè a di se melanj medikaman ak alkòl la ki lakòz ògàn li yo sispann fonksyone pandan li t ap dòmi; yo ban vèdik 'aksidan.' Papa li, Paul Ratnett, te eksplike Amy jis te swete viv tankou tout moun. Menmsi li te fè anpil chanjman pozitif, melanj medikaman ak alkòl lan te pote trajedi. Paran li yo, Paul ak Diane, pa t pale ak laprès apre ankèt la.
post_content: Heartbreaking story: Amy Ratnett overcame self-harm and helped others, but died after mixing alcohol with her meds during a night out. Her desire to feel 'normal' led to tragedy. #MentalHealthMatters #GoneTooSoon
translated_post: Tristès: Amy Ratnett te konbat blese tèt li epi ede lòt moun, men li mouri apre li te melanje alkòl ak medikaman li yon swa. Li te vle viv nòmal, sa vin pote trajedi. #SanteMantal #NouPediYonLòt

article_content: Every October, the Nobel Prizes recognize groundbreaking scientific achievements, shining a light on discoveries that often arise from unexpected places. George de Hevesy, winner of the 1943 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, established the method of using radioactive tracers. His pioneering experiment in 1911 took place at a Manchester boarding house cafeteria in the UK, where he suspected staff were reusing food leftovers. To test his suspicion, de Hevesy sprinkled a tiny amount of radioactive material onto his leftover meat. Days later, using an electroscope, he detected radioactivity in meals served at the cafeteria, confirming his theory. When he shared the findings, his landlady was astonished, exclaiming, 'this is magic'—but it was actually the birth of radioactive tracer technology. A year before this, de Hevesy had moved from Hungary to the UK to work with Nobel Prize-winning scientist Ernest Rutherford, then researching radium D, a radioactive byproduct notable for its 22-year half-life. Rutherford's sample was contaminated with large amounts of lead, and he enlisted de Hevesy to separate radium D from lead. After almost two years of attempts, de Hevesy’s efforts were unsuccessful—unbeknownst to him, radium D was actually a radioactive isotope of lead (Pb-210), inseparable by standard chemical techniques. This 'failure' inspired de Hevesy's breakthrough idea. Realizing radioactive isotopes like Pb-210 emit detectable particles or energy as they undergo radioactive decay, he conceived the tracer method—using these isotopes to follow and analyze chemical processes by tracking their radioactivity. In the early 1910s, de Hevesy relocated to Vienna and collaborated with Fritz Paneth at the Vienna Institute of Radium Research—the world's largest radium center. By adding small amounts of radioactive tracers to chemicals, they traced their movement through various chemical reactions. De Hevesy further advanced tracer science by introducing non-radioactive markers, like deuterium, a heavier, much rarer isotope of hydrogen. Alongside collaborators, he tracked deuterium-labeled water through his own body, measuring its elimination and opening new avenues for studying biological processes. For developing these isotope tracer techniques, de Hevesy was awarded the 1943 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Today, radioactive tracers are widely used in medicine, biology, geology, and materials science—tracking disease progression, studying nutrient uptake in plants, monitoring groundwater movement, and measuring material wear without invasive methods. Modern scientific facilities, such as the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB) at Michigan State University, produce and harvest unique radioisotopes for scientific and medical applications. For example, isolating rare Zn-62 from irradiated water—amid vastly more water molecules—supports research in nuclear medicine and plant biology. Eighty years after de Hevesy’s discovery, radioactive tracers remain a cornerstone of research and innovation, with scientists worldwide developing new tracers and applications. Article provided by The Conversation and republished under a Creative Commons license.
translated_content: Chak mwa Oktòb, Pri Nobèl yo rekonèt gwo reyalizasyon syantifik, mete aksan sou dekouvèt ki souvan soti kote moun pa t atann yo. George de Hevesy, ki te resevwa Pri Nobèl Chimie an 1943, mete sou pye metòd pou itilize trasè radyoaktiv. Premye eksperyans li an 1911 te fèt nan kafeterya yon gwo kay nan Manchester, UK, kote li t ap sispèk ke moun yo t ap resèvi rès manje. Pou verifye sa, de Hevesy te mete yon ti kras materyèl radyoaktiv sou rès vyann li. Kèk jou pita, li te itilize yon elektroskòp pou detekte radyoaktivite nan manje yo t ap resèvi, e li te konfime dout li yo. Pwopriyetè kay la te sezi: 'se majik' li di, men an reyalite, se te premye demonstrasyon siksè teknoloji trasè radyoaktiv la. Yon lane anvan, de Hevesy te soti Ongri epi ale UK pou travay ak syantis Ernest Rutherford, ki te deja genyen Pri Nobèl pou travay li sou radyoaktivite. Rutherford t ap travay ak radium D, yon byprodwi radyoaktiv ki gen demi-lavi 22 ane, men echantiyon an te konbine ak anpil plon. Rutherford mande de Hevesy separe yo, men apre prèske de zan li pa t reyisi—paske an reyalite radium D se te yon izotòp radyoaktiv plon (Pb-210) ke chimik pa ka separe. Echèk sa a te mennen de Hevesy gen yon ide revolisyonè. Li remake izotòp radyoaktiv tankou Pb-210 lage patikil oswa enèji detektab pandan yo dekonpoze, epi li imajine itilize izotòp sa yo kòm trasè — pou swiv epi analize pwosesis chimik atravè radyoaktivite. Nan kòmansman ane 1910 yo, de Hevesy te al Vyèn pou kolabore ak Fritz Paneth nan Enstiti Rechèch Radium—pi gwo sant radium nan mond lan. Yo te mete ti trasè radyoaktiv nan konpoze chimik epi suiv trajè yo pandan reyaksyon chimik. De Hevesy te pouse syans trasè a pi lwen avèk marker ki pa radyoaktiv tankou deuterium, yon izotòp idwojèn ki pi lou ak pi ra. Li ak kòlèg li yo te bwè dlo make ak deuterium pou mezire kijan kò a elimine li, e konsa louvri wout pou nouvo etid byolojik. Pou devlopman teknik trasè izotòp sa yo, de Hevesy te resevwa Pri Nobèl Chimie an 1943. Jodi a, trasè radyoaktiv yo esansyèl nan medsin, biyoloji, jeoloji ak syans materyèl—sèvi pou suiv maladi, absòpsyon eleman nitritif pa plant, etid sikilasyon dlo, epi mezire usure san operasyon. Sant rechèch modèn tankou Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB) nan Michigan State University ap pwodwi ak rekipere izotòp radyoaktiv inik pou syans ak medsin. Separe Zn-62 nan dlo iradyè—malgre kantite molekil dlo ki gen ladan li a—ede rechèch nan medsin nikleyè ak biyoloji plant. Katreven ane apre travay de Hevesy, trasè radyoaktiv toujou esansyèl pou inovasyon ak dekouvèt, ak syantis yo toujou ap pwogrese ak nouvo aplikasyon. Atik sa a sòti The Conversation epi li repibliye anba lisans Creative Commons.
post_content: Did you know radioactive tracers were discovered thanks to a scientist suspicious of recycled cafeteria food? de Hevesy’s curiosity led to a Nobel Prize and revolutionized medicine, plant science, and more! 🥼🔬 #ScienceHistory #RadioactiveTracers

article_content: Sixteen-year-old Laura Dekker completed her historic solo voyage around the world on Saturday, arriving in Sint Maarten after 518 days at sea. The Dutch sailor finished her journey alone aboard her 38-foot yacht, Guppy, making her unofficially the youngest person to sail around the globe solo. Dekker embarked on her voyage from Gibraltar at age 14 on August 21, 2010, traveling over 27,000 nautical miles. Her route took her west across the Atlantic, through the Panama Canal, across the Pacific, through the Indian Ocean, around the Cape of Good Hope, and finally to the Caribbean. The journey was marked by controversy, as Dutch authorities initially tried to stop her from departing due to concerns over her safety. After court rulings and meeting certain conditions, Dekker was permitted to set sail. Along her journey, she visited locations including the Galapagos Islands, Bora Bora, and Cape Town. Dekker changed her original plan to return to Gibraltar via the Suez Canal, instead choosing a safer route around South Africa to avoid piracy. Reflecting on her journey before completing it, Dekker expressed both disbelief and pride at her accomplishment, noting the personal growth and experiences gained throughout her solo circumnavigation.
translated_content: Laura Dekker, yon Olandèz ki gen 16 an, sot fini vwayaj istorik li pou li fè tout vire sou lanmè a poukont li, samdi, lè li rive Sint Maarten apre 518 jou sou lanmè. Jèn navigatè a te fè vwayaj la pou kont li sou bato li 38 pye yo rele Guppy, e li vin tounen moun ki pi jèn ki, malgre li pa ofisyèl, fè tout toune mond lan pou kont li. Dekker te kòmanse vwayaj la soti Gibraltar, li te gen 14 an, 21 out 2010, epi li te fè plis pase 27,000 mil lanmè. Chemen li te pase kont solèy la atravè Lanmè Atlantik, pase Panama Canal, travèse Oseyan Pasifik, pase nan Oseyan Endyen, rive bò Cape of Good Hope, epi fini nan Karayib la. Vwayaj la te gen anpil diskisyon paske otorite Olandè yo te vle anpeche li pati paske yo te gen kè sote pou sekirite li. Aprè desizyon tribinal ak aplike kondisyon yo, Dekker te jwenn pèmisyon pou soti. Pandan vwayaj la, li te vizite kote tankou zile Galapagos, Bora Bora, ak Cape Town. Dekker te chanje plan tounen li pou li pa pase nan Kanal Suez, men pito ale pa kote Lafrik di Sid pou evite pirat. Pandan li te prè pou fini vwayaj la, Dekker fè konnen li sezi ak fyè de sa li reyalize, e li mete aksan sou tout eksperyans ak devlopman pèsonèl li te fè pandan tout vwayaj la.
post_content: Wow! 16-year-old Laura Dekker just made history by solo sailing around the world in her yacht Guppy, starting at 14! Faced tough storms & big obstacles, but made it back to Sint Maarten after 518 days. #GirlPower #Adventure #SailingLegends 🛥️🌍

article_content:
Syed, Accenture’s High Tech global lead, supports clients with strategies for growth, business reinvention, and supply chain optimization. The high-tech sector has significantly shaped the modern world, but is currently contending with challenges from climate change, geopolitical tensions, inflation, and rising operational costs. Consumer electronics saw strong demand during the pandemic, but forecasts predict a 10% drop in 2023 before a slow recovery in 2024. However, enterprise demand for networking equipment and semiconductors is exceptionally high, fueled by growing IT budgets and generative AI advancements, causing recurring material shortages and supply chain issues, alongside a looming talent gap.

To remain competitive, high-tech companies must simultaneously invest in talent development, boost productivity, optimize costs, shorten lead times, and advance digital engineering and manufacturing.

Promising opportunities exist in recurring revenue and consumption-based models. Enterprise clients desire flexibility, while individual consumers are slowing discretionary spending. By scaling as-a-service (AaS) offerings, companies can provide both segments with up-to-date technology and manageable costs, while gaining stable, recurring income and improved customer engagement. For example, Apple’s services division saw sales increase over 8% to $21.2 billion in Q3 this year, up from 5.5% previously.

Many high-tech companies lag in adopting these models due to legacy revenue structures and limited cloud infrastructure. Investments in robust cloud platforms are essential, allowing support for AaS, reducing manual workloads, and enhancing data insights. Further, shifting from a hardware-focused to software-driven sales approach—alongside updating metrics to prioritize churn, conversions, and customer value—helps foster this transition.

Geopolitical shifts and sustainability requirements are spurring executives to reevaluate supply networks. According to Accenture’s survey of over 1,000 executives at U.S.-based companies with revenues above $1 billion, 94% are investing in nearshoring or onshoring. Bringing supply chains closer to customers shortens lead times, improves inventory management, and delivers better service, while also easing capital pressures. However, 57% of high-tech leaders report it can take a week or more to identify supply or production disruptions, highlighting the complexity of redesign efforts.

Industry growth also relies on partnerships, agile M&A, and sector convergence. High-tech expertise is driving progress in healthcare, automotive, and financial services. To stay ahead, companies should pursue smaller, outcome-focused acquisitions, emphasizing product development and market expansion, with internal processes streamlined for swift action, making M&A a core organizational capability.

Workforce shortages, particularly in semiconductors, are a major concern, with nearly 67,000 positions at risk of remaining unfilled over the next four years. By 2030, 1.4 million STEM jobs may go vacant. Many candidates favor roles at hyperscalers or consumer-focused firms over B2B tech and semiconductor companies. To counteract this, organizations must build skills-driven workplaces, engage teams in innovation pilots, and leverage technologies like the metaverse and generative AI, which can accelerate both talent engagement and product development.

Having transformed the world, the high-tech industry has the potential to define the future of business. However, legacy strategies may fall short. Success in this era will require leaders to be highly agile and adaptive.
translated_content:
Syed, ki se lidè mondyal High Tech Accenture la, ap travay pou ede kliyan devlope estrateji kwasans, transfòme biznis yo, epi optimize chenn apwovizyònman. Endistri high-tech la te pote gwo chanjman nan mond lan, men li ap fè fas ak defi tankou chanjman klimatik, konfli jeyopolitik, enflasyon, ansanm ak ogmantasyon nan depans ak materyo premyè yo. Pandan pandemi an, moun te depann anpil sou aparèy elektwonik; sepandan, yo prevwa yon bese 10% nan demann pou pwodwi sa yo an 2023 anvan yon rekiperasyon piti piti an 2024. An menm tan, demann pou ekipman rezo ak semi-conducteurs rete wo anpil, sitou avèk ogmantasyon depans IT ak devlopman entèlijans atifisyèl, sa ki lakoz mank materyèl ak pwoblèm nan chenn apwovizyònman, epi yon mank talan ap vini.

Pou konpayi high-tech yo kenbe pozisyon, yo dwe envesti an menm tan nan devlopman talan, ogmante pwodiktivite, optimize depans, diminye tan livrezon, epi amelyore dijitalizasyon jeni ak pwodiksyon.

Gen opòtinite kache ak modèl revni rekiran ak sèvis ki peye selon itilizasyon. Antrepriz bezwen plis fleksibilite pandan konsomatè yo ap diminye depans pa nesesite sou nouvo aparèy. Lè konpayi yo ogmante modèl 'as-a-service' (AaS), yo bay kliyan yo dènye teknoloji ak plis fleksibilite, epi yo jwenn revni ki pi stab ak angajman kliyan ak eksperyans pèsonalize. Pa egzanp, seksyon sèvis Apple la te grandi plis pase 8% pou rive 21.2 milya dola nan twazyèm trimès ane a.

Sepandan, anpil konpayi pa fin pare pou adapte modèl revni sa yo ak mank enfrastrikti cloud. Investi nan enfrastrikti cloud solid enpòtan pou akselere adaptasyon AaS yo, ogmante efikasite operasyonèl epi amelyore vizibilite done yo. Chanjman soti nan vann pyès pou vann lojisyèl, epi metrize nouvo endikatè pèfòmans (tankou to retansyon, kantite kliyan, pri akizisyon ak valè kliyan), ap ede nan chanjman sa a.

Chanjman jeyopolitik ak demann pou dirabilite ap pouse lidè yo repanse modèl chèn apwovizyònman yo. Yon sondaj Accenture ak 1,000 ekzekitif konpayi ameriken ki fè plis pase 1 milya dola revele 94% pral envesti nan rale chenn apwovizyònman yo pi pre. Sa pèmèt yo diminye tan livrezon, amelyore jesyon stock epi ogmante sèvis kliyan, pandan li reduit presyon kapital. Men, 57% ekzekitif high-tech di li pran plis pase yon semèn pou detekte pwoblèm oswa entèripsyon nan pwodiksyon.

Kwasans ap depann tou de patenarya, M&A rapid ak konvèjans endistri. Teknoloji high-tech ap chanje sante, oto ak finans. Pou rete devan, konpayi yo dwe chèche ti akizisyon efikas, konsantre sou pwodui epi rantre sou nouvo mache, ak bonjan kapasite pou aji vit.

Kriz mank travayè, espesyalman semi-conducteurs, rete grav: prèske 67,000 plas ka rete vid kat ane k ap vini yo. Jiska 2030, 1.4 milyon djòb STEM kapab rete san ranplasan. Kandida yo plis atire gwo konpayi teknoloji konsomatè oswa cloud pase B2B ak semi-conducteurs. Pou fè fas, konpayi yo dwe konstwi yon anviwònman kote devlopman kapasite ak inovasyon ap vanse, ankouraje patisipasyon talan, epi sèvi ak metaverse ak entèlijans atifisyèl pou amelyore eksperyans ak inovasyon pwodwi.

article_content: In Virginia, Republican Delegate Robert Marshall—known for his steadfast opposition to abortion—has reintroduced a 'personhood' bill. This proposal seeks to assign legal rights to embryos and fetuses from the moment of conception, affording them similar protections granted to other individuals under Virginia law, subject to current regulations and Supreme Court rulings. The Virginia House of Delegates has passed the measure, prompting concerns from reproductive rights advocates who argue it could limit access to abortion and some contraceptives, particularly those that prevent egg implantation. Marshall maintains that the bill's purpose is to provide legal recognition to the unborn and insists it neither bans abortion nor affects birth control. While he acknowledges the bill moves toward challenging Roe v. Wade, he believes opponents’ fears are exaggerated, emphasizing that the proposal itself does not outlaw abortion or address contraception. The legislation must still be approved by the Virginia Senate. Governor Robert McDonnell has stated his intention to review the bill upon arrival but has not indicated whether he intends to sign it. Delegate Eileen Filler-Corn, a Democrat supportive of abortion access, has criticized the proposed law as excessive government intervention and believes reproductive decisions should remain between a woman and her doctor. She warns the bill could establish grounds for further restrictions, potentially impacting contraception. This case in Virginia is part of a broader national debate, especially after a directive from the Obama administration required religious organizations to include free birth control in employee health plans. Although a compromise was later put forward, the issue remains contentious. States addressing similar personhood legislation have seen mixed results: Oklahoma is currently considering a comparable bill, while Colorado and Mississippi voters have previously rejected such amendments. Research by the Guttmacher Institute reports 24 states enacted abortion-restricting laws in 2011. NARAL Pro-Choice America highlights a steady increase in anti-abortion measures, growing from 303 enacted in 2001 to 713 by 2011. Regardless of the bill’s outcome, Marshall and his opponents remain dedicated to their respective causes, indicating that the debate over reproductive rights continues decades after Roe v. Wade.

Chanm Depite Virginia a deja apwouve mezi sa a, e sa lakoz enkyetid bò kote defansè dwa fanm paske yo kwè sa kapab diminye aksè ak avòtman ak kèk kontraseptif, espesyalman sa ki anpeche eg ap anrasinen. Marshall di objektif lwa a se pou tèt li bay ti moun yo rekonesans legal; li di lalwa a pa entèdi avòtman ni pa vize kontrasepsyon. Li admèt mezi a ka avanse pou konteste Roe v. Wade, men li di gen twòp dram pou opozan yo epi lwa a pa entèdi avòtman osinon pale de kontrasepsyon klèman. Mezi a dwe ale Sena Virginia toujou pou jwenn apwobasyon. Enstiti Guttmacher rapòte 24 eta te vote lwa ki restriksyon avòtman an 2011. Gwoup NARAL Pro-Choice America fè remake kantite lwa kont avòtman ogmante regilyèman: soti 303 an 2001 pou monte 713 an 2011. article_content: NEW DELHI: Batting maestro Virat Kohli has advised cricketers to prioritize learning new shots rather than focusing solely on technical perfection. Reflecting on his iconic straight six off Haris Rauf during his unbeaten 82 off 53 balls against Pakistan at the 2022 T20 World Cup in Australia, Kohli discussed the importance of continuous improvement. "There is practicing technique and skill, but what truly matters is thinking about what techniques you can use to win matches. Improvement happens when you consider what you can add to your game to help your team win. It's not just about looking like a complete batsman," Kohli said on a Star Sports show. "To look technically good, you don't just practice technique for its own sake; you do it so you can learn new shots and score runs for your team," he added. "My motivation is to be able to cover every area and score runs to win matches." Recalling the memorable straight six off Rauf on October 23, Kohli said, "I've watched that moment many times, and those little moments in the game are very special. Though I've lived them, seeing them again makes me feel nostalgic in a good way. Even today I don't know how I pulled off that shot, but it happened." In the recent ICC World Cup 2023, India defeated New Zealand by 4 wickets in Dharamshala. (With inputs from PTI)

Pandan l te sonje gwo kout bat li te bay Haris Rauf pandan li te fè 82 pwen san elimine sou 53 boul kont Pakistan nan T20 World Cup 2022 an Ostrali, Kohli pale sou enpòtans pou toujou ap amelyore jwèt li. "Gen antrènman sou teknik ak konpetans, men sa ki vreman enpòtan se reflechi sou ki teknik ou ka itilize pou ede ekip la genyen match la. Amelyorasyon fèt lè ou chèche kisa ou ka ajoute sou jwèt ou pou fè ekip la ranpòte viktwa. Se pa sèlman pou parèt kòm yon bèl batè teknik," Kohli te di sou yon emisyon Star Sports. article_content: Nigeria’s Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Dr. Bosun Tijani, has released a comprehensive 31-page blueprint detailing the government’s vision for accelerating economic growth through digital technology and innovation. The announcement came via his X (formerly Twitter) profile on Monday. Named ‘Accelerating our collective prosperity through technical efficiency’, the document sets out concrete strategies for transforming Nigeria into a global digital leader. Dr. Tijani explains that the plan was formed after broad consultations with government departments, agencies, and stakeholders in the tech ecosystem. The blueprint rests on five foundational pillars: Knowledge, Policy, Infrastructure, Innovation/Entrepreneurship/Capital, and Trade. Each pillar defines specific goals and action areas for pushing Nigeria forward in the digital era. Under the Knowledge section, a key focus is the commitment to developing three million early and mid-career tech professionals within the next four years, with efforts to secure job placements for them. The ministry also aims to position Nigeria among the top 25% globally in technical research fields such as AI, robotics, UAVs, IoT, blockchain, and additive manufacturing. Achieving 95% digital literacy across the population by 2030 is also targeted. On Policy, the plan promises to enact and update major laws and frameworks supporting the digital economy, including broadband, digital infrastructure, telecom, blockchain, data, AI, and intellectual property protection. Nine key policy initiatives slated for review and implementation are listed in the strategy. Infrastructure is another critical area, with plans to install 95,000 kilometres of fibre optic cable to improve nationwide connectivity. The ministry will introduce 'OneGOV,' a digital portal giving unified access to government services, expected by the end of 2024. Efforts will also modernize and upgrade postal services and boost the operational capacity of Nigeria’s communications satellite. For the Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Capital pillar, supporting startups—especially those in AgriTech, HealthTech, EdTech, MediaTech, CleanTech, and CreTech—is a priority. Strategic partnerships with other ministries and private sector actors will foster growth and sustainability in these sectors. Finally, Trade initiatives seek to raise Nigeria’s standing in the international technology arena and expand technological intra-African trade by 500% by 2027. The ministry will use the Public Sector Project Complexity Index to prioritize impactful projects. All these strategies underpin President Bola Tinubu’s ‘Renewed Hope Agenda’.

Li te fè anons la sou pwofil X li (ansyen Twitter) lendi. Dokiman an rele ‘Akselere Pwosperite Kolektif Nou atravè Efikasite Teknik’, mete aksan sou estrateji solid pou transfòme Nijerya an yon lidè dijital mondyal. article_content: Ajay Bagga, Chairman of Elyments Platforms, forecasts that India's stock markets may recover losses from the past two years over the next three months, likely resulting in solid returns. After this period, he anticipates markets might flatten or trend down slightly until national election outcomes become clear and a new government takes office, at which point the market could continue its upward movement. Addressing private banks and NBFCs such as Bajaj Finance, Bagga advises caution due to the Reserve Bank of India's decision to raise risk weights on unsecured lending. He suggests waiting for the impact of these regulations to become clearer after company management and analysts have met, noting today's market volatility may be an overreaction. In the global context, Bagga points to recent inflation data influencing expectations that central banks, including the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank, will pause rate increases, with rate cuts potentially starting after June 2024. This outlook is underpinned by the United States' better-than-expected economic performance and India's projected GDP growth above 6%. Bagga expects Indian markets to reach new highs by February, in line with the release of the budget and election announcements, followed by potential volatility. He predicts growth will resume following the establishment of a new government, stressing that although seasonal and macroeconomic factors are positive, market trends may remain uneven. The ongoing real estate boom in India, marked by improved loan accessibility and reduced housing inventory, is supporting related industries like building materials, construction, and cement. Both public and private capital expenditures are contributing to the sector's strong outlook. The pharmaceutical sector—especially Indian companies and hospitals—is starting to recover after a prolonged slump, with increased opportunities in the US generics market and potential for new initiatives forecasting a positive year ahead. Additional updates: The Indian government is reviewing the possibility of transferring unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account money to the Consolidated Fund of India, while ensuring investors can still make claims. Apple is on track to produce approximately ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India for the current fiscal year. In family court news, Nawaz Modi is seeking a significant share of Gautam Singhania’s assets as part of a separation settlement.

article_content: A drunk driver caused a tragic car crash that resulted in the death of his passenger, who had been celebrating his birthday on Friday night. Hugue Lapomarade, 31, was killed when the driver, Vladimir JeanPierre, crashed his white Nissan Quest minivan into a double-parked flatbed truck in East Flatbush, Brooklyn, in the early hours of Saturday morning. JeanPierre, 34, has been arrested and charged with manslaughter, reckless endangerment, vehicular manslaughter, and drunk driving. Emergency crews had to cut the roof and doors off the vehicle to remove the occupants. Lapomarade was taken to the hospital but was pronounced dead on arrival. The collision occurred around 4:25 a.m. on Saturday at 1304 Utica Avenue, East Flatbush. Barry Radow, a local garage worker, told the New York Daily News that according to police, the impact was so forceful it moved the flatbed truck five or six feet forward. Emergency workers arrived quickly at the scene. The flatbed truck was reportedly double-parked, but police said it is unclear whether the truck operator is at fault. Traffic backed up at the scene as emergency personnel responded and bystanders observed the aftermath.

article_content: Students at Tai Solarin University of Education (TASUED), located in Ijagun, Ijebu-Ode, Ogun State, protested a dramatic hike in tuition fees by blocking the Benin-Ore expressway early Wednesday. They demanded a reversal of the recent increase, which raised fees for returning students from around N65,000–N70,000 to N180,000 and for new students to N240,000, excluding additional fees. Protesters carried placards with messages like, 'I am not into fraud, I cannot afford N180K,' and 'Should I go and steal to pay school fees?' The protest coincided with the boycott of the scheduled 2022/2023 second semester examinations, following a statement from the students’ union. Union president Akinjetan Emmanuel and spokesperson Olarenwaju Olawale Daniel indicated that although the union had constructive discussions with management, only a 10% fee reduction was offered—a proposal they did not accept. After negotiations ended in a deadlock, the university management declared an immediate end-of-session holiday and instructed students to leave campus until further notice for safety reasons. Parents were advised to collect their children. The students’ union continues to advocate for a solution that better reflects the financial circumstances of the university community.

Yo mande anilasyon ogmantasyon an, paske frè yo pase soti N65,000–N70,000 pou rive N180,000 pou ansyen elèv ak N240,000 pou nouvo elèv, san konte lòt frè. Patisipan yo te pote pankat tankou ‘Mwen pa fè magouy, mwen pa ka peye N180K’ ak ‘Èske m dwe vòlè pou m peye frè lekòl?’ Manifestasyon an fèt pandan elèv yo te refize pran egzamen semès dezyèm lan pou ane akademik 2022/2023, apre yon deklarasyon sendika elèv yo. article_content:
Michael Sam's aspiration to become the first openly gay player in the NFL was set back as the St. Louis Rams released him during final roster cuts on Saturday. The seventh-round draft pick received national attention, both for his on-field abilities and for his courage in coming out. Though Sam displayed confidence and dedication throughout the preseason, he did not secure a spot on the Rams' roster, which was already filled with talented pass rushers. ESPN first reported his release.

Sam still has opportunities ahead. He may be picked up by another NFL team or be appointed to the Rams' practice squad. On the day of his release, Sam attended the University of Missouri's football opener and was introduced to an enthusiastic crowd alongside E.J. Gaines, a fellow rookie and sixth-round pick who made the team. Sam waved, blew a kiss, and took photos with fans before heading to the locker room.

The Rams had chosen Sam, the Southeastern Conference (SEC) co-defensive player of the year, with the 249th pick in the 2014 NFL draft. After coming out publicly following his final college season, Sam became widely regarded as a trailblazer. Coach Jeff Fisher and General Manager Les Snead emphasized that Sam was drafted for his talent and potential to improve the team’s defense, with Snead calling him a "designated pass rusher." Sam worked hard to adapt, shedding weight to improve his speed for special teams plays.

Throughout training camp and preseason, Sam’s performance was closely watched. He recorded a tackle and a quarterback hit in his first preseason game against the New Orleans Saints. Despite the intense media attention, Sam and his teammates handled the situation professionally, with many players expressing acceptance and support.

At Missouri, Sam had come out to his teammates before his senior season. His presence was a unifying force, and the team's performance improved markedly that year, achieving a school-record 12 wins and winning the SEC Eastern Division. Sam had a standout season, recording 11.5 sacks, and was highly respected by peers and coaches alike.

Although Sam was not a highly ranked recruit out of Hitchcock, Texas, he developed into a prominent player. The Rams selected him despite already having a strong roster at defensive end.

Sam’s time in the NFL draft spotlight included a celebrated moment when he kissed his boyfriend, Vito Cammisano, on national TV. He also received the Arthur Ashe Courage Award at the ESPY Awards and was supported by sports icons like Jim Brown. Sam’s journey has inspired many through his courage and determination. 'I'm determined to be great,' Sam asserted at his introductory press conference. 'Great things can happen when you have the courage to be yourself.'

Rèv Michael Sam pou tounen premye jwè NFL k ap viv ouvètman kòm masisi mete sou poz lè St. Louis Rams voye l ale pandan dènye rediksyon lis jwè yo, samdi. Sam, ki te 7yèm sou lis seleksyon yo, te resevwa anpil atansyon pou kapasite li sou tèren an ak odas li te gen pou l di tout moun oryantasyon li. Malgre Sam te montre anpil konfyans ak devouman pandan tout pre-sezon an, li pa t jwenn plas sou lis final Rams yo, paske te gen anpil lòt defansè menm jan avè l. ESPN te premye ki bay nouvèl la.

Gen toujou chans pou Sam. Yon lòt ekip NFL ka chwazi l oswa li ka monte sou ekip pratik Rams yo. Jou yo te anonse liberasyon l, Sam te asiste ouvèti sezon foutbòl University of Missouri kote foul la te akeyi l ak anpil kè kontan ansanm ak E.J. Gaines, yon lòt nouvo jwè ki te chwazi nan sizyèm wonn epi ki fè ekip la. Sam te fè siy ak men, voye bo epi pran foto ak fanatik yo anvan li ale nan vestiyè a.

Rams yo te chwazi Sam, ki te ko-dèfansè ane a nan SEC la, ak 249yèm chwa nan draf NFL 2014 la. Apre li te anonse piblikman oryantasyon li apre dènye sezon inivèsite li, Sam te konsidere kòm yon pyonye. Antrenè Jeff Fisher ak Manadjè Jeneral Les Snead te mete aksan sou Sam te seleksyone pou talan li ak potansyèl li te pote pou defans ekip la, Snead menm te rele l yon "designated pass rusher". Sam te fè anpil efò pou adapte l, li menm pèdi pwa pou vin pi rapid sou ekip espesyal yo.

Pandan tout antrènman ak pre-sezon an, pèfòmans Sam te anba mikwoskòp tout moun. Li te reyalize yon tackle ak frape quarterback la nan premye match pre-sezon kont New Orleans Saints. Malgre tout atansyon medya yo, Sam ak koekipye li yo te kenbe tout bagay profesyonèl; plizyè jwè te montre l sipò ak akseptasyon.

Nan Missouri, Sam te di koekipye li yo oryantasyon li anvan dènye sezon li. Prezans li te mete ekip la pi ini, epi ekip la te fè yon sezon ekstraòdinè ak 12 viktwa epi yo te genyen SEC Eastern Division. Sam te gen yon sezon remakab, li te fè 11.5 sack epi li te respekte anpil pa tout moun.

Malgre li pa t gran vedèt depi li te soti Hitchcock, Texas, Sam te evolye pou tounen yon jwè enpòtan. Rams yo te pran l menm si yo te deja gen lòt bon jwè defansif.

Sam te viv moman palman nan draf NFL la, sitou lè li te bo mennaj li Vito Cammisano sou televizyon nasyonal. Li resevwa Arthur Ashe Courage Award pandan ESPY Awards epi li te jwenn ankourajman nan men Jim Brown. Istwa Sam la enspire anpil moun atravè kouraj ak detèminasyon l. ‘Mwen detèmine pou m reyisi,’ Sam te di depi premye konferans pou laprès li. ‘Bèl bagay ka rive lè ou gen kouraj pou montre ki moun ou ye.’

Vicky and Sunny Kaushal, just over a year apart in age, share a close sibling bond filled with both support and the typical childhood squabbles. In a recent interview, Sunny recounted their frequent arguments growing up, often over borrowing each other's clothes without asking. He recalled how these disputes sometimes ended in playful scuffles and that wearing a sibling's shirt seemed to increase its appeal.

Their parents, Sham Kaushal (a veteran action director) and Veena Kaushal, would encourage the brothers to perform dance routines for family and guests when they were children. Both enjoyed dancing and participated together in cultural events, often choreographing their own synchronized performances. Sunny noted that he preferred cartoons and anime while Vicky was more interested in sports.

Asked whether Vicky or sister-in-law Katrina Kaif pampered him more, Sunny replied that their mother, Veena, cares for everyone equally. Vicky is currently anticipating the release of his film 'Sam Bahadur,' which has been praised for its trailer. Sunny’s next film is 'Haseen Dilruba Phirse,' following his role in Disney+ Hotstar’s 'Shiddat.'

Nan yon dènye entèvyou, Sunny fè konnen kòm timoun yo konn diskite anpil, sitou paske youn pran rad lòt la san mande. Tou de te renmen danse epi yo te patisipe ansanm nan aktivite kiltirèl, souvan ak koregraf byen pare. Sunny eksplike li te renmen gade desen anime tandiske Vicky te plis adore espò.

Lè yo te poze li kesyon sou kiyès ki gate li plis — Vicky oswa bèl-sè li Katrina Kaif — Sunny di se manman yo Veena ki pran swen tout moun egalman. Kounye a, Vicky ap tann sòti fim li ‘Sam Bahadur,’ ki resevwa anpil kompliman apre bando a. Sunny pral parèt nan pwochen fim li ‘Haseen Dilruba Phirse,’ apre dènye aparisyon li nan ‘Shiddat’ sou Disney+ Hotstar.

Arlo is recognized for producing top-quality security cameras, suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings. Their ease of installation, high video resolution, and user-friendly smartphone app have contributed to their wide appeal. Sometimes, users may find their Arlo camera offline and unusable. Here’s a guide to help resolve the issue:

1. Begin by inspecting your Wi-Fi router. Make sure it’s connected to the internet and there are no errors. Restart it by unplugging, waiting a minute, and plugging it back in.

2. Check if your camera has been relocated too far from the router, which can disrupt the wireless connection.

3. If restarting the router doesn't solve the problem, restart your Arlo camera. For battery-powered models, take out the battery, wait a minute, then put it back in. For wired models, unplug the camera, wait, and plug it back in.

4. Arlo cameras are made for outdoor use but aren't meant for extreme temperatures. If you’re experiencing very hot or cold weather, move the camera to a moderate environment until it returns to normal function.

5. Steer clear of third-party accessories like non-Arlo power cables or solar panels, as they may cause compatibility issues. Remove any recently added third-party accessories and see if the camera reconnects.

6. If all else fails, perform a factory reset by holding the pairing button for up to 25 seconds, or use the Arlo app to remove and re-add the camera.

These steps address most connectivity issues with Arlo cameras.
translated_content:
Arlo se youn nan pi bon mak kamera sekirite ki egziste, li ka itilize anndan oubyen deyò kay la. Kamera sa yo fasil pou w enstale, gen bon kalite imaj, epi aplikasyon telefòn yo a trè pratik, sa ki fè anpil moun renmen yo. Men, pafwa kamera Arlo ou ka dekonekte e li pa mache. Men sa ou ka fè pou rezoud sa:

1. Tcheke routeur Wi-Fi ou. Asire li konekte ak entènèt la san okenn erè. Dekonekte l, tann 1 minit, epi rekonekte l.

2. Gade si kamera a pa twò lwen routeur la; distans twòp ka lakoz pwoblèm koneksyon.

3. Si sa pa mache, rekòmanse kamera a. Si li mache ak batri, retire batri a, tann yon minit, epi mete l tounen. Si li mache ak fil, dekonekte li, tann, epi rekonekte li.

4. Kamera Arlo fèt pou itilize deyò, men li pa fèt pou tanperati ekstrèm. Si kote kamera a ye a cho oswa frèt anpil, mete l nan kote pi modere jiskaske li refè.

5. Pa sèvi ak aksesuà nenpòt lòt mak tankou kòd oswa panèl solè, paske sa ka lakoz pwoblèm koneksyon. Si ou te mete sa deja, retire yo epi tcheke si kamera a tounen nòmal.

6. Si tout sa pa mache, fè yon reset faktori: peze bouton pairing lan pou apeprè 25 segonn oswa retire kamera a ak aplikasyon Arlo a epi mete l ankò.

Swiv etap sa yo pou rezoud pwoblèm koneksyon ak kamera Arlo ou an.
post_content: Having trouble with your Arlo camera going offline? 🚨 Try checking your Wi-Fi, restart both the router & camera, and remember – extreme temps and third-party accessories can mess things up! #TechTips #Arlo #SmartHome

article_content: A mass grave was discovered Tuesday in downtown Montgomery, Alabama, and is believed to contain victims of a yellow fever epidemic from the 1870s, according to police. The site, where two 1940s-era buildings were recently demolished, was being prepared for new construction when maintenance workers uncovered human remains, Montgomery police spokesman Maj. Huey Thornton said. The location borders a cemetery, and historical records maintained by the cemetery suggest the remains may be connected to the yellow fever outbreak in the 1870s. Officials from the Alabama Archaeological Society and the Alabama Historical Association are on-site and expected to verify the findings, according to Thornton. It is not yet clear how many bodies are buried there, but authorities reassure the public that the remains are very old and pose no health risk. A report from the Mississippi Project of the American Local History Network noted a major yellow fever outbreak in 1878, which impacted eight states—especially Alabama, Louisiana, and Mississippi—and resulted in about 16,000 deaths that year.

Zòn nan bò yon simityè, epi dokiman istorik simityè a genyen sijere zo sa yo ka soti nan epidemi lafyev jòn ki te genyen nan ane 1870 yo. Responsab Sosyete Arkeolojik Alabama ak Asosyasyon Istorik Alabama deja sou plas pou verifye dekouvèt la, daprè Thornton. Yo poko konnen konbyen kadav ki antere la, men otorite yo asire popilasyon an ke zo yo trè ansyen epi pa gen okenn risk pou sante piblik. Yon rapò Mississippi Project of the American Local History Network endike te gen yon gwo epidemi lafyev jòn an 1878, ki te afekte uit eta—sitou Alabama, Louisiana ak Mississippi—epi ki lakoz apeprè 16,000 moun mouri ane sa.

The Nigeria Customs Service at Murtala Muhammed International Airport has confiscated $10,000 in counterfeit U.S. currency and handed it to the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC). Public Relations Officer Juliana Tomo reported that 41-year-old Ifeanachor Ugbor, a Nigerian from Enugu State, was detained while attempting to board Ethiopian Airlines flight ET900 to Brazil on November 10, 2023.

Tomo stated that Ugbor had allegedly violated the Money Laundering (Prohibition) Act by intending to travel with the counterfeit cash. This interception happened under the leadership of newly assigned Customs Area Controller Charles Orbih, who recently moved from Abia/Imo to MMIA. Section 15 of the revised Money Laundering Act was cited in the investigation.

After Ugbor declared $10,000 on his currency form, customs officers scrutinized the bills following Section 66 of the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 and confirmed all were fake. The suspect was blocked from traveling and is being held for further investigation.

Controller Orbih applauded his team’s constant vigilance. 'Our officers are always on alert to address customs-related crimes,' Orbih remarked. The counterfeit currency, Ugbor's passport, two phones, and his baggage have been sent to the EFCC for continued probing.

Pòtpawòl Juliana Tomo rapòte ke yo arete Ifeanachor Ugbor, yon Nijeryen 41-zan ki soti Eta Enugu, pandan li t ap eseye monte vòl Ethiopian Airlines ET900 pou Brezil 10 Novanm 2023.

Tomo di Ugbor sou akizasyon vyolasyon Lwa Blanchi Lajan, kòm li te ap vwayaje ak lajan fo. Zak sa a fèt anba nouvo Kontwolè Zòn Ladwàn Charles Orbih, ki fèk soti Abia/Imo pou vin MMIA. Yo mansyone Seksyon 15 nan nouvo lwa Blanchi Lajan an pandan ankèt la.

Apre Ugbor te deklare $10,000 sou fòm ladwàn lan, ajan yo egzaminen lajan yo dapre Seksyon 66 Lwa Sèvis Ladwàn 2023 epi konfime bil yo fo. Yo anpeche l vwayaje epi mete l an detansyon pou plis ankèt.

Kontwolè Orbih felisite ekip li pou vijilans yo. 'Ajan nou yo toujou sou gad pou konbat krim ladwàn,' Orbih deklare. Lajan fo yo, paspò Ugbor, 2 telefòn ak bagaj l yo bay EFCC pou kontinye ankèt la.

article_content: Middlesbrough’s pursuit of Belgian striker Jelle Vossen has ended with his signing on a season-long loan from Racing Genk. The 25-year-old was tracked by Middlesbrough throughout the summer and joins after impressing in Belgium, where he scored 111 goals for Genk and Cercle Brugge in the Jupiler League. Vossen has made 12 appearances for the Belgian national team since his debut in 2009, scoring twice. He is the 11th player signed by Middlesbrough manager Aitor Karanka this summer, and the second addition on transfer deadline day. Earlier in the day, Dutch winger Yanic Wildschut joined Middlesbrough on loan from Heerenveen.

article_content: The Great Depression of the 1930s was a period of severe poverty and economic decline, remembered for its significant impact on American society. One reason it remains vivid in history is the growth of photography during that era, which resulted in extraordinary documentation. Walker Evans was one of the most influential American photographers of this time. His powerful images, created mainly for the Farm Security Administration (FSA), captured the essence of the people and places affected by the Depression. Evans aspired to make photographs that were 'literate, authoritative, and transcendent.' His distinctive style and depth of emotion helped create a compelling portrait of America. In 1938, Evans became the first photographer to have a solo exhibition at the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) in New York, titled 'Walker Evans: American Photographs.' That same year, MoMA published a landmark book, 'American Photographs,' featuring around 60 of his works. To mark the 75th anniversary of this influential collection, MoMA held a new exhibition in 2013 and reissued the 'American Photographs' book. The exhibition preserves the structure of the original: the first section focuses on images of Americans and their social contexts; the second presents photographs of cultural artifacts—architecture, main streets, factory towns, rural churches, and houses. Evans’ photographs do not aim to tell a single story. Instead, they connect viewers through repeating visual structures and themes. His work is celebrated for its subtlety and ability to evoke a sense of both history and immediacy. Some notable Evans photographs include 'Country Store and Gas Station, Alabama, 1936,' 'Parked Car, Small Town Main Street, 1932,' 'Negro Barber Shop Interior, Atlanta, 1936,' and 'Main Street, Saratoga Springs, New York, 1931.' From 1935 to 1938, Evans worked first for the Resettlement Administration (RA) and later the FSA, focusing mainly on the Southern United States. After his work with the FSA, Evans became a staff writer at Time magazine, then an editor at Fortune magazine, and eventually taught at the Yale University School of Art. Walker Evans died at his home in Lyme, Connecticut, in 1975. His work remains a major influence on the history of photography and American visual culture.
translated_content: Gran Depresyon ane 1930 yo te yon peryòd povrete ak degradasyon ekonomik ki make anpil sosyete Ameriken. Youn nan rezon ki fè epòk sa sonje konsa, se paske fotografi te devlope anpil e sa te pèmèt gen bon dokimantasyon. Walker Evans te youn nan pi gwo fotograf Ameriken nan tan sa. Foto li yo, li te fè plis pou Farm Security Administration (FSA), te montre jan lavi te difisil pandan Depresyon an. Evans te vle kreye foto ki te 'enstriktif, otorite, epi transcandan.' Estil li ak emosyon nan travay li te fè li tounen youn nan pi gwo non nan fotografi. An 1938, Evans te premye fotograf ki te gen yon ekspozisyon pa li menm nan Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) New York, yo te rele 'Walker Evans: American Photographs.' Menm ane a, MoMA te pibliye liv 'American Photographs,' ki te genyen apeprè 60 foto li yo. Pou selebre 75èm anivèsè koleksyon sa, MoMA te fè yon lòt ekspozisyon an 2013 e yo relanse liv 'American Photographs' la. Ekspozisyon an toujou divize an de: premye pati montre moun Ameriken ak moun nan sosyete a; dezyèm pati a montre atik kiltirèl tankou achitekti, lari prensipal, vil faktori, legliz riral ak kay bwa. Foto Evans yo pa vle rakonte yon sèl istwa, men pito kreye koneksyon ak moun k ap gade yo atravè estrikti ak tèm ki repete. Travay li rekonèt pou subtilite ak kapasite li fè ou santi listwa a toupre ou. Gen kèk foto Evans ki pi popilè: 'Country Store and Gas Station, Alabama, 1936,' 'Parked Car, Small Town Main Street, 1932,' 'Negro Barber Shop Interior, Atlanta, 1936,' ak 'Main Street, Saratoga Springs, New York, 1931.' Soti 1935 rive 1938, Evans te travay dabò pou Resettlement Administration (RA), apre sa pou FSA, pi souvan nan sid peyi a. Apre travay li ak FSA, Evans te ekriven pou magazin Time, apre sa editè pou magazin Fortune, epi pita te pwofesè nan Yale University School of Art. Walker Evans te mouri lakay li nan Lyme, Connecticut, an 1975. Jouk jounen jodi, travay li kontinye enfliyanse fotografi ak kilti vizyèl Amerik la.
