article_content: Hollywood adaptations are common, but this year they're central to major pop-culture conversations. Studios are reimagining everything from books to toys to video games. These projects appeal to studios partly because they come with ready audiences and also because adaptations can add depth and complexity. Recently, my 2021 book, 'Big Vape: The Incendiary Rise of Juul,' was adapted into a Netflix series titled 'Big Vape: The Rise and Fall of Juul.' I was interviewed on camera and served as a consulting producer, helping bring Juul Labs’ story from page to screen. Juul set out to create an e-cigarette to replace traditional cigarettes but became notorious for getting many teenagers hooked on nicotine. Watching my reporting be adapted added new perspectives and complexity to Juul’s controversial story. Ahead of the series’ premiere, I spoke with director R.J. Cutler, known for documentaries such as 'The September Issue' and 'Billie Eilish: The World’s a Little Blurry,' about the adaptation process, the differences between documentary filmmaking and journalism, and how to capture nuance on screen. TIME: What interested you about Juul? R.J. Cutler: What intrigued me was how Juul’s story illustrates the unintended consequences of Big Tech. Two Stanford students wanted to create an e-cigarette they hoped would be safer and help people quit smoking. Instead, their product sparked a teenage vaping epidemic. TIME: How did you approach adapting nonfiction? Did basing the series on a book feel limiting? Cutler: Not at all. The book gave our narrative a strong foundation and structure. It also showed where we could expand beyond what was in the book. There was a lot of creative freedom since we could tell the story cinematically rather than just through prose journalism. Having someone who had lived the story and already crafted a compelling narrative was a gift. We could use all that material. TIME: When we started, my book wasn't finished. Did that concern you? Cutler: No, it didn’t. I usually trust that the process will work out, even if the path isn't clear at the start. Like cooking a reduction, you keep boiling it down to the essence. My main concern was keeping the story’s complexity in the transition from book to series. It's easy to make Juul the villain—and they do deserve much criticism—but they also helped some adult smokers. It’s a complicated story. TIME: What surprised you most about Juul’s story? Cutler: The biggest surprise was that the product actually worked. For all the company’s mistakes and the downfall of Juul, they invented an e-cigarette that could’ve achieved their aims. Many earlier accounts, except your book, oversimplified this complex story. I wanted to explore the gray areas. TIME: How does documentary filmmaking differ from journalism? Cutler: Documentary filmmaking is a cinematic art. While committed to truth like journalists, the values are different. We use light, color, sound, image, and structure to create something larger than life but still relatable. Documentary films engage emotions and embrace complexity. Note: This interview was condensed and edited for clarity.
translated_content: Adaptasyon nan Hollywood pa nouvo, men ane sa a yo nan sant anpil diskisyon kiltirèl popilè. Estidyo yo ap repanse tout bagay, soti nan liv, jwèt rive jwet videyo. Pwojè sa yo atire estidyo paske yo deja gen yon odyans epi yo kapab ajoute plis pwofondè ak konpleksite. Dènyèman, liv mwen an ki sòti an 2021, 'Big Vape: The Incendiary Rise of Juul,' te adapte kòm yon seri sou Netflix ki rele 'Big Vape: The Rise and Fall of Juul.' Yo te entèvyouve m sou kamera epi mwen te sèvi kòm konsiltan pwodiktè pou ede mete istwa Juul Labs la sou ekran. Juul te vize kreye yon e-sigarèt pou ranplase sigarèt tradisyonèl, men li vin tounen pi byen konnen paske anpil jèn te vin adikte ak nikotin. Lè m te wè rapò m yo pran yon lòt fòm, sa te pote nouvo pèspektiv ak plis konpleksite sou istwa kontwovèsyal Juul la. Anvan seri a te lanse, mwen te pale ak direktè R.J. Cutler, ki renome pou dokimantè tankou 'The September Issue' ak 'Billie Eilish: The World’s a Little Blurry,' sou pwosesis adaptasyon an, diferans ki genyen ant fè dokimantè ak jounalis, ak kijan pou pote nuans sou ekran. TIME: Kisa ki te enterese w sou Juul? R.J. Cutler: Sa ki te atire m, se fason istwa Juul la montre konsekans endezirab gwo teknoloji. De etidyan Stanford te vle kreye yon e-sigarèt yo te panse ki tap pi an sekirite epi ede moun sispann fimen. Men, pwodwi yo a te lakòz yon epidemi vap pami jèn yo. TIME: Kijan ou adapte materyèl reyalite? Èske adapte l soti nan yon liv te fè ou santi w limite? Cutler: Ditou pa. Liv la te bay narasyon an yon baz solid ak estrikti. Li te montre nou kote pou elaji pi lwen pase liv ou an. Nou te gen anpil libète kreyatif paske nou t ap rakonte istwa a an sinema, pa sèlman ak jounalis ekri. Sa te yon kado pou nou gen yon moun ki te deja viv eksperyans lan ak mete tout bagay ansanm pou fè yon narasyon atiran. TIME: Lè nou te kòmanse, liv mwen pa t fini. Èske sa te ba ou kè sote? Cutler: Non, sa pa janm te pwoblèm. Mwen konn gen lafwa ke tout bagay ap mache byen, menm si w pa ka wè chimen an okòmansman. Se tankou kwit yon sòs, w ap redwi l jiskaske w jwenn esans lan. Pi gwo sousi mwen, se te pou kenbe tout konpleksite istwa a nan pasaj soti nan liv pou rive sou ekran. Li fasil pou fè Juul pase pou mechan—yo merite anpil kritik—men yo ede tou kèk granmoun. Malgre tout erè konpayi an ak desann Juul, yo te toujou envante yon e-sigarèt ki te ka reyalize objektif yo. Anpil lòt sous, eksepte liv ou an, te twò redwi istwa konplèks sa a. Mwen te vle fouye pi fon nan tout gri yo. TIME: Kisa ki diferan nan fè dokimantè ak jounalis? Cutler: Fè dokimantè se yon atizay sinematografik. Nou toujou pran angajman sou verite tankou jounalis yo, men valè sinematografik yo diferan. article_content: Mauricio Pochettino, the manager of Tottenham Hotspur, will return to play against his old club Southampton this Sunday. Although he isn't sure how Southampton's fans will greet him, Pochettino expressed that he still holds them close to his heart. Pochettino departed from Southampton after 18 months at the helm, leaving at the same time as several prominent players, including Luke Shaw and Adam Lallana. Some supporters were displeased when he left for Spurs' White Hart Lane. Under new manager Ronald Koeman, Southampton have flourished and currently occupy second place in the Premier League—a development that Pochettino is genuinely pleased about. He attributes their performance to team spirit and doesn't claim credit for their achievements. With Spurs seeking a pivotal win after a shaky start to the season, Pochettino acknowledged the mix of personal feelings and professional stakes going into Sunday's emotionally charged game. He treasures his time at Southampton and looks forward to the match, noting its significance to both himself and his current team.

Menm si li pa fin sèten ki jan fanatik Southampton yo pral resevwa li, Pochettino fè konnen li toujou gen anpil afeksyon pou klèb la. Pochettino te kite Southampton apre 18 mwa kòm antrenè, avèk plizyè gwo jwè ki te ale ansanm avè l, tankou Luke Shaw ak Adam Lallana. Gen kèk fanatik ki pa t dakò ak ale li a pou Tottenham. Depi Ronald Koeman ap dirije klèb la, Southampton ap byen dewoule epi yo nan dezyèm plas Premier League la — yon reyalite ki fè Pochettino vre kontan. Li di se lespri ekip la ki pote siksè sa a epi li pa pran kredibilite pou tèt li. Avèk Tottenham ki bezwen yon viktwa enpòtan apre youn lèd kòmansman sezon an, Pochettino rekonèt ke match dimanch la emosyonèl anpil pou li. Li kenbe bon souvni ak Southampton epi li veye match la kòm yon rankont enpòtan pou li ak ekip li jodia.

article_content: On November 17, 2011, Prime Minister David Cameron addressed the Lord Mayor’s Banquet in London, describing the EU debt crisis as an opportunity for the UK to regain powers from the EU. Cameron warned that the EU was 'in peril' and criticized what he called 'pointless interference, rules and regulations,' voicing skepticism toward 'grand plans and utopian visions.' He vowed to reform the EU to better serve Britain's interests and said the EU had lost touch with citizens, especially while demanding budget increases during economic difficulties. German Chancellor Angela Merkel, meanwhile, called for a strengthened political and economic union in Europe, warning that if the euro failed, Europe would fail. Cameron maintained that leaving the EU would not be in Britain's interest due to key trade relationships, but advocated for a more flexible EU structure. Economic turmoil continued across Europe, as Italy paid an interest rate of 6.29% on government bonds and Spain’s yields exceeded 6%. Britain, by contrast, was increasingly seen as a safe haven by investors. Merkel resisted allowing the European Central Bank to further prop up the euro, focusing instead on stronger budgetary control and treaty changes to defend the union. Cameron faced pressure from MPs for a timetable to reclaim powers from Brussels and suggested that less should be decided at the EU level. Chancellor George Osborne sharply criticized the EU’s proposed financial transaction tax, labeling it a 'bullet aimed at the heart of London,' warning it could cost hundreds of thousands of jobs and damage the UK financial sector. Other prominent figures, including London Mayor Boris Johnson, Home Secretary Theresa May, Justice Secretary Kenneth Clarke, and Archbishop of Canterbury Dr Rowan Williams, also attended the banquet.
translated_content: Sou 17 Novanm 2011, Premye Minis David Cameron te pale nan Bankè Majistra Lond lan, kote li dekri kriz dèt Inyon Ewopeyen an kòm yon opòtinite pou Wayòm Ini reprann kèk pouvwa nan men Inyon an. Cameron te avèti ke Inyon Ewopeyen an 'an danje' epi li kritike sa li rele 'entèferans initil, règ ak regilasyon,' pandan li montre li sispèk sou 'gran plan ak vizyon utopik.' Li pwomèt pou refòme Inyon an pou li pi byen sèvi enterè Grann Bretay, epi li di Inyon an pèdi kontak ak sitwayen yo, sitou pandan li mande ogmantasyon bidjè lè gen pwoblèm ekonomik. Chanselye Alman, Angela Merkel, te mande ranfòsman inyon politik ak ekonomik an Ewòp, avèti ke si euro a echwe, Ewòp ap pèdi. Cameron tounen di ke sòti nan Inyon Ewopeyen an pa t ap bon pou enterè Grann Bretay akoz relasyon komès kle yo, men li te defann pou Inyon an vin pi fleksib. Toubiyon ekonomik la kontinye afekte Ewòp; Itali te peye to enterè 6.29% sou obligasyon leta, epi to enterè Espay depase 6%. Grann Bretay, toulède, vin wè kòm yon kote an sekirite pou envestisè yo. Merkel pa t vle Bank Santral Ewopeyen an ede plis euro a, mete aksan sou kontwòl bidjè pi solid ak chanjman nan trete yo pou defann inyon an. Cameron anba presyon pou bay yon plan pou reklame pouvwa nan men Brussels, epi li sijere plis desizyon ta dwe pran sou nivo nasyonal. Chanselye George Osborne te kritik frapant kont taks tranzaksyon finansye Inyon Ewopeyen pwopoze a, di li se yon 'boulèt ki vize kè Lond' epi avèti sa ka koute plizyè santèn milye travay epi domaje finans UK la. Lòt gwo pèsonalite tankou Majistra Lond Boris Johnson, Sèkretè Entèn Theresa May, Sèkretè Jistis Kenneth Clarke, ak Achèvèk Canterbury Dr Rowan Williams te prezan nan bankè a tou.

article_content: Sean "Diddy" Combs, music mogul and entrepreneur, attended the Billboard Music Awards in Las Vegas on May 15, 2022. A lawsuit filed by singer Cassie, whose real name is Casandra Ventura, alleging abuse by producer Sean "Diddy" Combs, has been settled, the artists announced Friday, just one day after it was filed. Attorney Douglas Wigdor, representing Cassie, stated that the parties reached a deal to their mutual satisfaction on Friday evening. No terms were disclosed, and no further statements are expected besides those from Ventura, Combs, and Wigdor. Ventura said: 'I have decided to resolve this matter amicably on terms that I have some level of control. I want to thank my family, fans, and lawyers for their unwavering support.' Combs also stated: 'We have decided to resolve this matter amicably. I wish Cassie and her family all the best. Love.' Ben Brafman, Combs’ attorney, did not immediately respond to a request for comment, but had said Thursday that Combs 'vehemently denies' the allegations. The lawsuit alleged that Combs involved Ventura in his high-profile, fast-paced, and drug-fueled lifestyle after she signed with his label in 2005, when she was 19 and he was 37. According to Ventura, now 37, Combs, now 54, began a pattern of abuse after their on-and-off relationship began in 2007. The lawsuit claimed Combs subjected Ventura to repeated physical abuse and coerced her into situations involving drugs and non-consensual acts. It was also alleged that in 2018, as Ventura tried to end their relationship, Combs forced entry into her Los Angeles home and raped her. The Associated Press generally does not name alleged sexual abuse victims unless they come forward publicly, as Ventura has. Combs is considered one of the most influential hip-hop producers and executives in the past thirty years. He founded Bad Boy Records, has three Grammy Awards, and has worked with artists like The Notorious B.I.G., Mary J. Blige, Usher, Lil Kim, Faith Evans, and 112. In 2023, Combs released his fifth studio album, 'The Love Album: Off the Grid,' his first in 17 years, which received two Grammy nominations. In September, New York City Mayor Eric Adams presented Combs with a ceremonial key to the city in Times Square. Combs was born in New York City and raised in Mount Vernon. Cassie became known for her hit single 'Me & U,' produced by Ryan Leslie, topping the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart in 2006. She has acted in projects such as 'Empire,' 'Step Up 2: The Streets,' and 'Spenser Confidential.' On Thursday, Brafman claimed Ventura demanded $30 million over six months, threatening to write a damaging book about her relationship with Combs. He described these demands as 'blatant blackmail' and said her resulting lawsuit was filled with 'baseless and outrageous lies.' Attorney Wigdor responded, stating that Combs tried to offer Ventura a large sum to prevent the lawsuit and that Ventura rejected efforts at silence, choosing instead to speak out for women who suffer in silence. Wigdor praised Ventura’s courage in his statement about the settlement, saying she deserves to be commended for speaking publicly.
translated_content: Sean "Diddy" Combs, gwo mogòl mizik ak antreprenè, te patisipe nan Billboard Music Awards nan Las Vegas 15 Me 2022. Yon pwosè ke chantez Cassie, ki vre non li se Casandra Ventura, te depoze kont pwodiktè Sean "Diddy" Combs akize li de abi epi yo deja regle l, dapre sa atis yo anonse Vandredi, jis yon jou apre yo te depoze l. Avoka Douglas Wigdor, ki reprezante Cassie, deklare ke yo jwenn yon akò ki satisfè tou de Vandrèdi aswè. Yo pa bay okenn pwennvi sou kondisyon akò a e pa gen lòt deklarasyon k ap fèt, eksepte sa ki soti bò Ventura, Combs, ak Wigdor. Ventura deklare: 'Mwen deside rezoud dosye sa an amoni sou tèm kote mwen gen kontwòl. M ap remèsye fanmi mwen, fanatik yo, ak avoka m pou sipò yo ki pa janm febli.' Combs deklare tou: 'Nou deside rezoud kesyon an an amoni. Mwen swete Cassie ak fanmi li tout sa ki pi bon. Lanmou.' Ben Brafman, avoka Combs, pa reponn imedyatman demann pou kòmantè, men li te deja di jedi ke Combs 'refize kategorikman' akizasyon yo. Pwosè a akize Combs te entegre Ventura nan vi li ki rapid, anwo, ak chaje ak dwòg, depi li te siyen l sou label li an 2005, lè Ventura te gen 19 an epi li menm te gen 37. Dapre Ventura, kounye a li gen 37 an, Combs (kounye a 54 an) te kòmanse abize li depi relasyon a te kòmanse on/off an 2007. Pwosè a pale de abi fizik repete ak kontrain sou dwòg ak zak seksyèl san konsantman. Yo deklare tou ke an 2018, pandan Ventura t ap eseye mete fen nan relasyon an, Combs te fòse antre lakay li nan Los Angeles epi vyole li. Associated Press anjeneral pa bay non viktim abi seksyèl eksepte si yo fè chwa pou sa an piblik, jan Ventura te fè sa. Combs konsidere kòm youn nan pi enpòtan pwodiktè ak lidè hip-hop 30 dènye ane yo. Li fonde Bad Boy Records, genyen twa Grammy epi li te travay ak atis tankou The Notorious B.I.G., Mary J. Blige, Usher, Lil Kim, Faith Evans ak 112. An 2023, Combs lage senkyèm albòm li, 'The Love Album: Off the Grid,' premye depi 17 lane, ki resevwa de nominasyon Grammy. Nan mwa septanm, Majistra New York Eric Adams remèt Combs yon kle onorè pou vil la nan Times Square. Combs fèt nan New York City epi leve nan Mount Vernon. Cassie te vin konnen ak premye gwo mizik li 'Me & U', ke Ryan Leslie pwodui, ki te premye sou Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs an 2006. Li te aji nan plizyè pwojè tankou 'Empire', 'Step Up 2: The Streets', ak 'Spenser Confidential.' Jedi, Brafman di Ventura te mande $30 milyon pandan sis mwa, menase pou ekri yon liv ki ta fè Combs mal. Li deklare demann sa yo te 'chantaj klè' epi li di pwosè li a te gen 'manti san baz ak eksajere'. Avoka Wigdor reponn pou di Combs te eseye ofri Ventura yon gwo kantite lajan pou evite pwosè a, epi Ventura te rejte tout efò pou silans li. Li pito pale piblikman an favè tout fanm ki soufri an silans. Wigdor salye kouraj Ventura nan deklarasyon li sou akò a, li di li merite onè pou jan li te pale ak piblik la.

article_content:
Spotify has introduced a new hub for artist merchandise, allowing fans to discover and purchase items such as T-shirts, vinyl records, and unique pieces like a brass Lana Del Rey lighter. This latest initiative continues Spotify's efforts to integrate merchandise shopping into its platform—a priority for artists who use the streaming service. Merchandise offerings began with Spotify’s 2021 partnership with Shopify, and gradual updates have improved the experience since then.

Currently, users can browse items within the Spotify app, but actual purchases are completed on external artist merchandise stores. Spotify does not take a commission on these sales, but making merchandise more visible serves both artists—who often earn little from streaming—and Spotify, which wants to keep artists satisfied with the platform. As of now, discovering merch is easiest through the ‘Merch’ tab on an artist’s individual page.

Some users report that the new hub is not yet appearing in app search results and is only accessible via a press release link. A Spotify spokesperson stated they are looking into this accessibility issue.

Spotify lanse yon nouvo seksyon pou machandiz atis yo, kote fanatik yo ka dekouvri epi achte pwodwi tankou T-shirt, vinil, ak atik inik tankou briquet kwiv Lana Del Rey la. Inisyativ sa a kontinye efò Spotify pou entegre achte machandiz sou platfòm li a—yon priyorite pou atis ki sèvi ak sèvis la. Machandiz sou Spotify te kòmanse depi patenarya ak Shopify an 2021, epi lapwochen yo kontinye amelyore eksperyans lan.

Kounye a, itilizatè yo ka chèche machandiz nan aplikasyon an, men pou achte yo oblije vizite boutik eksteryè atis la. Spotify pa pran okenn komisyon sou lavant sa yo, men mete machandiz yo pi vizib ede atis yo—ki souvan pa fè anpil lajan sou mizik yo ap difize—epi ede Spotify kenbe bon relasyon ak atis yo sou platfòm la. Pou kounye a, pi fasil jwenn machandiz la se ale sou tab ‘Merch’ sou paj atis yo.

Gen itilizatè ki di nouvo seksyon machandiz la poko parèt sou paj rechèch aplikasyon an epi li aksesib sèlman atravè lyen nòt pou laprès la. Yon potpawòl Spotify fè konnen yap verifye pwoblèm sa.

article_content: A research team at Boston’s Brigham and Women's Hospital has developed an innovative wound adhesive, inspired by the parasitic worm Pomphorhynchus laevis. This advanced bandage mimics the worm’s unique method of attachment by using microneedles with swelling tips to anchor dressings or skin grafts securely. Under the guidance of Dr. Jeffrey Karp, the scientists engineered a patch lined with cone-shaped microneedles. Once placed on the skin, the needles gently pierce the tissue, after which their tips swell upon exposure to moisture—firmly holding the graft in place. Importantly, this process can be reversed, enabling easy, less traumatic removal. Compared to conventional stitches and staples, this adhesive is noted for providing three times the holding strength and lowering the risk of infection. Its special design helps it grip soft tissues with minimal damage. The project’s leaders, including Dr. Karp and Dr. Scott Somers, attribute their success to copying nature’s solutions—specifically, the worm’s ability to cling tightly to its host. Dr. Seung Yun Yang points out that the microneedle tips swell only when wet, and the rest of the needle remains sturdy, making the patch efficient and safe. Another promising aspect is the patch's potential to deliver therapeutic agents—like antibiotics or healing compounds—straight to the wound. Dr. Bohdan Pomahac, director of the hospital’s Plastic Surgery Transplantation and Burn Centre, believes this device could be a breakthrough in both securing grafts and administering needed medications. Experts on the project celebrate the collaboration that enabled this advancement, predicting it will revolutionize wound care by reducing patient trauma and infection risks.
translated_content: Yon ekip chèchè nan lopital Brigham and Women's Hospital nan Boston devlope yon nouvo adezif medikal ki enspire pa vè parazit Pomphorhynchus laevis. Plas la modèn sa a imite jan vè a kole ak ògàn li, lè li itilize mikronwèl ak tèt ki ka gonfle pou kenbe gref oswa bandaj byen kole sou blesi. Avèk dirèksyon Doktè Jeffrey Karp, syantis yo kreye yon patch ak mikronwèl ki gen fòm kòn. Lè w ap mete l sou po moun, mikronwèl yo antre dousman epi tèt yo gonfle ak imidite, konsa yo kenbe gref la an plas. Sa ki enpòtan, pwosesis sa a pèmèt ou retire patch la fasilman epi san twòp doulè. Konpare ak koud oswa grapèt estanda, patch sa a gen plis pase twa fwa plis fòs epi li ogmante sekirite, paske risk enfeksyon diminye. Konsepsyon inik li pèmèt li kole ak tisi mou san li pa detwi tisi a. Lidè pwojè a tankou Doktè Karp ak Doktè Scott Somers mete aksan sou fason pwodui a enspire pa lanati—presizeman fason vè parazit la kole ak tèm li. Doktè Seung Yun Yang eksplike tèt mikronwèl yo gonfle lè yo mouye, men baz la rete solid, sa ki rann patch la efikas ak san danje. Yon lòt avantaj se kapasite li pou bay medikaman dirèkteman sou blesi a, tankou antibyotik oswa medikaman ki ede geri. Doktè Bohdan Pomahac, direktè Transplantasyon Chiriji Plastik ak Sant Boule nan lopital la, panse aparèy sa a kapab revolisyone tretman blesi yo. Manm ekip la selebre kolaborasyon sa a epi yo kwè patch sa pral amelyore swen blesi, toutotan li diminye doulè pasyan ak risk pou yo enfekte.

article_content: As global phenomenon BTS embarks on a temporary hiatus to fulfill their mandatory military service, they've given their devoted ARMY an exclusive behind-the-scenes glimpse of their remarkable journey in the upcoming docuseries, 'BTS Monuments: Beyond The Star.' Premiering on Disney+ on December 20, this eight-part series offers an intimate look at how the group evolved into "21st-century pop icons." The newly released main trailer previews an emotional experience, showing everything from BTS's early training days to their recent major achievements. The trailer candidly presents the members’ struggles, with RM stating, "We worked our tails off, life was difficult," while Suga adds some humor by admitting, "I was going to run away, for real." These moments reveal the group’s determination and resilience. Despite obstacles, the trailer also highlights BTS's excitement during award ceremonies and their monumental performances. Suga describes the thrill of performing to huge crowds, emphasizing that reaching such heights was their ultimate goal. The docuseries, curated by BTS’s label Hybe, is designed to provide an in-depth account of the hurdles the group has overcome to reach global success. Rather than focusing solely on their fame, the series gives an unfiltered look at their daily lives and personal reflections. The trailer shows their reactions to canceled concerts during the pandemic, capturing moments of uncertainty. The release of the docuseries coincides with the official start of the military enlistment process for RM, Jimin, Jungkook, and V. Korean media report that these members, who have been busy with solo projects, are expected to begin their service in South Korea on December 11 or 12. The trailer serves as an emotional prelude to this new chapter for both the group and fans. During the hiatus, which is expected to last until 2025, the BTS members have pursued individual projects. Jimin, Jungkook, V, and RM have each released solo work: Jimin’s Production Diary, Jungkook’s Golden, V’s Layover, and RM’s Indigo have kept fans engaged during the group’s absence. 'BTS Monuments: Beyond The Star' is more than a documentary—it’s a heartfelt message to fans, assuring them that even during the hiatus, the connection between BTS and ARMY remains strong. The series promises to reveal untold stories, struggles, and victories of the seven members who have become global icons, establishing a lasting legacy in the music world. Mark your calendars for December 20 and prepare for an emotional journey with BTS.

Dokimantè a ap kòmanse sou Disney+ 20 Desanm, epi li se yon seri wityèm epizòd ki montre kijan gwoup la tounen 'ikon pop 21yèm syèk la.' Manm gwoup la pataje difikilte yo; RM di, 'Nou te travay di, lavi te difisil,' epi Suga mete lòd ak imè: 'Mwen te panse kouri ale, serye.' Pawòl sa yo montre rezistans ak detèminasyon yo. Trelè a montre jan yo te reponn ak anilasyon konsè pandan pandemi an, ak moman kote tout bagay te sanble kanpe. Dat pwogram lan ap sòti menm lè RM, Jimin, Jungkook, ak V ap kòmanse sèvis militè. Medya Koreyen konfime ke manm sa yo, malgre yo te trè okipe ak pwojè solo, ap antre nan sèvis militè an Kore di Sid 11 oswa 12 Desanm. Trelè a sèvi kòm yon entwodiksyon emosyonèl ak nouvo etap sa a pou BTS ak fanatik yo. Pandan poz la ki ka kontinye rive 2025, manm gwoup la kontinye lanse pwojè solo. article_content: Dr. Karina Ochis | Gen Z Expert | Professor of Leadership and Management | Executive Consultant | Speaker | Author.  While the world of diplomacy might seem distant from the business arena, leaders can benefit greatly from diplomatic methods. If Elon Musk’s unconventional management or Mark Zuckerberg’s relaxed leadership aren’t your style and you prefer more structured approaches, adopting the practices of seasoned diplomats could be the answer.  What is diplomacy? Diplomatic etiquette refers to rules and traditions guiding how diplomats, officials, and leaders represent their countries globally. Diplomats maintain professionalism and respect to foster positive relationships and advance interests. Adopting diplomatic etiquette can enhance your leadership in several ways:  1. Etiquette: Always present your best self! Etiquette is a set of social norms guiding appropriate behavior. Humans are naturally social, so following these norms is important. Practicing good etiquette shows refinement and leaves a strong impression. It instructs on proper communication, movement, and interaction, all essential for making memorable first impressions. How you interact with superiors, peers, and friends reflects your upbringing and character, helping earn respect.  2. Negotiations: Master the art! Negotiations bring together different parties to reach agreement. One side presents their position, and the other responds, aiming for a mutually acceptable outcome. Skilled negotiators prepare by understanding the other side’s strengths, weaknesses, and possible counterarguments.  3. Conflict management: Address issues constructively. Conflict stems from differing views, goals, or desires and is a normal part of any organization. Managing it requires awareness, rational thinking, and respectful engagement. Steps include identifying the conflict, exploring solutions, and agreeing on a way forward.  4. Workwear: Dress to impress! Like fur or feathers in animals, clothing shapes first impressions for humans. People often judge us initially by our appearance, followed by our behavior and character.  5. Conversation: Communicate effectively. Balanced exchanges are central to great conversation but can easily become one-sided. Being a good listener is as vital as being a good speaker. Dominating discussions tends to leave a poor impression.  6. Greetings: First impressions matter. Use thoughtful, sincere greetings. If you already know about someone before meeting, expressing genuine pleasure is appropriate (e.g., "I am delighted to meet you"). Avoid generic or insincere phrases like "pleased to meet you" unless you truly feel it.  7. Cultural awareness: Recognize your assumptions. Culture shapes our attitudes and actions. Each person’s background influences perceptions and interactions. For example, Eastern cultures may emphasize social relationships, while many Western cultures value individuality. Awareness of these differences is key to global leadership.  Conclusion: Diplomats live by rules—formal and informal—and business leaders should as well, following global and local guidelines and respecting cultural norms. Despite some modern informality, traditional protocols are still crucial, especially in places like Asia and the Middle East, where business conduct can outweigh the deal itself. translated_content: Dr. Karina Ochis | Espè sou jenerasyon Z | Pwofesè Lidèchip ak Jesyon | Konsiltan Egzekitif | Oratè | Otè.  Menm si mond diplomasi a ka parèt lwen zafè biznis, lidè yo ka genyen anpil avantaj si yo sèvi ak metòd diplomat yo. Si stil dirijan Elon Musk ki pa suiv reg oswa stil rilaks Mark Zuckerberg pa fè sans pou ou, e ou pito apwòch ki plis estriktire, sa diplomat ki gen eksperyans yo itilize ka bon pou ou.  Kisa diplomasi ye? Etikèt diplomatik la se sòti yon seri règ ak tradisyon ki gide kijan diplomat, ofisyèl ak lidè reprezante peyi yo entènasyonalman. Diplomat toujou demontre pwofesyonalis ak respè pou bati bon relasyon ak reyalize objektif yo. Mete etikèt diplomatik nan fason w dirije ka amelyore lidèchip ou:  1. Etikèt: Toujou prezante tèt ou pi byen! Etikèt se lansanble règleman sosyal ki gide konpòtman ki apwopriye. Lè ou pratike bon etikèt, sa montre ou se yon moun rafine epi li ede w kreye bon enpresyon. Jan w kominike, jan w deplase, ak jan w konpòte ou enpòtan pou premye enpresyon. Fason ou aji ak chèf, zanmi ak kolèg montre karaktè ak edikasyon ou, li ede w jwenn respè.  2. Negosyasyon: Vin ekspè! Negosyasyon se kote plizyè pati ap chèche jwenn yon akò. Chak moun ekspoze pozisyon pa yo, epi lòt la reponn, ak objektif jwenn yon teren dantant. Yon bon negosyatè ap toujou prepare, konnen avantaj ak feblès lòt bò a, epi reflechi sou posib kontra-argument.  3. Jesyon konfli: Rezoud dezakò ak entèlijans! Konfli ka vini ak opinyon, objektif oswa anvi diferan; se yon pati nòmal nan tout òganizasyon. Jere konfli mande konsyantizasyon, reflechi byen epi trete lòt yo ak respè. Idantifye pwoblèm nan, chèche solisyon epi mete tout moun dako.  4. Abiman travay: Abiye pou montre ou se lidè! Rad enpòtan paske jan moun wè w depann de sa. Premye jijman sou ou fèt dapre jan w abiye, apre sa yo gade konpòtman ak karaktè w.  5. Konvèsasyon: Kominike ak ekilib! Yon bon konvèsasyon mande ekilib, pa janm kite tèt ou pale pou kont ou. Koute lòt moun enpòtan menm jan ak pale. Si ou twò domine konvèsasyon, ou ka kite move enpresyon.  6. Salitasyon: Premye enpresyon enpòtan! Itilize salitasyon sensè ak reflechi. Si w deja tande pale de yon moun anvan, eksprime kontantman ou lè w rankontre li (“M kontan anpil rankontre w”). Evite fraz jeneral tankou “m kontan rankontre w” si ou pa santi li vrèman.  7. Konsyans kiltirèl: Fè atansyon ak préjugé ou yo! Chak moun soti nan yon kilti epi sa enfliyanse jan yo panse ak aji. Pa egzanp, nan kilti lès moun plis wè tèt yo kòm yon pati nan sosyete, pandan kilti oksidantal voye je sou endividyèl. Konprann diferans sa yo esansyèl pou dirije avèk siksè.  Konklizyon: Diplomatik swiv règ formal ak enfòmal; lidè biznis ta dwe fè menm jan an. Swiv règ ak kilti lokal pou reyisi nan afè entènasyonal. Menm si biznis modèn sanble plis ouvè, tradisyon ak etikèt toujou gen anpil pwa, espesyalman nan rejyon tankou Azi ak Mwayen Oryan kote fason ou negosye gen plis valè pase kontra a menm.  Forbes Coaches Council se yon gwoup sele pou lidè ak kouè biznis ak karyè. Èske w kalifye?

article_content: Chris Packham, presenter of BBC's Autumnwatch, recently stated that feeding urban foxes is generally fine as long as it’s not done too often. He highlighted that urban foxes are frequently misunderstood and unfairly blamed, noting that incidents of foxes harming people are much less common than problems involving domestic dogs. Packham challenged popular stories about foxes behaving unusually in homes—such as climbing stairs or letting people pick them up—saying these are mostly overstated. He believes that such stories create unnecessary fear. According to Packham, with some 33,000 urban foxes across the UK, humans and foxes can easily share urban environments. He advises against feeding foxes by hand or every day, as it can encourage them to overly rely on people. Occasional feeding from a distance, he suggests, allows for safe wildlife observation. He also pointed out that Western nations’ tendency to waste food has contributed to an increase in urban foxes. Packham sees foxes as a reflection of excess food waste, especially when contrasted with global hunger. In the upcoming Autumnwatch series, airing October 29 on BBC2 and in partnership with the University of Brighton, Packham will document two families of urban foxes to show how understanding fox behavior can help people live peacefully alongside them.

A new report has called for major reforms to Ofsted's school inspection system, stating that inspectors should not be present in classrooms and describing the current approach as 'in need of a big change.' The Beyond Ofsted inquiry, led by former Schools Minister Lord Knight and funded by the National Education Union, recommends a 'transformational' shift in how school inspections are conducted. Instead of external inspections, the report suggests that schools be responsible for developing their own improvement plans, accountable to parents and local communities. 

Ofsted, however, defends the current system, arguing that inspections are necessary to maintain high education standards. 'Children only get one chance at education, and inspection helps make sure that standards are high for all,' a spokesperson said. 

The inquiry asserts that Ofsted has become 'toxic' and is 'not fit for purpose.' It also calls for the end of brief, single-word judgements like 'outstanding' or 'inadequate,' suggesting that these are too simplistic to represent whole schools. Instead, the inquiry recommends narrative-style judgements, echoing recent findings from the Institute for Public Policy Research.

The recent suicide of head teacher Ruth Perry has drawn attention to the pressures Ofsted inspections can place on school staff, sparking a broader debate about the agency's role. Ofsted is responsible for inspecting all educational institutions for young people in England, including schools, nurseries, and childminders.

Further recommendations include limiting Ofsted's direct contact with schools and introducing external 'improvement partners,' such as experienced school leaders, to help schools with their self-evaluations. Annual safeguarding checks would be conducted by a new national body. The inquiry, carried out by University College London academics, was based on surveys, focus groups, international comparisons, and research.

Lord Knight highlighted in his report that Ofsted is 'under-resourced' for the significant responsibilities it faces, with inspections shifting from comprehensive, team-based approaches to shorter, less in-depth reviews. The report recommends pausing regular Ofsted inspections while proposed changes are implemented.

Ofsted responds that 'nine out of 10' schools feel inspections are helpful to their improvement. 'We always want inspections to be a constructive experience for school staff,' the spokesperson noted, adding that their inspectors are all current or former school leaders who understand the pressures of the job. 

The Department for Education states that Ofsted plays a 'crucial role' in ensuring students receive a high-quality education and are kept safe, and points to 89% of schools now being rated good or outstanding.

article_content: Police in north-west London took swift action after receiving a silent 999 emergency call. Tracing the address, officers arrived at the flat but, receiving no response at the door, broke it down to investigate. To their relief and amusement, they discovered the source of the call—Bruce, a pedigree Singapura kitten left alone while his owners were at work. Bruce had been playing with the house telephone and accidentally dialed 999 while pawing at the buttons. The kitten was found by officers hiding in a wardrobe. James Cocksedge, 33, a sound engineer, returned home to find police outside his flat and the front door off its hinges. He explained that Bruce has always been fascinated by the telephone, often rushing to it when it rings. The officers informed Mr. Cocksedge they had received an emergency call from his address, and despite a neighbor reassuring them that nothing seemed wrong, the police felt they could not take any risks. Cocksedge expressed understanding of the police actions, recognizing they were doing their job, though the incident left him with an unexpected bill for a new door. A Metropolitan Police spokesperson confirmed that police attended the address on October 17, noting that a cat was referenced in their report, and emphasized that all abandoned or silent emergency calls are treated seriously.

article_content: MINNEAPOLIS – Shipping on the St. Lawrence Seaway has come to a halt due to a strike, stopping exports of grain and other goods from Canada and the U.S. via the Great Lakes to global markets. About 360 Unifor union members in Ontario and Quebec began striking early Sunday over wages in their dispute with the St. Lawrence Seaway Management Corporation. The strike has closed 13 locks between Lake Erie and Montreal, trapping vessels within the Great Lakes system and blocking additional ships from entering. The St. Lawrence Seaway and Great Lakes make up a network of locks, canals, rivers, and lakes stretching over 2,300 miles (3,700 kilometers) from the Atlantic Ocean to the western end of Lake Superior. Last year, this system moved cargo valued at over $12 billion (nearly $17 billion Canadian). Ships using the seaway include both oceangoing vessels, known as “salties,” and “lakers” that operate within the lakes. It is the first time since 1968 that a strike has completely shut down this major shipping route. Before the walkout, the union stated both sides were still ''1,000 nautical miles apart on wages'' after several months of talks. By Tuesday, in the strike’s third day, the Canadian government directed both parties to resume negotiations Friday with a federal mediator in Toronto. U.S. officials are also urging a quick settlement. "We have grain that feeds the world, salt for winter road safety, and iron ore for steelmaking—all currently stopped," said Jason Card, spokesman for the Chamber of Marine Commerce in Ottawa. Management asked the Canadian government to pass a law allowing grain ships to transit the system, but the request has been declined. Jean Aubry-Morin, the Seaway Management Corporation’s vice president of external relations, said Thursday negotiations have been slow but expressed hope for a fair agreement. While Unifor recently secured major pay raises from automakers, Aubry-Morin noted that the nonprofit management company cannot match those increases. Union officials did not reply to requests for comment but stated, “Unifor will join mediation and continue supporting members while talks go on.” Management is aware of about 115 vessels stranded on the St. Lawrence River and Lake Ontario, though numbers for incoming ships are uncertain. The shutdown’s economic impact is estimated at $110 million US ($153 million Canadian) per day. MarineTraffic.com showed many ships still inside the system Thursday. The Welland Canal in Ontario, now closed, is a key bottleneck. Roughly 25 salties and lakers are anchored outside Lake Ontario and Lake Erie. The U.S. Navy’s USS Marinette, due to leave Cleveland Monday, is also delayed. Five ships are stuck at Thunder Bay, Ontario, and two on the Detroit River; they cannot move past Lake Erie until shipping resumes. Shipments of materials like iron ore and coal within the four Great Lakes from Superior to Erie are not affected. John Jamian, Port of Detroit director of operations, said the strike has already delayed eight ships destined for Detroit with steel and cement cargoes. Jamian added, “Each ship carries significant tonnage, and these ships are simply not entering the system. One is still in Europe with Detroit-bound cargo, waiting.” Officials in the Twin Ports of Duluth, Minnesota, and Superior, Wisconsin are also concerned. The bulk carrier Isadora left Duluth for Algeria and reached Lake Erie, but cannot proceed. Jason Hron, spokesman for the Duluth Seaway Port Authority, emphasized that the strike hits during peak harvest season and disrupts the entire seaway shipping system. According to Hron, more oceangoing ships are expected to arrive on the lakes in the next few days, but their next steps are uncertain. He added, “North America’s main inland trade corridor should not be used as leverage in a labor dispute. Port officials and unions are urging the Canadian government to intervene and restore shipping operations as soon as possible.”
translated_content: MINNEAPOLIS – Tout transpò sou St. Lawrence Seaway sispann akoz yon grèv, sa mete fren sou ekspòtasyon sereyal ak lòt machandiz soti Kanada ak Etazini atravè Great Lakes pou ale sou mache mondyal. Apeprè 360 manm sendika Unifor nan Ontario ak Quebec te kòmanse grèv la dimanch bonè pou mande pi bon salè kont St. Lawrence Seaway Management Corporation. Grèv la fèmen 13 eklis ant Lake Erie ak Montreal, sa ki fè plizyè bato bloke nan sistèm Great Lakes la epi anpeche lòt bato antre. St. Lawrence Seaway ak Great Lakes fòme yon rezo eklis, kanal, rivyè ak lak ki long plis pase 2,300 mil (3,700 kilomèt) soti Oseyan Atlantik la rive nan tèt lwès Lake Superior. Ane pase, sistèm sa a te transpòte plis pase $12 milya (prèske $17 milya Kanadyen) an machandiz. Bato ki sèvi ak pasaj sa a genyen “salties” ki soti lanmè epi “lakers” ki navige sèlman nan lak yo. Se premye fwa depi 1968 yon grèv fèmen tout wout machandiz enpòtan sa a nèt. Anvan grèv la, sendika a te di de pati yo toujou '1,000 mil maren lwen sou salè' apre plizyè mwa negosyasyon. Nan twazyèm jou grèv la, gouvènman Kanadyen an te mande de pati yo reprann negosyasyon vandredi ak yon medyatè federal nan Toronto. Otorite Ameriken ap fè presyon pou jwenn yon solisyon rapid. "Nou gen sereyal pou nouri mond lan, sèl pou sekirite wout sezon fredi, ak min fè pou fè asye—tout yo bloke kounye a," dapre Jason Card, pòt pawòl Chamber of Marine Commerce nan Ottawa. Direksyon an mande gouvènman Kanadyen an pase yon lwa pou pèmèt bato sereyal yo travèse sistèm nan, men demann lan pa te aksepte. Jean Aubry-Morin, vis prezidan relasyon ekstèn pou Seaway Management Corporation, di jedi ke negosyasyon yo ap pran tan men li gen espwa pou jwenn yon akò ki jis. Pandan Unifor sot jwenn gwo ogmantasyon salè ak konpayi machin yo, Aubry-Morin fè remake ke konpayi a se yon òganizasyon san pwofi epi li pa ka peye menm jan ak endistri oto a. Dirijan sendika yo pa reponn demann pou pale men deklare, "Unifor pral ale pou medyasyon epi kontinye soutni manm sou liy grèv pandan negosyasyon ap fèt." Jesyon konnen gen apeprè 115 bato bloke nan St. Lawrence River ak Lake Ontario, men yo pa konnen konbyen lòt bato ap tann. Enpak ekonomik la estime a $110 milyon ameriken ($153 milyon Kanadyen) chak jou. Sit MarineTraffic.com te montre anpil bato toujou andedan sistèm lan jedi. Welland Canal la nan Ontario, ki fèmen, se yon gwo blokis. Gen anviwon 25 “salties” ak “lakers” ankre deyò antre Lake Ontario ak Lake Erie. USS Marinette pa Lame Navy Ameriken an te sipoze kite Cleveland lendi, men li bloke tou. Gen senk bato nan Thunder Bay, Ontario, ak de sou Detroit River; yo pa ka depase Lake Erie jiskaske transpò rekomanse. Livrezon min fè ak chabon ant kat Great Lakes soti Superior pou rive Erie pa afekte. John Jamian, direktè operasyon Port of Detroit, di grèv la deja fè uit bato ki te vin Detroit ak kago asye ak siman rete tann. "Chak bato pote anpil tòn machandiz, epi yo pa rantre nan sistèm lan. Youn toujou ann Ewòp ak kago pou Detroit, l ap atann," Jamian ajoute. Otorite nan Duluth, Minnesota ak Superior, Wisconsin konsène tou. Bato Isadora te kite Duluth pou Aljeri, li rive Lake Erie, men pa ka pase. Jason Hron, pòt pawòl Duluth Seaway Port Authority, mete aksan sou grèv la rive pandan sezon rekòt la epi li deregle tout sistèm lan. Dapre Hron, gen kèk lòt zouti ki pral antre nan lak yo byento, men pa klè ki sa k ap rive apre. Li ajoute, "Kòwoidò komès prensipal enteryè Amerik di Nò pa dwe sèvi kòm zouti nan konfli travay. Dirijan pò ak sendika ap mande gouvènman Kanadyen an entèvni pou reprann transpò nòmal pi vit posib."

article_content: Startups are typically grouped based on how they operate: business-to-business (B2B), business-to-consumer (B2C), and business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C). Recently, B2B2C tech startups have emerged as strong players in bridging companies and customers, promising substantial growth and unique advantages. The B2B2C approach allows startups to diversify income by reaching both businesses and end-users. This not only boosts growth but also reduces dependency on a single market. By teaming up with established companies, these startups increase their credibility, offer more convenience to customers, and access ready-made consumer bases—resulting in faster user adoption. B2B2C startups can zero in on what they do best thanks to partnerships, and their collaborative model helps them break into untapped markets and address unmet consumer needs. This positions them as innovators ready to reshape the digital landscape. Several B2B2C tech startups are making notable waves: Coho AI is advancing the SaaS sector with a platform that simplifies data-driven decisions through AI-powered cohort analysis. It helps businesses understand customer journeys and identify upselling opportunities, streamlining the process for both SaaS and B2C companies. With its focus on product-led growth and AI insights, Coho AI is paving the way for smarter business strategies. Bright.md is transforming healthcare delivery with its asynchronous telehealth solutions. By providing virtual care for non-urgent conditions, it saves time for patients and providers, lowers emergency visits, and cuts administrative work. Patients benefit from faster interviews and reduced healthcare costs, making medical care more accessible and convenient. dv01 addresses inefficiencies in structured finance. The company standardizes loan data and offers integrated analytics, replacing outdated systems and enabling more transparent and effective decision making. With a broad client base, dv01 is modernizing financial markets with comprehensive tech and data solutions. Mahmee is redefining maternity care by offering a comprehensive subscription service that covers pregnancy and postpartum needs. Their 24/7 support team, which includes healthcare professionals from various fields, ensures tailored and continuous care—available both virtually and in person. Clients enjoy significant savings and a smoother experience during maternity. Scipher Medicine tackles the issue of wasted spending on ineffective prescriptions by analyzing patients' molecular data. Their proprietary blood test, supported by extensive research, guides personalized therapy, helping patients get the right drugs from the outset. Scipher Medicine continues to improve its platform and expand its impact on autoimmune disease treatment. Ultimately, B2B2C startups connect companies and consumers in ways that enrich experiences, simplify processes, and improve outcomes. Their recent rise is fueled by tangible advantages for all parties involved. As technology advances, these trailblazers are expected to drive even bigger changes in how businesses and customers interact in the future. Featured Image Credit: Photo by Canva Studio/Pexels.
translated_content: Nou souvan klase startup yo selon fason yo fonksyone: business to business (B2B), business to consumer (B2C), ak business to business to consumer (B2B2C). Dènyèman, startup teknoloji B2B2C yo ap parèt tankou gwo jwè k ap mete ansanm konpayi ak kliyan, ak anpil potansyèl pou kwasans ak avantaj inik. Modèl B2B2C la pèmèt startup yo divèsifye sous revni yo paske yo sèvi konpayi ak konsomatè yo. Sa pa sèlman bay plis kwasans, men li redwi depandans sou yon sèl mache. Gras ak patenarya ak gwo konpayi, startup sa yo ranfòse kredibilite yo, fasilite aksè kliyan yo ak yon baz konsomatè ki deja egziste, epi akselere adopsyon sèvis la. Startup B2B2C yo ka konsantre sou fòs yo gras ak patenarya, epi modèl kolaborasyon sa a ede yo louvri nouvo mache epi reponn bezwen ki pa sech. Sa mete yo nan pozisyon inovatè pou reyalize chanjman nan mond dijital la. Men kèk startup B2B2C nan teknoloji k ap fè diferans: Coho AI ap revolisyone sektè SaaS la ak yon platfòm ki itilize analiz kohòt ak entèlijans atifisyèl pou pran desizyon. Li ede biznis konprann chemen kliyan an ak dekouvri opòtinite pou vann plis. Avèk konsantre sou inovasyon, Coho AI ap mennen nan estrateji biznis pi entelijan. Bright.md ap chanje fason swen sante fèt ak solisyon telemedsin asenkron li yo. Li permet tretman pou kondisyon ki pa ijan sou entènèt, redwi vizit nan ijans, ak senplifye administrasyon. Pasyan benefisye de konsiltasyon rapid ak depans swen yo bese. dv01 ap rezoud pwoblèm nan finans estriktire. Li estandadize done prè epi bay analiz entegre pou transparans ak bon desizyon. Avèk anpil kliyan, dv01 ap modernize sektè finans ak solisyon teknoloji. Mahmee ap transfòme swen matènite ak yon sèvis abònman konplè ki kouvri bezwen gwosès ak aprè akouchman. Ekip la, ki gen tout kalite pwofesyonèl sante, disponib 24/7 swa sou entènèt oswa an fas. Kliyan sove anpil epi jwenn yon eksperyans matènite san stres. Scipher Medicine ap adrese depans gaspiyaj sou preskripsyon ki pa bay rezilta, pa analize done molekilè moun yo. Tès san espesyal yo, soutni pa anpil rechèch, ede jwenn terapi ki vrèman ap travay. Scipher Medicine ap agrandi enpak li nan tretman maladi otoiminitè. Anfen, startup B2B2C yo bati pon ant konpayi ak konsomatè pou amelyore eksperyans, senplifye pwosesis, epi jwenn pi bon rezilta. Avanse teknoloji ap mennen inovasyon plis sou relasyon biznis ak kliyan nan tan kap vini. Kredi Foto: Canva Studio/Pexels.
post_content: B2B2C tech startups are shaking up the digital world, bridging businesses and customers for faster growth, smarter solutions, and better experiences! Companies like Coho AI, Bright.md, dv01, Mahmee, and Scipher Medicine are changing the game. The future looks even brighter! #Startups #Innovation

article_content: A cargo ship named Raptor, registered in the Comoros, sank early Sunday in stormy seas near the Greek island of Lesbos. Authorities report that 13 crew members, including four Indians, are missing while one Egyptian crew member has been rescued. The vessel, carrying 6,000 tonnes of salt, was on route from Alexandria, Egypt, to Istanbul, Turkey. The Raptor had a crew of 14—eight Egyptians, four Indians, and two Syrians. According to the coast guard, the ship reported mechanical problems at 7 a.m., sent a distress signal, and then disappeared about 8 kilometers southwest of Lesbos. Rescue efforts involve eight merchant ships, two helicopters, and a Greek navy frigate, though rough seas have made it difficult for three coast guard vessels to reach the area. Strong northwesterly winds exceeding 80 kilometers per hour are impacting rescue operations, and it is believed that the heavily loaded ship took on water due to powerful waves, causing it to list and sink.
translated_content: Yon bato kago ki rele Raptor, ki te anrejistre nan Komò, koule bonè dimanch maten nan lanmè ki t ap bouje fò toupre zile Lesbos, nan Lagrès. Otorite yo fè konnen 13 manm ekipaj yo, enkli kat Endyen, disparèt, pandan yonn ki se yon Ejipsyen te sove. Bato a t ap transpòte 6,000 tòn sèl, li t ap soti Alexandria, Ejip pou li ale Istanbul, Lasiri. Raptor te gen 14 ekipaj — uit Ejipsyen, kat Endyen, ak de Siryen. Dapre Gad Kòt la, bato a te rapòte li te gen pwoblèm mekanik a 7è nan maten, te voye yon siyal ijans epi pita, li te disparèt apeprè 8 kilomèt nan sidwès Lesbos. Efò sekou ap fèt ak uit bato komèsyal, de elikoptè ak yon frègat marin grèk, men move lanmè a fè twa bato Gad Kòt yo gen difikilte pou antre nan zòn nan. Van nòdwès fò, ki depase 80 kilomèt pa èdtan, ap anpeche operasyon sekou yo, epi yo panse bato ki chaje a te ranmase dlo akòz gwo vag yo, sa ki te fè li panche epi koule.
post_content: A cargo ship, Raptor, sank near Lesbos, Greece amid strong storms. 13 crew, including four Indians, are still missing. Only one member was rescued so far. Huge search efforts underway! 🌊🚢 #BreakingNews #Lesbos #SeaRescue

article_content: Super Eagles captain Ahmed Musa delivered a speech in Lagos on Friday during the ceremony unveiling the team’s ‘Let’s Do It Again’ mantra, as they aim for a fourth AFCON title in Ivory Coast next year. He acknowledged the privilege of working under former coaches Stephen Keshi, Daniel Amokachi, and Samson Siasia, as well as his former teammate and captain Joseph Yobo, expressing gratitude for their encouragement. Musa recalled being the youngest player on the team, often sharing accommodation with Yobo, and highlighted his simultaneous representation of the Super Eagles, U-23, and U-20 teams within a single month. He described his debut home game in Calabar, and how the support from Yobo and coaches motivated him. Musa credited former NFF President Amaju Pinnick for his faith during a challenging time at Leicester City, recounting how Pinnick insisted he be included in the national team, which led to his key role at the 2018 World Cup. He thanked Aisha Falode for her consistent support, noting her encouragement went beyond women’s football. Reflecting on the 2013 AFCON win, Musa emphasized the impact of home-based players, urging a renewed focus on Nigeria’s local league to nurture talent and provide opportunities. He argued that improved salaries in the league would discourage players from leaving, contrasting the social isolation abroad with community connections at home. Addressing Nigeria's draw against Lesotho, Musa explained that negative media and social media scrutiny affects young players’ confidence, sometimes forcing premature retirements. He called for experienced players like Mikel Obi and Victor Moses to be brought back, stating the need for balance in the team. Musa pushed back against claims about his age, citing his long service since debuting at 19, and stressed his continued pride and commitment to Nigeria. He described the strain on players’ families due to intense public criticism and the unique pressures faced by those whose families live in Nigeria. Reflecting on Nigeria’s failure to qualify for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, Musa described the emotional and financial cost, commended Pinnick’s efforts, and highlighted the role of sports betting in shifting fan attitudes from passion to criticism. He specifically mentioned threats against Odion Ighalo’s family as a factor in Ighalo’s departure from the team, decrying personal attacks on players’ families. Musa drew attention to the struggles of retired footballers and called on the sports minister to establish systems to support them. He encouraged players to plan for life after football, acknowledging that not everyone earns large sums from major clubs. Concluding, Musa thanked the NFF and organizers for their support and reiterated his commitment to uniting and inspiring Nigeria. He emphasized the unifying power of football regardless of religious or ethnic differences, using the example of nationwide jubilation after key international victories.
translated_content: Kapten Super Eagles, Ahmed Musa, te bay yon diskou nan Lagos vandredi, pandan seremoni lansman mantra ekip la 'Ann Fè Sa Ankò' pandan y ap vize katriyèm tit AFCON lan nan Ivory Coast ane pwochèn. Li remèsye ansyen antrenè li yo: Stephen Keshi, Daniel Amokachi, ak Samson Siasia, ansanm ak ansyen kapitèn ak koékipye li Joseph Yobo pou tout sipò ak ankourajman yo. Musa sonje li te jwè ki pi jèn nan ekip la, toujou pataje chanm ak Yobo, epi li mete aksan sou jan li te reprezante an menm tan Super Eagles, ekip U-23 ak U-20 pandan yon sèl mwa. Li pale de premye match li lakay nan Calabar, ak kijan sipò Yobo ak antrenè yo te motive l. Musa remèsye ansyen Prezidan NFF, Amaju Pinnick, pou konfyans li te gen nan li pandan moman difisil l nan Leicester City, li eksplike kijan Pinnick te fè tout sa pou mete l nan ekip nasyonal la, ki mennen l jwe wòl kle li nan Mondyal 2018. Li di mèsi Aisha Falode pou sipò li toujou ap bay, e li mete aksan ke ankourajman li pa sèlman nan foutbòl fanm. Pandan li sonje viktwa AFCON 2013 la, Musa mete aksan sou enpòtans jwè ki soti nan chanpyona lokal la e li rele pou plis ankourajman ak devlopman lig lokal la pou bay talan opòtinite briye. Li di salè ki pi bon nan lig la tap ralanti dezesperasyon jwè yo a kite peyi a. Li konpare solitid ak izòlman aletranje ak chalè kominotè lakay. Konsènan matche nil kont Lesotho a, Musa esplike kijan kritik negatif nan medya ak sou rezo sosyo afekte jèn jwè yo, pafwa rann yo dekouraje oswa fòse yo pran retrèt avan lè. Li mande pou retou jwè eksperimante tankou Mikel Obi ak Victor Moses pou ede balans ekip la. Musa reponn moun sou zafè laj li, li fè konnen li sèvi ekip la depi li gen 19 an, li kontinye fyè epi angaje pou Nijerya. Li pale sou presyon fanmi jwè yo sibi ak gwo kritik piblik la, espesyalman pou sila ki gen tout fanmi yo anndan peyi a. Konsènan echèk Nijerya pa te kalifye pou Mondyal 2022 an Qatar, Musa pale sou chòk emosyonèl ak finansye a, felisite efò Pinnick, epi li mete aksan sou jan paryaj vin chanje atitid fanatik yo. Li eksplike menas kont fanmi Odion Ighalo te fè Ighalo kite ekip la, epi li kondane atak pèsonèl sou fanmi jwè yo. Musa atire atansyon sou kondisyon ansyen foutbolè yo e li rele minis spò a pou mete yon mekanis èd pou yo. Li ankouraje jwè yo pou planifye lavni yo apre karyè foutbòl la, e li rekonèt pa tout moun ki jwenn gwo lajan ak klèb entènasyonal. Pou fini, Musa remèsye NFF ak òganizatè yo pou tout sipò, li rekòmanse angajman li pou ini ak motive Nijerya. Li mete aksan sou jan foutbòl ini tout moun kèlkeswa relijyon oswa orijin, epi li sonje kè kontan nasyonal apre viktwa istorik yo.
post_content: Ahmed Musa wants unity for Nigeria and more support for local league stars! From old coaches, tough losses, to fan pressure on young players, he's urging everyone to keep faith in Super Eagles for AFCON 2024! 🇳🇬⚽ #SuperEagles #AFCON2024 #LetsDoItAgain
translated_post: Ahmed Musa vle plis inite pou Nijerya epi plis sipò pou jwè lig lokal yo! Li pale de ansyen antrenè, moman difisil, ak presyon sou jèn jwè yo. Ann soutni Super Eagles pou AFCON 2024! 🇳🇬⚽ #SuperEagles #AFCON2024 #AnnFeSaAnko

article_content: Mark Cavendish continued his impressive run by winning the sixth stage of the Tour de France, completing the 227.5km stretch from Montargis to Gueugnon with another dominant sprint finish. This marks the Briton’s second consecutive stage victory, following his win in stage five. With a strong lead-out from his HTC-Columbia teammate Mark Renshaw, Cavendish surged past Tyler Farrar and Alessandro Petacchi to claim the win. The overall race standings remained mostly unchanged, as Fabian Cancellara kept hold of the yellow jersey. Team Sky’s Geraint Thomas managed to reduce his gap to Cancellara to 20 seconds due to a minor division in the peloton. Cadel Evans, the current world champion, continues in third place, trailing by 39 seconds, while top contenders such as Andy Schleck, Alberto Contador, and Lance Armstrong all finished comfortably with the main group. The day’s action included an early breakaway attempt by Ruben Perez Moreno, Sebastian Lang, and Mathieu Perget, who at one point led by as much as eight minutes. They were eventually reeled in with 10km remaining, paving the way for Cavendish’s decisive sprint. Reflecting on his 12th career stage win, Cavendish credited his teammates for their effort, saying his main job was to finish what they started. Next, the Tour heads into the medium mountains at Station des Rousses for stage seven, where overall contenders are expected to move to the forefront.
translated_content: Mark Cavendish kontinye montre fòm li pa ranpòte sizyèm etap Tour de France la, soti Montargis pou rive Gueugnon (227.5km), ak yon lòt sprint pwisan. Sa a make dezyèm viktwa etap yonn apre lòt pou Britanik la apre li te ranpòte etap senkyèm lan. Avèk bon èd kanmarad li Mark Renshaw ki se kòlèg li nan HTC-Columbia, Cavendish depase Tyler Farrar ak Alessandro Petacchi pou pran viktwa a. Klasman jeneral kous la pa vrèman chanje, paske Fabian Cancellara toujou kenbe mayo jòn nan. Geraint Thomas, ki nan Team Sky, bese diferans li ak Cancellara a pou sèlman 20 segonn gras ak yon ti separasyon ki te gen nan peloton an. Cadel Evans, ki se chanpyon mondyal, toujou nan twazyèm plas ak 39 segonn dèyè; pandan gwo kandida tankou Andy Schleck, Alberto Contador ak Lance Armstrong te fini san pwoblèm avèk peloton an. Te gen yon echapée bonè kote Ruben Perez Moreno, Sebastian Lang ak Mathieu Perget te mennen e te rive gen uit minit avan sou gwoup prensipal la. Yo te rattrapé ak anviwon 10km pou fini, sa ki te pèmèt Cavendish fè sprint desizif li a. Apati de 12yèm viktwa etap li, Cavendish remèsye ekip li a, li di job li se fini bon travay yo te fè. Pwochèn etap la ap mennen Tour la nan mòn mwayen nan Station des Rousses, kote kandida prensipal yo ka kòmanse mete tèt yo an avan.
post_content: Mark Cavendish does it again! Back-to-back wins in the Tour de France after crushing the sixth stage sprint. Yellow jersey stays with Cancellara, but things are heating up with tighter gaps. Ready for the mountain battles tomorrow? 🚴‍♂️🔥 #TourDeFrance #Cavendish #Cycling
translated_post: Mark Cavendish frape ankò! Li ranpòte de etap youn apre lòt nan Tour de France epi li kraze sprint sizyèm etap la. Cancellara kenbe mayo jòn nan, men tout bagay ap vin cho ak diferans ki ap tounen pi piti. Pare pou batay mòn yo demen? 🚴‍♂️🔥 #TourDeFrance #Cavendish #Velo

article_content: Each evening in Beijing, countless couples gather in public spaces to ballroom dance, moving to lively music from portable speakers. For many, especially migrant workers who have come to the city in recent decades seeking better opportunities, this tradition offers relaxation and community. Over the past 20 years, China has experienced dramatic economic growth, largely thanks to reforms associated with Deng Xiaoping’s call to embrace prosperity. This development has helped millions transition from rural farming to jobs in manufacturing, construction, retail, and services. While some have found considerable success and wealth, not everyone has shared equally in these gains. The authority of the Chinese Communist Party has been closely linked to its ability to deliver steady economic improvements. But with growth now slowing—reported GDP growth was 7.4%, the slowest in three years—the leadership faces new challenges. China is increasingly compelled to move away from an economic model built on cheap labor, exports, and massive investment, and toward one focused on stimulating domestic consumer spending. Experts agree this transition will be complex and takes time. Figures such as Victor Chu and John Quelch believe China's leaders have the capacity and resources to oversee these changes and maintain national stability, though concerns persist about income gaps and shrinking opportunities for the less privileged. On the global stage, China’s economy is a major influence, and its path forward has become a heated topic in U.S. politics. Presidential candidates have debated how to respond to what some consider unfair Chinese trade and currency practices. Chinese authorities, however, assert that fair and mutually beneficial trade should prevail. Business executives like Martin Sorrell argue that Western nations should take responsibility for their own economic issues rather than blaming China, pointing to China's historical significance as a global economic leader—a position it is expected to regain. Despite its remarkable progress, China’s leaders remain under pressure to address economic inequality, social stability, the rule of law, and human rights if they are to uphold their legitimacy. While people continue to dance in Beijing’s public spaces each night, questions linger about the future if the economic ‘music’ were to stop.
translated_content: Chak swa nan Beijing, ou jwenn anpil koup ap danse bal nan plas piblik yo, ap deplase sou ritm mizik ki sòti nan gwo bwat son. Pou anpil moun, espesyalman travayè migran ki vini lavil la dènye ane sa yo pou chèche pi bon lavi, dans sa yo se yon ti repo ak okazyon fè kominote. Pandan 20 dènye ane yo, Lachin fè gwo pwogrè ekonomik, sitou ak refòm ki te vin apre konsèy Deng Xiaoping sou richès. Devlopman sa a pèmèt milyon moun kite jaden epi rantre nan fabrikasyon, konstriksyon, komès ak sèvis. Gen kèk ki reyisi ak fè anpil lajan, men tout moun pa jwenn menm avantaj la. Pati Kominis Chinwa a jwenn pouvwa li akoz kapasite l pou amelyore ekonomi a. Jodi a, kwasans lan vin pi dousman—dènye chif piblik la montre PIB a grandi sèlman 7.4%, ki se to ki pi ba nan twa dènye ane yo—e sa mete presyon sou lidè yo. Lachin dwe soti nan yon modèl ekonomik ki baze sou travay bon mache, ekspòtasyon ak gwo envestisman, pou l ankouraje konsomasyon andedan peyi a. Ekspè yo di tranzisyon sa pa fasil epi ap pran tan. Lidè tankou Victor Chu ak John Quelch kwè dirijan Lachin yo gen kapasite ak resous pou mennen chanjman sa yo san brase, men pwoblèm diferans richès ak opòtinite ki limite pou pòv yo toujou egziste. Sou plan mondyal, ekonomi Lachin enpòtan anpil, e chwa peyi a ap kreye anpil deba nan politik Amerik la. Kandida prezidansyèl yo ap diskite repons pou sa yo konsidere kòm fo pratik komès ak lajan Chinwa. Otorite Chinwa yo ensiste komès dwe fèt ak respè ak benefis pou toule de. Biznisman tankou Martin Sorrell panse peyi oksidantal yo ta dwe konsantre sou pwòp difikilte yo anvan yo blam Lachin, e li raple enpòtans istorik Lachin kòm gwo aktè ekonomik mondyal. Malgre tout siksè sa yo, lidè Chinwa yo ap sou presyon pou rezoud inegalite, estabilite sosyal, règ lalwa ak dwa moun si yo vle kenbe konfyans pèp la. Pandan moun kontinye danse chak swa sou plas piblik Beijing, gwo kesyon rete konsènan sa kap pase si ekonomi an ta ralanti.
post_content: In Beijing, nightly ballroom dancing brings joy to migrant workers seeking a better life—but as China’s economic boom slows and leaders face tough decisions, will the music keep playing? #China #Economy #BeijingNights
translated_post: Chak swa, koup ap danse bal sou plas piblik nan Beijing, men ak ekonomi Lachin ki ap ralanti, èske mizik la ap toujou jwe? #Lachin #Ekonomi #Beijing

article_content:
The San Francisco 49ers released defensive end Ray McDonald on Wednesday following allegations of sexual assault. General Manager Trent Baalke stated, "While our organization believes strongly in due process, Ray McDonald has shown a pattern of poor decision-making that has created multiple distractions for this team and organization, which can no longer be tolerated."

San Jose Police have executed a search warrant at McDonald's residence as part of the investigation. No arrests have been made, and McDonald has not been charged.

The NFL, which updated its personal conduct policy on December 10, confirmed it will be conducting its own investigation. NFL spokesman Greg Aiello told CNN, "We are looking into it."

According to the San Jose Police Department, authorities received a call from a hospital on Tuesday about a possible sexual assault victim being treated. The alleged victim said the assault may have occurred the previous day, and the preliminary investigation identified McDonald as the suspect.

Last month, the Santa Clara District Attorney’s Office announced it did not have sufficient evidence to charge McDonald in a separate domestic violence case involving his pregnant fiancée. McDonald was arrested on August 31 in connection with that incident, shortly after the NFL revised its personal conduct policy due to criticism over the Ray Rice case.

Under the revised NFL policy, the league initiates investigations upon learning of possible violations, coordinating with law enforcement as necessary to avoid interference.
translated_content:
San Francisco 49ers mete Ray McDonald, defansè defans la, deyò mèkredi poutèt akizasyon agresyon seksyèl. Manadjè Jeneral Trent Baalke di, "Malgre òganizasyon nou kwè anpil nan dwa moun pou defann tèt yo, Ray McDonald deja montre li pran move desizyon plizyè fwa ki lakoz anpil distraksyon pou ekip ak òganizasyon an, epi nou pap tolere sa ankò."

Lapolis San Jose fè fouy lakay McDonald kòm pati nan ankèt la. Yo poko arete pesonn, epi yo poko akize McDonald ofisyèlman.

NFL la, ki mete règ konduit pèsonèl li ajou 10 desanm, konfime li ap lanse yon ankèt tou. Pòtpawòl NFL Greg Aiello di CNN, "Nou ap gade sa."

Dapre lapolis San Jose, yo resevwa yon apèl lopital madi sou yon viktim ki t ap resevwa swen pou yon agresyon seksyèl ki sanble fèt anvan. Viktim lan deklare agresyon an ta fèt jou anvan, e ankèt premyèman mete McDonald kòm sispèk la.

Mwa pase, Biwo Pwokirè Santa Clara te deside li pa t gen ase prèv pou akize McDonald nan yon lòt ka vyolans domestik kont fiyanse ansent li. Yo te arete li 31 out nan relasyon ak ensidan sa a, kèk jou apre NFL te chanje règ konduit pèsonèl li apre kritik sou ka Ray Rice.

Avèk nouvo règ yo, NFL ap lanse ankèt sou tout ka posib vyolasyon e ap kolabore ak lapolis pou evite konfli.
post_content: Ray McDonald was released by the 49ers after new sexual assault allegations. Cops are investigating, and the NFL is looking into it after updating their conduct rules! 🏈 #49ers #NFLNews #RayMcDonald
translated_post: Ray McDonald mete deyò pa 49ers akoz nouvo akizasyon agresyon seksyèl. Polis ap mennen ankèt, epi NFL ap suiv dosye a ak nouvo règ yo! 🏈 #49ers #NFLAyiti #RayMcDonald

article_content: A-list celebrities and big salaries fill the Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) locker room, but Zlatan Ibrahimovic isn't complaining. In fact, he's delighted that David Beckham has joined him at PSG—not only for Beckham’s football skills, but also because Beckham now receives the majority of the media attention. Ibrahimovic transferred to PSG from AC Milan during the summer. Beckham, one of the most recognizable athletes in the world, signed with PSG on a free transfer in January after leaving LA Galaxy. "It's good for me that Beckham came. He gets more attention, so they leave me alone," Ibrahimovic told CNN. "Everyone said that in Paris, footballers can walk the city undisturbed, unlike in Italy. But since I arrived, it’s been stressful, with people constantly following me—even on scooters. Now that David is here, he handles the media attention, so I can focus on football." When PSG signed Beckham, some believed it was simply a PR move to increase the team’s profile, especially with backing from wealthy Qatari owners—the Qatar Investment Authority. However, coach Carlo Ancelotti has frequently played Beckham, though he faced criticism from the French press after being substituted 20 minutes before the end against Barcelona in the Champions League quarterfinal first leg, which ended in a 2-2 draw. Despite the criticism, Ibrahimovic feels Beckham’s experience is invaluable for PSG as they aim to upset Barcelona and win their first French league title since 1994. "He’s been very important for us," Ibrahimovic said. "The club is changing from a normal club to a top club, and Beckham gives you confidence. He has great quality and elegance on the field." Coach Ancelotti has said he would start Beckham again in the second leg. Fans can expect another dramatic match after the eventful first game: Lionel Messi gave Barcelona a first-half lead, Ibrahimovic leveled from an offside position in the 79th minute, and Xavi restored Barcelona’s advantage with an 89th-minute penalty. Blaise Matuidi then equalized for PSG four minutes into injury time. PSG’s chances could improve if Messi, who is doubtful after a hamstring injury, is unable to play the second leg. After the first leg, Barcelona filed an official complaint to UEFA, criticizing referee Wolfgang Stark’s decisions—including allowing play to continue while Javier Mascherano and Jordi Alba were injured on the pitch. In other Champions League action, Bayern Munich leads Juventus 2-0 ahead of their second leg and are favorites to progress. Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund won their matchups to reach the semifinals.
translated_content: Gen anpil selebrite ak gwo salè nan vestiyè Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), men Zlatan Ibrahimovic pa ap plenyen ditou. Anfèt, li trè kontan ke David Beckham vin jwe avè l nan PSG—pa sèlman paske Beckham gen anpil talan, men paske kounye a se Beckham ki pran tout atansyon medya yo. Ibrahimovic te transfere soti AC Milan pou li vin jwe nan PSG pandan sezon ete a. Beckham, youn nan atlèt ki pi rekonèt sou latè, te siyen ak PSG gratis an janvye apre li te kite LA Galaxy. "Mwen kontan Beckham vin la paske li jwenn plis atansyon, konsa yo kite m anpè," se sa Ibrahimovic te di CNN. "Tout moun te di mwen, nan Pari jwè foutbòl ka mache lib san moun deranje yo, pa tankou Itali. Men depi mwen rive, moun swiv mwen toutan, menm ak motosiklèt. Kounye a David la, se li kap okipe medya yo, mwen ka konsantre sou foutbòl la." Lè PSG te siyen Beckham, kèk moun te panse se te yon estrateji PR pou bay ekip la plis popilarite, espesyalman avèk sipò pwopriyetè Katar yo—Qatar Investment Authority. Men antrenè Carlo Ancelotti souvan itilize Beckham, menm si laprès franse te kritike li apre yo te ranplase Beckham 20 minit anvan fen match kont Barcelona nan premye manch kwaf final Champions League la; match la fini 2-2. Malgre tout kritik yo, Ibrahimovic kwè eksperyans Beckham se yon avantaj pou PSG pandan yap chèche bat Barcelona epi pran premye tit lig franse yo depi 1994. "Li enpòtan anpil pou nou," se sa Ibrahimovic di. "Klèb la ap chanje soti yon klèb nòmal pou vin yon gwo klèb, epi Beckham bay ekip la plis konfyans. Li gen anpil kalite ak ladrès sou teren an." Antrenè Ancelotti di li ta kòmanse Beckham ankò nan dezyèm match la. Fanatik yo ka atann yon lòt gwo match apre sa ki te pase: Lionel Messi te bay Barcelona avantaj nan premye mitan, Ibrahimovic te egalize pou PSG sou yon pozisyon hors-jeu nan 79yèm minit, Xavi te remet avantaj la ak yon penalite nan minit 89. Blaise Matuidi egalize pou PSG kat minit apre tan siplemantè. Chans PSG yo ta ka amelyore si Messi, ki poko sèten pou l jwe akòz blesi janm li, pa patisipe nan dezyèm match la. Apre premye men nan dezyèm faz la, Barcelona depoze yon plent ofisyèl bay UEFA, kritike abit Wolfgang Stark pou desizyon li yo—tankou lè li kite jwèt la kontinye pandan Javier Mascherano ak Jordi Alba te blese atè. Nan lòt aksyon Champions League la, Bayern Munich ap mennen Juventus 2-0 avan dezyèm men an epi yo byen plase pou pase. Real Madrid ak Borussia Dortmund kalifye pou demi-final yo.
