article_content: Anthony Skipper, 50, long considered one of Britain’s most prolific hoarders, is selling nearly all his possessions after finding new love. Skipper, from Felthorpe, Norfolk, has always disliked seeing things go to waste, quickly amassing a large collection of unwanted machinery, vehicles, gadgets, and furniture. After beginning a new relationship with Karen Bradley, 51, of Whitwell, Derbyshire, in January, Skipper decided to change his lifestyle. He is now auctioning off more than 800 items he collected over the years. The auction will be held this weekend in Lenwade, Norfolk. Items up for sale range from classic American sports cars and vintage farm machinery to household goods like lawnmowers, garden wendy houses, furniture, tools, and unusual finds such as a carousel horse and a goat tether chain. The most valuable item is a 1965 Chevrolet C10 panel van, valued between £4,000 and £5,000. He also hopes to sell a large Winnebago camper van and a 30ft Roma caravan. Skipper’s collection, described as an 'Aladdin’s cave' by the Norwich Livestock Market organizing the sale, also includes several motor vehicles, old bicycles, sheds, a fruit machine, and various pieces of vintage equipment. He estimates that if everything sells, he could raise up to £30,000. Reflecting on his past, Skipper said he began collecting to fill a void after his marriage collapsed about eight years ago. He admitted that watching television shows about hoarders helped him realize the extent of his habit, motivating his decision to let go of his collection. He vows to keep collecting, but never to the same degree. Anyone interested can view the full auction list on www.norwichlivestockmarket.com.
translated_content: Anthony Skipper, 50 an, ke anpil moun konsidere kòm youn nan pi gwo rasanble bagay (hoarders) nan Angletè, pral vann prèske tout sa li posede aprè li jwenn lanmou ankò. Skipper, ki soti Felthorpe, Norfolk, pa ka sipòte wè bagay gaspiye, li te rapidman ranmase anpil machin, ekipman, aparèy, ak mèb ki pa t nesesè. Depi li te kòmanse yon nouvo relasyon ak Karen Bradley, 51 an, ki soti Whitwell, Derbyshire, nan mwa janvye, Skipper deside chanje lavi li. Kounye a, li pral mete plis pase 800 atik li yo nan ochèn. Vant lan ap fèt fen semèn sa a Lenwade, Norfolk. Bagay ki pou vann yo sòti nan machin klasik Ameriken, ekipman agrikòl ansyen, jiska zouti kay tankou machin koupe gazon, ti kay jaden pou timoun, mèb, zouti, ak atik etranj tankou chwal karousèl ak chenn pou mare kabrit. Atik ki pi chè a se yon Chevrolet C10 panel van 1965, ki valè li estime ant £4,000 ak £5,000. Li swete tou vann yon gwo Winnebago ak yon karavàn Roma 30 pye. Koleksyon Skipper la, ke Norwich Livestock Market, òganizatè vant lan, dekri kòm “twou Aladenn,” gen ladan plizyè machin, bisiklèt ansyen, ti kay, machin aza, ak plizyè ekipman vye. Li panse si tout bagay vann, li ka fè jiska £30,000. Pandan li ap reflechi sou tan pase li, Skipper di li te kòmanse rasanble bagay apre maryaj li fini sa gen uit ane. Li di li te kòmanse gade emisyon televizyon sou rasanble bagay (hoarders), sa ki fè li rann li kont jan bagay yo te pran jarèt, epi sa ba li kouraj pou l lage yo. Li pwonmèt li pap tounen nan menm nivo ansyen an, menm si li toujou swaf rasanble kèk bagay. Nenpòt moun ki enterese kapab al wè lis konplè a sou www.norwichlivestockmarket.com.
post_content: From hoarder to fresh start! Anthony Skipper is selling 800+ quirky items (think vintage cars, tools, even a goat chain!) at auction after finding new love. Will he reach his £30K goal? #LifeChange #Auction #FreshStart
translated_post: Soti rasanble bagay pou vire nouvo paj! Anthony Skipper ap vann plis pase 800 atik depiw ka imajine (machin klasik, zouti, chenn kabrit!) paske li jwenn lanmou ankò. Èske l ap rive fè £30,000? #NouvoKòmansman #VantAuxEnchères

article_content: As previously reported, Disney/Marvel's Deadpool 3 will no longer premiere on its original release date of May 3, 2024, leaving the beginning of the summer movie season without a kickoff film. The film, directed by Shawn Levy and currently resuming production, will now be released on July 26, 2024, taking the slot once occupied by Captain America: Brave New World. Captain America: Brave New World has been shifted to February 14, 2025, and will not launch the 2024 summer season as previously planned. Earlier expectations suggested Captain America was further along in production compared to Deadpool 3, which was about halfway complete, but the release order has changed. To accommodate these moves, Disney postponed Marvel Studios' Blade from February 14, 2025, to November 7, 2025. Marvel's Thunderbolts, which had not begun production due to recent industry strikes, is now rescheduled from December 20, 2024, to July 25, 2025. Additional changes include Mufasa: The Lion King moving from July 5 to December 20, 2024. Disney also removed two untitled films previously set for July 25 and November 7, 2025. These scheduling shifts may prompt further changes from other studios as the SAG-AFTRA strike wraps up and productions restart. For example, Sony has delayed its upcoming Venom film from July 14 to November 8, 2024.
translated_content: Jan nou te deja anonse, Deadpool 3 ki sòti Disney/Marvel pap sòti sou dat li te prevwa a, 3 me 2024, sa ki kite sezon fim été a san premye fim li. Fim sa, ki Shawn Levy ap reyalize epi ki rekòmanse pwodiksyon kounye a, pral sòti 26 jiyè 2024, pran plas Captain America: Brave New World te genyen anvan. Captain America: Brave New World deplase pou 14 fevriye 2025 e li pap louvri sezon été 2024 jan li te pwograme anvan. Yo te panse Captain America te pi pre fini pase Deadpool 3, ki te a demi chemen, men lòd sòti yo chanje kounye a. Pou ajiste mouvman yo, Disney ranvwaye Blade Marvel Studios soti 14 fevriye 2025 pou 7 novanm 2025. Thunderbolts Marvel la, ki poko kòmanse pwodiksyon akoz grèv endistri a, gen nouvo dat sòti: soti 20 desanm 2024 pou 25 jiyè 2025. Gen lòt ajisteman tankou Mufasa: The Lion King ki deplase soti 5 jiyè pou 20 desanm 2024. Disney retire tou de fim san tit ki te sou kalandriye pou 25 jiyè ak 7 novanm 2025. Chanjman sa yo ka ankouraje lòt estidyo pou fè lòt ajisteman, espesyalman kounye a grèv SAG-AFTRA fini epi pwodiksyon retounen. Pa egzanp, Sony retade nouvo fim Venom li a soti 14 jiyè pou 8 novanm 2024.
post_content: Big Marvel shakeup! Deadpool 3 pushed to July, Cap to Valentine's, and more Disney release date swaps. Even Venom got delayed! 🎬 #Marvel #movieupdates
translated_post: Gwo chanjman Marvel! Deadpool 3 pase pou jiyè, Captain America pou 14 fevriye, e gen lòt fim ki chanje dat. Menm Venom retade! 🎬 #Marvel #fimnouvèl

Alex Miller, 25, was at the center of a love triangle that led to a violent confrontation during a Christmas party for staff at the City financial firm Brewin Dolphin. The incident began when Miller's fiancé, stockbroker Robert Nicolson, 27, was told by a friend that Miller had been unfaithful with a colleague, IT worker Anthony Field. Nicolson confronted Field at the Queen of Hoxton cocktail bar in Shoreditch, east London, igniting a fight that involved up to six other men.

Field suffered two black eyes and facial injuries. Police arrested Nicolson and at least two of his friends. At Snaresbrook Crown Court, Nicolson admitted affray but was cleared of assault after a three-day trial. Gary Jones, 33, admitted to hitting Field with a glass bottle, while data analyst Graham Sutherland, 27, was cleared of any charges related to the fight.

Friends reported that the publicity surrounding the case led Miller to withdraw from her previous social circles, moving out of her shared home with Nicolson in Grays, Essex; she now lives in Ashford, Kent. Judge Joanna Korner QC indicated Nicolson would likely receive a community penalty when sentenced next week. Miller and Nicolson declined to comment. Jones will also be sentenced on the same day.
translated_content:
Alex Miller, 25 an, te jwenn tèt li nan mitan yon triyang lanmou ki te vire lakay vyolans pandan fèt Nwèl anplwaye Brewin Dolphin, yon konpayi finansye nan City la. Tousa te kòmanse lè fiyanse Miller la, stockbroker Robert Nicolson, 27 an, te tande nan bouch yon zanmi ke Miller te trayi li ak yon kòlèg ki se Anthony Field, yon teknisyen IT. Nicolson al defye Field nan bar Queen of Hoxton kote sa te toumen an goumen ak prèske sis lot gason ki patisipe.

Field te sòti ak de je nwa ak blesi sou figi li. Polis arete Nicolson ak omwen de zanmi li. Nan tribinal Snaresbrook Crown Court, Nicolson te admèt koupab pou dezòd piblik (afray) men li te libere sou akizasyon vyolans apre twa jou pwosè. Gary Jones, 33 an, te admèt li te frape Field ak yon boutèy, pendant Graham Sutherland, 27 an, ki se analyst done, te libere sou tout akizasyon batay la.

Dapre zanmi Miller yo, tout publicite sa a fè li izole tèt li, li kite ansyen kay li ak Nicolson nan Grays, Essex, e kounya li ap viv Ashford, Kent. Jij Joanna Korner QC fè konnen Nicolson ka resevwa yon penalite kominotè lè y ap bay jijman semèn pwochèn. Miller ak Nicolson pa t fè okenn kòmantè. Jones ap jwenn santans li menm lè sa a.
post_content: Drama at a City firm's Christmas party! A love triangle led to a wild brawl in London, leaving one with facial injuries and several arrests. #OfficeDrama #LondonNights

article_content: Forget classic cake cutting and bouquet tossing poses—this year's top wedding photographs are anything but ordinary. The International Society of Professional Wedding Photographers (ISPWP) recently announced the winners of its annual awards, recognizing excellence in 20 categories for each season. The 2014 winners showcased innovative and diverse approaches to wedding photography, moving beyond conventional wedding portraits. From traditional 'Bride and Groom Portraits' to the vibrant 'All About Light' category, judges evaluate all aspects of the portraits. Members of the ISPWP, representing photographers from around the world, gather four times a year—once each season—to pick winners from thousands of entries. In 2014, over 20,000 photographs were submitted. Some of the winning images: Pedro Cabrera (Spain) took 1st place in 'The Decisive Moment' (Spring 2014); Matous Duchek (Czech Republic) won 'Bridal Party Portrait' (Winter 2013); and Raymond Phang (Singapore) earned 1st place in 'Engagement Portrait' (Summer 2014). The winning portraits range from the very serious to the very playful, reflecting the emotional spectrum of weddings. The contest is competitive; judges carefully assess technical skill, composition, artistic vision, and emotional impact in each photo. By year's end, 80 winners are recognized. According to Joe Milton, executive director of ISPWP, creating an award-winning wedding photograph requires both technical proficiency and creative imagination. 'A great wedding photographer is both an artist and a technician,' he says, emphasizing the lifelong significance of these images for families. Categories include everything from 'The Dress,' 'Family Love,' and 'Ceremony,' to themes like 'Pure Art,' 'Humor,' and 'Emotional Impact.' Winning photographers are based all over the globe, with first-place entries from locations such as Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Prague, Taipei, Florence, New York, Frankfurt, Canton, Cabo San Lucas, The Hague, Vigo, Denver, Bangkok, Belo Horizonte, Sydney, Jakarta, Brussels, Bristol, Hong Kong, Saint-Petersburg, Nanping, Zurich, Cracow, Lake Tahoe, Sussex, and Florence. Photos capture varying styles and moments—from candid emotions and playful group shots to artistic compositions and dramatic use of light. 'We want to highlight the best wedding photos in the world, demonstrating the range of images wedding photographers can create during a celebration,' says Joe Milton. Judges look for images that truly capture the atmosphere and significance of weddings, ensuring both artistic merit and deep emotional resonance.
translated_content: Bliye poze klasik lè w ap koupe gato ak jete boukè—pi bèl foto maryaj ane sa yo pa menm jan ak sa w abitye wè. Sosyete Entènasyonal Fotogwaf Pwofesyonèl Maryaj (ISPWP) fèk anonse gayan prim anyèl yo, kote yo rekonèt ekselans nan 20 kategori pou chak sezon. Gayan 2014 yo te montre apwòch inovatif epi divès nan foto maryaj, depase portre tradisyonèl yo. Soti nan 'Portre Lamarye ak Marye' rive kategori vibran 'Tout Sou Limyè', jij yo evalye tout aspè foto yo. Manm ISPWP yo, ki gen fotogwaf bò kote latè, reyini kat fwa chak ane—chak sezon—pou chwazi gayan pami anpil mil foto. An 2014, plis pase 20,000 foto te soumèt. Men kèk ladan yo: Pedro Cabrera (Espay) te premye nan 'Momans Desizif' (Prentan 2014); Matous Duchek (Repiblik Tchek) te ranpòte 'Portre Gwoup Lamarye' (Iver 2013); epi Raymond Phang (Singapore) te premye nan 'Portre Fiyanse' (Ete 2014). Foto ki jwenn prim yo varye soti nan trè serye rive komik, sa ki reflete tout kalte emosyon maryaj. Konkou a di; jij yo egzamine ladrès teknik, konpozisyon, vizyon atistik, ak enpak emosyonèl chak foto. Nan fen ane a, 80 gayan ap rekonèt. Dapre Joe Milton, direktè egzekitif ISPWP, fè yon foto maryaj ki touche prim mande tou de ekspètiz teknik ak imajinasyon kreyatif. 'Yon bon fotogwaf maryaj se yon atis ak yon teknisyen an menm tan,' li di, mete aksan sou enpòtans foto sa yo pou fanmi pandan lavi yo. Kategori yo genyen tout bagay soti nan 'Ròb la', 'Lanmmou Fanmi', 'Seremoni', jiska tèm tankou 'Atizay Pwofon', 'Imin', ak 'Enpak Emosyonèl'. Gayan yo sòti tout kote sou planèt la, ak premye plas ki soti Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Prague, Taipei, Florence, New York, Frankfurt, Canton, Cabo San Lucas, La Haye, Vigo, Denver, Bangkok, Belo Horizonte, Sydney, Jakarta, Brussels, Bristol, Hong Kong, Saint-Pétersbourg, Nanping, Zurich, Krakovi, Lake Tahoe, Sussex, ak Florence. Foto yo montre tout stil ak moman—soti nan emosyon natirèl ak poz komik, rive sou konpozisyon atistik ak itilizasyon limyè dramatik. 'Nou vle mete pi bèl foto maryaj yo an valè pou montre tout varyete imaj fotogwaf ka reyalize pandan selebrasyon an,' Joe Milton deklare. Jij yo chèche foto ki vrèman bay sans ak enpòtans maryaj la, asire merite atistik ak gwo enpak emosyonèl.
post_content: This year’s best wedding pics aren’t your usual cake-cutting shots! The ISPWP picked 80 top photos worldwide—think epic, funny, and emotional. Congrats to all the creative photographers! #WeddingGoals #ISPWPAwards

The number of migrants arrested while attempting to reach Britain from Calais has doubled in six months, surpassing 7,000, according to new figures released yesterday. Despite heightened security measures by French authorities, there has been a marked increase in individuals trying to access the UK via the Channel Port. Data from the local prefecture indicates that 7,414 people were detained between January and June this year, compared to 3,129 during the same period in 2013.

Most detained migrants expressed intentions to seek asylum in Britain, aiming to access social security and other benefits. A source at Calais port told AFP, France’s national news agency, “We have noticed a significant rise in the number of migrants, and our checks are revealing more individuals.”

In the first two weeks of this month alone, approximately 1,200 migrants were arrested, but most were released immediately due to overcrowding in detention centers. This allows them to return to Calais or nearby ports, where they continue to evade authorities while attempting to board lorries and ferries bound for the UK.

Recently, the mayor of Calais enacted a decree banning the establishment of camps in specific areas, citing public health concerns. Several unauthorized camps have been demolished as authorities strive to encourage migrants to leave the town. The camp near the Ferry port in Calais was cleared by police and machinery. However, these measures have not stopped hundreds of migrants from countries such as Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea, Iraq, and Afghanistan from arriving.

Calais Mayor Natacha Bouchart has repeatedly claimed that Britain’s “generous welfare system” contributes to the ongoing migrant crisis. Deputy Mayor Philippe Mignonet, who also oversees immigration at the port, stated in December that Britain should do more to address the rising number of migrant crossings, describing the country as “a magnet for illegal immigrants.” Mignonet asserted that many migrants refuse assistance in Calais, instead focusing on reaching England. “They only want to go to England. They refuse everything—we offer facilities, but they refuse because they want to go to England,” he explained. He also accused Britain of failing to support France in tackling the issue: “They play no role, they do nothing.”
translated_content:
Nimewo migran yo arete pandan y ap eseye rive Grann Bretay depi Calais double sou sis mwa, li depase 7,000 dapre nouvo chif ki pibliye yè. Malgre otorite franse yo ogmante mezi sekirite yo, gen plis moun k ap eseye pase atravè Pò Chènèl la pou ale UK. Selon done prefekti lokal la, 7,414 moun te arete ant janvye ak jen ane sa a, konpare ak 3,129 menm peryòd an 2013.

Pifò migran ki arete yo di yo vle mande azil nan Grann Bretay pou jwenn avantaj sosyal ak lòt benefis. Yon sous nan Pò Calais te di AFP, ajans nouvèl nasyonal Lafrans, "Nou remake gen anpil plis migran, e pandan verifikasyon nou yo, nou jwenn pi plis moun toujou." 

Nan premye de semèn mwa sa a sèlman, anviwon 1,200 migran te arete, men pifò te libere touswit paske sant detansyon yo chaje. Sa pèmèt yo retounen Calais oswa lòt pò Lafrans, kote yo kontinye jwe kach kach ak lapolis epi eseye monte sou kamyon ak ferry k ap ale UK.

Dènyèman, majistra Calais la mete yon dekrè pou entèdi kan nan kèk zòn, akoz enkyetid sou sante piblik. Plizyè kan ilegal detwi pandan otorite yo ap chèche ankouraje migran yo kite vil la. Kan ki te bò Pò Ferry Calais la te debake ak lapolis ak machin lou. Men sa yo pa anpeche plizyè santèn migran soti peyi tankou Soudan, Somali, Eritre, Irak, ak Afganistan kontinye rive.

Majistra Calais, Natacha Bouchart, deklare sistem byennèt sosyal Grann Bretay la se youn nan prensipal koz kriz migran an. Adjwen Majistra a, Philippe Mignonet, ki responsab imigrasyon pò a, te di nan Desanm ke Grann Bretay dwe fè plis pou jere kantite migran k ap travèse paske peyi a 'atire imigran ilegal yo'. Mignonet di anpil migran refize tout èd nan Calais, paske objektif yo se rive Angletè: “Yo sèlman vle ale Angletè. Yo refize tout sa nou pwopoze paske yo vle ale Angletè,” li te esplike. Li te akize tou Grann Bretay pa ede Lafrans jere pwoblèm nan: “Yo pa patisipe, yo pa fè anyen.”
post_content: Over 7,000 migrants were arrested trying to reach the UK from Calais in just 6 months—double last year's figure. Most are released quickly cuz of overcrowded centers, so the struggle keeps going! #Calais #Migration #UKNews
translated_post: Plis pase 7,000 migran arete pandan y ap eseye ale UK soti Calais nan 6 mwa—sa double kantite ane pase! Pifò libere vit paske sant yo chaje, kidonk batay la ap kontinye! #Calais #Migrasyon #NouvèlUK

article_content: Natascha Kampusch, a 26-year-old Austrian who survived a notorious kidnapping, has chosen a reclusive lifestyle due to the lasting psychological effects of her ordeal. Once optimistic about her future after escaping her captor, Wolfgang Priklopil, in 2006—after being held for over eight years—Kampusch now finds regular contact with others overwhelming. She has given up her studies and no longer attends driving lessons, citing intense anxiety and panic, especially around her instructor. Kampusch recently withdrew from social media and rarely makes new friends, explaining that interacting with fellow students was especially distressing. Her experience was adapted into the film '3,096 Days,' in which Irish actress Antonia Campbell-Hughes—who underwent a strict diet to portray Kampusch's difficult situation—played the lead role. Observers have noted a significant difference in appearance between Kampusch and the actress; Kampusch herself has experienced notable weight gain since her captivity. She has stated that she no longer desires to have children and continues to struggle with the impact of her traumatic past.
translated_content: Natascha Kampusch, yon fanm Ostrich 26 zan ki te siviv kidnaping ki te fè pale anpil, chwazi viv pou kont li akoz konsekans sikolojik eksperyans li te pase. Li te gen espwa pou lavni li apre li te chape anba kidnape li, Wolfgang Priklopil, an 2006—apre plis pase uit ane nan kaptivite—men kounye a li santi li mal alèz ant kontak regilye ak lòt moun. Li kite lekòl li ak leson kondwi paske l ap soufri laperèz ak kè sote, sitou ak enstriktè li. Dènyèman, Kampusch retire tèt li sou rezo sosyal epi li pa souvan fè nouvo zanmi; li eksplike entèraksyon ak lòt elèv te trè difisil pou li. Istwa li te vin tounen yon fim rele '3,096 Days,' kote aktris Ilandèz Antonia Campbell-Hughes—ki te fè yon rejim strik pou jwe wòl Kampusch—te jwe wòl prensipal la. Moun remake diferans aparans ant Kampusch ak aktris la; Kampusch li menm pran plis pwa depi delivrans li. How do you use your smartphone, tablet, or laptop? Are you a hypersharer like Kim Kardashian, a tinkerer like WILL.I.AM, or a make-doer like Jennifer Aniston? Research by Dr. Jonathon Hutchinson, a lecturer at Sydney University in partnership with Microsoft, highlights six main categories of technology users, each illustrated by a celebrity.

- Tinkerers (like WILL.I.AM): Enthusiasts who explore, experiment, and innovate with technology.
- Self-improvers (like Blake Lively): Individuals who use tech to enhance productivity and personal growth.
- Hypersharers (like Kim Kardashian): People who love to share content widely on social media.
- Make-doers (like Jennifer Aniston): Users who aren't interested in the latest tech trends and prefer familiar tools.
- Spectators (like Julia Roberts): Those who mainly observe or consume digital content but rarely contribute.
- Content creators (like Katy Perry): Highly engaged users who regularly produce and share their own online content.

Dr. Hutchinson conducted focus groups with students aged 22-25 and professionals aged 33-43, who were asked about their technology use. The research found that 73% of the younger group and 22% of the older group were active technology users. An online quiz—hosted by Microsoft—lets people find out which technology type best matches their habits. According to Microsoft’s Steven Miller, there’s no one-size-fits-all approach in tech: everyone’s preferences are different.

Ki jan w itilize telefòn entelijan, tablèt, oswa òdinatè w? Èske ou se yon hypersharer tankou Kim Kardashian, yon tinkerer tankou WILL.I.AM, oswa yon make-doer tankou Jennifer Aniston? Selon rechèch Dr Jonathon Hutchinson, yon pwofesè nan Inivèsite Sydney ansanm ak Microsoft, gen sis kategori prensipal itilizatè teknoloji, chak ak yon selebrite kòm egzanp:

- Tinkerers (tankou WILL.I.AM): Moun ki renmen eksplore, teste, ak inove ak teknoloji.
- Self-improvers (tankou Blake Lively): Moun ki itilize teknoloji pou amelyore tèt yo ak pwodiktivite yo.
- Hypersharers (tankou Kim Kardashian): Moun ki renmen pataje anpil sou rezo sosyal yo.
- Make-doers (tankou Jennifer Aniston): Moun ki pa pran swen dènye tandans teknoloji yo, yo pito sa yo abitye ak li.
- Spectators (tankou Julia Roberts): Moun ki plis ap gade oswa li kontni dijital men yo pa abitye pataje.
- Content creators (tankou Katy Perry): Itilizatè ki toujou ap kreye epi pataje kontni pa yo sou entènèt la.

Dr Hutchinson te fè gwoup diskisyon ak jèn 22-25 an ak pwofesyonèl 33-43 an, pou poze kesyon sou itilizasyon teknoloji. Rechèch la montre 73% jèn yo ak 22% nan pi gran yo se itilizatè aktif. Gen yon tès sou entènèt—Microsoft ap òganize l—pou ede moun chèche konnen ki kategori ki pi sanble ak itilizasyon pa yo. Dapre Steven Miller, pa gen yon sèl fason pou tout moun sèvi ak teknoloji—chak moun diferan.

article_content: A luxury vacation tailored for gamers is now available, priced at £5,500 per person. The month-long 'Epic Gaming Adventure,' curated by GAME and STA Travel, spans three continents and eight countries, giving travelers a chance to visit sites significant to video game history and popular culture. The itinerary includes destinations that are either the birthplace of game franchises or places that have inspired iconic video games. The adventure kicks off in Edinburgh, Scotland, at Rockstar North’s headquarters—the creators of Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption, and Max Payne. From there, participants travel to London to visit the Loading Bar in Soho, a venue modeled after the gaming cafes of Tokyo. After leaving the UK, the trip heads to Phuket, Thailand, immersing travelers in the scenic Ko Tapu Islands, which featured in 'Tomb Raider Underworld.' The group moves on to Seoul, South Korea, to explore the celebrated e-Sports Stadium, a centerpiece of the country’s professional gaming scene. Tokyo, Japan, is next, where visitors stop by Konami's headquarters and dive into the celebrated arcade experience at Taito Station. Los Angeles is home to the E3 Games Conference and landmarks that inspired games like L.A. Noire and Grand Theft Auto’s Los Santos—the next experience on the route. The journey crosses the US to San Francisco, then Santa Clara, where Atari developed Pong in 1972, marking a key moment in gaming history. Travelers then visit the Funspot Family Entertainment Centre in New Hampshire—a legendary arcade and museum that has been welcoming visitors since the 1950s. The trip continues to New York, where guests see locations from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Crysis 3, before wrapping up in Bandera County, Texas, the setting that shaped the landscapes found in Red Dead Redemption and Gun. Ailsa McKnight, marketing director at GAME, describes the tour as a comprehensive celebration of gaming, combining its history and ongoing innovation to offer enthusiasts an experience beyond the typical holiday. Neil Hassall, marketing manager at STA Travel, refers to the adventure as an exclusive, behind-the-scenes journey to the real-world inspirations behind the world’s top games—a rare opportunity for avid gamers.

Itinera a enkli destinasyon ki se swa kote gwo fransis jwèt yo te kòmanse, oswa kote ki enspire kèk nan pi gwo jwèt yo. Aventura a kòmanse Edinburgh, Scotland, lakay Rockstar North—kreyatè Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption, ak Max Payne. Apre sa, patisipan yo ale nan London pou vizite Loading Bar nan Soho, yon kote ki pran enspirasyon nan bar jwèt Tokyo yo. Lè yo fini UK, yo vwayaje ale nan Phuket, Thailand, kote yo dekouvri bèl zile Ko Tapu yo, kote ki parèt nan ‘Tomb Raider Underworld’. Gwoup la kontinye nan Seoul, Kore di Sid, pou eksplore e-Sports Stadium la, kote e-sports se kè sèn jwèt pwofesyonèl peyi a. Apre sa se Tokyo, Japon, kote vizitè yo antre nan katye jeneral Konami epi jwi arcade Taito Station. Prochen etap la se Los Angeles, kote yo gen opòtinite pou tande konferans E3 ak wè moniman ki enspire jwèt tankou L.A. Noire ak Grand Theft Auto Los Santos. Vwayaj la Lè sa a, travèse Etazini pou rive San Francisco epi Santa Clara, kote Atari te devlope Pong an 1972, yon evènman kle nan istwa jwèt videyo. Apre sa, vwayajè yo vizite Funspot Family Entertainment Centre nan New Hampshire, yon arcade ak mize byen renome ki ekziste depi ane 1950 yo. Vwayaj la kontinye New York pou wè kote ki sèvi kòm enspirasyon pou Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 ak Crysis 3, epi li fini nan Bandera County, Texas, ki enspire peyizaj Red Dead Redemption ak Gun. Ailsa McKnight, direktè maketing nan GAME, dekri vwayaj la kòm yon selebrasyon total kilti jwèt, ki konbine istwa ak inovasyon pou bay fanatik yo yon eksperyans ekstraòdinè. Shoji Kawamori, the renowned anime director and designer, unveiled his latest project—the Inochi-Dama (Ball of Life)—at a recent press conference for Expo 2025. This creation is an intricate, spherical artwork intertwined with various creatures, representing the connection between all forms of life.

During the event, Kawamori discussed his role at Expo 2025, emphasizing collaborations with partners deeply committed to biodiversity conservation. Environmental protection and the importance of safeguarding natural diversity are at the core of his pavilion’s theme, echoing the messages found in his acclaimed anime series like Earth Maiden Arjuna, Macross Frontier, and Aquarion.

Aside from his well-known work as a mecha designer—such as on Armored Core VI—Kawamori is also recognized for his contributions to world-building in productions like Cowboy Bebop. His diverse expertise will be prominently featured at his Expo 2025 pavilion.

Expo 2025 is set to open near Osaka, Japan, in April next year. For further details, including ticket information, visit the official event website.

article_content: MP David Burrowes was left waiting for over 12 hours, initially in a storage area and later in a corridor at North Middlesex Hospital, after arriving with a ruptured appendix at 5:30am. Burrowes, the Conservative MP for Enfield Southgate, expected a quiet emergency department but found A&E overcrowded, with staff under significant pressure. After collapsing from pain on June 2, he was brought to A&E by ambulance. At 7am, a doctor assured him a CT scan would happen within a few hours. Due to an error, however, the scan was not booked, and he waited in pain on a trolley for several hours. Burrowes stated that without advocacy from his wife, mother, and friend, he might not have received treatment in time. He finally received a scan at 5:30pm, but then waited another seven hours in a corridor before a diagnosis could be made. He had surgery at 2pm the following day, nearly 33 hours after his arrival. Doctors found his appendix was perforated and gangrenous. Timely surgery averted a life-threatening infection. Burrowes expressed concern for patients without advocates, who could be vulnerable in a strained system. He noted that overcrowding prevented optimal care for everyone. The pressure at North Middlesex has been linked to the closure of the A&E at Chase Farm Hospital, which increased patient numbers beyond expectations. A Care Quality Commission report highlighted the hospital's resource shortfall. In response, a hospital spokesperson insisted Burrowes was safe throughout his stay and rejected claims that unaccompanied patients are at risk, stating staff remain vigilant and carry out hourly checks. The hospital apologized to Burrowes, attributing the delays to unusually high demand.

Burrowes, depite konsèvatè pou Enfield Southgate, te espere sèvis ijans lan te trankil, men li te jwenn A&E a plen ak pasyan pandan anplwaye yo te bouke anpil. Apre li te tonbe ak doulè nan dat 2 jen, yo te mennen l ijans ak anbilans. A 7am, yon doktè te di l ap gen yon CT scan nan kèk èdtan. Men, akòz yon erè, scan lan pa t rezève e li te oblije rete ap soufri sou yon kabwa pandan plizyè èdtan. Burrowes di si se pa t pou madanm li, manman l ak yon zanmi ki te batay pou li, li pa t ap jwenn swen a tan. Finalman, li fè scan a 5:30pm, men li te tann sèt lòt èdtan nan koridò a avan yo dyagnostike li. Yo te opere l a 2pm jou apre, prèske 33 èdtan apre li te rive. Doktè yo jwenn apendis li te pèforasyon ak enfeksyon grav. Operasyon rapid la te sove l kont yon enfeksyon ki ka bay lanmò. Burrowes eksprime kè sote pou pasyan ki pa gen moun pou defann yo, paske yo ka vin frajil ak pèdi nan sistèm lan. Li mete aksan sou jan laplipa ap tann konplike ba tout moun pi bon swen. Presyon sou North Middlesex gen rapò ak fèmen sèvis ijans Chase Farm Hospital la, ki ogmante kantite pasyan plis pase sa yo te panse. Rapò Komisyon Kalite Swen Sante UK mete aksan sou mank resous yo. Yon pòt pawòl lopital la di Burrowes te an sekirite pandan tout vizit li epi rejte lide ke pasyan ki pou kont yo an danje, li mete aksan sou vijilans ak chèk regilye pa pèsonèl la. Lopital la fE eskiz bay Burrowes epi mete reta yo sou epòl demann ekstraòdinè ki te genyen nan peryòd sa a.

As multiple crises intensify worldwide, the need for improved mental healthcare has never been greater. Ongoing challenges—including the persistent impacts of COVID-19, rising climate-related emergencies, and the continued effects of conflict and displacement—are putting immense pressure on individuals’ mental health and the support services that serve them. Stigma and discrimination against individuals with mental health conditions and psychosocial disabilities still exist across schools, workplaces, and communities.

With nearly one billion people globally—about one in eight—living with a mental health condition, and long-standing underinvestment in mental health services, the gap between those needing care and those receiving it is widening. This disparity poses serious risks to the well-being and happiness of millions. COVID-19 exposed weaknesses in mental health systems globally, intensifying existing challenges and highlighting new ones. In Chile, as in many other nations, the pandemic’s toll on mental health was profound, emphasizing the importance of robust and resilient support structures.

Recent events underline the urgency of transforming approaches to mental health. Mental health should be recognized as an integral part of health and well-being, a fundamental human right, and a key contributor to public health and sustainable development. Mental healthcare systems need strengthening, ensuring accessible, affordable, and high-quality services through community-based networks. The World Health Organization (WHO) is partnering with countries to advance these goals. For instance, the Special Initiative for Mental Health has, since 2019, helped extend access to mental health services—where previously none existed—to 40 million people across nine countries.

Addressing mental health challenges demands coordinated action. The Global Summit on Mental Health in Argentina highlighted the necessity of a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach to mental health promotion and care. Policies must also focus on reshaping environments to reduce mental health risks and build protective factors, offering everyone equal opportunities for well-being.

Chile has undertaken major reforms through its 'Construyendo Salud Mental' (Building Mental Health) strategy. This program aims to strengthen leadership, improve services, enhance crisis support, and advance research in mental health. Essential to this effort is integrating mental health services into primary healthcare and community centers, ensuring a holistic approach. The strategy also targets suicide prevention—a critical issue globally as suicide is now the second leading cause of death among 15 to 24-year-olds.

Real progress in mental health requires strong political leadership, commitment, and greater investments across sectors. Chile’s example demonstrates that sustained public mental health initiatives can offer substantial benefits. However, many countries still lag in providing adequate care.

On World Mental Health Day, with its focus on mental health as a basic human right, it is vital to remember that many still experience neglect, abuse, or lack of agency in mental health services. There is a collective responsibility to ensure that mental health care respects human rights and supports patient recovery. To support this, WHO and the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights have released new guidance to help countries align mental health laws and policies with international human rights standards.

Communities and governments are urged to recognize mental health as a universal human right, enhance awareness, and take concrete steps to make mental health support accessible to all.

Pandan gen plizyè kriz kap ogmante atravè mond lan, nesesite pou amelyore sèvis sante mantal vin pi presan pase tout tan. Pwoblèm tankou konsekans COVID-19, ogmantasyon ijans ki gen rapò ak klima, ak efè konfli ak deplasman kontinye mete presyon sou sante mantal moun ansanm ak sèvis ki dwe ede yo. Geno toujou estigma ak diskriminasyon kont moun ki gen maladi mantal ak andikap sikososyal nan lekòl, nan travay, ak nan kominote yo.

Prèske yon milya moun nan lemond—epreske 1 sou 8—ap viv ak yon maladi mantal. Anpil peyi pa janm envesti ase nan sèvis sante mantal, sa ki fè plizyè moun bezwen swen men pa jwenn. Diferans sa menase byennèt ak kè kontan milyon moun. Pandemi COVID-19 mete defo sistèm sante mantal yo laklè, ogmante pwoblèm deja egziste epi fè lòt parèt. Nan Chili, menm jan ak lòt peyi, COVID-19 afekte sante mantal anpil, sa ki montre enpòtans sistèm sipò solid.

Dènye evènman yo montre jan li enpòtan transfòme apwòch nou genyen sou sante mantal. Li ta dwe wè kòm yon eleman enpòtan nan sante ak byennèt, yon dwa imen, epi yon bagay esansyèl pou sante piblik ak devlopman dirab. Sistèm sante mantal dwe vin pi solid, bay sèvis ki fasil pou jwenn, pri abòdab, epi ak bon kalite atravè rezo kominotè. Òganizasyon Mondyal Lasante (OMS) ap travay ak peyi yo pou avanse objektif sa yo. Pa egzanp, Special Initiative for Mental Health lan, depi 2019, ogmante aksè a sèvis mantal pou 40 milyon moun nan 9 peyi.

Reponn ak defi sante mantal mande tout leta ak sosyete travay ansanm. Global Summit on Mental Health ki fèt ann Ajantin te met aksan sou nesesite sa. Politik sante yo dwe ede redui risk epi ranfòse faktè ki pwoteje, pou tout moun gen opòtinite egal pou byennèt.

Chili mete an plas gwo refòm ak estrateji "Construyendo Salud Mental". Pwogram sa vize ranfòse lidèchip, amelyore sèvis, ogmante asistans an ka ijans, epi avanse rechèch sou sante mantal. Entegre swen mantal ak sant swen premye degre ak sant kominotè se kle pou konstriksyon apwòch solid. Estrateji a ap fòkous sou prevansyon swisid tou—yon gwo pwoblèm sante piblik paske swisid se dezyèm koz lanmò pami jèn 15 a 24 an atravè lemond.

Progres reyèl mande lidèchip politik fò, angajman ak envestisman solid. Egzanp Chili montre ke angajman long tèm ka bay gwo rezilta. Men toujou gen twòp peyi kote swen ap manke.

Se devwa nou kolektivman asire dwa sa a respekte epi ede yon rekiperasyon diyite. Pou sa, OMS ak Komisyon Nasyonzini pou Dwa Moun mete deyò nouvo gid pou ede peyi yo mete lwa ak politik sante mantal yo aliman ak dwa moun sou plan entènasyonal.

Kominote ak gouvènman yo ap ankouraje pou rekonèt sante mantal kòm yon dwa inivèsèl, ogmante konsyans epi pran aksyon pou tout moun jwenn swen mantal ki bon.

Opinyon ki parèt nan atik sa a se opinyon otè a epi pa nesesèman reflete sa Al Jazeera panse.

article_content:
Former South Carolina Governor Nikki Haley's presidential campaign is gaining momentum. Recent polling shows she is increasingly competitive with President Joe Biden in a hypothetical general election. Meanwhile, Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, once seen as the primary threat to former President Donald Trump's quest for the GOP nomination, is now trailing significantly and continues to lose ground.

Haley, while still polling lower than Trump, is seeing a notable rise: her average in the FiveThirtyEight GOP polls has climbed to about 8%, up from 3% in early August. As the Iowa caucuses and New Hampshire primary draw near, candidates with lower polling numbers may drop out, creating a more direct contest with Trump.

Many Republicans were not familiar with Haley earlier this year, despite her tenure as Ambassador to the United Nations under Trump from 2017 to 2018. Unlike other candidates, she had low unfavorable ratings, and many voters expressed no opinion about her, indicating room for growth among primary voters. After the second debate, a Morning Consult survey conducted from September 29 through October 1 found that 49% of potential GOP primary voters viewed Haley favorably, while 20% had an unfavorable view; 15% still had not heard of her.

Haley is improving her position in several statewide polls, especially after debate performances where she was seen positively. In a Public Opinion Strategies poll of South Carolina, Trump led with 53% among definite and likely supporters, with Haley in second at 18%. In New Hampshire, Trump polled at 44% with Haley next at 17%, according to Public Opinion Strategies. A USA TODAY/Boston Globe/Suffolk poll in New Hampshire showed Trump at 49%, Haley at 19%, and DeSantis at 10%.

Highlighting Haley's electability, a recent NBC poll showed her leading Biden by 5 points (46%-41%), whereas Trump was tied with Biden (46%-46%), and DeSantis trailed slightly (45%-46%).

Many Republican donors, concerned about another Trump nomination, were optimistic about DeSantis, who had been reelected governor of Florida with ease in 2022, leading a strong GOP performance in the state. However, DeSantis has generally lingered in second or third place in state and national polls, while Haley, entrepreneur Vivek Ramaswamy, and Senator Tim Scott have also gained attention in early-voting states.

As DeSantis's campaign faces challenges, Haley could benefit, particularly since she has mostly avoided the contentious culture war issues DeSantis has engaged in, such as disputes with the Walt Disney Company and debates over education in Florida. Recently, DeSantis has concentrated his efforts on winning Iowa, aiming for a victory to gain momentum for New Hampshire and South Carolina. Trump, however, is also campaigning in Iowa, though he has faced criticism from some evangelicals regarding controversial statements on abortion.

With the Iowa caucuses scheduled for January 15, 2024, Republican candidates still have time to make their case. However, those polling in low single digits may exit the race by year’s end. As long as multiple non-Trump candidates remain, the former president is likely to maintain his advantage. If the field narrows to just Trump and Haley, she could consolidate support from other candidates' backers, potentially providing more of a challenge to Trump. With Trump's ongoing legal battles possibly interrupting his campaign, Haley may have more opportunities to present her case. Ultimately, Haley could become the candidate who puts pressure on Trump.

Kanpay prezidansyèl ansyen Gouvènè South Carolina Nikki Haley ap monte wo. Dènye sondaj yo montre li vin plis konpetitif kont Prezidan Joe Biden pou eleksyon jeneral la. Pandan sa, Gouvènè Florid Ron DeSantis, ki te konsidere kòm pi gwo rival Donald Trump pou nominasyon GOP la, li dèyè epi ap pèdi pwen toujou.

Malgre Haley poko depase Trump nan sondaj, li ap ogmante: li rive 8% nan sondaj mwayèn FiveThirtyEight, pandan li te sèlman 3% nan kòmansman mwa Out. Avèk caucus Iowa ak primè New Hampshire ki prè pou komanse, kandida ki fè ba ka kite kous la, ki ap fè l pi dirèk kont Trump.

Anpil Repibliken pa t konnen Haley byen, menm si li te Anbasadè Nasyonzini anba Trump entre 2017 ak 2018. Diferan ak lòt kandida yo, li te gen ti kantite moun ki pa t renmen li epi anpil ki pa t gen opinyon sou li, ki bay li opòtinite pou monte. Sondaj Morning Consult, 29 septanm pou 1 oktòb, apre dezyèm deba a, te montre 49% elektè GOP te gen opinyon favorab sou Haley, 20% pa t renmen li, epi 15% pat janm tande non li.

Apre deba, Haley ap monte nan plizyè sondaj sou eta yo kote li parèt pozitif. Nan South Carolina, sondaj Public Opinion Strategies mete Trump devan ak 53%, Haley dezyèm ak 18%. Nan New Hampshire, Trump te gen 44%, Haley 17%. Sondaj USA TODAY/Boston Globe/Suffolk nan New Hampshire bay Trump 49%, Haley 19%, ak DeSantis 10%.

Sou kesyon eleksyon jeneral la, sondaj NBC fè konnen Haley mennen Biden ak 5 pwen (46%-41%), pandan Trump ak Biden egal (46%-46%), epi DeSantis dèyè (45%-46%).

Anpil gwo donatè GOP te swete DeSantis ta fè pi byen akòz reeleksyon li fasil an 2022, men jiskaprezan, li toujou rete dezyèm oswa twazyèm nan sondaj yo. Haley, antreprenè Vivek Ramaswamy, ak Senatè Tim Scott ap gen pi plis vizibilite.

article_content: Went The Day Well? Witnessing Waterloo by David Crane (William Collins, £20) offers a vivid re-examination of the Battle of Waterloo by combining military history with rich social and cultural insights. News of the battle, where nearly 200,000 men fought on Belgian soil, didn’t arrive in London until June 21, 1815—three days after the event. Prime Minister Lord Liverpool was dining when an exhausted Major Henry Percy entered, bringing two captured French imperial eagles. Liverpool hurried to the Prince Regent (the future George IV), who responded with joy but concern about possible British losses. Major Percy solemnly confirmed extensive casualties, causing the Prince to weep. Crane’s book sets itself apart from traditional histories by weaving the action in Belgium with scenes of British life on June 18, 1815. His narrative spans all social strata, featuring artists, writers, prize-fighters, clergy, and more. By drawing parallels to Bruegel’s The Fall of Icarus, Crane illustrates how life continued in Britain as the battle raged elsewhere. Readers encounter historical figures like Mary Lamb, William Hazlitt, and William Wilberforce, against the lively backdrop of Regency London. Crane skillfully builds suspense throughout the day, contrasting scenes of soldiers preparing for battle, a grieving mother in Harris, children at Sunday school in Altrincham, and jousting spectators at Arundel Castle—while everyone anxiously awaited news from Waterloo. He argues that the Napoleonic Wars, like 20th-century world wars, were ‘total wars’ permeating all aspects of national life. His attention to detail yields striking anecdotes, including unsynchronized watches among soldiers and powerful battlefield moments like boxer Jack Shaw’s last stand and Lord Uxbridge’s resilient amputation. Above all, the book honors the resolve and sacrifices of ordinary soldiers from across Britain. An illustrative episode has Wellington indicating that victory depended on these common infantrymen. Crane validates Wellington's view: it was their collective courage that brought down Napoleon.
translated_content: Liv 'Went The Day Well? Witnessing Waterloo' pa David Crane (William Collins, £20) bay yon re-eksplikasyon klè sou Batay Waterloo a, an melanje istwa militè ak detaye sou lavi sosyal ak kiltirèl. Nouvèl batay la, kote prèske 200,000 moun te goumen sou tè Bèljik, pa t rive Lond jiskaske 21 jen 1815—twa jou apre l te fèt. Premye Minis Lord Liverpool t ap dine lè Major Henry Percy, fatige, te rive ak de estanda imerial franse. Liverpool prese al jwenn Prince Regent (ki vin tounen George IV), ki te kontan men ki t ap enkyete pou kantite moun Britanik ki te pèdi lavi yo. Major Percy avèti yo pèdi anpil, sa ki fè Prince la woule dlo nan je. Liv Crane lan pa menm ak listwa òdinè paske li melanje evènman an Bèljik ak lavi britanik 18 jen 1815—li eksplike kijan tout klas sosyal, atis, ekriven, batè, ak pèsonalite relijye te viv jounen sa. Li fè referans ak tablo Bruegel 'The Fall of Icarus' pou montre kijan lavi t ap dewoule an Angletè pandan batay la, pandan li mete aksan sou figi istorik tankou Mary Lamb, William Hazlitt, ak William Wilberforce kont yon dekor Regency London ki dinamik. Crane ogmante sans saspens la pandan li konpare sòlda k ap pare pou lagè, yon manman ki ap soufri sou zile Harris, timoun nan lekòl dimanch Altrincham, ak foul k ap gade joute nan Arundel Castle—tout moun ap tann nouvèl Waterloo a. Li fè konnen lagè Napoléon yo, tankou lagè mondyal le 20yèm syèk la, se te 'lagè total' ki te touche tout aspè lavi peyi a. Detay li bay yo montre moman enpòtan, tankou konfizyon sou lè nan mitan sòlda yo, dènye konba Jack Shaw, ak amputasyon Lord Uxbridge san anestezi. Pi enpòtan, Crane onore kouraj ak sakrifis sòlda òdinè yo atravè tout Gran Bretay. Gen yon epizòd kote Wellington fè konnen tout bagay te depann de sòlda sa yo. Crane montre se kouraj pèp sa yo ki te kraze Napoleon.

Former CIA Director David Petraeus’s affair with his biographer, Paula Broadwell, was marked by its use of espionage tactics—ironically exposing vulnerabilities at the highest levels of intelligence. Petraeus and Broadwell concealed their relationship for nearly a year by communicating through a single Gmail account. Instead of sending emails, which would create a digital record, they saved messages as drafts for the other to read and erase, mimicking the 'dead drop' methods used by spies.

The affair came to light when Broadwell sent anonymous, threatening emails to Jill Kelley, an honorary social liaison for MacDill Air Force Base in Florida. Concerned for her safety, Kelley contacted an FBI friend after receiving messages with warnings like 'I know what you did,' 'back off,' and 'stay away from my guy.' The FBI investigation that followed exposed the secret communications.

Jill Kelley, her husband Scott, and the Petraeus family had been close friends for several years, often attending social events together. Petraeus’s messages to Kelley via official channels were deemed appropriate by investigators. However, further scrutiny fell on extensive email correspondence between Kelley and General John Allen, commander of U.S. and NATO forces in Afghanistan. Investigators examined thousands of pages of their exchanges, with some flagged for their flirtatious nature. Allen’s use of terms like 'sweetheart' sparked debate, though Pentagon officials noted such language can be common and platonic in southern culture.

Each principal figure—Petraeus, Broadwell, Kelley, and Allen—was married with families. The high-profile scandal brought public attention to the convergence of personal relationships, national security, and the challenges of digital privacy in government life.
translated_content:
Ansyen Direktè CIA David Petraeus te gen yon afè amoure ak biyograf li, Paula Broadwell, kote yo te sèvi ak teknik espyonaj—yon ironi ki montre feblès sekirite nan pi gwo nivo. Petraeus ak Broadwell te kache relasyon yo pandan prèske yon ane, lè yo te pataje yon kont Gmail. Olye yo voye imèl, yo te ekri mesaj kòm bouyon epi kite lòt la li ak efase yo, tankou sistèm 'dead drop' espyon yo.

Zafè a sòti an piblik lè Broadwell te voye imèl anonim ak menas bay Jill Kelley, ki se yon madanm socialite e lyezon sosyal onorè pou MacDill Air Force Base nan Florid. Apre Kelley te resevwa mesaj tankou 'Mwen konnen sa ou fè,' 'rete lwen,' ak 'kite nonm mwen an', li te al jwenn yon zanmi li ki ajan FBI paske li te pè. Ankèt FBI a te mete relasyon kache yo an limyè.

Jill Kelley, mari li Scott, ak fanmi Petraeus la te bon zanmi, yo te konn soti ansanm souvan. Envestigatè yo te di korespondans Petraeus ak Kelley sou chanèl ofisyèl yo te apwopriye. Men yo te verifye anpil imèl ant Kelley ak Jeneral John Allen—kòmandan fòs Ameriken ak NATO ann Afganistan—epi yo te jwenn kèk ki gen nati fè flèrt. Mo tankou 'chou' ke Allen te itilize te bay deba, men ofisyèl Pentagon yo di se yon mo platonyk e li komen nan sid peyi a.

Tout akte prensipal yo—Petraeus, Broadwell, Kelley ak Allen—te marye ak gen pitit. Eskandal la mete aksan sou melanj lavi prive, sekirite nasyonal ak difikilte pou kenbe vi prive dijital nan leta.

article_content: Sarah Murnaghan, a 10-year-old girl from Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, is recovering after a double lung transplant enabled by a judge ordering her placement on the adult donor list following her family's petition. She remains heavily sedated and intubated, with her family reporting significant pain after coming out of a medically-induced coma post-surgery on June 12. Earlier, Sarah transitioned from a heavy-duty breathing machine to a traditional ventilator, according to her mother, Janet Ruddock Murnaghan. "We are tapering sedation and pain medication to help Sarah become more alert before extubation, but she's in a lot of pain," her mother wrote on Facebook. Typically, lung transplant patients have their breathing tubes removed within 24 hours and are out of intensive care within a week, but children's recoveries can vary, sometimes taking months. Family spokeswoman Tracy Simon said Sarah has been awake since last Friday and can answer yes or no questions by nodding. Her family feels encouraged by her progress, though Sarah is frustrated that the tube prevents her from speaking. Sarah has cystic fibrosis, a life-threatening genetic disorder, and doctors said she had only weeks to live without a transplant. Because pediatric organ donations are rare and previous policies barred her from the adult list, her condition was critical. On June 6, a federal judge ruled that Sarah could be added to the adult transplant list, giving her access to a suitable set of lungs, likely from an adult or teen donor. Sarah's situation led to national debate over transplant policies that previously excluded children under 12 from adult waiting lists. Her family expressed deep gratitude for the donor, while also acknowledging the grief experienced by the donor's loved ones. Dr. Arthur Caplan, a bioethicist at NYU Langone Medical Center, questioned the judge's intervention, pointing out that children tend to have more complications than adults after lung transplants. He suggested this legal precedent could invite more court involvement in medical resource allocation. Sarah has been hospitalized since February, and recently marked 100 days at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia with her parents and three younger siblings. According to the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network, about 1,700 people in the U.S. are waiting for a lung transplant, including 31 children under age 11.
translated_content: Sarah Murnaghan, yon tifi 10 zan ki soti Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, ap sòti piti piti apre yon transplantasyon doub poumon. Jij la te pèmèt li ale sou lis donatè granmoun apre fanmi li te fè petisyon. Li toujou sou anpil medikaman ak entibasyon, epi fanmi li di li santi anpil doulè depi yo leve li nan koma medikal li te ladan l'apre operasyon 12 jen an. Anvan sa, Sarah te kite aparèy respiratwa lou epi li tounen sou yon vantilatè nòmal, dapre manman li, Janet Ruddock Murnaghan. "Nou ap bese sedasyon ak medikaman doulè yo pou Sarah ka vin pi konsyan anvan nou retire tib la, men li ap santi anpil doulè," manman li ekri sou Facebook. Nòmalman, pasyan transplantasyon poumon retire tib respirasyon an anndan 24 èdtan epi yo soti nan swen entansif aprè yon semèn, men retablisman timoun ka pran plizyè mwa. Pòtpawòl fanmi an, Tracy Simon, di depi vandredi pase a Sarah leve epi li ka reponn kesyon "wi" oswa "non" ak tèt li. Fanmi an ankouraje ak pwogrè li, men Sarah fristre paske tib la pa kite l pale. Sarah gen fibwoz kistik, yon maladi jenetik grav, e doktè yo te di li sèlman te gen kèk semèn pou viv san transplantasyon. Piske don ògàn pou timoun ra epi règleman avan yo pa t kite li sou lis granmoun, li te vrèman an danje. Sou 6 jen, yon jij federal te bay lòd pou Sarah antre sou lis transplantasyon granmoun yo, sa ki te pèmèt li jwenn poumon nan men yon granmoun oswa adolesan. Sitiyasyon Sarah la te kreye yon gwo deba atravè peyi a sou règ transplantasyon an ki pa t mete timoun ki gen mwens pase 12 an sou lis granmoun. Fanmi li remèsye donatè a anpil epi yo panse ak la doulè fanmi ki pèdi yon moun. Dr. Arthur Caplan, yon biyetikis nan NYU Langone Medical Center, mete an kesyon entèvansyon jij la. Li di timoun yo fè plis konplikasyon pase granmoun apre transplantasyon poumon. Li panse desizyon sa a ka bay lòt moun kouraj pou ale nan tribinal sou kesyon resous medikal yo. Sarah ap viv lopital depi mwa fevriye epi li fenk selebre 100yèm jou li nan Children's Hospital of Philadelphia ak paran ak twa ti frè ak sè l yo. Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network fè konnen gen apeprè 1,700 moun Ozetazini k ap tann transplantasyon poumon, ladan yo 31 timoun ki pi piti pase 11 an.

article_content:
The massacre at Sandy Hook Elementary School prompted the Obama administration to consider new gun laws, such as banning high-capacity magazines. Until now, such efforts—along with other policy changes—have often been hindered by the National Rifle Association (NRA), which has consistently advocated for looser gun restrictions, despite widespread public support for reasonable legislation. While there is hope that this time might be different, some worry the outcome could remain unchanged.

A major factor behind the NRA’s influence is what economists and political scientists call the 'collective action problem.' Although most Americans favor common-sense firearm restrictions, gun control supporters tend to be less mobilized than a smaller group of passionate opponents. Legislative hearings often see overwhelming numbers of gun rights advocates, while those supporting gun control are mostly absent. Tragic events can temporarily motivate what has been called the 'silent majority,' but sustaining that momentum is difficult, as seen with the Million Mom March. In 2000, approximately 750,000 people gathered in Washington, D.C., to call for tougher gun laws in response to high-profile shootings. Yet, momentum quickly faded—the following year, the rally drew just about 100 people. Today, some federal gun laws are weaker than they were a decade ago. For example, the federal assault weapons ban expired in 2004 and was not renewed.

Currently, there is a brief opportunity for strong action on gun control. Turning short-term willingness into a sustained commitment is key. One solution is to encourage those upset by recent shootings to sign up for automatic, monthly contributions to a fund dedicated to challenging the NRA’s financial sway. For every dollar the NRA spends on political candidates, this fund would ideally spend two to support candidates favoring stronger gun laws. This approach can address politicians’ concerns about losing NRA backing, by ensuring they receive matched or greater support from gun control advocates.

According to the Center for Responsive Politics, the NRA spent about $20 million in the 2012 election cycle, including over $1 million in direct campaign contributions and around $8.5 million in support of congressional candidates. Although this may seem substantial, it’s just a fraction of what President Obama raised in 2012 and a small portion of the net worth of the NRA’s outspoken critic, New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg. If Bloomberg and other gun control supporters pledged a comparable percentage of their wealth, average supporters could contribute affordable amounts, such as $10 or $20 a month. Most people wouldn’t even notice these small deductions from their accounts, but collectively, they could significantly alter the balance of political influence.

Changing the default from political inactivity to consistent engagement could, over time, diminish the NRA’s grip. When that happens, it may finally lead to meaningful changes in American gun policy, driven by the will of the people. (The opinions in this commentary reflect those of Ethan Bueno de Mesquita and Jens Ludwig.)

Gen espwa fwa sa a ka diferan, men gen kè sote ke anyen pap chanje.

article_content: The Lagos State Ministry for Basic and Secondary Education has encouraged teachers to update their teaching methods to meet the needs of the rapidly evolving educational landscape. Commissioner for Basic and Secondary Education, Mr. Jamiu Alli-Balogun, delivered this message at the opening ceremony of a capacity-building programme for public and private secondary school teachers. The programme, held in partnership with Casio/SKLD Integrated Services Ltd., is themed ‘Equipping Educators with Enquiry-Based Methodology and Accuracy Skills in the 21st Century Classroom’ as part of the Casio Model School Project 2023/2024. The initiative aims to train 1,200 teachers. Alli-Balogun noted the importance of teachers adapting to modern classrooms, where students are increasingly active in their learning. He said, 'Our classrooms are now vibrant centers of knowledge and innovation, where students take an active role in their learning journeys. As educators, we must equip them with the tools needed to navigate a complex and ever-changing world.' Deputy Managing Director of SKLD Integrated Services Ltd., Mr. Tayo Oshiyemi, stated that the five-year collaboration with MBSE has produced several educational initiatives. According to Oshiyemi, enhancing student learning experiences involves training teachers and providing resources across various levels. Oshiyemi added that the SKLD and Casio partnership, which began in 2018 under the Gakuhan Programme of Casio Japan, has led to many capacity-building efforts in education. In 2021, a Casio lab was established at the Lagos Education Resource Centre, where over 3,000 teachers were trained in using analytical tools such as Casio scientific calculators. He expressed hope that this project would empower teachers with new methodologies, engage students in innovative ways, and help unlock every student's potential in Lagos State. Additionally, 1,200 calculators were donated to encourage hands-on learning. Permanent Secretary of MBSE, Mr. Abolaji Abayomi, stated that the ministry's goal is to continually improve teaching and learning outcomes, aiming to surpass the previous year's achievements. General Manager of Casio Middle East Africa, Mr. Koji Shimada, affirmed that Casio will continue supporting the ministry with technological advancements, including scientific calculators. Shimada also mentioned ongoing classroom renovations across six education districts, which will be used for teacher and student capacity development. Mrs. Victoria Peregrino, Chairman of the Lagos State Teaching Services Commission, highlighted that this training programme gives teachers the chance to enhance their knowledge and skills.

Komisyonè Edikasyon Fondamantal ak Segondè a, Mesye Jamiu Alli-Balogun, te bay mesaj sa a pandan ouvèti yon pwogram ranfòsman kapasite pou pwofesè lekòl segondè piblik ak prive. Pwogram lan, ki fèt an patenarya ak Casio/SKLD Integrated Services Ltd., gen tèm 'Ekip Pwofesè ak Metod Ansèyman ki Baze sou Rechèch ak Presizyon nan Salklas 21yèm Syèk la' kòm yon pati nan Casio Model School Project 2023/2024. Objektif la se fòme 1,200 pwofesè. Alli-Balogun mete aksan sou nesesite ke pwofesè yo adapte ak nouvo salklas kote elèv yo plis aktif nan aprantisaj yo. Li di: 'Salklas nou yo se kounye a sant konesans ak inovasyon kote elèv yo jwe yon gwo wòl nan aprantisaj yo. Kòm edikatè, se responsablite nou pou bay yo zouti pou yo oryante tèt yo nan yon mond ki konplike ak ap chanje toujou.' Direktè Adjwen SKLD Integrated Services Ltd., Mesye Tayo Oshiyemi, deklare ke kolaborasyon senk ane ak MBSE mennen plizyè inisyativ edikasyon. An 2021, yon laboratwa Casio te etabli nan Lagos Education Resource Centre, kote plis pase 3,000 pwofesè te resevwa fòmasyon sou itilizasyon zouti analiz tankou kalkilatris syantifik Casio. article_content: Danny Sevilla, 33, a Chicago police officer, has been charged with drunk driving after being found traveling the wrong way on the I-57 freeway early Friday morning. At around 5:45 am, Sevilla drove northbound in the southbound lane toward downtown Chicago in a black Mitsubishi Outlander. Other motorists noticed Sevilla driving dangerously, pursued him, and honked their horns as he entered the freeway via an exit ramp. Bystanders were able to catch up, open his car door, and turn off the ignition. According to the Chicago Tribune, police arrived shortly after, detained Sevilla, and discovered he was carrying a firearm. Sevilla has been relieved of his police powers and placed on administrative duty. Police sources noted he appeared intoxicated when removed from the vehicle. Jujuan Williams, 42, who was driving to the gym, said Sevilla was headed for a potential head-on collision if he had not been stopped. Fortunately, nobody was injured and no vehicles were struck, largely due to the light traffic at that early hour. Sevilla was alone in the car during the incident.

Anviwon 5:45 am, Sevilla t ap kondwi direksyon nò sou liy ki mennen sid pou ale sant vil Chicago nan yon Mitsubishi Outlander nwa. Lòt chofè yo remake danje a, yo swiv li epi sonnen klakson yo pandan li t ap monte otowout la pa yon ram sòti. Temwen yo te rive jwenn Sevilla, louvri pòt machin nan, epi fèmen motè a. Dapre Chicago Tribune, polis yo rive aprè, arete Sevilla epi dekouvri li te genyen zam sou li. Yo retire tout otorite polisye Sevilla epi mete l sou travay administratif. Sous polis yo di li te sanble sou enfliyans alkòl lè yo te sòti li nan machin lan. Heureusement, pèsonn pa blese ni okenn machin pa frape, sitou paske te gen ti trafik nan moman sa. Sevilla te sèl nan machin nan pandan evènman an.

article_content: The Marrakech International Film Festival is preparing to host its sixth Atlas Workshops, an initiative that supports up-and-coming filmmakers from Morocco, the Arab world, and Africa. Scheduled for November 27-30, the event will showcase 25 chosen projects—16 at the development stage and 9 either in production or post-production. These were selected from 320 entries representing 11 countries, highlighting the broad spectrum of narratives and genres being explored by regional filmmakers. Featured projects include Sandra Tabet’s horror film 'Rabies' from Lebanon, Hind Bensari’s Moroccan documentary 'Out of School', and Adnane Baraka’s poetic work 'We Don’t Forget'. The lineup also includes filmmakers with international experience, such as Baraka (known for 'Fragments from Heaven'), Erige Sehiri (whose 'Under The Fig Trees' was Tunisia’s Oscar submission), and Khadar Ayderus Ahmed (whose 'The Gravedigger's Wife' was Somalia’s first Academy Award entry). Other anticipated films are 'Agora' by Tunisian director Ala Eddine Slim, 'The Village Next To Paradise' by Somalia’s Mo Harawe, and 'Motherhood' by Tunisia’s Meryam Joobeur, an Oscar nominee for her short film 'Brotherhood'. Teams behind the selected projects will receive tailored guidance from specialists in screenwriting, production, distribution, editing, and music composition. They will also participate in a co-production market attended by about 250 accredited professionals. The workshops will grant €126,000 in prizes, including the ArteKino Prize, as determined by the juries. Beyond project development and networking, attendees can join panel discussions, including a conversation with Oscar-nominated director Tarik Saleh about 'Boy From Heaven', and a case study from Moroccan director Sofia Alaoui on her film 'Animalia', focusing on the use of special effects in African and Middle Eastern filmmaking.

Soti 27 pou 30 Novanm, 25 pwojè pral prezante—16 nan devlopman ak 9 swa annapre oswa ap fini—yo te chwazi pami 320 kandida ki soti nan 11 peyi, sa ki montre gran varyete istwa ak estil sinema moun rejyon an ap pote. Pami chwa yo gen fim laterè 'Rabies' pa Sandra Tabet (Liban), dokimantè 'Out of School' pa Hind Bensari (Maròk), ak travay powetik 'We Don’t Forget' pa Adnane Baraka. Gen sinematograf ki deja make non yo entènasyonalman tankou Baraka (ki fè 'Fragments from Heaven'), Erige Sehiri (fim li 'Under The Fig Trees' te reprezante Tinizi nan Òskè a), ak Khadar Ayderus Ahmed (fim li 'The Gravedigger's Wife' te premye sinema Somali nan Istwa Òskè yo). Pami lòt pwojè enpòtan yo gen 'Agora' pa Tinisyen Ala Eddine Slim, 'The Village Next To Paradise' pa Mo Harawe (Sòmali), ak 'Motherhood' pa Meryam Joobeur (Tinizi), ki te jwenn nominasyon Òskè ak kout fim li 'Brotherhood'. article_content: Amazon Seller Services, which runs Amazon's Indian marketplace, saw its net loss swell by 33% for the fiscal year ending March 2023. The loss reached Rs 4,854 crore, compared to Rs 3,649 crore the year before. Total expenses rose nearly 8% to Rs 27,283 crore, outpacing the 3.42% increase in revenue from operations, which totaled Rs 22,198 crore. Marketplace services revenue, encompassing third-party seller fees, increased by 33% to Rs 12,548 crore. The company also reported a 30% rise in advertising and related marketplace services revenue, amounting to Rs 5,380 crore. Meanwhile, revenue from services to related parties dropped sharply by 46% to Rs 4,269 crore. Expenditure on delivery rose slightly by 1.6% to Rs 6,863 crore. However, advertising and sales promotion spending decreased by 6.3% to Rs 3,209 crore. Employee benefit costs jumped 27.46%, reaching Rs 2,795 crore. During the year, Amazon Seller Services secured Rs 7,850 crore in new capital by issuing shares to Amazon Corporate Holdings and Amazon.com Inc. The company's operations largely stayed the same, except for discontinuing the Alexa Auto feature under Alexa Smart Vehicle as of March 31, 2023. Following this, all contracts for this service were shifted to Amazon Digital Services effective April 1, 2023. The company also clarified its approach on Prime offerings like Prime Video and Prime Music, stating that original content production costs are initially capitalized and later expensed (mainly using accelerated depreciation). Intangible assets related to digital video and music content jumped 38% in value to Rs 8,789 crore, with these assets being written off over their expected lifespan—no more than five years or the period of the relevant license.
translated_content: Amazon Seller Services, ki jere platfòm Amazon lan nan peyi End, te wè pèt nèt li ogmante pa 33% pou ane finansye ki fini mwa Mas 2023. Pèt la atenn Rs 4,854 crore, konpare ak Rs 3,649 crore ane anvan. Depans total yo ogmante prèske 8% pou rive Rs 27,283 crore, pandan revni operasyonèl sèlman ogmante 3.42% pou atenn Rs 22,198 crore. Revni ki soti nan sèvis makèt la monte pa 33% rive Rs 12,548 crore. Yo te anrejistre yon ogmantasyon 30% nan revni piblisite ak lòt sèvis, ki totalize Rs 5,380 crore. Nan lòt men an, revni ki soti nan sèvis pou patnè afilye bese anpil—li desann pa 46% pou rive Rs 4,269 crore. Depans livrezon ogmante leje, 1.6%, pou atenn Rs 6,863 crore. Sepandan, depans pou piblisite ak pwomosyon diminye pa 6.3% rive Rs 3,209 crore. Frè avantaj anplwaye ogmante anpil—27.46% pou atenn Rs 2,795 crore. Pandan ane a, Amazon Seller Services jwenn yon envestisman kapital Rs 7,850 crore atravè vann aksyon bay Amazon Corporate Holdings ak Amazon.com Inc. Aktivite konpayi an te rete prèske san chanjman, eksepte yo mete fen nan Alexa Auto anba Alexa Smart Vehicle depi 31 Mas 2023. Tout kontra ki gen rapò ak sèvis sa a te transfere bay Amazon Digital Services apati 1 Avril 2023. Konpayi an fè konnen depans pou pwodiksyon kontni orijinal sou Prime Video ak Prime Music ap anrejistre kòm avantaj, epi yo fè amortisman yo pi rapidman. Valè avantaj imateryèl pou videyo dijital ak mizik ogmante pa 38% rive Rs 8,789 crore, epi avantaj sa yo ap amortize sou yon peryòd ki pa depase 5 ane oswa selon lisans lan.

FIFA, the world governing body of soccer, has confirmed that vice president Jack Warner has resigned from his position. Last month, Warner, who is from Trinidad, and fellow FIFA member Mohammed bin Hammam were provisionally suspended by FIFA's Ethics Committee while corruption allegations against them were investigated. However, with the resignation of Warner, who is 68 years old, the investigation into his case will not proceed.

A FIFA statement said: "His resignation has been accepted, and his contribution to international football, particularly in the Caribbean, is appreciated and acknowledged. Mr. Warner has chosen to leave FIFA after nearly 30 years of service to focus on his duties in Trinidad & Tobago as a cabinet minister and as chairman of the United National Congress, the main party in his country's coalition government. The FIFA Executive Committee, the president, and management thank Mr. Warner for his service and wish him well."

The statement added that as a result of Warner's voluntary resignation, all Ethics Committee proceedings against him have been closed, and his presumption of innocence is maintained.

Warner, who led the Confederation of North, Central American and Caribbean Association Football (CONCACAF), and bin Hammam, the Asian football chief, were suspended after allegations surfaced that cash gifts of $40,000 were offered to leaders of CONCACAF's national associations to influence the FIFA presidential election earlier this month. These allegations were reported by CONCACAF general secretary Chuck Blazer during a conference held in Trinidad on May 10 and 11. Sepp Blatter was later re-elected unopposed for a fourth term as FIFA president.

Mwa pase, Warner ki soti Trinidad ak yon lòt manm FIFA, Mohammed bin Hammam, te sispann pwovizwa pa Komite Etik FIFA pandan yo t ap mennen ankèt sou akizasyon koripsyon kont yo. Sepandan, ak demisyon Warner, ki gen 68 lane, ankèt sou li pap fèt.

Yon deklarasyon FIFA di: "Yo aksepte demisyon li epi yo apresye ak rekonèt kontribisyon li nan foutbòl entènasyonal, espesyalman nan Karayib la. Mesye Warner chwazi kite FIFA apre prèske 30 lane sèvis pou li konsantre sou travay li kòm minis epi kòm chèf United National Congress, pi gwo pati nan gouvènman koalisyon peyi li a. Komite egzekitif FIFA, prezidan an ak jesyon an remèsye Mesye Warner pou sèvis li yo epi swete l bon chans pou lavni."

Yo ajoute, akoz Warner deside demisyone, tout pwosede Komite Etik kont li fèmen epi li kontinye konsidere kòm inosan.

Warner, ki te dirije Konfederasyon Foutbòl Amerik di Nò, Santral ak Karayib (CONCACAF), ansanm ak bin Hammam, chèf foutbòl Aziz la, te sispann apre akizasyon te bay sou don lajan kach $40,000 ki ta vle enfliyanse lidè asosyasyon CONCACAF yo pou eleksyon prezidan FIFA mwa sa a. Sekretè jeneral CONCACAF, Chuck Blazer, te rapòte akizasyon sa yo pandan yon konferans ki te fèt nan Trinidad 10 ak 11 me. Sepp Blatter te re-eli san opozisyon pou katriyèm fwa kòm prezidan FIFA.
