Busan’s Asian Contents & Film Market (ACFM) has long served as a hub where sales agents promote both films in development and completed works. Increasingly, ACFM is also emerging as a prime destination for producers searching for stories and new source material to adapt for film and television.

In 2022, ACFM introduced the Busan Story Market, streamlining access for industry professionals to discover literary works and concepts available for adaptation or remake. Following positive feedback, the initiative has expanded in 2023 to include a greater variety of early-stage intellectual properties (IPs), with a notable focus on original content such as unpublished novels, web novels, and webtoons.

ACFM general manager Seri Park explained, “The industry’s feedback was that there was demand for more original works, including those that have yet to be published. While not intentional, this year’s selection naturally features more unique stories because our selection committee includes a wider range of industry professionals.”

Noteworthy projects selected from Korea this year include the disaster-themed book ‘On Suffering’ from Greenbook Agency, the office thriller ‘Anonymous App, The Behind The Scenes’ from Sam&parkers, and the webtoon ‘General Manager Dharma’ by Toyou’s Dream Inc.

Past editions of the IP market have highlighted projects like the dystopian science fiction webtoon ‘Black Knight,’ which was adapted into a six-episode Netflix series in 2023. This year, the Busan Story Market is further broadening its scope by collaborating with Taiwan’s TAICCA and Japan’s VIPO to bring in works from Taiwan and Japan. Indonesia also joins this year, with its Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology leading a large industry delegation and contributing Indonesian IPs.

Among the selected Asian IPs are Taiwanese writer Wu Xiao-le’s novel ‘No Secrets Between Us’ and Japanese titles translated into Korean, such as Kadokawa’s ‘Hotel Miacis’ and Tokuma Shoten’s ‘Fragile’.

For 2023, ACFM is partnering with FLY ASIA to co-host CINE FLY 2023, an initiative supporting tech startups in the audiovisual sector. The event, developed with Berlin Film Festival’s EFM Start-up and Cannes NEXT, invites startups to pitch their services to industry attendees.

Additionally, Taiwan’s Rising Films has launched a $750,000 (KRW1 billion) investment program, the Rising Films International Awards, to support independent Korean filmmakers. Rising Films’ first production, Ho Wi-ding’s ‘Terrorizers’ (2021), garnered five Golden Horse Award nominations. “Rising Films aims to boost original IPs and integrate international resources in the Korean and Taiwanese film and TV industries through these awards,” Park said.

ACFM is part of several industry support and talent development programs under the umbrella of the Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), including the Asian Project Market (APM), Asian Cinema Fund (ACF), and Platform Busan. This year’s APM will present 30 projects, with new works from Koji Fukada, Makbul Mubarak, and Rima Das, alongside cash awards sponsored by One Cool Pictures (Hong Kong) and Dreama Pictures (China) for the first time.

Platform Busan, a networking event for Asian independent filmmakers, is working with TAICCA, VIPO, and film organizations from Thailand, the Philippines, and Indonesia to offer case studies, seminars, and pitching sessions in addition to networking opportunities.

Registrations for ACFM 2023 have already surpassed last year’s numbers by early September, with the biggest delegations coming from Korea, Japan, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. ACFM is being held October 7–10 at the Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO).
translated_content:
Asian Contents & Film Market (ACFM) Busan lan toujou se yon sant pou ajan k ap vann fim ki an devlopman oswa ki deja fini. Jodi a, ACFM ap vin tounen kote pwodiktè vin chèche istwa ak nouvo materyèl pou adapte pou sinema ak televizyon.

An 2022, ACFM te lanse Busan Story Market pou ede pwofesyonèl endistri a jwenn travay literè ak konsèp ki disponib pou adaptasyon. Apre repons pozitif, inisyativ la agrandi an 2023 pou enkli plis IP nan premye etap—sa vle di plis woman orijinal, web novels ak webtoons menm sa ki poko pibliye.

Manadjè jeneral ACFM, Seri Park, te di: "Endistri a t ap chèche plis travay orijinal, menm sa ki poko monte sou mache a. Menm si se pa t plan nou, ane sa a gen plis istwa orijinal paske komite seleksyon an gen plis ekspè endistri." 

Pami pwojè Koreyen ki chwazi yo, gen liv ‘On Suffering’ pa Greenbook Agency (istwa dezas), ‘Anonymous App, The Behind The Scenes’ pa Sam&parkers (thriller nan biwo), ak webtoon ‘General Manager Dharma’ soti Toyou’s Dream Inc.

Ediksyon pase yo te mete aksan sou pwojè tankou webtoon syans fiksyon ‘Black Knight’ ki te tounen miniséri sou Netflix an 2023. Ane sa a, Busan Story Market ap elaji gras a kolaborasyon ak TAICCA nan Taiwan ak VIPO nan Japon pou pote travay diferan. Endonezi patisipe tou avèk Ministè Edikasyon, Kilti, Rechèch ak Teknoloji yo, k ap mennen yon delegasyon epi ajoute travay pa kreyatè endonezyen.

Pami IP Azyatik yo chwazi, gen woman ‘No Secrets Between Us’ pa ekriven taiwanais Wu Xiao-le, epi woman Japonè tankou ‘Hotel Miacis’ (Kadokawa) ak ‘Fragile’ (Tokuma Shoten) ki tradui an koreyen.

Pou 2023, ACFM kolabore ak FLY ASIA pou òganize CINE FLY 2023, yon inisyativ pou start-up teknoloji nan odyovizyèl la. Devlope ak EFM Start-up Berlin ak Cannes NEXT, evènman an pèmèt start-up yo prezante sèvis yo bay patisipan endistri k ap patisipe.

Rising Films Taiwan lanse tou yon pwogram envestisman $750,000 (KRW1 milya), Rising Films International Awards, pou sipòte sinematograf endepandan Koreyen. Premye fim yo, ‘Terrorizers’ (2021) pa Ho Wi-ding, te resevwa senk nominasyon Golden Horse. “Rising Films vize ranfòse IP orijinal epi rantre resous entènasyonal sinema ak televizyon Kore ak Taiwan,” Park eksplike.

ACFM fè pati anpil pwogram BIFF (Busan International Film Festival) tankou Asian Project Market (APM), Asian Cinema Fund (ACF), ak Platform Busan. APM ap prezante 30 pwojè, enkli nouvote Koji Fukada, Makbul Mubarak ak Rima Das, epi pou premye fwa prim lajan pa One Cool Pictures (Hong Kong) ak Dreama Pictures (Lachin).

Platform Busan ap bay rezo, etid ka, seminè ak okazyon pou pitching ak kolaborasyon ak TAICCA, VIPO, ak lòt òganizasyon fim Azyatik, tankou Thailand, Filipin ak Endonezi.

Enskripsyon pou ACFM 2023 deja depase ane pase, pi gwo delegasyon yo soti Kore, Japon, Taiwan ak Azi Sidès. ACFM ap fèt 7 pou rive 10 Oktòb nan Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO).
post_content: Busan ACFM is bringing together film, tech, & original stories from all over Asia! From webtoons to indie films and big investments, the future of Asian cinema is being made here. #BusanACFM #AsianFilm #StoryMarket
translated_post: ACFM Busan ap mete ansanm sinema, teknoloji ak nouvo istwa soti toupatou ann Azi! Soti webtoon rive fim endepandan ak envestisman lou, lavni sinema Azyatik la ap bati isit la. #BusanACFM #SinemaAzyatik #StoryMarket

article_content: The Court of Appeal in Abuja has affirmed the electoral victories of Nasarawa and Gombe State Governors, Abdullahi Sule and Inuwa Yahaya, both of the All Progressives Congress (APC). The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) had earlier declared them winners of the March 18 governorship elections. However, the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) challenged both results at the election tribunals. In Nasarawa, the tribunal led by Justice Ezekiel Ajayi, in a split decision, nullified Sule’s election and declared PDP's David Ombugadu as winner. Sule appealed to the Court of Appeal, which on Thursday restored his victory. Justice Uchechukwu Onuemenam, delivering the lead judgment, ruled that crucial evidence from eight of Ombugadu's witnesses was inadmissible due to late submission. She cited Section 285(5) of the 1999 Constitution and Section 132(7) of the Electoral Act 2022, which require that witness statements be filed within a stipulated time along with the petition. The court concluded that the remaining evidence could not sustain the tribunal’s judgment. The appellate court also held that the tribunal was wrong to deduct 1,868 votes from Sule's tally over unproven allegations of over-voting, noting that the petitioners failed to provide adequate supporting materials. Furthermore, Justice Onuemenam criticized the tribunal for dismissing Sule's witnesses without explanation and for recomputing the votes to declare the PDP candidate the winner. The appeal was allowed, the tribunal judgment dismissed, and Sule’s electoral victory restored. In Gombe, the tribunal had upheld Yahaya’s election while dismissing the petition from PDP's Jibrin Barde. The Court of Appeal, led by Justice S.B. Belgore, agreed with the lower tribunal. Justice T.N. Orji-Abadua stated that Barde's appeal lacked merit and affirmed Yahaya’s re-election. No costs were awarded. Reacting to the Nasarawa judgment, PDP state chairman Francis Orogu said the party would appeal to the Supreme Court, insisting that they had sufficient evidence and decrying what he described as technicalities and injustice. He expressed hope that the Supreme Court would consider their case more effectively.
translated_content: Tribinal Dapèl nan Abuja konfime viktwa elektoral Gouvènè Nasarawa ak Gombe yo, Abdullahi Sule ak Inuwa Yahaya, tout de APC. Komisyon Nasyonal Elektoral Endepandan (INEC) te deja deklare yo gayan eleksyon gouvènè 18 mas la. Sepandan, Pati Demokratik Pèp la (PDP) te konteste rezilta yo nan tribinal elektoral yo. Nan Nasarawa, tribinal la dirije pa Jij Ezekiel Ajayi te anile eleksyon Sule ak desizyon a majorite epi deklare David Ombugadu nan PDP kòm gayan an. Sule te fè apèl devan Tribinal Dapèl la, ki Jedi sa a mete l tounen kòm gouvènè. Jij Uchechukwu Onuemenam, ki li desizyon prensipal la, te di temwayaj uit temwen Ombugadu yo pa t kapab aksepte paske yo te soumèt an reta. Li site Seksyon 285(5) Konstitisyon 1999 lan ak Seksyon 132(7) Lwa Elektoral 2022 la ki mande tout deklarasyon sou sèman ak plent lan soumèt nan delè legal la. Tribinal Dapèl la te konkli rès prèv yo pa t ase pou soutni desizyon tribinal la. Li di tou tribinal la te fè erè lè l te retire 1,868 vòt sou kont Sule sou akizasyon vòt anplis san prèv ase. Anplis, Jij Onuemenam te kritike tribinal la paske li te mete sou kote temwen Sule yo san eksplike epi pou rekalkile vòt yo pou deklare kandida PDP a gayan. Tribinal dapèl la te aksepte apèl la, revoke desizyon tribinal an premye grèf la epi retabli viktwa elektoral Sule. Nan Gombe, premye tribinal la te deja konfime eleksyon Yahaya epi li te rejte rekevasyon Jibrin Barde nan PDP. Tribinal dapèl la ak Jij S.B. Belgore kòm chèf te dakò ak desizyon sa. Jij T.N. Orji-Abadua te di apèl Barde a pa t gen merit epi li te konfime re-eli Yahaya. Pa gen lòd pou frè. Apre desizyon Nasarawa a, prezidan PDP Eta Nasarawa, Francis Orogu, te di pati a pral mennen dosye a nan Kour Siprèm nan, li ensiste yo gen ase prèv epi li plenyen pou teknikalis ak enjistis. Li espere Kour Siprèm nan ap konsidere ka yo pi seryezman.
post_content: Big news! The Court of Appeal in Abuja has restored Governor Sule in Nasarawa and confirmed Governor Yahaya's win in Gombe after legal drama over the March 18 elections. PDP plans to take the Nasarawa fight to the Supreme Court. #Elections #NigeriaNews #CourtUpdate

Elon Musk’s social media platform X has filed a lawsuit against the advocacy group Media Matters for America, which accused the site of allowing antisemitic posts to appear alongside advertisements. X’s legal complaint alleges that Media Matters manipulated data to harm the reputation and business of the platform, formerly known as Twitter. Several major companies—including Apple, Disney, IBM, and Comcast—paused their ads on X after Media Matters published its findings.

Media Matters reported that ads had appeared alongside content supporting Nazism, including quotations from Hitler and Holocaust denial. X, for its part, claims that Media Matters intentionally created situations where such ad placements would appear and presented these manufactured scenarios as if typical users experienced them.

Linda Yaccarino, X’s chief executive, stated that, “Not a single authentic user on X saw IBM’s, Comcast’s, or Oracle’s ads next to the content in Media Matters’ article.”

Following the controversy, other organizations and companies—including the European Commission, Warner Bros Discovery, Paramount, and Lionsgate—also suspended advertising on X. Elon Musk, responding to Media Matters’ accusations, called the lawsuit a ‘thermonuclear’ legal action against the group and anyone alleged to have collaborated in what he describes as a fraudulent attack.

Media Matters President Angelo Carusone responded that the group stands by its reporting, accusing Musk of trying to silence accurate investigations with meritless lawsuits.

Media Matters, founded in 2004, describes itself as a progressive research and information center dedicated to monitoring and correcting conservative misinformation in US media. The organization is known for its criticism of conservative commentators.

Separately, Elon Musk faced criticism for amplifying an antisemitic trope on X, replying to a post that promoted a conspiracy theory about Jewish communities. Musk later clarified that his comments referred not to all Jewish people but to specific groups like the Anti-Defamation League.

In addition, Texas Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton announced an investigation into Media Matters over potential fraudulent activity related to its allegations about X. Paxton described Media Matters as a ‘radical anti-free speech organization’ and pledged to ensure the public is not deceived.

Meanwhile, the White House revealed that President Joe Biden, the First Lady, Vice President, and Second Gentleman have opened accounts on Threads, the Meta-owned competitor to X.
translated_content:
Platfòm rezo sosyal Elon Musk lan, X, depoze yon pwosè kont gwoup defans Media Matters for America, ki te akize sit la dèske li pèmèt posts antisemitis parèt akote piblisite yo. Plent legal X la deklare Media Matters manipile done pou domaje repitasyon ak biznis platfòm lan, ki te rele Twitter anvan. Plizyè gwo konpayi, tankou Apple, Disney, IBM, ak Comcast, sispann mete piblisite sou X apre Media Matters pibliye rezilta li yo.

Media Matters rapòte ke piblisite te parèt akote kontni ki sipòte Nazism, tankou sitasyon Hitler ak refi masak la (Holocaust denial). X, pandan sa, di li panse Media Matters te fè tout sa pou kreye sitiyasyon kote piblisite parèt akote kontni sa yo epi prezante sa tankou si tout itilizatè wè li.

Linda Yaccarino, chèf egzekitif X, deklare: "Pa gen okenn itilizatè otantik sou X ki te wè piblisite IBM, Comcast oswa Oracle bò kote kontni nan atik Media Matters la."

Apre kontwovès la, lòt enstitisyon tankou Komisyon Ewopeyen an, Warner Bros Discovery, Paramount, ak Lionsgate, tou sispann piblisite sou X. Musk, ap reponn ak Media Matters, rele pwosè a yon aksyon legal 'termoniklè' kont gwoup la ak nenpòt ki te kolabore nan sa li rele yon atak fwod.

Prezidan Media Matters la, Angelo Carusone, reponn pou di gwoup la kenbe pozisyon li epi akize Musk èske li ap eseye silans moun ki mete l nan difikilte atravè pwosè ki pa gen merit.

Media Matters, ki fonde an 2004, dekri tèt li kòm yon sant rechèch progresis ki veye, analize, epi korije dezinformasyon konsèvatè nan medya ameriken. Òganizasyon an renome pou kritik li vokal sou kominikatè konsèvatè yo.

Elon Musk viktim kritik tou repons li bay yon post antisemitis sou X, kote li te dakò ak yon teyori konplo sou kominote jwif. Musk pita klarifye ke kòmantè li yo pa vize tout jwif, men pi plis pou gwoup tankou Anti-Defamation League.

Anplis, Avoka Jeneral Repibliken Texas la, Ken Paxton, fè konnen li ap ouvri ankèt sou Media Matters pou posib aksyon fwod sou akizasyon sa yo. Paxton dekri Media Matters kòm "yon òganizasyon radikal ki kont libète pawòl" epi li di li pral asire piblik la pa vin twonpe.

Mezon Blanch lan anonse tou ke Prezidan Joe Biden, Premye Dam lan, Vis Prezidan an ak Dezyèm Mesye a vin gen kont sou Threads, platfòm Meta ki konkirans ak X la.
post_content: Big drama on X as Elon Musk sues Media Matters, accusing them of faking data about antisemitic ads! Top brands are pulling ads, Texas launches an investigation, and Biden's jumping to Threads. #SocialMediaNews #ElonMusk #FreeSpeech
translated_post: Gwo batay sou X! Elon Musk ap mennen Media Matters an tribinal paske yo di li monte istwa sou piblisite antisemitis. Gwo konpayi ap wete piblisite yo, Texas ap mennen ankèt, e Biden ap migrate sou Threads! #NouvèlSosyal #ElonMusk #LibètePawòl

Chinese entrepreneur Chen Guangbiao, recognized for his philanthropy and prominent self-promotion, recently attracted attention during his visit to the United States. While there, Chen distributed business cards featuring grandiose titles such as 'Most Influential Person of China,' 'Moral Leader,' and 'Most Well-known and Beloved Chinese Role Model.'

Chen, whose wealth comes from recycling and renewable resources, traveled to New York with two women, Hao Huijun and her daughter Chen Guo. Both suffered severe injuries during a 2001 Tiananmen Square protest, self-immolating alongside other Falun Gong practitioners to protest the Chinese government’s crackdown on the spiritual movement. Chinese authorities have labeled Falun Gong a cult.

Chen pledged to cover the costs of surgeries for the women in New York, expecting to spend over $2 million. He reported that American doctors believed the procedures could restore up to 80 percent of their pre-injury appearance. At a press conference, Chen introduced the women, allowed them to show their injuries, and performed an original song about his 'Chinese dream.'

Chen also shared his intention to purchase The New York Times, initially offering $1 billion and later increasing his bid to $3 billion after learning the outlet's estimated value was $2.5 billion. He mentioned seeking support from a Hong Kong tycoon for the acquisition. If this bid failed, Chen expressed willingness to buy other major media outlets such as CNN, The Washington Post, or The Wall Street Journal, emphasizing his desire for more impartial and accurate coverage of China.

The case of Hao Huijun and Chen Guo remains controversial. Their presence at Chen's press conference was met with protest by Falun Gong practitioners, who argued the women were being used as propaganda by Chinese authorities. The women had previously appeared in state-organized events denouncing Falun Gong after surviving their protest. The issue continues to spark debate over their agency and the motives behind their public exposure.

Additionally, Chen warned Americans about trusting Japan, referencing ongoing territorial disputes between China and Japan over several remote islands.
translated_content:
Antreprenè chinwa Chen Guangbiao, byen koni pou charite li ak jan li renmen mete tèt li devan, te atire anpil atansyon pandan vizit li Ozetazini dènye tan sa yo. Pandan li te la, Chen te distribye kat biznis ak gwo tit tankou 'Moun ki gen plis enfliyans an Chin', 'Lidè Moral', ak 'Pi Bon Modèl ak Pi Renome Chinwa.'

Chen, ki fè lajan li nan domèn resiklaj ak resous renouvlab, te vwayaje New York ak de fanm, Hao Huijun ak pitit fi li Chen Guo. Toude te sibi blesi grav apre yo te mete dife sou kò yo pandan yon pwotestasyon nan Tiananmen Square an 2001 ansanm ak lòt manm Falun Gong, pou proteste kont represyon otorite chinwa ap fè sou mouvman sa a ke Leta Konsidere kòm yon sek.

Chen te pwomèt peye plis pase $2 milyon pou operasyon de fanm yo, e li di doktè ameriken panse yo ka retabli jiska 80% aparans yo. Nan yon konferans pou laprès, Chen mete fanm yo anvan, fè yo montre blesi yo e li chante yon chanson li te ekri sou 'rèv chinwa' li.

Li te di li vle achte The New York Times, kòmanse ak $1 milya epi ogmante òf la rive $3 milya apre li tande valè jounal la ka $2.5 milya. Li pale de chèche èd nan men yon gwo rich Hong Kong. Si sa pa mache, Chen eksplike li louvri pou achte lòt medya tankou CNN, The Washington Post, oswa The Wall Street Journal, paske li vle plis kouvèti egzat ak san patipri sou Lachin.

Ka Hao Huijun ak Chen Guo toujou bay pale anpil. Prezans yo nan konferans lan te pwovoke pwotestasyon bò kote pratiyan Falun Gong, ki di otorite chinwa ap sèvi ak fanm yo pou fè pwopagann. Yo te deja parèt nan evènman leta kote yo te di move bagay de Falun Gong apre yo te sove. Dosye a toujou ap louvri sou si fanm yo gen kontwòl pwòp aksyon yo e sa k ap pouse sa.

Anplis, Chen di Ameriken yo pou yo fè atansyon ak Japon, paske gen konfli teritoryal ant Lachin ak Japon pou kèk ti zile.
post_content: Chinese billionaire Chen Guangbiao hit the U.S. media circuit, handing out wild business cards and pledging millions for two Tiananmen Square burn victims. He wants to buy the NYT and called out Western media bias—controversy and drama followed! #ChenGuangbiao #NYT #FalunGong #ChinaNews
translated_post: Chinwa milyadè Chen Guangbiao te lage pawòl ak kat biznis ekstravagan Ozetazini. Li pran swen de fanm ki boule nan Tiananmen epi deklare li vle achte New York Times. Gen pakèt pale sou li ak gouvènman Chinwa! #ChenGuangbiao #NYT #FalunGong #Lachin

article_content: Acclaimed writer Viet Thanh Nguyen's scheduled reading at the 92nd Street Y, New York (92NY) was abruptly canceled, prompting several staff members to resign. Following this decision, the remainder of 92NY's poetry reading season—which was to feature authors like Emily Wilson, Roxane Gay, and Tracy K. Smith—is now on hold, according to a spokesperson. Nguyen, a Pulitzer Prize-winning author known for 'The Sympathizer', was set to promote his new memoir, 'A Man of Two Faces.' Earlier in the week, Nguyen joined over 700 writers in signing an open letter in the London Review of Books urging a ceasefire in Gaza. The letter conveyed sympathy for both Palestinian and Israeli victims, calling for an end to escalating violence against Palestinians in Gaza, which it attributed to Western support. Just hours before his October 20th event, 92NY announced the reading was 'postponed.' A spokesperson stated that, as a Jewish organization, 92NY needed time to reflect on how to best support its community, leading to the difficult decision to postpone the event. Nguyen instead held his reading at McNally Jackson bookstore in Manhattan. Sarah Chihaya, director of the poetry center, and senior program coordinator Sophie Herron confirmed their resignations after the event’s cancellation. Since 1939, 92NY’s Unterberg Poetry Center has hosted numerous renowned writers, ranging from T.S. Eliot and Langston Hughes to Sandra Cisneros and Lorrie Moore. Nguyen told NPR he has not communicated directly with the board or spokespersons from 92NY, but stated on Instagram that he has no regrets about his statements or actions regarding Palestine, Israel, or the conflict.
translated_content: Lejandè ekriven Viet Thanh Nguyen te gen yon lekti pwograme nan 92nd Street Y, New York (92NY) ki te anile bridsoukou, sa ki lakòz plizyè manm pèsonèl demisyone. Apre desizyon sa a, rès sezon lekti powetik 92NY a—ki te sipoze gen otè tankou Emily Wilson, Roxane Gay, ak Tracy K. Smith—sispann pou kounye a, daprè sa yon pòtpawòl di. Nguyen, ki se yon otè ki te genyen pri Pulitzer e li konnen pou liv 'The Sympathizer', t ap pwomouvwa nouvo memwa li a, 'A Man of Two Faces.' Kèk jou avan sa, Nguyen te siyen, ansanm ak plis pase 700 ekriven, yon lèt ouvè nan London Review of Books kote yo mande yon sesefè nan Gaza. Lèt la te eksprime senpati pou viktim Palestinyen ak Izrayelyen, epi li te fè apèl pou sispann vyolans k ap ogmante kont Palestinyen nan Gaza, sa li mete sou kont sipò peyi oksidantal yo. Kèk èdtan anvan evènman 20 Oktòb la, 92NY te anonse lekti a 'ranvwaye.' Yon pòtpawòl te deklare, kòm yon òganizasyon jwif, 92NY bezwen yon ti tan pou reflechi kijan pou pi byen sipòte kominote li, sa ki fè yo pran desizyon difisil pou ranvwaye evènman an. Nguyen te fè lekti li nan McNally Jackson Bookstore, Manhattan olye de sa. Sarah Chihaya, direktris sant powetik la, ak koòdonatè pwogram an chèf la, Sophie Herron, konfime bay medya yo ke yo demisyone aprè anilasyon evènman an. Depi 1939, Unterberg Poetry Center nan 92NY ap resevwa anpil ekriven renome, sòti T.S. Eliot ak Langston Hughes rive Sandra Cisneros ak Lorrie Moore. Nguyen di NPR li pa pale dirèkteman ak Konsèy Administrasyon oswa pòtpawòl 92NY, men li ekri sou Instagram li pa gen okenn regrè pou pawòl oubyen aksyon li sou Palestine, Izrayèl oswa konfli a.
post_content: Big changes at 92NY after Viet Thanh Nguyen’s reading got canceled—staff quit & the poetry season’s on hold! Nguyen still shared his story at another venue. #FreeSpeech #LiteraryNews
translated_post: Gwo chanjman nan 92NY: Yo anile lekti Viet Thanh Nguyen, plizyè anplwaye kite travay, epi tout sezon powèt la sispann. Nguyen toujou te pataje liv li yon lòt kote! #NouvelLiterati #LibEkriven

Modi highlighted that the BJP-led central government has actively worked to strengthen Mizoram’s infrastructure—improving railways, healthcare, and sports facilities. He also remarked that Mizoram’s natural beauty and rich culture make it poised to become a global tourist hotspot. Referencing a past visit, Modi mentioned his previous promise to transform Mizoram through improved transportation, suggesting that substantial advancements have taken place across various sectors thanks to the BJP-led government's initiatives.

Wearing her iconic red updo, red lipstick, and polka-dotted dress, 915 Lucy Ricardo look-alikes gathered in Jamestown, New York, on Saturday, setting a new record for the most Lucys in one place at one time. This record-breaking event was part of a weekend filled with festivities celebrating the 100th birthday of Lucille Ball, legendary comedienne and star of the classic television show "I Love Lucy."

Journey Gunderson, executive director of the Lucy Ball Desi Arnaz Center for Comedy, noted, “This year, we’ve really tried to honor Lucy’s vision by packing as much comedy as possible into one weekend.”

Headlining entertainers Joan Rivers and Paula Poundstone were scheduled to perform during the multiday celebration, which also featured a parade, amateur comic showcases, and a special kids' performance by the Story Pirates sketch comedy group.

Now in its 20th year, the Lucille Ball Festival of Comedy continues to draw passionate fans from around the world, including visitors from Australia, Britain, Canada, and Japan, eager to tour the Lucy-Desi Museum and Desilu Playhouse—two of the Center’s star attractions.

Gunderson emphasized that the festival is intended to be more than a tribute to Lucille Ball’s legacy; it seeks to deliver contemporary and evolving comedy offerings for years to come. She reflected on Ball’s pioneering achievements: “She was the first woman ever visibly pregnant on television, the first female head of a Hollywood studio, and her comedy was always clean but edgy—independent of societal standards.”

Lucy Fest has long been a weekend to celebrate Lucille Ball’s contributions to comedy on her birthday. This year, in honor of her 100th, a major marketing campaign including social media outreach was launched, with expectations of 5,000 to 10,000 festivalgoers.

The festival forms one of four main pillars in the Center’s strategic vision: expanding comedic programming, developing educational initiatives with universities, launching a comedy film festival to honor Ball and Desi Arnaz’s work as producers, and potentially bringing a National Comedy Hall of Fame to Jamestown. “We want Jamestown to be the Cooperstown of comedy,” said Gunderson, acknowledging competition from larger cities but embracing the challenge. “Go ahead and laugh,” she added. “That’s the point.”
translated_content:
Abiye ak kouch cheve wouj li, makiyaj wouj ak rad ak ti pwen blan, 915 moun abiye tankou Lucy Ricardo te rasanble nan Jamestown, New York, samdi, e yo mete yon nouvo rekò pa janm gen plis "Lucy" ansanm yon sèl kote an menm tan. Evenman sa a ki bat tout rekò te fè pati yon fen semèn konplè ak selebrasyon pou 100èm anivèsè nesans Lucille Ball, gran komedyèn ak zetwal seri televizyon klasik "I Love Lucy".

Journey Gunderson, direktè egzekitif Lucy Ball Desi Arnaz Center for Comedy, deklare: "Ane sa a, nou te vreman chache onore vizyon Lucy e mete tout komedyen ak blag posib nan fen semèn nan."

Pi gwo komedyèn tankou Joan Rivers ak Paula Poundstone te sou lis prensipal pou péfòmans pandan plizyè jou selebrasyon an, kote te gen tou yon parad, tès komedyen amatè ak pèfòmans espesyal pou timoun pa gwoup komik Story Pirates.

Festival Komedy Lucille Ball la, ki gen 20 lane depi li egziste, kontinye atire fanatik pasyone soti toupatou nan mond lan, tankou Otrali, Angletè, Kanada ak Japon, ki vin vizite Lucy-Desi Museum ak Desilu Playhouse—de atraksyon prensipal Sant la.

Gunderson mete aksan sou festival la dwe plis pase onore eritaj Lucille Ball; objektif li se pote komedy modèn ak inovasyon pou ane kap vini yo. Li pale de gwo reyalizasyon Ball: "Li te premye fanm ansent sou televizyon, premye fanm dirije yon estidyo Hollywood, epi komedy li te toujou modere men orijinal—li pa t respekte nòmal sosyete a."

Lucy Fest se toujou yon fen semèn pou selebre kontribisyon Lucille Ball pou anivèsè nesans li. Ane sa a, pou make 100èm anivèsè a, yo lanse yon kanpay maketin sou medya sosyal, epi yo atann ant 5,000 ak 10,000 moun pou patisipe.

Festival la se youn nan kat pilier prensipal nan vizyon Sant la: agrandi pwogram komedyen, lanse inisyativ edikatif ak inivèsite, kreye yon festival fim komedy pou onore travay Ball ak Desi Arnaz kòm pwodiktè, epi petèt mennen yon Comedy Hall of Fame Nasyonal nan Jamestown. "Nou vle Jamestown tounen Cooperstown nan komedy," Gunderson di, pandan li rekonèt vil la ap konpetisyon ak pi gwo vil, men li onore defi a. "Ale ri," li ajoute. "Se sa gist la."

article_content: In a case from rural Missouri, David Mangum, 36, has been charged with knowingly putting his partners at risk of HIV infection. Police reports indicate Mangum told authorities that since being diagnosed with HIV in 2003, he had unprotected sex with more than 300 people, many of whom he only knew by first name, making it difficult for police to reach them. The investigation was prompted when a former partner, who tested positive for HIV, reported that Mangum deceived him about his status. Authorities arraigned Mangum in Stoddard County, located about 160 miles south of St. Louis, and set his bail at $250,000. It is believed that between 50 and 60 of his partners reside in Stoddard County. Under Missouri law, intentionally exposing someone to HIV without their consent is a felony that can lead to up to 15 years in prison; if transmission occurs, the sentence can be for life.

Yo te louvri ankèt la apre yon ansyen patnè, ki teste pozitif pou VIH, pote plent Mangum te kache enfòmasyon sou maladi li. Dapre lwa Missouri, ekspoze yon moun ak VIH san konsantman li se yon krim ki ka mennen jiska 15 lane nan prizon, epi si viktim lan enfekte, lap ka resevwa prizon avi.

article_content: Pioneering early farmers who arrived on the Baltic coast about 6,000 years ago may have begun fishing after observing indigenous hunter-gatherer communities, a major new study has found. Previous studies of prehistoric cooking pots in places like Britain, Spain, France, and Portugal indicated that people stopped cooking fish when they started farming crops and animals, even near the coast. In contrast, the new research published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, led by academics at the University of York in collaboration with the British Museum, found that early farmers on Northern Europe’s Baltic coast adopted a mixed diet of fish and domesticated animal products. Researchers examined fats preserved in more than a thousand prehistoric pottery fragments from coastal areas stretching from western Denmark to southern Finland. The findings suggest close cooperation and interaction between new farmers and local forager communities. Professor Oliver Craig, director of the BioArCh Lab at the University of York, said, “Our findings suggest that early farmers moved to this resource-rich region and adapted their economy and daily habits—including diet and cooking practices—by observing indigenous hunter-gatherer-fishers. This is in significant contrast to other Early Neolithic coastal sites, where there is little evidence of marine resource use.” Although genetic studies suggest little intermarriage occurred between farmers and hunter-gatherers, archaeological records indicate that the local hunter-gatherer-fisher population was well established when the first farmers arrived from Central Europe and the Eurasian Steppe. Researchers believe these indigenous groups may have influenced the newcomers, leading to some cultural blending. The pottery fragments also showed that some hunter-gatherer groups had access to dairy products before agriculture’s arrival. Professor Craig noted, “The presence of dairy in hunter-gatherer pots before farming might be explained by the exchange of foods and goods with farming communities, possibly located less than 100 km away.” Analysis suggests that these two distinct groups lived nearby without much genetic mixing but did exchange goods. Fermented dairy products like butter might have been traded for furs, marine mammal oils, or honey. Researchers analyzed fatty acids from pottery fragments dating from 4,000 to 8,000 years ago using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, revealing that about 50% of farmer pots contained fish residues, while 5% of hunter-gatherer pots had traces of dairy. Dr. Alexandre Lucquin, lead author from the University of York, said, “In one of the largest studies of its kind, new archaeological science methods allowed us to extract and interpret the remains of meals during a key period of transition. We found a surprising overlap in culinary practices between old and new communities, suggesting the move to farming was gradual, not sudden.” Co-author Dr. Harry Robson added, “The shift from foraging to farming in Europe is often seen as uniform, but our study shows it was complex and nuanced.” The early farmers of the western Baltic region used pottery in similar ways as the region’s earlier hunter-gatherer-fishers. Except for the Danube Gorges, this is the only area in Europe known to share this practice. The study also gives the first widespread evidence for the exchange of commodities, including dairy products, between the groups. Many questions remain about why Europeans shifted to large-scale farming. Dr. Lucquin concluded, “There are still unanswered questions about why people made this shift. Perhaps a farming lifestyle seemed to offer more predictable resources. Once the Neolithic revolution began, there was no going back, and we may never truly know what happened to the last hunter-gatherers of Europe.”
translated_content: Premye kiltivatè ki te rive sou kòt Baltik la anviwon 6,000 ane pase yo ka te kòmanse lapèch apre yo te obsève kominote chasè-pechè aborijèn yo, daprè yon nouvo etid enpòtan. Etid anvan sou veso kwizinaj pre-istorik tankou nan Grann Bretay, Espay, Lafrans ak Pòtigal te montre moun yo te sispann kwit pwason lè yo te kòmanse fè agrikilti ak elvaj, menm lè yo t ap viv bò lanmè. Menm jan ak sa, nouvo rechèch sa a, ki pibliye nan Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences epi ki fèt pa syantis University of York ansanm ak British Museum, jwenn ke premye kiltivatè kòt Baltik Nò Ewòp yo te adopte yon rejim alimantè melanje ak pwason ak pwodwi bèt domestik. Rechèch la te egzamine grès konsève nan plis pase mil fragman veso pre-istorik soti nan zòn litoral ant lwès Denmark ak sid Fenlann. Dekouvèt yo montre te gen gwo koperasyon ak entèraksyon ant nouvo kiltivatè yo ak kominote chasè-pechè lokal yo. Pwofesè Oliver Craig, direktè BioArCh Lab nan University of York, te di: “Sa nou jwenn montre premye kiltivatè yo te deplase nan yon zòn ki rich ak resous epi yo te adapte ekonomi ak abitid chak jou yo—including rejim alimantè ak pratik kwizinaj—apre yo te obsève chasè-pechè lokal yo. Sa a kraze ak sa n ap jwenn nan lòt sit Neolitik bò lanmè kote pa gen prèv, yo te itilize resous lanmè.” Menmsi etid jenetik montre ti kras maryaj te fèt ant kiltivatè ak chasè-pechè, dokiman arkeolojik montre popilasyon chasè-pechè lokal la te byen tabli lè premye kiltivatè yo soti Ewòp Santral ak Step Ewasyatik te rive. Syantis yo panse gwoup aborijèn sa yo ka te enfliyanse nouvo arivan yo, sa ki te lakoz yon melanj kiltirèl. Fragman veso yo te demontre tou kèk chasè-pechè te deja gen aksè ak pwodwi letye avan agrikilti te vini. Pwofesè Craig te ajoute: “Prezans letye nan veso chasè-pechè yo anvan agrikilti a ka sòti nan echanj manje ak lòt pwodwi ak kominote kiltivatè ki petèt te pi pre pase 100 km.” Rechèch la montre de gwoup sa yo te viv toupre youn ak lòt, san anpil melanj jenetik, men yo te echanje machandiz. Pwodwi letye fermente, tankou bè, te kapab echanje pou po bèt, lwil bèt lanmè, oswa siwo myèl. Syantis yo te analize asid gra ki soti nan fragman veso ki datye ant 4,000 a 8,000 ane de sa avèk chromatografi gaz-espektrometri de mas. Rezilta yo montre anviwon 50% veso kiltivatè yo te gen rès pwason, pandan 5% veso chasè-pechè yo te gen tras letye. Dr Alexandre Lucquin, otè prensipal etid la, University of York, di: “Nan youn nan pi gwo rechèch arkeolojik, nouvo metòd sa yo pèmèt nou etidye ak entèprete sa ki te rete nan manje yo te prepare pandan epòk tranzisyon sa a. Nou sezi wè pratik kwizinaj de gwoup yo te kwaze, sa endike tranzisyon ale nan agrikilti te fèt pito piti piti, pa toudenkou.” Ko-otè Dr Harry Robson ajoute: “Chanjman soti nan ranmase ak peche rive nan agrikilti souvan parèt menm jan nan Ewòp, men nou wè li te pi konplike ak nuanse.” Premye kiltivatè rejyon Baltik lwès la te sèvi ak veso yo menm jan ak ansyen chasè-pechè lokal yo. Sauf Danube Gorges, se sèl zòn sa a an Ewòp kote pratik sa fèt. Etid la bay premye prèv lajè ke komodite, tankou letye, t ap echanje ant gwoup yo. Gen anpil kesyon ki rete poukisa Ewopeyen yo te chwazi agrikilti sou gwo echèl. Dr Lucquin fini: “Gen toujou kesyon san repons sou poukisa moun yo te fè chwa sa a. Petèt yo te panse fason viv sa te bay plis sekirite. Lè revolisyon Neolitik la te kòmanse, pa te gen tounen, epi nou ka pa janm konn sa ki te rive dènye chasè-pechè Ewòp yo.”

article_content: HTC is preparing to send its Vive Focus 3 virtual reality headset to space. The company announced that a modified, microgravity-friendly version of the headset will be launched aboard a NASA resupply mission to the International Space Station (ISS) on November 7th. Danish astronaut Andreas Mogensen will use the device to test its ability to reduce the mental stress astronauts experience due to lack of privacy, demanding workloads, and long separations from loved ones. HTC has partnered with virtual reality therapy company XRHealth and aeronautics research firm Nord-Space ApS to adapt the Vive Focus 3 for use in space as part of a mental wellness initiative. A key challenge was to prevent motion sickness caused by the lack of gravity, which can impact orientation in virtual reality. HTC addressed this by updating its tracking software to link the headset’s spatial orientation to one stationary controller tracked by onboard cameras and a proximity sensor. Astronauts can control menus using either eye-tracking or the other controller. The current hardware is largely identical to the Vive Focus 3 unit sold on Earth, aside from software and minor power management tweaks, according to Thomas Dexmier, HTC's AVP of Enterprise Solutions. Previously, the headset has only undergone brief zero-gravity tests lasting around 20 seconds aboard parabolic flights. This upcoming mission will be the first long-term test of the device’s performance in space. Success could pave the way for more immersive VR experiences during extended missions, including potential Mars voyages. Accompanying the modified headset will be XRHealth's software, offering about 10 mainly 360-degree videos—including scenes from Denmark to help Mogensen feel connected to home—as well as breathing and meditation exercises. Future software updates may introduce new features after the headset reaches the station. XRHealth's founder and CEO, Eran Orr, stresses that this is an early stage experiment rather than a therapeutic treatment, though the long-term goal is for astronauts to connect virtually with professionals or loved ones on Earth. NASA has long explored virtual reality technology for training and operations. In the 1980s, the agency’s work contributed to early VR developments like the Power Glove. More recently, NASA and Microsoft have jointly created HoloLens software to enhance collaboration and visualization between crew in space and teams on the ground. Now, VR may also help support astronauts’ behavioral health during extended missions. Correction, November 2nd, 2023, 11:36 PM ET: The previous version of this article misspelled Thomas Dexmier’s name. We regret the error.
translated_content: HTC ap prepare pou voye kas reyalite vityèl li a, Vive Focus 3, nan espas. Konpayi an anonse ke yon vèsyon modifye, adapte ak mikwogravite kas la, pral lanse a bord yon misyon ravitayman NASA pou Estasyon Espasyal Entènasyonal (ISS) sou 7 Novanm. Astronòt Danwa Andreas Mogensen pral teste aparèy la pou wè si li ka diminye estrès mantal ke astronòt yo konn santi akoz mank entimite, anpil travay, ak separasyon ak moun yo renmen. HTC asosye ak konpayi terapi VR XRHealth ak antrepriz rechèch aewonotik Nord-Space ApS pou adapte Vive Focus 3 pou itilize nan espas kòm yon inisyativ byennèt mantal. Youn nan pi gwo defi yo se anpeche malèstomak ki lakoz pa absans gravite, ki ka deranje oryantasyon nan VR. HTC mete ajou lojisyèl swiv li a pou oryantasyon kas la relye ak youn nan kontwolè yo ki pa deplase epi ke kamera ak detektè pwoksimite a swiv. Astronòt yo ka itilize kontwolè oswa fonksyon swiv je pou navige meni yo. Aparèy la prèske menm ak modèl Vive Focus 3 ki vann sou Latè a, sèlman ak kèk ajisteman lojisyèl ak konsomasyon enèji, dapre Thomas Dexmier, AVP Enterprise Solutions nan HTC. Anvan sa, kas la te sèlman teste nan gravite zewo pandan apeprè 20 segonn pandan vòl parabòl. Misyon sa a ap premye verifikasyon alontèm sou pèfòmans aparèy la nan espas. Si eksperyans lan reyisi, li ka ouvè chemen an pou VR plis avanse pou misyon ki dire plis tan, menm jiska Mars. Lojisyèl XRHealth ap vini ak kas la, ofri anviwon 10 videyo 360 degre—enkli sèn soti nan Denmark pou ede Mogensen santi l pi pre lakay li—ansanm ak egzèsis souf ak meditasyon. Lojisyèl la ka resevwa ajou nan fiti apre kas la rive sou estasyon an. Fondatè ak CEO XRHealth, Eran Orr, fè konnen sa se yon premye faz esè, pa yon tretman, men objektif final la se pou astronòt yo ka konekte ak terapis oswa fanmi sou Latè atravè kas la. NASA depi lontan ap teste teknoloji reyalite vityèl pou fòmasyon ak operasyon. Nan ane 1980 yo, travay ajans lan te kontribye nan devlopman VR bonè tankou Power Glove. Dènyèman, NASA ak Microsoft devlope ansanm lojisyèl HoloLens pou amelyore kolaborasyon ak vizyalizasyon ant ekip sou latè ak ekip nan espas. VR ka ede ak byennèt mantal astronòt yo pandan misyon ki long. Korekisyon, 2 Novanm 2023, 11:36 PM ET: Vèsyon anvan atik sa a te mal ekri non Thomas Dexmier. Nou regrèt erè a.

article_content:
After significant flaws were found in the franchise bidding process, Sir Richard Branson’s Virgin Trains has been asked to keep operating the West Coast Main Line for up to 13 more months. The Department for Transport (DfT) reversed its original decision to give the line to First Group, originally set to take over in December, and instead will pay Virgin to run services while a new solution is found. Problems with how bids were assessed led the DfT to suspend three civil servants, cancel the deal, and face potential costs of over £100 million to taxpayers for compensation and re-bidding.

For now, Virgin Trains will continue running the line before an interim operator is found and another full-length contract is awarded. Richard Branson, who had previously criticized the fairness of the bidding process, welcomed the move as good news for staff. Transport Secretary Patrick McLoughlin apologized to all bidders and taxpayers, and said his top priority was to keep services running smoothly. To address the failures, McLoughlin also froze new franchise competitions on other major lines and began two independent reviews into DfT’s handling of rail contracts.

Labour’s shadow transport secretary Angela Eagle criticized the government for poor oversight and said ministers were wrong to blame just civil servants for the debacle. Union leaders like RMT’s Bob Crow accused ministers of blocking public control of the railways for ideological reasons, pointing to the state-run East Coast Main Line as evidence that public ownership can work well, with rising profits and reliability since 2009. Despite calls for renationalization, the government chose to keep the line with a private provider. Virgin thanked staff and customers and pledged to maintain service standards during the extension.
translated_content:
Apre gwo defi te detekte nan pwosesis òf franchiz la, Virgin Trains ak Sir Richard Branson resevwa demann pou kontinye jere Liy Prensipal West Coast la pou jiska 13 mwa anplis. Depatman Transpò (DfT) te chanje lide li sou desizyon an pou First Group te pran kontwòl la, bagay ki te dwe fèt nan mwa Desanm, epi kounye a ap peye Virgin pou kontinye ofri sèvis pandan yap chèche yon lòt solisyon. Pwoblèm nan fason òf yo te evalye lakòz DfT sispann twa fonksyonè, kraze kontra a, sa ki ka lakoz kontribyab peye plis pase £100 milyon pou dedomajman ak relanse pwosesis la ankò.

Pou moman an, Virgin Trains ap kontinye bay sèvis sou liy la jiskaske yo jwenn yon lòt operatè pwovizwa epi fòmalize yon nouvo kontra alontèm. Richard Branson, ki te deja kritike fason konpetisyon an te fèt, di nouvèl la bon pou anplwaye yo. Minis Transpò a, Patrick McLoughlin, prezante eskiz li bay patisipan yo ak kontribyab yo epi li di priyorite li se pou sèvis tren yo pa sispann. Pou korije erè yo, McLoughlin friz lòt òf franchiz sou lòt gran liy tren epi komanse de revizyon endepandan sou fason DfT jere kontra tren yo.

Angela Eagle, Minis Transpòtasyon opozisyon Labour la, kritike gouvènman an pou mank siveyans epi li di minis yo pa ka jis blame fonksyonè yo pou sa k rive a. Lidè sendika RMT, Bob Crow, di minis yo kont lide leta k ap jere tren pou rezon ideyolojik, epi li mete aksan sou egzanp Liy East Coast Main Line ke leta ap jere depi 2009 avèk plis benefis ak sèvis ki pi regilye. Malgre apèl pou tren tounen anba kontwòl leta, gouvènman an deside kontinye ak yon operatè prive. Virgin remèsye ekip anplwaye ak kliyan li epi pwomèt pou kontinye ofri sèvis de kalite pandan peryòd ekstansyon an.

The school notified parents in a letter, describing the situation as 'inappropriate behavior' and stating it is being addressed as a 'personal issue.' The teacher has been barred from teaching at the school, but authorities have not provided additional details about his status. No arrest was made, nor was the incident reported to police. School officials are investigating. Students described the incident as surprising for a generally well-liked teacher, but rumors spread quickly. MailOnline is awaiting comment from the principal.

article_content: Ambien is commonly prescribed to help people with insomnia. In a remarkable turn of events, the drug is believed to have helped 23-year-old Sam Goddard, who was in a coma after suffering multiple strokes. Sam, from Brisbane, Australia, experienced severe headaches while playing football in February 2010 and was rushed to the hospital. Doctors determined Sam had suffered eight strokes, leaving him with permanent brain damage and predicting he would remain in a vegetative state. His family and fiancée, Sally Jane Nielson, were told he would never walk, talk, or recognize loved ones. Sam spent 45 days in the ICU at Royal Brisbane Hospital, where he also contracted pneumonia. Despite the grim prognosis, Sally refused to give up. She found reports online that suggested Ambien had sometimes helped stroke patients regain speech and movement. Against medical advice, Sally arranged for Sam to receive the drug. Miraculously, after a year of being unable to communicate, Sam began to talk while on the medication. Ambien, also known as Stilnox or zolpidem, is a prescription medication for insomnia. Some studies suggest it increases brain blood flow, especially in language areas, but research into its use for stroke recovery is still in early stages. Fewer than 10% of stroke patients respond as Sam did. Sam now takes Ambien up to four times a day, but its effects last for only about an hour. While his speech remains slow and slurred, the drug has confirmed his underlying cognitive function. Sally is Sam's full-time caregiver, and the couple still plans to get married. Doctors at Moss Rehabilitation Center in Philadelphia are currently researching Ambien’s effects on stroke recovery. Despite uncertainties, Sally is determined to support Sam, believing their connection is unbreakable.
translated_content: Ambien se yon medikaman ki souvan preskri pou ede moun ki gen pwoblèm dòmi. Nan yon sitiyasyon ki vrèman etonan, yo kwè medikaman an te ede Sam Goddard, yon jenn gason 23 an, ki te tonbe nan koma apre li te fè plizyè aksidan serebral. Sam, ki soti Brisbane, Ostrali, te gen gwo maltèt pandan li t ap jwe foutbòl an fevriye 2010 epi yo te mennen l lopital. Doktè yo te jwenn ke Sam te fè uit aksidan serebral, sa ki te bay li gwo domaj nan sèvo epi yo te panse li tap rete nan yon eta vejetatif. Fanmi li ak fiyanse li, Sally Jane Nielson, te resevwa nouvèl li pap janm mache, pale, oswa rekonèt moun li renmen yo. Sam te pase 45 jou nan ICU lopital Royal Brisbane kote li te pran nemoni tou. Malgre nouvèl sa yo, Sally pa t dekouraje. Li te fè rechèch sou entènèt epi jwenn ke Ambien te ede lòt moun ki te fè aksidan serebral reprann pale ak bouje. Malgre doktè yo pa t dakò, Sally te fè Sam pran medikaman an. Etonan, apre plis pase yon ane san li pa t ka pale, Sam te kòmanse pale pandan li pran medikaman an. Ambien, yo rele li tou Stilnox oswa zolpidem, se yon medikaman doktè preskri pou ensomni. Gen kèk rechèch ki montre li ka ogmante san nan sèvo a, sitou kote ki gen rapò ak pale, men etid sou itilizasyon li apre aksidan serebral toujou pa fin avanse. Mwens ke 10% pasyan ki fè aksidan serebral reyaji menm jan ak Sam. Sam pran Ambien jiska kat fwa pa jou, men efè li dire sèlman anviwon yon èdtan. Pale li toujou dousman epi pafwa difisil pou konprann, men medikaman an montre kapasite entelektyèl li toujou la. Sally ap pran swen Sam a plen tan, epi yo toujou gen plan pou marye. Doktè nan Moss Rehabilitation Center, Philadelphia, ap fè plis rechèch sou kijan Ambien ka ede moun ki te fè aksidan serebral. Malgre ensekirite yo, Sally detèmine pou kontinye soutni Sam paske koneksyon yo fò anpil.
post_content: Woah! A sleeping pill, Ambien, helped Sam Goddard talk again after 8 strokes and a year in a coma. His fiancée refused to give up and now they're still dreaming of their wedding. #TrueLove #MedicalMiracle #NeverGiveUp
translated_post: Men sa! Yon grenn dòmi, Ambien, fè Sam Goddard pale ankò apre li te fè 8 aksidan serebral epi li te pase yon lane nan koma. Fiyanse li pa t janm lage; yo toujou ap rèv maryaj yo. #LanmmourVrè #MirakMedikal #KenbeFèm

article_content:
The heirs of the late Sir Lawrie Barratt are facing criticism for evicting tenants—including women and children—from their homes on the former Barratt estate in Farndale, North York Moors. The evictions are part of efforts to cover a £20 million inheritance tax following Barratt’s £48 million estate.

Sir Lawrie, who passed away nine months ago, was known for fostering a close-knit community on the estate, transforming it into a haven for artists, scholars, and writers. Many residents recall his generosity, noting that he offered affordable rentals and trustworthy agreements.

After his death, sons Peter and David Barratt began to sell off parts of the estate, with some cottages selling for up to £380,000—much higher than previous rental amounts. Some tenants, lacking legal protection, have requested assistance from housing charity Shelter amid fears of homelessness.

Concerns among residents have led to activism, including petitions, fundraising, and mass meetings to preserve the community. While early reports indicated 13 properties might be sold, this number was reduced to seven after public protest. Estate agent Strutt & Parker has confirmed that only four occupied and three vacant properties are currently being offered for sale.

Local Member of Parliament Anne McIntosh has called the situation ‘difficult’ and pledged to help find a solution. Tenants remain anxious that further sales could turn homes into holiday lets and threaten the historic character of Farndale, beloved for its daffodil fields and popularity with tourists.
translated_content:
Eritie Sir Lawrie Barratt yo ap reponn ak kritik paske yap mete fanm ak timoun deyò lakay yo sou ansyen domèn Barratt lan nan Farndale, North York Moors. Delokasyon sa yo fèt pou peye yon taks eritaj £20 milyon apre lanmò Sir Lawrie ki te gen byen ki vo £48 milyon.

Sir Lawrie, ki te mouri nèf mwa pase, te konnen kòm yon pwopriyetè angaje ki te bati yon kominote soud nan domèn nan, ki te tounen refij pou atis, entelektyèl, ak ekriven. Anpil rezidan sonje jenewozite li paske li te bay kay pou lwaye bon mache epi li te kenbe pawòl li.

Apre lanmò li, pitit li yo, Peter ak David Barratt, kòmanse vann kay sou domèn nan. Gen kèk kay k ap vann jiska £380,000—bien pi wo pase pri lwaye anvan yo. Gen lokatè ki pa gen pwoteksyon legal e kounye a ap frape pòt òganizasyon Shelter paske yo pè rete san kay.

Kè sote ak kolè rezidan yo lakoz yo lanse petisyon, ranmase fon, epi oganize ranmasay pou defann kominote a. Okòmansman, yo te di 13 kay ta pral vann; men, apre pwotestasyon, nimewo a desann a 7. Ajans imobilye Strutt & Parker konfime ke kat kay kote gen moun ap viv ansanm ak twa ki vid ap vann kounye a.

Depite lokal Anne McIntosh di sa 'difisil' epi li pwomèt pou ede jwenn yon solisyon. Lokatè yo toujou pè ke plis kay pral tounen kay vakans epi sa ka detwi tèt orijinal istorik Farndale, pi popilè pou jaden jonkil li yo ak vizit touris yo.
post_content: Estate drama in Farndale! Sir Lawrie Barratt's sons are selling off historic cottages to pay a huge tax bill—leaving families worried about losing their homes and tight-knit community. Locals are fighting back! #Farndale #Community #HousingCrisis
translated_post: Gwo tòde kay nan Farndale! Pitit Sir Lawrie Barratt yo ap vann ansyen kay yo pou peye gwo taks—fòk anpil fanmi pèdi kay ak bèl kominote yo. Moun nan zòn lan ap simonte! #Farndale #Kominote #Lojman

article_content: In a gripping showdown at the 2011 Frys.com Open in California, Briny Baird and Bryce Molder battled through the longest and most dramatic playoff of the PGA Tour season. After six tense extra holes, Molder, 31, clinched victory with a clutch six-foot birdie putt, leaving Baird still in search of his first Tour win in what was his 348th career event. Reached by CNN after the tournament, expectations were that Baird would be dejected, following yet another missed chance for a breakthrough. Instead, Baird was found fishing off the coast of Stuart, Florida, in good spirits. 'I’ve caught two speckled trout and one red fish,' he reported enthusiastically. 'We're having them for dinner at a friend's house. Honestly, I play golf mainly to support my fishing habit!' Baird's golf career has been financially rewarding: with total earnings of $12,460,542, his recent second-place finish added $540,000 to his tally, putting him 87th on the all-time PGA Tour earnings list—above prominent names such as Tom Kite and Tom Watson. Still, Baird admits, 'I’d rather be known as the guy who made the most money without a win than the least money. If you can do what you love and be rewarded for it, that’s a bonus. But not winning isn’t something I enjoy.' Golf runs in the Baird family. Briny’s father, Butch Baird, won twice on the PGA Tour and was highly involved in shaping his son's early game. However, the two have been estranged for years following his parents’ difficult divorce, and Briny notes, 'From age three to 18, I learned everything about golf from my dad. In the next twenty years, nothing.' Despite the rift, Baird says the separation is a matter of personal life, not golf. During his college years, Baird played alongside future legends David Duval and Stewart Cink at Georgia Tech, later transferring to Valdosta State where he met his wife. Despite substantial career earnings, Baird has experienced setbacks, including losing his PGA Tour card twice after falling just short of the top 125 ranking, which determines eligibility. He describes the pressure of qualifying school as immense. Despite repeated close calls—his latest runner-up finish being the fifth of his career—Baird remains optimistic. 'It was a huge disappointment to lose that playoff,' he reflects, 'but I know I can win on Tour—more than once, even.' Briny Baird’s unwavering self-belief and determination keep him focused on future successes. Known for his positive personality, golf’s richest runner-up is sure his first victory is on the horizon.
translated_content: Nan yon rankont sansasyonèl nan Frys.com Open 2011 nan Kalifòni, Briny Baird ak Bryce Molder te batay nan pi long ak plis dramatik playoff la sou sezon PGA Tour la. Apre sis twou siplemantè chaje tansyon, Molder, 31 lane, ranpòte viktwa ak yon birdie sis pye, kite Baird toujou ap chèche premye viktwa li apre 348yèm tounwa karyè li. Lè CNN te kontakte Baird apre tounwa a, anpil te panse li t’ap dekouraje apre li te rate yon lòt gwo okazyon. Okontrè, yo jwenn Baird ap lapèch bò kote Stuart, Florida, kè kontan. 'Mwen trape de truit ak yon sèl pwason wouj,' li di ak antouzyas. 'Nou pral manje yo lakay zanmi pita. Franchman, mwen jwe gòlf sitou pou m ka kontinye lapèch mwen!' Karyè golf Baird la pote anpil benefis finansye: ak $12,460,542 ameriken total, plas li dezyèm fwa a fè li touche $540,000, mete l 87yèm sou lis lajan PGA Tour tout tan—devan gran non tankou Tom Kite ak Tom Watson. Sepandan, Baird admèt, 'Mwen ta prefere yo sonje m kòm nèg ki touche plis lajan san viktwa pase youn ki touche mwens. Si ou ka fè sa w renmen epi jwenn rekonpans, se yon trè bon bagay. Men, mwen pa renmen pa genyen.' Gòlf se yon istwa fanmi Baird. Papa li, Butch Baird, ranpòte 2 fwa sou PGA Tour epi li te anpil enplike nan devlopman pitit li. Sepandan, depi divòs difisil paran li, li ak papa l pa pale. Briny di, 'Soti 3 pou rive 18 lane, tout sa mwen konnen sou gòlf, se papa m ki anseye m. Lè sa fini, mwen pa resevwa anyen ankò de li.' Malgre divizyon an, Baird deklare pwoblèm lan se lavi pèsonèl yo, pa gòlf. Pandan lavi inivèsite li, Baird te jwe ak gran jwe tankou David Duval ak Stewart Cink nan Georgia Tech, men pita li ale Valdosta State kote li rankontre madanm li. Malgre tout lajan li touche, Baird te gen difikilte, tankou pèdi kat PGA Tour li de fwa apre li te fini jis deyò top 125. Li di presyon lekòl kalifikasyon an ekstrèm. Malgre kantite fwa li rive pre san li pa ranpòte—denye dezyèm plas li se senkyèm gwo final li—Baird toujou gen lespwa. 'Sa te yon gwo dezapwentman pèdi playoff la,' li reflechi, 'men mwen konnen mwen kapab genyen sou Tour la… e plis pase yon fwa menm.' Konfyans ak detèminasyon Briny Baird fè l kontinye vize siksè. Li se youn nan pi pozitif sou PGA Tour la e li sèten premye viktwa li deja tou pre.
post_content: Briny Baird is still chasing his first PGA Tour win after an epic six-hole playoff loss, but his spirits are high! With over $12M earned and a love of fishing, he's proof that passion (and a little patience) pays off. #Golf #BrinyBaird #ChasingVictory
translated_post: Briny Baird toujou ap chèche premye viktwa li sou PGA Tour apre li pèdi nan yon playoff 6 twou! Depi li fè plis pase $12 milyon epi li renmen lapèch, li montre jan pasyon ak pèsistans se kle pou reyisi. #Golf #BrinyBaird #Pasyon

Zambia's government has revoked retirement benefits and privileges for former President Edgar Lungu following his decision to return to active politics. Lungu, who lost the presidency to Hakainde Hichilema in 2021, had initially announced his retirement after his six-year term, during which Zambia became Africa’s most indebted nation. His return to the political arena sets the stage for a potentially contentious 2026 presidential race.

According to government spokesperson Cornelius Mweetwa, Lungu has already been notified of the immediate withdrawal of his retirement entitlements. By law, former presidents who resume active politics forfeit these benefits, which previously included security officers, a diplomatic passport, state vehicles, a furnished home, medical insurance, and funeral expenses. As a retired leader, Lungu also enjoyed immunity from prosecution.

Mweetwa stated that Lungu will now be treated like any other senior citizen under the law. Lungu insists his return is driven by a desire to defend democracy and unite his divided party, the Patriotic Front, which is facing possible deregistration over leadership disputes. The government has dismissed Lungu's allegations that he is being targeted by supporters of the ruling United Party for National Development (UPND), calling his claims of threats “a mere false alarm.”

Lungu was recently cautioned against confrontational political activities, including public jogging, which police described as political activism. While it is currently unclear if his immunity from prosecution will be removed, Zambia’s parliament has previously revoked this protection from two former presidents. Some UPND members are calling for the removal of Lungu’s immunity and prosecution over alleged corruption during his rule, which Lungu says are politically motivated.

Meanwhile, civil society organizations have raised concerns about diminishing human rights freedoms in Zambia.
translated_content:
Gouvènman Zambi a retire benefis ak privilè retrèt ansyen prezidan Edgar Lungu apre li retounen angaje nan politik. Lungu, ki te pèdi prezidans lan an 2021 kont Hakainde Hichilema, te deklare retrèt li apre sis lane sou pouvwa kote peyi a te vin youn nan pi endète nan Afrik. Retou li sou sèn politik la ka mennen nan yon eleksyon prezidansyèl 2026 ki trè chofe.

Cornelius Mweetwa, pòt pawòl gouvènman an, te di Lungu deja resevwa avi ofisyèl sou retrè benefis li yo. Lalwa di tout ansyen prezidan ki retounen fè politik pèdi benefis sa yo, tankou ajan sekirite, paspò diplomatik, machin leta, kay meble, asirans medikal, ak depans fineray. Kòm ansyen prezidan, Lungu te gen iminite kont pouswit lajistis.

Mweetwa presize kounye a, Lungu ap trete menm jan ak tout lòt grannèg anba lalwa a. Lungu di rezon li retounen se pou defann demokrasi ak rasanble pati li, Patriotic Front, ki ka pèdi estati li akoz divizyon lidèchip. Gouvènman an refize akizasyon Lungu kote li fè konnen li viktim menas pa sipòtè pati sou pouvwa UPND; yo te di se "fa-alarme".

Lungu resevwa avètisman kont konpòtman politik ki ka kreye konfli, tankou fè jogging an piblik, paske polis di se yon jès aktivis politik. Jouk kounye a, li poko klè si iminite Lungu ap retire, menm jan sa te fèt ak de ansyen prezidan anvan. Kèk manm UPND ap mande pou yo retire iminite li epi pouswiv li pou akizasyon koripsyon pandan manda li, men Lungu di tout sa se politik.

An menm tan, òganizasyon sosyete sivil eksprime enkyetid sou regresyon dwa moun anndan Zambi.
post_content: Former president Edgar Lungu lost his retirement perks after jumping back into Zambian politics! The 2026 race is heating up while the government and civil society trade shots over rights and corruption. #ZambiaPolitics #LunguReturns
translated_post: Edgar Lungu pèdi tout avantaj li kòm ansyen prezidan paske li retounen fè politik! Eleksyon 2026 ap pwomèt flanm, ak gouvènman ak sosyete sivil yo ap fè pale sou dwa ak koripsyon. #ZambiePolitiques #LunguRetounen

Paul Scholes, legendary former Manchester United and England footballer, has shared a personal side of his life: his six-year-old son, Aiden, has autism and faces learning difficulties. Scholes, who typically values his privacy, makes this revelation in his new autobiography, 'Scholes: My Story.'

He details how autism influences Aiden’s everyday experiences, describing his son as often being in his own world. The family is deeply committed to Aiden’s well-being, supporting him through speech and play therapy. Scholes talks warmly about Aiden’s love for swimming—so much that family vacations are planned around making sure he can spend as much time in the pool as possible.

With the help of his wife, Claire, and their two older children, Arron and Alicia, the family works together to support Aiden, adapting to his needs and celebrating his progress. 

Scholes also brings awareness to autism’s early signs, its genetic ties, its higher occurrence in boys, and the impact it can have on communication and independence. He notes that other well-known figures like Sylvester Stallone, John Travolta, and John Bercow have children with autism too. Through his story, Scholes expresses hope and dedication to providing Aiden a joyful and fulfilling life.
translated_content:
Paul Scholes, ansyen lejand foutbòl Manchester United ak Angletè, fè konnen yon aspè pèsonèl sou lavi li: pitit gason li Aiden, ki gen sis an, ap viv ak otis epi li gen kèk difikilte pou aprann. Scholes, ki toujou prete atansyon sou vi prive li, revele sa nan nouvo otobyografi li a, 'Scholes: My Story.'

Li rakonte kijan otis bay Aiden defi chak jou, e li di pitit li pafwa sanble ap viv nan pwòp ti mon pa li. Fanmi an sipòte Aiden avèk tout fòs li, ansanm ak terapis pou pawòl ak jwèt. Scholes pale ak anpil chalè sou lanmou Aiden genyen pou naje—lè yo ale vakans, yo asire li pase anpil tan ap naje nan pisin nan pou fè l' kontan.

Avèk sipò madanm li Claire ak de lòt pitit yo, Arron ak Alicia, fanmi an kontinye adapte ak bezwen Aiden ak selebre chak reyalizasyon li fè. 

Scholes pale tou sou kijan otis ka parèt bonè, li pi souvan lakay ti gason, epi li ka gen enpak sou kominikasyon ak endepandans moun. Li site ke lòt pèsonalite tankou Sylvester Stallone, John Travolta, ak John Bercow, genyen pitit ki gen otis tou. Avèk testamany sa, Scholes montre detèminasyon li ak espwa pou Aiden ka viv yon lavi kontan ak plen akonplisman.
post_content: Football legend Paul Scholes opens up about his son Aiden’s autism, sharing how the family supports him with love and therapy. Inspiring to see public figures use their voices for awareness! #FamilySupport #AutismAwareness
translated_post: Ansèn foutbolè Paul Scholes rakonte kijan pitit li Aiden ap viv ak otis epi fanmi an ap sipòte l avèk lanmou ak terapis. Bèl egzanp ak kouraj! #SipòFanmi #KonsyantizasyonOtis

In Malaga on Saturday, Italian tennis star Jannik Sinner achieved a remarkable feat by defeating world number one Novak Djokovic twice in a single day, propelling Italy into the Davis Cup final with a 2-1 victory over Serbia. This marks Italy's first appearance in the final since their only title back in 1976. They will face the 28-time champion Australia on Sunday.

Sinner, currently ranked world number four, played a crucial role by keeping Italy's hopes alive. He edged out Djokovic, a 24-time Grand Slam winner, 6-2, 2-6, 7-5 in the second singles match. Later, Sinner partnered with Lorenzo Sonego to secure the decisive doubles win against Djokovic and Miomir Kecmanovic, finishing 6-3, 6-4. Earlier, Kecmanovic had overcome Lorenzo Musetti 6-7 (7/9), 6-2, 6-1 to give Serbia the lead.

With this latest victory, Sinner has now beaten Djokovic three times in their last four meetings within just 11 days. Notably, Sinner became the first player to defeat Djokovic in a Davis Cup singles match since Juan Martin del Potro in 2011, ending Djokovic's 21-match unbeaten streak in the event.

"I have to be really proud about how I handled the situation," Sinner said after his win, emphasizing Italy's excitement but also the need to stay relaxed ahead of the final. Djokovic, who won seven titles this year including three Grand Slams, expressed disappointment after missing match points but congratulated Italy for their performance, particularly praising Sinner's play in both singles and doubles.

The doubles match featured tense moments, with animated Italian fans and Djokovic responding to their chants. Despite his efforts, Djokovic ended the year without the team title he aimed for.

Italy, led by captain Filippo Volandri, will meet Lleyton Hewitt's Australian team, who defeated Finland in the other semifinal. The Davis Cup final signifies a major moment for Italian tennis, taking place 25 years after their last appearance.

(With inputs from AFP.)
translated_content:
Samdi nan Malaga, zetwal tenis Italyen Jannik Sinner reyalize yon gwo eksplo lè li bat nimewo en mond Novak Djokovic de fwa menm jou a, mete Itali nan final Davis Cup la ak yon viktwa 2-1 sou Sèbi. Sa make premye fwa depi 1976 Itali rive an final. Dimech la, y'a jwe kont Ostrali, ki te ranpòte tit la 28 fwa.

Sinner, ki klase katriyèm mondyal, te toujou kenbe espwa Itali vivan. Li bat Djokovic, ki gen 24 tit Grand Slam, 6-2, 2-6, 7-5 nan dezyèm match senp la. Apre sa, Sinner ak Lorenzo Sonego bat Djokovic ak Miomir Kecmanovic nan doub 6-3, 6-4. Ouvèti a, Kecmanovic te bat Lorenzo Musetti 6-7 (7/9), 6-2, 6-1 pou bay Sèbi avantaj.

Avèk viktwa sa a, Sinner bat Djokovic twa fwa sou kat dènye match yo an 11 jou. Li se premye jwè ki bat Djokovic nan Davis Cup senp depi Juan Martin del Potro an 2011, mete fen nan 21 viktwa Djokovic yo.

"Mwen fyè jan mwen jere sitiyasyon an," Sinner deklare, ankouraje Itali kenbe kalm anvan final la. Djokovic, ki te jwen sèt tit lane sa, gen ladan twa Grand Slam, te dezapwente apre li rate pwen match yo men felisite Itali, e sitou Sinner, pou bon pèfòmans yo.

Match doub la te gen anpil tansyon ak anpil sipòtè Italyen ki tap fè bri, e Djokovic te reponn ak imè. Malgre efò li, Djokovic fini ane a san tit ekip li ta vle genyen an.

Itali, ak kaptèn Filippo Volandri, ap jwe kont ekip Ostrali Lleyton Hewitt, ki te elimine Fenlann. Final sa a make gwo etap pou tenis Italyen, 25 an apre dènye final yo.

(Avèk kèk detay AFP)
post_content: What a day for Italian tennis! 🇮🇹 Jannik Sinner beats Djokovic not once, but TWICE, pushing Italy to their first Davis Cup final since '76! They'll take on powerhouse Australia next. Can they pull it off? #DavisCup #ItalianTennis #SinnerMagic
translated_post: Sezon bèl pou tenis Italyen! Jannik Sinner kraze Djokovic de fwa menm jou a, mete Itali nan final Davis Cup pou premye fwa depi 1976! Yo pral jwe kont Ostrali. Ou panse y'ap chemen? #DavisCup #Sinner #TenisItali

A 70-hour work week could create legal and compliance concerns, as it exceeds limits set by Indian labour laws, according to Dhriti Prasanna Mahanta, Vice President and Business Head for TeamLease Degree Apprenticeship. Mahanta highlighted that Indian labour law permits employees to work up to 9 hours per day, and consistently working 70 hours a week would breach these regulations. He noted that this kind of schedule may be suitable for entrepreneurs or highly self-motivated individuals, but not for regular employees constrained by legal requirements and overtime rules. Former Infosys CEO N R Narayana Murthy’s recent call for a 70-hour work week has sparked broad discussion.

Mahanta added that increased weekly working hours would boost employment costs, especially where overtime pay is restricted by law. Speaking to PTI, Mahanta observed that about 65% of new job demand in fields like AI, machine learning, and blockchain is now coming from non-technology sectors—including telecom, aviation, retail, fintech, and electronics. He attributed this trend to heightened investment from both government and the private sector, as well as shifts in consumer behavior since the Covid-19 pandemic.

Mahanta pointed out a 51% skill gap in AI talent, calling for the growth of work-based learning programs and apprenticeships to address this shortfall. Roles such as cloud engineers have seen a 25% rise in demand, while jobs for AI, blockchain, and machine learning-certified professionals are growing by 35%. Network and computer systems administrators have observed a 10% increase, and network security engineers’ roles are predicted to grow by 20%, driven by industry reports and ongoing research.

In other business developments, India’s luxury car market is increasingly dominated by younger buyers, with a significant share of Audi, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW customers under 40 years old. Apple has also set a new quarterly revenue record in India, pointing to the market’s strategic importance. Meanwhile, Zee Entertainment CEO Punit Goenka’s leadership is uncertain amid regulatory investigations, as Sony seeks its own executive to head the proposed merger.
translated_content:
Yon semèn travay 70 èdtan ka pote pwoblèm legal ak konfòmite, paske sa depase limit lwa travay Endyen yo, dapre sa Dhriti Prasanna Mahanta, Vis Prezidan ak Chèf Divizyon TeamLease Degree Apprenticeship di. Mahanta mete aksan sou ke lwa travay nan peyi End akòde anplwaye yo jiska 9 èdtan travay pa jou, kidonk travay 70 èdtan pa semèn ta vyole règleman sa yo. Li fè konnen orè sa ka mache pou antreprenè oswa moun ki gen anpil motivasyon, men se pa reyalistik pou anplwaye komen akoz restriksyon legal ak règ sou lè siplemantè. Ansien CEO Infosys, N R Narayana Murthy, te sèvi ak sijesyon sa dènyèman epi sa louvri anpil diskisyon.

Mahanta te ajoute ogmantasyon kantite èdtan travay pa semèn ap ogmante depans travay la, sitou kote peye lè siplemantè limite pa lwa. Pandan li pale ak PTI, Mahanta fè konnen prèske 65% demann nouvo travay nan AI, machine learning, ak blockchain ap sòti nan sektè ki pa teknoloji tankou telecom, aviasyon, détaillant, fintech ak elektwonik. Li di sa vini gras ak plis envestisman nan gouvènman ak sektè prive, epi se yon chanjman konpòtman kliyan depi apre Covid-19.

Mahanta souliye tou gen yon mank 51% talan nan domèn AI, epi li mande plis pwogram aprantisaj ak fòmasyon pratik pou konble diferans sa. Travay pou enjenyè cloud ogmante 25%, pandan demand pou pwofesyonèl AI, blockchain ak machine learning sètifye ap ogmante 35%. Administratè sistèm rezo ak òdinatè gen 10% plis opòtinite, epi enjenyè sekirite rezo yo ta kapab wè kwasans 20%, dapre rechèch ak rapò endistri. 

Nan lòt nouvèl biznis, jèn yo ap rantre plis nan achte machin liks, kote kliyan Audi, Mercedes-Benz ak BMW ki gen mwens pase 40 an ap domine. Apple genyen yon rekò nouvo pou revni trimès an End, sa montre enpòtans mache End la pou konpayi an. Nan lòt men an, pozisyon CEO Zee Entertainment, Punit Goenka, pa klè akoz ankèt regilatè, pandan Sony ap chèche mete pwòp administratè li pou dirije fizyon an.
post_content: Can you imagine working 70 hours a week? Experts warn it breaks Indian labor laws and isn't practical for regular employees. Meanwhile, tech jobs are booming in AI, cloud, and more! #WorkLifeBalance #IndiaNews #AIGrowth
translated_post: Ou ta travay 70 èdtan chak semèn? Ekspè di sa pa legal ann End epi li pa bon pou travayè òdinè. Men djòb teknoloji ap eksploze—sitou nan AI, cloud, elatriye! #TravayLavi #NouvèlEnd #Teknoloji

article_content: Jessica Ennis-Hill, renowned for her Olympic gold medal in 2012, has announced she is expecting her first child. She first showed her baby bump at a stadium opening in Glasgow, an event leading up to the 2014 Commonwealth Games. Married to her childhood sweetheart Andy Hill for eight months, Ennis-Hill spoke excitedly about her upcoming motherhood and a year of big changes. Though her pregnancy means she'll sit out the Commonwealth Games, she remains dedicated to staying fit through yoga and cycling, even updating fans with her exercise routines online. Looking forward, she plans to resume training for the 2016 Rio Olympics. article_content: Cryptocurrency markets posted a mixed showing on Wednesday, as the weakening US dollar added upward pressure. This has helped lift cryptocurrencies further. Analysts indicate Bitcoin is in a cautiously upward trend, trading over $37,100, facing resistance at $38,000, and finding support between $35,800 and $34,500. Technical factors point toward a balanced yet slightly bullish outlook. Javier Milei's win as Argentina’s new president, noted for being pro-Bitcoin, added to market optimism and contributed to a recent BTC rally. Experts highlight that increasing institutional participation, as shown by Fidelity's application for an Ethereum ETF alongside other major firms, signals more mainstream acceptance.
