Paul Scholes is no stranger to accolades from fellow professionals as one of the top midfielders of his era. However, he isn't usually honoured at halftime during a game. During a recent all-star charity match at Allianz Arena, World Cup winner and Bayern Munich standout Bastian Schweinsteiger sought out Scholes at halftime, eager to swap shirts. The former England international gladly obliged, exchanging jerseys with Schweinsteiger before returning to the pitch in a plain replacement shirt for the second half.

Scholes later discussed the moment, saying, "I've given it to Schweinsteiger. He asked me for my shirt at halftime, so I gave it to him. He gave me one of his as well, which was appreciated—he's an amazing footballer, having just won the World Cup. It was nice to talk to him for a few moments. Swapping shirts with such a great player, someone who's achieved so much with Bayern Munich and for his country, was a pleasure."

Scholes captained the Manchester United XI in a 3-3 draw against Bayern Munich, scoring United's second goal. Reflecting on the game and his performance at age 39, he said, "It's very difficult when you're nearly 40, but I enjoyed it—a six-goal game, and I hope the crowd had a good time."

After the final whistle, Scholes showed reporters the back of his jersey, which was left numberless after the shirt swap.
translated_content:
Paul Scholes pa etranje ak lwanj k ap soti bò kote lòt pwofesyonèl ki konsidere l kòm youn nan pi bon milje jenerasyon li a. Men, li pa souvan resevwa onè konsa pandan mitan tan yon match. Pandan yon match charite tout-zetwal ki fèt resamman nan Allianz Arena, Bastian Schweinsteiger, ki se gayan Koup di Mond ak vedèt Bayern Munich, te vin kote Scholes pandan poz la pou mande l fè echanj mayo. Ansien entènasyonal Angle a te aksepte byen fasil, yo te echanje mayo epi Scholes te tounen sou teren an ak yon mayo san nimewo pou dezyèm mitan an.

Scholes pale sou moman an pita, li di: "Mwen bay mayo a bay Schweinsteiger. Li te mande m li pandan mitan tan an, epi li ban mwen pa li tou, sa fè m plezi—se yon foutbolè etonan, li sot ranpòte Koup di Mond lan. Te bèl pale ak li pou kèk minit. Echanje mayo ak yon jwe konsa ki deja reyalize anpil ak Bayern Munich ak peyi li, se te yon gran onè."

Scholes te kapitèn Manchester United XI nan match 3-3 kont Bayern Munich, kote li te make dezyèm gòl ekip li an. Lè l ap reflechi sou jwèt la ak pèfòmans li a 39 an, li di: "Li pa fasil ditou lè w rive prèske 40 an, men mwen te pran plezi—sis gòl, e mwen espere foul la te jwi match la."

Apre sòti final la, Scholes te montre jounalis yo do mayo li ki te vin san nimewo apre echanj la.
post_content: Paul Scholes swapped shirts with Bastian Schweinsteiger at halftime during a legendary charity match in Munich! 💥 Scholes scored, led United, and still wowed at nearly 40. Legends respect legends. #FootballIcons #ShirtSwap #Scholes #Schweinsteiger
translated_post: Paul Scholes fè echanj mayo ak Bastian Schweinsteiger pandan mitan tan yon gwo match charite nan Minik! 🔥 Scholes make, li te kapitèn United, epi li toujou ap bay kalite prèske 40 an. Lejand ap respekte lejand! #Foutbòl #Scholes #Schweinsteiger #EchanjMayo

article_content: Persistant heavy rainfall in several districts of Tamil Nadu, as well as Puducherry and Karaikal, has led local authorities to declare holidays for schools and colleges on Tuesday as a safety precaution. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has placed an orange alert on the coastal regions of Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Karaikal, warning of isolated heavy to very heavy rain (approximately 115 to 204 mm) expected on November 14. Affected districts such as Cuddalore, Villupuram, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Ariyalur, Tiruvarur, and Thanjavur have announced holidays for educational institutions, while in some taluks of Tiruvannamalai, Pudukkottai, and Dindigul, only schools are closed. Revenue authorities have instructed all district administrations to prepare for emergency responses as more adverse weather is forecast. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) attributes the rainfall to an upper-air cyclonic circulation over the Andaman-Nicobar Islands and the adjoining Bay of Bengal, which has led to a low-pressure area forming in the southeastern Bay region. Reports show significant rainfall totals: 17 cm in Velankanni, 15 cm in Nagapattinam, 14 cm in Karaikal, and 12 cm each in Nannilam, Cuddalore, Paringipettai, and Puducherry. The cyclonic circulation, which reaches up to the upper troposphere and tilts southwestward, is projected to move west-northwest and strengthen into a depression over the west-central Bay of Bengal by November 16. In the coming hours, forecasts call for moderate thunderstorms and rainfall in various districts—such as Chennai, Cuddalore, Thanjavur, and more—and heavy downpours in Puducherry and Karaikal. Chennai has been experiencing unrelenting rain since Monday night. As of 5:30 am Tuesday, Meenambakkam recorded 3.55 cm and Nungambakkam 2.5 cm of rain. Diploma exams scheduled for today have been postponed, with revised dates to be provided later. The RMC had previously warned several districts, including Ramanathapuram and Karaikal, about the possibility of heavy rainfall from November 13–14, alongside isolated warnings for numerous other regions.

Depatman Meteyowolojik Endyen (IMD) mete yon alèt zoranj sou zòn kotyè Tamil Nadu, Puducherry ak Karaikal pou lapli lou jiska trè lou (apeprè 115 a 204 mm) sou 14 novanm. Distri afekte yo tankou Cuddalore, Villupuram, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Ariyalur, Tiruvarur, ak Thanjavur deja bay jou konje pou lekòl ak kolèj. Nan kèk taluk Tiruvannamalai, Pudukkottai ak Dindigul, se sèlman lekòl ki fèmen. Otorite revni yo mande tout administrasyon distri yo pou pare ak plan ijans paske yo prevwa lòt move tan. Sant Meteyowolojik Rejyonal la (RMC) di lapli yo soti nan yon siklòn atmosferik anlè zile Andaman-Nicobar ak zòn lanmè Andaman-Bay of Bengal, ki koze yon zòn presyon ba nan sidès Bay la ak zòn ki bò kote. Rapò yo montre Velankanni resevwa 17 cm lapli, Nagapattinam 15 cm, Karaikal 14 cm, pandan Nannilam, Cuddalore, Paringipettai ak Puducherry chak gen 12 cm. RMC di siklòn nan k ap elaji jiska twoposfè anwo epi panche sou sidwès, ap deplase pi pre lwès-nodwès epi ap vin tounen depresyon nan zòn santral Bay of Bengal alantou 16 novanm. Nan kèk èdtan k ap vini yo, previzyon yo anonse loraj modere ak lapli nan plizyè distri tankou Chennai, Cuddalore, Thanjavur elatriye, epi lapli lou pou Puducherry ak Karaikal. Chennai ap resevwa lapli san rete depi lendi swa. Jouk 5:30 nan maten madi, Meenambakkam anrejistre 3.55 cm lapli epi Nungambakkam 2.5 cm. Egzamen diplòm ki te pwograme jodi a ranvwaye, yo va bay nouvo dat pi devan. During an episode of 'Iyanla: Fix My Life,' life coach Iyanla Vanzant confronted Jay Williams, a man who has fathered 34 children with 17 women. The segment, shared on OWN TV’s YouTube channel, shows Williams holding dolls representing his children, with several more dolls arranged behind him. Vanzant sits across from him, questioning his approach to fatherhood and birth control.

Vanzant asks Williams if he ever considered that having 34 children might be excessive and whether he ever thought about getting a vasectomy. Williams answers that the thought never occurred to him and expresses no regrets about his choices. When pressed about using condoms, Williams insists he did but jokes he might have had 200 children otherwise.

Throughout the conversation, Vanzant highlights the challenges of caring for so many children, using the dolls as a symbolic representation. She further points out that Williams seems unaware of the responsibility involved, especially when he places the dolls carelessly. Vanzant reflects on her own experiences as a mother, emphasizing that, regardless of circumstances, a parent cannot simply put down their responsibilities when it becomes inconvenient.

Pandan yon epizòd "Iyanla: Fix My Life," coach lavi Iyanla Vanzant te konfwonte Jay Williams, yon nonm ki gen 34 pitit ak 17 fanm diferan. Segman an, ki pataje sou chèn YouTube OWN TV a, montre Williams k ap kenbe poupées ki reprezante pitit li yo, ak plizyè lòt poupées dèyè li. Vanzant chita anfas li, ap poze kesyon sou fason li jere wòl papa ak metòd planin.

Vanzant mande Williams si li janm panse 34 timoun se trop, epi si li te janm panse fè vazektomi. Williams reponn li pa janm panse a sa epi li pa regrèt chwa li yo. Lè yo mande l sou itilize kapòt, Williams ensiste li te sèvi ak yo, men li fè blag li ta ka gen 200 pitit si li pa t itilize yo.

Pandan tout konvèsasyon an, Vanzant mete aksan sou jan li difisil pou okipe tout timoun sa yo, lè li itilize poupées pou montre. Li remarke Williams pa sanble konsyan responsablite sa mande, espesyalman lè li depoze poupées yo depaman. Vanzant pataje eksperyans li kòm manman, epi li mete aksan sou lefèt ke, kèlkeswa sitiyasyon an, yon paran pa sipoze lage responsabilite li paske li pa pratik.

article_content: Google has enhanced its At a Glance widget, introducing new tools for avid shoppers. As revealed by 9to5Google, a fresh feature called 'At a store' now appears in the widget’s settings (in version U.11.playstore.pixel8.570642812). This function displays your shopping lists and Google Pay rewards when you enter select stores, using QR codes to detect if the store is supported. You can also access your shopping lists with ease. Currently, this addition is available exclusively on the Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro. Additionally, Google has unified all At a Glance settings into a single menu, providing 21 toggle options such as weather, deliveries, commutes, upcoming events, and more. A personalization section lets users adjust content preferences, and you can also hide sensitive data from displaying on the lock screen. To use these updates, navigate to Pixel Launcher’s Home Settings and select the At a Glance gear icon. Right now, these changes are limited to the Pixel 8 series, and there's no confirmation of broader rollout. These tweaks are aimed at making life easier rather than introducing headline-grabbing features. Last month, Google refreshed the widget’s design with a pill-shaped style to align with other app interfaces. The left side shows important information at a glance, and the right side gives quick weather snippets. Alongside software improvements, the Pixel 8 Pro has been recognized for its premium design and build, while Google’s new AI-powered features make editing photos and videos more straightforward.

article_content: Omar al-Kutobi and Mohammad Kiad, accused of planning a terrorist attack in Sydney, are in protective custody at Silverwater Jail after receiving threats from other inmates. They were arrested in a police raid at their shared flat in Fairfield, where authorities found weapons, an Islamic State flag, and a video showing threats of violence. Both men, aged 24 and 25, were placed under special protection due to the risk associated with their charges. They appeared in court via video link and did not apply for bail, with another hearing scheduled for March. Officials are investigating how the pair secured residency and accessed government benefits. Reports indicate al-Kutobi, originally from Iraq, became a citizen after entering Australia with false documents, while Kiad was granted a family visa and welfare. Prime Minister Tony Abbott shared information in parliament about the case and the evidence obtained, which prompted concerns from legal experts about possible repercussions on a fair trial. However, prosecutors state such statements do not influence their proceedings. Images from social media highlight different aspects of Kiad’s lifestyle, alternating between trendy outfits and gym settings, and traditional Islamic dress. Al-Kutobi was reportedly studying nursing before his arrest. Correctional authorities have declined to provide detailed comments about custody arrangements or safety concerns, citing privacy reasons.

Barack Obama, showing renewed confidence, has reignited the messaging from his 2008 campaign by presenting himself as a challenger to the status quo and criticizing 'lobbyists and special interests' in Washington. Speaking to about 10,000 enthusiastic supporters in Boulder, Colorado, Obama delivered a spirited 36-minute speech intended to energize his base and recapture the excitement of his earlier campaign ahead of Tuesday's election.

After his speech, Obama greeted supporters, including young fans, at a campaign event in Hilliard, Ohio. His Republican opponent, Mitt Romney, faces the challenge of needing to win both Virginia and Florida. At the moment, Obama leads the RealClearPolitics national poll average by a narrow margin of 0.1 percent and appears to have an upper hand in the important swing state of Ohio. While Romney must win Virginia and Florida to stay competitive, Obama is now actively campaigning in Wisconsin, Colorado, and Nevada—states he won easily in 2008 but are now considered battlegrounds. Obama's aides believe that if Ohio, Florida, and Virginia are lost, a win in these other states could still secure his reelection.

In Boulder, Obama stated, 'Back in 2008, when we talked about change, I made it clear I wasn’t just talking about changing Presidents or parties—I was talking about changing our politics. I ran because the American people’s voices had been shut out of our democracy for too long by lobbyists, special interests, and politicians unwilling to compromise.'

Despite the anti-lobbyist message, various lobbyists have been frequent White House visitors during Obama’s administration, as reported by the Washington Post. Notable examples include Tim Hannegan (Taser International), Bill Samuel (AFL-CIO), Michael Taylor (Monsanto), and Chris Dodd (Motion Picture Association of America). Nevertheless, Obama's populist rhetoric remains popular with supporters, as he promises to hire 100,000 new math and science teachers and offer job training for two million workers.

Romney has recently claimed he is the real candidate of change, suggesting Obama now represents the status quo in Washington. Countering Romney, Obama said, 'I know what real change looks like because I’ve fought for it. After all we’ve experienced together, Colorado, we can’t give up now.'

While this appeal may not win over many swing voters—many of whom have grown disillusioned by persistent economic problems and partisan deadlock over the past four years—it strongly resonates with Democratic loyalists whom Obama needs to mobilize. Obama also compared his presidency to those of George W. Bush and Bill Clinton, stating in Green Bay, Wisconsin, 'We know which ideas worked, and we know which didn’t. After Bill Clinton left office, his policies were reversed to the country’s detriment.'

Pandan li t'ap pale devan anviwon 10,000 sipòtè ki te chofe nan Boulder, Colorado, Obama te bay yon diskou chaje ak enèji ki te dire 36 minit pou motive baz li an epi mete dife sou antouzyas premye kanpay li a anvan eleksyon madi a.

Prashant Jain, Founder of 3P Investment Managers, highlights that Indian large-cap stocks, though not especially cheap, remain appealing investments, with the potential for returns of about 12% or more. He points out that U.S. interest rates have reached 5% and may climb to 5.5% or 6% within a year, but markets have largely absorbed this increase.

When it comes to IPOs, Jain exercises tight discipline. The fund’s exposure to IPOs is typically kept minimal, as many are priced high; he only invests significantly when underlying fundamentals are strong, ensuring IPOs represent a small portion of the portfolio.

On the IT sector, Jain describes it as having matured in recent years, with sustainable growth rates now at 6-8% in dollar terms. The sector's rapid pandemic-era growth was driven by unique circumstances, leading to market over-expectation and inflated valuations. Those valuations have since normalized. While large IT companies have strong returns on capital and high dividend payouts, Jain notes their overall growth is lower than India’s GDP, making them fairly valued but not exceptional.

Jain sees some emerging SaaS and niche IT businesses in India, yet observes that successful, scalable product companies remain rare, and global adoption is a significant challenge.

He draws attention to the power sector, where increasing demand is being fueled by greater appliance adoption and ongoing electrification. The sector’s success, especially in renewables, depends largely on securing low borrowing costs due to its capital-intensive and regulated nature. While a shift to solar and wind continues, the market still relies heavily on thermal energy, particularly during peak hours, because of renewable storage limitations.

Jain believes India’s markets may support higher valuations thanks to higher expected growth, lower inflation and borrowing costs, and increasing domestic investment. He sees strong fundamentals: low corporate leverage, healthy banks, improved logistics infrastructure for business, and a boost in jobs and exports thanks to digitalization.

He acknowledges that recent industrial growth slowed to 5.8% in September due to a high base and heavy rains. Meanwhile, investments in sectors like education technology remain robust, as seen with Ranjan Pai’s Rs 1,400 crore investment in Aakash Institute. Jain also remarks on how a digitally proficient youth workforce is accelerating transformation in manufacturing.

Overall, Jain maintains a cautiously optimistic view, anticipating steady, compounding returns rather than dramatic gains, and advising disciplined investment in India’s increasingly healthy macroeconomic environment.

Prashant Jain, fondatè 3P Investment Managers, mete aksan sou lefèt ke aksyon gwo konpayi endyen yo, menm si yo pa bon mache, toujou gen potansyèl kòm envestisman ak retou sou envestisman anviwon 12% oswa plis. Li fè konnen to enterè Ozetazini rive 5% e li ka monte 5.5% oswa 6% nan yon ane, men mache yo deja byen absòbe ogmantasyon sa a.

Konsènan IPO yo, Jain toujou fè bagay yo ak anpil disiplin. Pati fon an ki mete nan IPO anjeneral piti paske majorite yo vann chè; li sèlman envesti plis lè konpayi an solid sou plan fondamantal, konsa IPO pa reprezante gwo pati nan portefèy la.

Pou sektè IT la, Jain di sektè a vin pi matirite dènye ane yo, ak kwasans stab ant 6-8% an dola. Gwo kwasans ki te gen pandan Covid la te fèt akoz sikonstans espesyal, kote mache yo te panse kwasans sa ap dire e fè valè konpayi yo monte twò wo. Kounye a, valè sa yo retounen nan nivo ki pi rasyonèl. Malgre gwo konpayi IT yo gen bon rannman ak peye bon dividann, Jain fè remake kwasans sektè a an jeneral pi ba pase GDP peyi a, sa ki fè li jis byen evalye, pa ekstraòdinè.

Li wè kèk nouvo antrepriz SaaS ak IT nich k parèt ann End, men li note ke bon jan konpayi pwodui ak sikse toujou ra e aksepte sou mache entènasyonal la se yon gwo defi.

Li mete aksan tou sou sektè elektrisite a kote demann ap ogmante, gras ak plis itilizasyon aparèy ak elektrifikasyon k ap fèt. Siksè nan sektè sa a, sitou pou enèji renouvlab, depann anpil sou kapasite pou jwenn prete ak enterè ba, paske sektè a mande anpil kapital epi li trè reglemante. Pandan peyi a ap kontinye mache ak solè ak van, li toujou depann sou enèji tèmik, espesyalman lè demann lan wo, paske depo enèji vèt toujou gen limitasyon.

Jain kwè mache End ka kenbe nivo valorizasyon pi wo paske kwasans pi rapid, enflasyon ak to prete ki pi ba, epi plis envestisè lokal ap vin nan mache a. Li soulve ke endikatè ekonomik yo solid: dèt konpayi yo ba, bank yo an bon sante, enfrastrikti biznis la amelyore, plis opòtinite travay ak ekspòtasyon, grasa dijitalizasyon.

Li mansyone tou ke kwasans endistriyèl resan ralanti a 5.8% nan mwa septanm akoz efè baz ak move tan. Pandan se tan, envestisman nan domèn edikasyon teknolojik ap ogmante, tankou sa Ranjan Pai mete nan Aakash Institute. Jain remake fasilite jèn moun ak teknoloji ap ede transfòme fabrikasyon an.

An konklizyon, Jain apwoche mache a ak pridan epi li optimis: li prevwa retou konstan pito ke gwo sote, epi li konsèy envestisman disipline nan ekonomi Endyen ki ap amelyore.

article_content: University of Central Florida (UCF) linebacker Jason Johnson stands out on and off the football field. Hailing from Chicago’s south side, Johnson balances athletics and academics, earning a spot as a semifinalist for the Campbell Trophy, which honors college football’s top scholar-athletes. He maintains a 3.64 GPA and earned his undergraduate degree in May. Johnson began his college career at Eastern Illinois University (EIU) as a digital media major before transferring to UCF in the spring of 2022 and switching to integrated general studies. At EIU, he was recognized as an FCS All-American and led the Ohio Valley Conference in tackles. Johnson transferred to UCF after EIU head coach Adam Cushing left in early 2022, attracted by a promising visit and new opportunities. He quickly became a key player, finishing third in the American Athletic Conference for tackles last season, and earning recognition on major preseason defensive award watchlists. Now in the Big 12, Johnson averages 8.5 tackles per game, ranking third in the conference. In UCF's recent 45-3 victory over No. 15 Oklahoma State, he contributed six tackles, a sack, and played a role in a crucial interception. With one more win needed for bowl eligibility, Johnson remains determined: 'Finish the season strong and get a bowl win,' he said, aiming to end his college career successfully.

Li gen yon mwayèn 3.64 epi li fini etid li nan me. Johnson te kòmanse nan Eastern Illinois University (EIU) kòm etidyan medyad dijital, epi li transfere UCF nan prentan 2022, chanje pou Etid Jeneral Entegre. Pandan li te EIU, li te FCS All-American epi li mennen Ohio Valley Conference la nan kantite takl. Li te transfere UCF apre antrenè EIU a, Adam Cushing, te kite. Yon vizit pozitif ak nouvo chans motive l. Li te vin jwè enpòtan rapid, fini 3zyèm pou takl nan American Athletic Conference lan ane pase, epi li sou lis pou pi gwo pri defansif yo. Kounye a nan Big 12 la, Johnson ap fè 8.5 takl pa match — 3zyèm nan konferans lan. Nan viktwa 45-3 kont Oklahoma State, li fè 6 takl, yon sack, epi ede sou yon entèsepsyon kle. Ak yon sèvisman viktwa anko pou kalifye bowl, Johnson di: 'Fini sezon an fò, epi ranpòte bowl la.' Li vize fè bèl final ak karyè inivèsite l.

article_content: On Friday, people in eastern Canada and parts of the northern United States felt an earthquake that originated near the Quebec-Ontario border, according to the Canadian government. Natural Resources Canada reported a preliminary magnitude of 5.2, while the U.S. Geological Survey recorded it at 4.4. The earthquake's epicenter was about 11 miles (18 kilometers) from Shawville in western Quebec. The quake was felt in the Ottawa-Gatineau area, reaching as far as Toronto, more than 260 miles away. Residents in New York state and Cleveland also reported feeling tremors. Ontario Premier Kathleen Wynne tweeted, 'My house shook!' Authorities indicated that the earthquake, which occurred at 9:43 a.m., was unlikely to have caused significant damage. About ten minutes later, an aftershock was recorded. Natural Resources Canada measured it at magnitude 4.1, and the U.S. Geological Survey at 3.6, with its epicenter about 12 miles (19 kilometers) from Shawville. Jonathan Essiambre of Shawville told the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation, 'It kind of made me a little nervous and I got out of the house as quickly as I could. It certainly got my heart racing.' Dan Duggan, a bakery owner in Shawville, said, 'It was like a massive explosion that went off. It just started shaking and the walls of the bakery were moving. I thought it was my propane tanks exploding. We were evacuating employees out of the building. It lasted for about 25 seconds and continued for about another minute.' Kim Bulmer, town clerk of nearby Renfrew, Ontario, said, 'We had a lot of shaking, that's for sure.' She also checked with the public works director and reported no damage so far. New York Governor Andrew Cuomo stated that state emergency officials were monitoring the situation, noting there was no damage to any critical infrastructure. According to Natural Resources Canada, eastern Canada has a relatively low rate of earthquake activity. Four or more earthquakes above magnitude 4 are typically recorded per year, and, on average, three events exceed magnitude 5 each decade.

article_content: On Wednesday, Indian stock markets followed the global trend, buoyed by lower-than-expected inflation data from the US, which boosted investor confidence. The Sensex index shot up by more than 700 points, closing at 65,675.93, while the Nifty climbed over 230 points to settle well past the 19,650 mark. This upbeat session saw gains spread broadly across various stocks, especially in the midcap and smallcap categories. Stocks such as Trident, Manappuram Finance, and Info Edge India all jumped between 5% and 7%. However, not all stocks performed well — Rajesh Exports dropped sharply by 8%. Avdhut Bagkar, a derivatives and technical analyst at StoxBox, provided trading advice for these stocks as markets prepare to reopen. For Trident, after falling from 43 to around 33 rupees, the stock has found support at its 200-day moving average. A move above 40 rupees is needed for upward momentum, while holding above 37 rupees is important to avoid further declines. Manappuram Finance recently broke out of a downtrend (the 'Falling Channel') as seen on daily charts. This signals a potential rally toward the 170-rupee level, with 140 rupees offering support. If it crosses 155 rupees, more upside may follow. Info Edge’s technical setup suggests a possible move up to 5,000 rupees, with supports seen at 4,600 and 4,480 rupees. Strong buying near the 200-day average points to a positive long-term outlook. In contrast, Rajesh Exports is on a downward trajectory, with analysts predicting a gradual slide toward 370 and possibly 350 rupees. The stock is trading below key moving averages, highlighting a bearish trend and making it a candidate for short selling. Elsewhere in the business world, India’s central bank, RBI, has introduced stricter capital rules for banks making unsecured retail loans, aiming to prevent excessive risk in the financial system. Cricketer Mohammed Shami has seen his marketability soar, doubling his endorsement deal rates amidst his standout performance in the ongoing ICC Cricket World Cup. Meanwhile, the Mines Ministry informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd. that any company restructuring would require official government approval.

The Republic of Niger has announced a ban on all exports of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), according to an official statement released on Tuesday. This decision, the government noted, is to ensure national production meets domestic needs. Exports may only occur if there is a surplus and with special authorization, as reported by Reuters.

Niger, which exports LPG to neighboring Nigeria, had previously strengthened energy ties with its neighbor. In 2020, both countries signed a Memorandum of Understanding on petroleum product imports, witnessed by Nigeria's Minister of State for Petroleum Resources, Timipre Sylva, and Niger's Minister of Petroleum, Foumakoye Gado.

Speaking about the agreement, Sylva called it “a major step forward,” highlighting that Niger's surplus products could be exported to Nigeria, which has a ready market for them. He described the relationship as mutually beneficial and hoped it would further deepen trade ties between the two countries.

Meanwhile, LPG is widely used in Nigeria for cooking, heating, and as vehicle fuel. Recently, its price in Nigeria has surged dramatically from N750 to an unprecedented N1,000 per kilogram. The Nigerian Association of Liquefied Petroleum Gas Marketers previously warned that fluctuations in foreign exchange rates and international market conditions could drive prices even higher.
translated_content:
Repiblik Nijè fè konnen li entèdi tout ekspòtasyon gaz petwòl likifye (LPG), dapre yon deklarasyon ofisyèl ki soti madi. Dapre gouvènman an, mezi sa a fèt pou asire pwodiksyon nasyonal la sèvi bezwen lokal yo an premye. Ekspòtasyon ap sèlman pèmèt si gen depase ak ak otorizasyon espesyal, jan Reuters rapòte.

Nijè, ki ekspòte gaz LPG bay vwazen li Nijerya, te pase pi fò relasyon enèji ak li. An 2020, de peyi yo te siyen yon Memorandòm Dantant sou pwodwi petwòl, ak minis petwòl Nijerya, Timipre Sylva, ak minis petwòl Nijè, Foumakoye Gado, prezan pou siyati a.

Pale sou akò a, Sylva te di "Sa se yon gwo avans," li mete aksan sou ke Nijè gen pwodwi sipli pou ekspòtasyon bay Nijerya, kote gen bon mache pou yo. Li dekri relasyon an kòm benefis mityèl epi li swete sa ap kontinye ranfòse echanj komès ant de peyi yo.

Nan menm tan an, LPG sèvi anpil nan Nijerya pou kwit manje, chofaj ak kòm gaz machin. Dènyèman, pri LPG monte anpil nan Nijerya, soti N750 pou rive N1,000 pou chak kilogram. Asosyasyon Komèsan Gaz Petwòl Likifye Nijerya te deja avèti ke chanjman nan to echanj lajan etranje ak mache entènasyonal kapab fè pri yo monte plis toujou.

article_content: Victoria Milligan shared the heart-wrenching story of how a family holiday in Cornwall quickly turned to tragedy when a speedboat accident claimed the lives of her husband Nick and eight-year-old daughter Emily. In May 2013, the Milligan family—Victoria, Nick, and their four children—were thrown into the Camel Estuary after their speedboat spun out of control. The unmanned boat continued circling, causing further injuries. Nick, who worked as a Sky Media executive, and their daughter Emily died in the incident. Victoria suffered severe injuries, resulting in the loss of her left leg, and her son Kit survived after undergoing twelve surgeries to repair his leg. The remaining daughters, Amber and Olivia, were less seriously hurt. Victoria recalled the terror of trying to keep her children safe in the cold water and hearing her eldest, Amber, realize their father had died. Authorities determined the tragedy partly stemmed from Nick disconnecting the boat’s essential ‘kill cord’ safety device while retrieving sunglasses. The boat's sharp turn threw the entire family into the water, leaving the engine running uncontrolled. Quick-thinking watersports instructors and nearby canoeists intervened at great personal risk to bring the boat under control and rescue the family. Despite her grief, Victoria found strength in caring for her surviving children and made the decision to move forward. Since the accident, Victoria has raised significant donations for charities like Child Bereavement UK and Cornwall Air Ambulance, wearing a prosthetic leg as she continues to advocate for safety and support for those who have lost loved ones. She writes and speaks about her experiences to help others cope with loss. An inquest into the deaths was scheduled at Truro Coroner’s Court. Information on supporting Victoria’s charity work can be found at milliganbikeride.com.

A new medical breakthrough could soon bring hope to thousands of women unable to have children naturally. Derya Sert, who underwent the world's first successful womb transplant in Turkey in August 2011, is now preparing for in vitro fertilization (IVF) in her quest to become a mother. Professor Omer Ozkan from Akdeniz University, who led the operation, has reported that Sert's recovery has been excellent, and his team is confident that pregnancy using a donor womb could soon be achieved.

Before her transplant, Sert had eight embryos preserved. Doctors now plan to thaw and implant two of them into her transplanted uterus, hoping for a successful pregnancy. Should this effort succeed, it would be a milestone that could benefit an estimated 15,000 women in the UK alone who have been born without a womb or have lost it because of illness.

However, the procedure is not without risks. Experts like fertility specialist Lord Winston warn of possible complications resulting from pregnancy with a transplanted womb, the use of strong immunosuppressant drugs, and the necessity for cesarean delivery. Some critics question whether these risks are justified, since womb transplants are not life-saving operations.

Surrogacy and adoption are alternatives, but each comes with legal, ethical, and emotional challenges. Surrogacy is tightly regulated in the UK and prohibited in some countries, which leads some British couples to seek services abroad, such as in India, facing complex legal processes later. Adoption offers a different path to parenthood but does not allow women to experience pregnancy with a genetically related child.

British surgeon Richard Smith, who has spent more than 15 years researching this area, hopes to offer uterus transplants within two years pending more animal trials. In Sweden, Professor Mats Brannstrom and his team at the University of Gothenburg are currently running similar procedures, often transferring wombs from relatives, and will soon begin embryo implants. Ongoing debates weigh the use of live versus deceased donors, considering both the risks and the likelihood of success.

Around the world, more than 100 women have been assessed as potential candidates for uterus transplants, and many more are interested. The strong desire to become mothers motivates these efforts, and while the medical community debates the risks and ethics, progress in this field continues to attract close attention.

Pwofesè Omer Ozkan, lidè ekip doktè Inivèsite Akdeniz, deklare ke Derya refè vrèman byen epi li kwè ansanm ak ekip li ke yon gwosès ak yon matris donatè posib pa twò lwen.

Anvan transplant lan, yo te frize uit anbrayo pou Derya. Kounye a, plan an se dekonjle ak transfere de anbrayo nan nouvo matris la, pa swete ke youn ap abouti ak yon ti bebe. Si tout bagay mache, eksperyans sa ta ka benefisye prèske 15,000 fanm sèlman nan Wayòm Ini ki swa pa janm gen matris oswa ki te pèdi li apre maladi.

Egziste risk kle toujou. Espesyalis fe-ekil Lord Winston mete aksan sou posiblite konplikasyon, medikaman fò anti-rejeksyon, ak obligasyon pou fè sezaryèn. Gen kritik ki mande si risk sa vo li, paske transplant matris yo pa operasyon ki sove lavi moun.

Opsyon tankou seregasi ak adopsyon pote defi legal, etik ak emosyonèl. Seregasi anpil kontwole nan Wayòm Ini epi li entèdi nan kèk peyi; kèk pè britanik ale peyi etranje tankou peyi End pou sèvis sa yo, epi yo konfwonte konplikasyon legal pou yo ka vin paran ofisyèl. Diskisyon ap kontinye sou avantaj ak risk sou donatè vivan kont donatè ki mouri.

Plis pase 100 fanm atravè lemond deja chèche patisipe, ak anpil ankò ap aplike. Dezi pwofon pou vin manman ap motive efò sa yo, e menm si gen kontwovès sou risk ak etik, tout je sou avans sa yo nan medsin.

Pippa Middleton, aged 30, completed the demanding 3,000-mile Race Across America as part of an eight-member team, being the only woman alongside her 27-year-old brother, James Middleton. The team began in Oceanside, California, and finished in Annapolis, Maryland, after traversing twelve states in six days, ten hours, and fifty-four minutes. This effort was aimed at raising money for the British Heart Foundation—where Pippa serves as ambassador—and The Michael Matthews Foundation.

Pippa credited her comfortable saddle and the use of special chamois cream for helping her endure the ride. She noted that sleep deprivation was the greatest obstacle, as the team averaged only about three hours of sleep per night. Despite equipment failures, breakdowns of support vehicles, and nighttime wildlife encounters, Pippa and her teammates completed the journey. She attributed much of her motivation to her brother James and the supportive team atmosphere.

The team’s route crossed California, Arizona, Utah, Colorado, Kansas, Missouri, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, and Maryland. By the race’s end, Pippa had raised more than £4,800 for charity. The Race Across America is renowned for its difficulty, with previous years seeing serious incidents.

Our view of the cosmos is limited because we are situated within a galaxy filled with interstellar gas and dust. This is most apparent in the Milky Way's central region, known as the Zone of Avoidance, which contains so much dust that it significantly blocks our observations of objects beyond our galaxy. Although visible light cannot penetrate this region, infrared and radio waves can. For years, astronomers have used these wavelengths to study the center of our galaxy, including the stars orbiting its supermassive black hole.

Now, a new study posted to the arXiv preprint server has used public sky surveys to search for galaxies within the Zone of Avoidance. The research utilized data from the VISTA Variables in Vía Láctea (VVV) survey, collected by the VISTA telescope in Paranal, Chile. While the VVV survey primarily studied globular and open clusters, it also recorded data on galaxies in the area. To identify galaxies, the team selected extended objects in the dataset and filtered them by typical galactic spectra. Although this approach missed some galaxies, it aimed to confirm the presence of at least a few, rather than all.

The researchers then compared these candidate galaxies with data from the 2MASS Extended Source Catalogue. While 2MASS lists 1.5 million objects, only 271 are within the VVV survey area, and the team identified 182 of these as galaxies. Although this is a relatively small number, the VVV survey provided images with much more detail than 2MASS. The study managed to confirm about 75% of the 2MASS galaxies in the region.

This research marks an initial step in uncovering galaxies hidden by the Zone of Avoidance. The team intends to expand their work using data from the upcoming VVV eXtended Survey, which could allow for the study of thousands more galaxies. As this study demonstrates, the central region of our galaxy is becoming more accessible, offering the opportunity to understand parts of the universe that were once hidden from view.

Yo sèvi ak done sondaj VISTA Variables in Vía Láctea (VVV), ki soti nan teleskòp VISTA nan Paranal, Chili. Malgre VVV te fokis sou gwoup zetwal, li te jwenn done sou galaksi tou. Ekip la chwazi objè ki sanble ak galaksi epi filtre yo ak espèk galaksi nòmal. Metòd sa pa idantifye tout galaksi, men li pèmèt yo jwenn kèk nan yo pou asire egzistansyal.

Indian businesses are showing a growing interest in hiring talent with expertise in green and sustainability-related technology. According to a recent report by IBM and Morning Consult, 82% of Indian business leaders surveyed indicated they plan to hire people with green and sustainability tech skills in 2024. The study, which surveyed more than 250 business leaders in India, also revealed a considerable skills gap in sustainability. Approximately 75% of respondents expressed confidence in their organizations’ plans to invest in IT sustainability training by the end of next year.

Justina Nixon-Saintil, IBM’s Vice President and Global Chief Impact Officer, emphasized the urgency of developing green skills, especially those related to artificial intelligence (AI), which are in high demand globally. In corporate settings, sustainability involves reducing the carbon footprint of buildings, operations, processes, and transportation through the use of renewable energy, improved waste management, and sustainable development.

During her first visit to India, Nixon-Saintil highlighted the country’s potential, noting its large population of young learners. IBM has partnered with the University of Chicago Trust in Delhi to launch water management initiatives as part of its ‘Sustainability Accelerator’ program. The pilot, starting in Maharashtra, will aggregate water quality data, build tools to improve access to this information, and advance water resource management practices. The program will be expanded to other states and aims to make clean water accessible to all, focusing on vulnerable and underrepresented communities.

Additionally, IBM is rolling out a roadmap for sustainability skills courses and is helping farmers in northern India adopt regenerative agriculture practices. This approach aims to increase farmers’ profitability while promoting long-term sustainability by prioritizing climate, water quality, and ecosystem health. Over 1,000 farmers are currently involved, and the project could impact more than 25,000 hectares by the end of the year.

Nixon-Saintil stated that given India’s significant role in global food security, advanced environmental sustainability solutions are essential. The broader trend in India shows an alignment of technology and agriculture sectors toward more sustainable practices.

article_content: Venice announced on Thursday that it will introduce a fee for day tourists to enter the city's overcrowded historic center on 29 days in 2024, aiming to tackle overtourism. Day visitors will be required to pay five euros ($5.45) to access the city center between 8:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. during the peak tourist season from April 25 to May 5. The fee also applies to the remaining weekends in May and June, as well as the first two weekends of July. Authorities have debated for years how best to manage the millions of visitors eager to see landmarks like St. Mark's Square, the Rialto Bridge, and Venice’s scenic canals. The plan was repeatedly postponed due to concerns that it might reduce tourism revenue and compromise freedom of movement. However, earlier this year, city leaders decided to move forward after UNESCO warned Venice could be listed as a world heritage site at risk. 'Venice is the first city in the world to introduce such a system, which could serve as a model for other fragile and delicate cities that need protection,' Mayor Luigi Brugnaro said in a statement. He described the fee as a 'first step' rather than a 'revolution', emphasizing that authorities are open to making changes to ensure the system works effectively.

Vizitè jounen yo ap oblije peye senk ero (5.45 dola) pou antre nan sant vil la ant 8:30 a.m. ak 4:00 p.m., pandan pi gwo sezon touris la soti 25 avril pou rive 5 me. Frè a ap aplike tou pou tout lòt wikenn ki rete nan me ak jen, epi de premye wikenn jiyè. Otorite yo te diskite depi ane sou fason pi bon pou jere milyon moun ki vin vizite pou wè St Mark, pon Rialto, ak tout bèl kanal Venise yo. Yo te repousse plan frè sa a plizyè fwa paske yo te pè sa ta ka limite antre lajan ak libète moun pou deplase. Men, pi bonè ane sa a, lidè vil la deside avanse ak eksperyans lan apre UNESCO te avèti yo ka mete Venise sou lis sit patrimwàn mondyal an danje. 'Venise se premye vil ki enpoze yon sistèm konsa, epi sa ka sèvi kòm modèl pou lòt vil ki fràjil epi ki bezwen pwoteksyon,' Majistra Luigi Brugnaro deklare. Li di frè a se 'yon premye etap' pa 'yon revolisyon,' epi otorite yo pare pou fè chanjman si sa pa mache jan yo vle.

article_content: DETROIT – The United Auto Workers (UAW) union has overwhelmingly ratified new contracts with Ford and Stellantis. Along with a similar deal at General Motors, these agreements will increase pay across the industry, impose higher costs on automakers, and help reshape the auto industry as it transitions from gasoline-powered vehicles. At Stellantis, the maker of Jeep, Dodge, and Ram vehicles, 68.8% of workers voted in favor of the contract, bringing an end to a contentious labor dispute marked by strikes and heated rhetoric. The contract passed with a margin of about 10,000 votes, with balloting wrapping up Saturday. Ford workers voted 69.3% in favor, approving the deal by nearly 15,000 votes in balloting that concluded early Saturday. Earlier in the week, GM workers narrowly approved a similar agreement. The contracts, which run through April 2028, conclude a period of intense negotiations that began last summer and led to six-week-long strikes at all three automakers. New UAW president Shawn Fain characterized the companies as adversaries led by highly paid CEOs, signaling an end to an era of close union-corporate cooperation. After months of stalled negotiations, strikes began September 15 at one assembly plant for each company. The union later expanded strikes to parts warehouses and other factories, ultimately leading to tentative agreements in late October. The contracts have been widely viewed as a win for the UAW. Automakers agreed to significant wage increases and cost-of-living adjustments totaling up to 33% for top-scale assembly plant workers. These workers receive an immediate 11% raise and will earn about $42 per hour by April 2028. The deals also end many tiered wage structures and include plans to bring future electric-vehicle battery plants under the union agreement, paving the way for UAW representation in this growing sector. Art Wheaton, director of labor studies at Cornell University, called this a big victory for the union, noting it benefits many workers in the industry. Honda, Toyota, and Hyundai, non-union foreign automakers operating in the U.S., raised factory worker pay following the UAW agreements and the union's stated intent to increase organizing efforts. Foreign automakers have argued their pay is comparable to UAW wages but receive less comprehensive benefits. UAW workers generally enjoy better healthcare and retirement benefits, which may make unionization attractive as the workforce ages. The new contracts are also expected to influence wages at auto parts suppliers and other related industries. UAW member Mark McGill, a 28-year Ford veteran, expressed satisfaction with the deal, especially the pay raises and compensation for time spent on strike. The contracts provide even larger percentage raises for new hires and temporary workers, addressing a key concern in the negotiations, especially at GM. The automakers reported significant revenue losses from the strikes and will absorb much of the increased labor costs in an industry where it’s difficult to raise prices. Ford's CFO, John Lawler, said the new deal would add $850-$900 to labor costs per vehicle. Michelle Krebs, analyst at Cox Automotive, suggested that, with a slowing market and high vehicle prices, automakers may face challenges passing these costs to consumers. Flat sales and higher interest rates could result in more discounts. The union's success could boost President Joe Biden, who visited picket lines and supported the UAW’s cause. The agreement includes Stellantis pledging to reopen a closed factory and establish an EV battery plant in Belvidere, Illinois. Biden, the first sitting president to visit a union picket line, has emphasized his blue-collar roots and support for the middle class. The strikes ended without damaging the economy, but resulted in substantial wage gains for workers whose votes Biden likely values as he seeks reelection.

Akò yo fini ak anpil nivo salè epi gen plan pou mete plant batri machin elektrik yo anba akò sendika a, sa ap ouvè wout pou UAW nan sektè sa a. Art Wheaton, direktè etid travay nan Cornell University, di se yon gwo viktwa pou sendika a e sa benefisye anpil travayè. Honda, Toyota, ak Hyundai, ki se konpayi etranje san sendika Ozetazini, ogmante salè apre akò UAW epi UAW di yo vle oganize plis faktri. Konpayi etranje yo di salè yo prèske menm ak UAW men benefis pa menm. Travayè UAW gen plis avantaj nan swen sante ak retret, sa fè sendika a atiran kòm popilasyon an ap vye. Nouvo kontra yo espere gen enpak sou salè nan lòt sektè tankou konpayi pyès machin. Manm UAW Mark McGill, ki pase 28 ane ak Ford, di li satisfè ak kontra a, sitou ogmantasyon salè ak lajan yo te touche la grèv. Kontra yo bay ogmantasyon plis pou nouvo travayè ak tanporè, sa te enpòtan sitou pou GM. Konpayi yo di yo pèdi anpil lajan pandan grèv yo epi yo dwe sipòte pi fò depans salè yo nan yon endistri kote li difisil ogmante pri. Direktè finans Ford la, John Lawler, di nouvo kontra a ajoute ant $850 ak $900 pa machin. Michelle Krebs, analis Cox Automotive, di ak mache ki ap ralanti ak pri wo, otokonpayi yo ka gen difikilte fè kliyan peye plis. Vant yo plat ak to enterè wo ka menen plis rabè. Siksè sendika a kapab ede Prezidan Joe Biden, ki te vizite liy grèv ak bay sipò li pou UAW. Akò a gen ladan angajman Stellantis pou relouvri yon faktori fèmen ak louvri plant batri machin elektrik nan Belvidere, Illinois. Biden, premye prezidan an fonksyon ki vizite liy grèv, mete aksan sou orijin klas ouvriye li ak sipò pou klas mwayèn. Grèv yo fini san domaj ekonomik men bay ogmantasyon salè enpòtan pou travayè yo, vòt Biden bezwen pou reeleksyon.

article_content: Steve Bruce, the manager of Hull City, has voiced his concerns regarding the growing problem of diving in the Premier League, warning that such conduct could erode the league’s global reputation for fairness and integrity. While Bruce is not fully persuaded by Arsenal manager Arsène Wenger’s proposal to set up a panel to review suspected dives, he does agree that action should be taken to address the issue. Chelsea has recently faced criticism over alleged simulation, notably when Diego Costa and Willian were both booked for apparent dives during a December 13 match against Hull. Bruce humorously likened Gary Cahill’s dramatic fall in that game to a ballet performance, emphasizing how exaggerated some incidents have become. Eden Hazard’s penalty against Arsenal, drawn after a challenge from Laurent Koscielny, further illustrated how referees struggle to discern real fouls from theatrics. Bruce pointed out that talented players like Hazard and Willian, with their speed and agility, can sometimes be easily toppled with minimal contact. Nonetheless, he insists blatant dives must be met with firm sanctions. He underscored the importance of maintaining the Premier League’s tradition of honesty and intensity, noting that global audiences cherish the league’s authentic spirit. Bruce warned that the Premier League should not lose its unique identity. The debate extended to Cesc Fabregas, who received a booking for simulation in a match against Southampton despite replays showing some contact from Matt Targett. Bruce’s comments highlight the ongoing challenge in football to uphold fairness, while supporting referees in their difficult role on the field.
translated_content: Steve Bruce, manadjè Hull City, eksprime enkyetid li pou kantite simile k ap ogmante nan Premier League la, li avèti konpòtman sa yo ka gate repitasyon lig la pou onètete ak entegrite atravè lemond. Malgre Bruce pa fin konvenki ak pwopozisyon manadjè Arsenal la, Arsène Wenger, sou yon komisyon pou revize zak simile yo, li dakò fòk yo pran mezi pou konbat sa. Chelsea sibi kritik dènyèman poutèt akizasyon sou simile, patikilyèman le Diego Costa ak Willian te resevwa kat jòn pou sa pandan yon match kont Hull 13 desanm. Bruce menm konpare fason Gary Cahill te lage kò li ak yon show balè, pou mete aksan sou kijan aksyon an te tewatrik. Lòt egzanp, tankou penalite Eden Hazard te jwenn kont Arsenal apre Laurent Koscielny te fè fòt sou li, montre kijan li difisil pou arebit yo fè diferans ant vrè fòt ak simile. Bruce eksplike jwè kijan Hazard ak Willian, ki vit ak souple, kapab fasil tonbe ak yon ti manyen. Men li ensiste fòk yo pran mezi sevè kont simile ki klè yo. Li mete aksan sou enpòtans pou konsève tradisyon onètete ak entansite Premier League la, e li fè konnen fanatik atravè lemond apresye lespri reyèl lig la. Bruce avèti pou Premier League pa pèdi idantite espesyal li. Diskisyon an pwolonje ak ka Cesc Fabregas ki te pran yon kat jòn pou simile kont Southampton, menm si videyo montre te gen kontak ak defansè Matt Targett. Remak Bruce yo mete aksan sou defi ki egziste toujou nan foutbòl la pou soutni jistis, pandan ap ankouraje sipò pou arebit nan travay di yo sou teren an.
post_content: Steve Bruce is calling out diving in the Premier League, saying it risks ruining the league’s honest reputation! He wants action but isn’t sold on new panels. Chelsea players in the spotlight again. ⚽️🚩 #PremierLeague #NoDiving
translated_post: Steve Bruce di simile nan Premier League la ka kraze onètete lig la! Li vle aksyon men li pa fin dakò ak komisyon nouvèl yo. Jwè Chelsea yo tounen anba kritik ankò. ⚽️🚫 #PremierLeague #PaSimile

article_content: Port Terminal Multipurpose Limited (PTML) in Lagos has announced that it will receive the largest container-Roll-On-Roll-Off (con-Ro) ship ever to visit West Africa, the MV Great Lagos, on November 27. According to the terminal operator, the ship is owned by the Grimaldi Group and was launched in April. MV Great Lagos measures 250 meters in length, 38 meters in width, and weighs over 45,000 tonnes. It can transport up to 4.7 kilometers of rolling freight, 2,500 car-equivalent units (CEUs), and 2,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs). Mr. Ascanio Russo, PTML’s Managing Director, stated that MV Great Lagos is the second G5-class ship launched by Grimaldi Group and named after Nigeria’s commercial capital. Russo called the ship’s arrival a milestone for Nigeria’s maritime sector and PTML, and thanked the Nigerian Ports Authority for its support. He pointed out that the visit highlights PTML’s advanced capabilities to handle new generations of mega-vessels and elevates Nigeria’s status in global shipping. Russo added that the ship’s modern design ensures it meets top environmental standards, reducing its environmental footprint and supporting efforts to protect marine ecosystems. PTML invested more than $20 million to host MV Great Lagos, including extending Berth 11, deepening berths, expanding storage, and acquiring state-of-the-art cargo handling equipment. With these enhancements, PTML is positioned among West Africa’s most advanced logistics terminals, prepared to handle a broad range of cargo types such as bulk, break-bulk, containerized, and RORO shipments.
translated_content: Port Terminal Multipurpose Limited (PTML) nan Lagos anonse li pral resevwa pi gwo bato container-Roll-On-Roll-Off (con-Ro) ki janm vini Afrik Lwès la, MV Great Lagos, 27 novanm. Dapre operatè terminal la, se Grimaldi Group ki posede bato a epi yo te lanse li an avril. MV Great Lagos gen 250 mèt longè, 38 mèt lajè, epi li peze plis pase 45,000 tòn. Li ka transpòte jiska 4.7 kilomèt machandiz ki sou rou, 2,500 inite machin (CEUs), ak 2,000 kontenè ekivalan 20 pye (TEUs). Mesye Ascanio Russo, Direktè Jeneral PTML, deklare MV Great Lagos se dezyèm nan klas G5 ke Grimaldi Group lanse epi yo bay li non kapital komèsyal Nijerya a. Russo di arive bato a se yon gwo etap pou sektè maritim Nijerya ak PTML, epi li remèsye Nigerian Ports Authority pou sipò yo. Li mete aksan sou ke vizit la montre kapasite modèn PTML pou jere mega-bato dènye jenerasyon an epi mete Nijerya pi wo nan endistri transpò maritim mondyal la. Russo ajoute konsepsyon modèn bato a reponn ak pi wo estanda anviwònman yo, reduit enpak sou lanviwònman epi sipòte efò pou pwoteje ekosistèm maren yo. PTML envesti plis pase 20 milyon dola pou resevwa MV Great Lagos, ki gen ladann agrandisman Berth 11, fonde berths yo, elaji zòn depo, ak achte ekipman modèn pou manipilasyon kago yo. Avèk tout amelyorasyon sa yo, PTML klase kòm youn nan pi avanse tèminal lojistik nan Afrik Lwès, pare pou jere tout tip kago, tankou bulk, break-bulk, kago nan kontenè ak kago RORO.

translated_post: Gwo nouvèl pou pò Lagos! 🚢 Mega bato MV Great Lagos ap rive 27 novanm—pi gwo con-Ro ki janm vini Afrik Lwès. PTML mete $20M pou amelyore tèminal la. Nijerya ap monte! #Lagos #Kago #Inovasyon

article_content:
Across the United States, job fairs are drawing record numbers of attendees as more people search for employment. In Loveland, Colorado, nearly 900 seniors aged 50 and over attended a job fair this week—the highest turnout ever for the annual event. Nan Cooper, one of the job seekers, shared with KMGH in Denver that finding a job now requires much more than submitting a resume in person. She spends countless hours online filling out job applications, even exploring sites like eBay for openings.

Meanwhile, in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, there are 22,000 open positions, yet employers find it difficult to connect with potential workers. Mayor Luke Ravenstahl announced that the city would boost its support, both financially and through city agencies, for programs that help place job seekers. As part of Imagine Career Week, high school students will meet employers; businesses will also visit classrooms to bridge the gap. Paul Leger of the Allegheny Conference highlighted the disconnect: while many young people say jobs are scarce, employers struggle to fill roles.

In North Carolina, Wal-Mart announced plans to hire 3,000 new employees, representing a nearly six percent increase in its workforce there. The retail giant already employs 51,000 at 155 state locations. David Cameron, the general manager for the Carolinas, assured locals that Wal-Mart is committed to the community, though he did not specify where new jobs will be located. North Carolina is among eight states with unemployment rates topping 10%.

Economic pressures are also driving more people to consider military service. Technical Sgt. Greg O'Conner, an Air Force recruiter in Bradenton, Florida, reported a significant uptick in inquiries from young men and women. One recruit, Dakota Slentz, chose the Air Force after deciding law enforcement training was too costly, attracted by the opportunities and salary it offers. According to the Department of Defense, the Air Force has met its recruiting goals each month since the current fiscal year began in October.

On the West Coast, Sacramento, California, is set to undergo major development as Thomas Enterprises plans to transform rail yards into a vibrant district of homes, businesses, entertainment venues, and government offices. Suheil Totah, a company representative, said the first phase—such as road building—will supply 3,000 jobs, with more than 56,000 workers needed over the next 20 years.

Nationally, job creation efforts continue: Tennessee will use federal stimulus money to employ 12,000 people aged 24 and younger, and a food company is converting a North Carolina textile plant, creating 172 new jobs.
translated_content:
Nan tout Etazini, salon travay yo ap atire plis moun pase anvan, pandan anpil moun ap chèche djòb. Nan Loveland, Colorado, prèske 900 granmoun ki gen 50 lane oswa plis te patisipe nan yon salon travay semèn sa a—se pi gwo patisipasyon yo janm genyen pou evènman sa a. Nan Cooper, youn nan moun k ap chèche travay yo, te di KMGH nan Denver ke jodi a, w ap bezwen fè plis bagay pase jis pote rezime ou an pèsòn pou jwenn travay. Li pase anpil èdtan ap ranpli aplikasyon sou entènèt, menm ap chèche opòtinite sou sit tankou eBay.

An menm tan, nan Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, gen 22,000 djòb ki disponib men patwon yo gen difikilte pou jwenn travayè. Majistra Luke Ravenstahl te anonse vil la pral ogmante sipò li, finansyèlman ak ak ajan vil la, pou pwogram ki ede moun jwenn travay. Pandan Imagine Career Week, elèv lekòl segondè ap rankontre ak patwon; biznis ap vizite sal klas yo pou ede tise lyen. Paul Leger nan Allegheny Conference mete aksan sou kouman anpil jèn di pa gen travay men anpil patwon ap chèche moun.

Nan North Carolina, Wal-Mart anonse li pral anboche 3,000 nouvo anplwaye, sa ki prèske sis pousan ogmantasyon nan staf la. Yo deja gen 51,000 anplwaye sou 155 kote nan eta a. David Cameron, direktè jeneral pou Carolinas yo, asire moun yo ke Wal-Mart angaje pou kominote a, men li pa di ki kote nouvo travay yo ap ye. North Carolina se youn nan uit eta kote chomaj la sitiye pi wo pase 10%.

Ekonomi an pouse plis moun panse pou antre nan militè a. Sèjan Greg O'Conner, rekritè Air Force nan Bradenton, Florid, di li resevwa anpil plis demann ak vizit chak jou soti nan jèn gason ak fi. Youn nan rekrit li yo, Dakota Slentz, chwazi Air Force paske lekòl fòmasyon lapolis twò chè, epi li atire pa opòtinite ak salè ke Air Force ofri. Selon Depatman Defans la, Air Force satisfè tout objektif rekritman li depi kòmansman ane fiskal la nan mwa Oktòb.

Nan Sacramento, Kalifòni, Thomas Enterprises ap transfòme teren tren pou kreye katye ak kay, biznis, espas amizman ak biwo gouvènman. Suheil Totah, reprezantan konpayi an, di premye faz la—tankou konstriksyon wout—ap bay 3,000 djòb, epi plis pase 56,000 moun ap bezwen pou pwojè a sou 20 ane.

Nasyonalman, efò kreye djòb la ap kontinye: Tennessee ap itilize lajan federal pou anboche 12,000 jèn 24 tan ak mwens, epi yon konpayi manje ap transfòme yon faktori twal nan North Carolina ki ap kreye 172 nouvo travay.

During a recent episode of the Club Prairie Fire podcast, cricket personalities Ravi Shastri, Michael Vaughan, and Adam Gilchrist discussed the finest technical batsmen in cricket history. When asked who he considered the most technically skilled, Shastri, a former India player and coach, firmly named Sachin Tendulkar.

Shastri praised Tendulkar’s adaptability, consistency, and the pure technique he brought to batting, noting that Tendulkar made even the toughest batting situations appear effortless, regardless of pitch or match format. He emphasized that while others may be higher run-scorers or display more power, Tendulkar’s technical excellence and natural style set him apart.

Michael Vaughan, once the England captain, agreed with Shastri’s assessment, reinforcing it on social media by calling Tendulkar "the greatest technician the game has seen." The shared admiration from both Shastri and Vaughan highlights Tendulkar’s iconic place in the sport.
translated_content:
Pandan yon dènye epizòd podcast Club Prairie Fire la, pèsonalite krikèt Ravi Shastri, Michael Vaughan, ak Adam Gilchrist te diskite sou ki batè ki gen pi bon teknik nan istwa krikèt la. Lè yo te mande Shastri, ki se yon ansyen jwè ak antrenè ekip End la, li te klèman nonmen Sachin Tendulkar.

Shastri te fè lwanj pou adaptabilite, konsistans, ak teknik Tendulkar ki sanble natirèl. Li te mete aksan sou jan Tendulkar te konn fè menm sitiyasyon bat ki pi difisil parèt fasil, kèlkeswa kondisyon pitch la oswa tip match la. Shastri te di ke, menm si kèk lòt jwè ka gen plis kouri oswa plis fòs, sa ki fè Tendulkar espesyal se teknik li ak fason natirèl li jwe.

Michael Vaughan, ansyen kapitèn Angletè a, te bay menm opinyon ak Shastri epi li te aji sou rezo sosyal pou rele Tendulkar "pi gran teknisyen jwèt la." Sa montre respektasyon tou de moun sa yo pou pozisyon Tendulkar kòm yon lejand nan krikèt la.

article_content: Five foreign nationals, including two British citizens, have been charged with conspiring to smuggle 100 kilograms of methamphetamine—worth approximately $3.7 million—from North Korea into the United States. The suspects were arrested in Thailand in September and extradited to New York, where they appeared in federal court. The individuals charged include Britons Scott Stammers and Philip Shackels, along with three others from China, Thailand, and the Philippines. All face potential sentences ranging from ten years to life imprisonment if convicted. According to U.S. Attorney Preet Bharara, methamphetamine is a dangerous drug regardless of its country of origin, and its presence in American communities poses a severe public health threat. Bharara stated, 'This investigation shows our determination to close a potential floodgate of supply.' Court documents allege that, in 2012, group members sold over 30 kilograms of North Korean methamphetamine, which was seized in Thailand and the Philippines. The meth tested at more than 99% purity. In 2013, the defendants agreed to provide 100 kilograms to undercover sources working with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA). One defendant, Le Tiong Tan Lim of China, reportedly claimed their organization was the sole remaining group able to obtain meth from North Korea after increased U.S. pressure led authorities in North Korea to destroy other labs. He allegedly said that their product was 99% pure, likening it to high-quality meth depicted in popular culture. The DEA confirmed that meth seized in the investigation tested at 99% purity. The plan was to send the shipment from Thailand, hiding the drugs on a boat to enter the U.S. A fourth defendant, Alexander Lnu, is accused of organizing an armed biker group to provide security for the shipment. The fifth suspect, Kelly Allan Reyes Peralta from the Philippines, allegedly met undercover agents as part of the conspiracy. U.S. DEA Administrator Michele Leonhart said the case demonstrates North Korea's emergence as a significant source of meth in the international drug trade. Thai authorities described the suspects as accomplices of Joseph Hunter, a former U.S. soldier arrested during the same operation. Hunter, known as 'Rambo,' faces unrelated charges of being a contract killer, and prosecutors declined to comment on his connection to the drug case. Authorities note Southeast Asia, along with North Korea and China, as major regions involved in the production and trafficking of methamphetamine.
translated_content: Senks etranje, enkli de sitwayen Britanik, akize kòm konplo pou fè kontrebann 100 kilogram metanfetamin—ki vo apeprè 3.7 milyon dola—soti Kore di Nò pou antre Ozetazini. Yo te arete sispèk yo an Thaïlande nan mwa septanm epi ekstrade New York kote yo parèt devan tribinal federal. Moun yo akize yo enkli Britanik Scott Stammers ak Philip Shackels, ansanm ak twa lòt soti Lachin, Thaïlande, ak Filipin. Tout ap fè fas ak santans ki ka sòti 10 lane pou rive vi si yo jwenn koupab. Avoka Ameriken Preet Bharara deklare ke metanfetamin se yon dwòg danjere kèlkeswa kote li sòti, e prezans li nan kominote ameriken reprezante yon gwo menas pou sante piblik. Li di: 'Envestigasyon sa a montre detèminasyon nou pou fèmen sa ki ka tounen yon gwo sous dwòg.' Dokiman tribinal fè konnen an 2012, manm gwoup la te vann plis pase 30 kilogram metanfetamin Kore di Nò ki te sezi an Thaïlande ak Filipin. Met la te teste plis pase 99% pite. An 2013, akize yo te dakò bay 100 kilogram ak moun k ap travay an kachèt ak DEA. Youn nan akize yo, Le Tiong Tan Lim ki soti Lachin, ta fè konnen se òganizasyon yo sèlman ki ka jwenn metanfetamin nan Kore di Nò apre presyon Etazini te fè otorite yo kraze lòt laboratwa. Li ta di ke pwodwi yo gen 99% pite, menm jan ak met kalite siperyè nan kilti popilè. DEA konfime metanfetamin yo teste te gen 99% pite. Plan an se te voye dwòg la soti Thaïlande sou yon bato kache pou antre Ozetazini. Yon katriyèm akize, Alexander Lnu, akize pou òganize yon gwoup motosiklis ame pou bay sekirite pou chajman an. Senkyèm sispèk la, Kelly Allan Reyes Peralta soti Filipin, ta rankontre ak ajan DEA an kachèt kòm pati plan an. Administratè DEA a Michele Leonhart di ka a montre kijan Kore di Nò ap vin yon gwo sous metanfetamin pou trafikan entènasyonal. Otorite nan Thaïlande opinyon ke akize yo se asosye Joseph Hunter, ansyen sòlda ameriken arete jou operasyon an. Hunter, yo rele 'Rambo,' ap fè fas ak akizasyon tankou asasen a lwaye; pwokirè yo pa bay detay sou lyen li ak ka dwòg la. Otorite yo di Azi Sidès ansanm ak Kore di Nò ak Lachin se pi gwo rejyon kote yo fabrike epi fè kontrebann metanfetamin.

article_content: Amanda Brewer, a 25-year-old art teacher from Gloucester County, New Jersey, returned from her trip to South Africa with a striking, close-up photo of a great white shark that has captured attention on social media. She volunteered as a scientific data collector for White Shark Africa, an organization focused on animal conservation and eco-tourism. Brewer, who has long been passionate about sharks and photography, went cage diving off Seal Island in Mossel Bay hoping to see great white sharks. During one dive, she took an extraordinary photo of a large female shark, which was lured near the cage by two fish heads tied to a rope as bait. Using her GoPro camera in burst mode, Brewer took around 30 photos, but one dramatic image of the shark with its jaws open stood out from the rest. In an interview with Time Lightbox, Brewer said she felt no fear, describing the sharks as beautiful, graceful, and intelligent. Her viral photo has been shared widely online, covered by various media outlets, and is displayed in her classroom at Whitman Elementary School in Washington Township. While some have criticized the use of bait, Brewer explained that precautions were taken to keep the shark safe and prevent feeding. She pointed out that the fish-eye effect of her camera lens made the shark appear closer than it was—it was actually about three feet from the cage. Brewer said that capturing this moment was a lifelong dream. The photo was also shared by GoPro on their Twitter account, boosting its popularity.
translated_content: Amanda Brewer, yon pwofesè atizay 25-zan ki soti Gloucester County, New Jersey, retounen soti vwayaj li an Afrik di Sid ak yon foto ekstraòdinè ak pre kote li pran yon gwo reken blan ki fè pale anpil sou rezo sosyal yo. Li te volontè kòm kolektè done syantifik pou White Shark Africa, yon òganizasyon ki konsantre sou konsèvasyon bèt ak ekotouris. Brewer, ki depi lontan se yon pasyone reken ak fotografi, te ale fè cage diving toupre Seal Island nan Mossel Bay ak lespwa pou l wè gwo reken blan. Pandan youn nan plonje yo, li te pran yon foto espesyal nan yon gwo reken femèl, kote yo te atire toupre kaj la ak de tèt pwason mare sou yon kòd kòm mawon. Avèk GoPro li an sou mòd rafal, Brewer te pran anviwon 30 foto, men se yon imaj dramatik reken an ak bouch li louvri ki te pi atiran. Nan yon entèvyou ak Time Lightbox, Brewer te di li pa t pè ditou, li di reken yo bèl, graisye, ak entelijan. Foto viral li a gaye anpil sou entènèt, li parèt nan plizyè medya, epi li ekspoze foto a nan klas li nan Whitman Elementary School, Washington Township. Gen moun ki kritike itilizasyon mawon an, men Brewer te eksplike yo te pran tout prekosyon pou sekirite reken an epi pou yo pa ba li manje. Li fè konnen efè lantiy 'fish-eye' kamera a fè reken an parèt pi pre pase li te ye—an reyalite, li te anviwon twa pye lwen kaj la. Brewer di te toujou rèv li fè yon eksperyans konsa. GoPro te pataje foto a sou Twitter yo, sa ki ogmante popilarite li.

article_content:
Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) recently decided to shelve the completed movie 'Coyote vs. Acme', which was intended to be the newest entry in the Looney Tunes series. The film was set to debut on Max, then slated for a theatrical release, but WBD chose to vault the project permanently. This move follows similar decisions for nearly finished films like 'Batgirl' and 'Scoob! Holiday Haunt.'

Many of the movie’s key creators, including director Dave Green and producers Chris DeFaria and James Gunn, were only informed about the cancellation as it happened. Composer Steven Price openly criticized WBD, calling the decision “bizarre anti-art studio financial shenanigans.” Price and others had shared behind-the-scenes content, but WBD issued copyright claims to remove such material from social platforms.

Despite offers from interested buyers, WBD refused to sell the movie, instead choosing to take a $30 million tax write-off. Screenwriter Brian Duffield mentioned that test audiences responded positively, but this did not alter WBD’s choice.

The film’s plot centered on Wile E. Coyote suing Acme Corporation for their faulty products. Will Forte was cast as Coyote’s lawyer, and John Cena would have portrayed Acme’s CEO. The shelving of this film has drawn sharp criticism in the industry, with many arguing it undermines creative efforts and harms WBD’s reputation, especially regarding children’s entertainment.

Crew members, like editor Chris Kupanek, spoke of the emotional investment poured into the project, expressing disappointment over its cancellation. Industry figures, such as Looney Tunes voice actor Eric Bauza, note these actions could set back WBD’s appeal to younger viewers.

More broadly, criticisms reflect a growing belief that studios are placing financial incentives above artistic contributions, leading to concern and frustration among creatives and fans alike.

article_content: Several popular online adult film websites available in Texas have started showing disclaimers labeled "Texas Health and Human Services," warning users about alleged, but unverified, health risks related to viewing pornography, as reported by 404 Media. This change comes after a recent decision by a US appeals court to temporarily reinstate Texas law HB 1181. This law requires adult sites to verify users’ ages and display state-issued health warnings. Vixen Media Group's sites—including Deeper, Blacked, and Vixen—currently do not require age verification but now display these controversial disclaimers. These pop-ups, visible to Texas-based users, claim that pornography is "potentially biologically addictive," "proven to harm human brain development," and "increases the demand for prostitution, child exploitation, and child pornography." The disclaimers also associate exposure to pornography with "emotional and mental illnesses." The accuracy of these warnings is widely disputed. It’s unclear when the disclaimers first appeared, but their deployment seems intended to comply with HB 1181, which was originally set for September 1 implementation. In late August, US District Judge David Alan Ezra blocked the law after a coalition—including Pornhub, Brazzers, and the Free Speech Coalition—challenged it in court, arguing that it promoted misinformation and enforced an official viewpoint. Judge Ezra agreed, stating that the health warnings had not actually been issued by the Texas Health and Human Services Commission despite being labeled as such. On September 19, however, the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals stayed the injunction, allowing the law to proceed temporarily pending further review. Similar laws have been passed in other states including Arkansas, Mississippi, Utah, and Virginia. In response, MindGeek, the parent company of Pornhub, has blocked users from those states from accessing its adult sites.

Chanjman sa a vini apre yon dènye desizyon tribinal apèl ameriken ki retabli tanporèman lwa Texas HB 1181. Lwa sa a egzije sit pou granmoun tcheke laj itilizatè yo epi mete avètisman sante leta. Jij Ezra te dakò, epi li di avètisman sante sa yo pa soti dirèkteman nan Texas Health and Human Services menm si yo make konsa. Men, 19 septanm, Tribinal Apèl Senkyèm Sikwi an leve entèdiksyon an, sa ki pèmèt lwa a aplike tanporèman pandan y ap kontinye revizyon. article_content: More children in South Asia are facing severe water scarcity, worsened by the impacts of climate change, than anywhere else in the world, according to a United Nations report released Monday. The UN children's agency, UNICEF, stated that an estimated 347 million children under 18 in South Asia are exposed to high or extremely high water scarcity—the largest number globally. South Asia, composed of Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Maldives, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka, is home to over a quarter of the world's child population. Climate change is disrupting weather patterns and rainfall, resulting in unpredictable water availability, the report said. The problem is compounded by poor water quality, decreased water supply, over-pumping of aquifers, and insufficient replenishment due to climate change. UNICEF highlighted that when village wells run dry, it affects homes, health centers, and schools. The organization warned that with increasingly unpredictable weather, water scarcity in South Asia is expected to worsen for children. At the upcoming UN COP28 climate conference in Dubai in December, UNICEF plans to urge global leaders to take action to protect a ‘livable planet.’ "Safe water is a basic human right," said Sanjay Wijesekera, UNICEF regional director for South Asia. "Yet millions of children in South Asia lack enough to drink in a region affected by floods, droughts, and other extreme weather, increasingly driven by climate change." Last year, 45 million children in South Asia did not have access to basic drinking water services—the highest number globally. However, UNICEF reported progress, with efforts underway to halve that number by 2030. Eastern and Southern Africa are also facing high risk, with 130 million children threatened by severe water scarcity, the report added.

Ajans timoun Nasyonzini an, UNICEF, di gen anviwon 347 milyon timoun ki poko gen 18 an ki ekspoze ak nivo mank dlo trè wo oswa ekstrèm—se pi gwo kantite nan tout rejyon yo.
