article_content: Routine screening for prostate cancer using serum PSA, a blood test that measures Prostate-Specific Antigen levels, is not recommended for any age group or family history, according to the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). PSA is a protein produced by cells in the prostate gland. While higher PSA levels in the blood may suggest a greater risk of prostate cancer—especially among older adults—the ICMR emphasizes there is no evidence that population-wide PSA screening improves prostate cancer survival rates. Often, doctors recommend PSA tests during preventive health check-ups or when urinary difficulties arise. However, the ICMR's new consensus document on prostate cancer management recommends against routine PSA screening. The document highlights that even individuals with the BRCA2 gene mutation, which increases prostate cancer risk, should not undergo routine PSA screening because of insufficient supporting evidence. Instead, PSA blood tests should be used when there is clear clinical suspicion of prostate cancer. In the United States, the lifetime risk of being diagnosed with prostate cancer is around 11%, while the lifetime risk of dying from it is 2.5%. The US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) advises that men aged 55 to 69 make individual decisions about PSA-based screening after thoroughly discussing the benefits and risks with their clinician. While screening may slightly reduce the risk of death for some men, it can also cause false-positive results, unnecessary further testing, overdiagnosis, overtreatment, and side effects such as incontinence or erectile dysfunction. Dr Amrendra Pathak, a senior consultant urologist, commented that the ICMR guidelines are consistent with global standards. He stated that PSA should not be used for routine screening and should only be performed for people with symptoms like frequent urination, difficulty urinating, incontinence, advanced age, or a family history of prostate cancer. Other common causes of these symptoms should be ruled out first. Prostate cancer rates have been steadily increasing in recent years. According to the National Centre for Disease and Informatics (NCDIR), prostate cancer is among the top 10 cancers in urban cancer registries in cities like Bangalore, Delhi, Bhopal, and Mumbai.
translated_content: ICMR (Konsèy Rechèch Medikal Endyen) pa rekòmande fè tès PSA regilye nan san pou depistaj kansè pwostat, kèlkeswa laj oswa istwa fanmi. PSA se yon pwoteyin selil pwostat pwodui. Lè nivo PSA ogmante nan san, sa ka endike yon risk pi wo pou kansè pwostat – sitou lakay moun ki aje – men ICMR mete aksan pa gen prèv ke depistaj PSA nan tout popilasyon amelyore siviv kansè pwostat. Dòktè souvan rekòmande tès PSA pou chèk-santé prevantif oswa si gen pwoblèm pipi. Men, nouvo dokiman konsansis ICMR sou jesyon kansè pwostat la di pou pa fè depistaj PSA regilye. Dokiman an presize menm moun ki gen mutasyon BRCA2 (ki ogmante risk kansè pwostat) pa dwe fè tès PSA regilye paske pa gen ase prèv. Olye de sa, tès PSA la dwe fèt si gen sispèk klinik sou kansè pwostat. Ozetazini, risk pou yon gason fè kansè pwostat pandan lavi li apeprè 11%, ak risk pou mouri ak kansè pwostat lan se 2.5%. US Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) sijere gason ant 55–69 lane pran desizyon endividyèl ak doktè sou tès PSA, apre yo fin diskite avantaj ak risk. Depistaj la ka diminye lieve risk lanmò pou kèk gason, men li ka ba fo-rezilta, egzamen siplemantè, dyagnostik oswa tretman depase, ak efè segondè tankou inkontinans oswa difikilte seksyèl. Dr Amrendra Pathak, urolog konsiltan, bay opinyon ke direktiv ICMR yo suiv estanda mondyal. Li di tès PSA pa dwe sèvi kòm depistaj regilye, sèlman pou moun ki gen sentòm tankou pipi souvan, difikilte pipi, pwoblèm kenbe pipi, granmoun, oswa istwa fanmi kansè pwostat. Fòk lòt koz sentòm sa yo elimine anvan. Kansè pwostat ap ogmante dènye ane sa yo. Selon NCDIR (Sant Nasyonal pou Enfòmatik ak Maladi), kansè pwostat se pami 10 pi gwo kansè nan vil tankou Bangalore, Delhi, Bhopal, ak Mumbai.

article_content: Two employees at a Papa John's in Sanford, Florida, were fired after accidentally leaving a racist voicemail on a customer's phone. The message, unintentionally recorded after a pizza delivery, included conversations about a tip the customer gave and frequent use of racial slurs. The recording was later posted online, making the incident public. Identified as delivery drivers, the staff mocked the customer in the voicemail, including singing a modified opera song with offensive language. Although they complained about the tip, the customer had actually left a 21% gratuity on a $15.26 order. The issue became known after the customer checked his phone and found the voicemail from the delivery workers. Papa John’s CEO John Schnatter publicly apologized, distancing the company from the workers’ actions and confirming their dismissal. He said the conduct violated company values and that he had personally reached out to express his regret to the impacted customer, their family, and the community.

Anrejistreman an te parèt sou entènèt, epi sa fè tout istwa a vin piblik. Chofè livrezon yo te pase kliyan an nan rizib nan mesaj la, yo te chante yon mizik opera ak pawòl ofansif ladan l tou. Malgre yo te plenyen, kliyan an te bay yon poubo 21% sou yon lòd $15.26. Sitiyasyon an te vin parèt lè kliyan an tcheke telefòn li epi l jwenn mesaj vwa a. article_content: Dominican Republic President Leonel Fernandez is continuing his campaign against government corruption by making significant changes among top military and police commanders. Following the recent dismissal of 700 police officers and the forced retirement of 31 generals, Fernandez removed and reassigned more high-ranking officials. Over the past six months, the government says more than 535 members of the country's 24,000-strong military have been dismissed, mainly due to suspected involvement in drug trafficking. High-level officials affected include the former director of the Dominican National Drug Control agency (DNCD). In a recent national address, Fernandez declared, 'In the Dominican Republic -- listen well -- narcotrafficking will not pass.' Despite his statements, many citizens and analysts believe that drug trafficking and corruption are deeply rooted within the country. Tomas Castro Monegro, a long-serving anti-corruption attorney, noted that organizations meant to combat corruption are often implicated themselves. Tobias Friedl from iJET Intelligent Risk Systems described both the army and the police as impacted by corruption. Although it is customary for military retirements and promotions to take place on February 27, coinciding with the nation's independence anniversary, this year's scale is unprecedented. Prior records show far fewer dismissals, highlighting the exceptional nature of the current actions. National police chief Rafael Guzman urged officers to resist temptations, stating that the institution must stand with the nation against drug trafficking. Observers like Castro suggest that corruption has persisted for years, as evidenced by some officials' lifestyles, which surpass what public salaries can afford. According to Castro, corrupt officials often seek roles in customs, airports, border posts, and anti-drug units, and accept bribes or profit from confiscations. Castro has represented drug suspects and has experience arguing before the Dominican Supreme Court. Tobias Friedl highlighted that although the Dominican Republic is not a major drug producer, it acts as a transit point for narcotics destined for the United States and Europe. Key trafficking routes involve sea passage from South America via other Caribbean islands. Research from Jane's Sentinel and indexmundi notes that the country is also involved in money laundering and serves as a trans-shipment point for ecstasy. Deteriorating conditions in neighboring Haiti have shifted some trafficking activities to the Dominican Republic. Journalist Ramon Cruz Benzan reported that unlike before, some drugs brought into the country now remain for local consumption, partly due to increased tourism and diaspora connections. U.S. authorities have prosecuted Dominican nationals on drug charges for years. While some see Fernandez's actions as a genuine effort to fight corruption, others believe he was compelled by public reaction to a recent incident involving the deaths of several Colombians in a drug-linked shooting. A special commission found lower-level officials were involved, but many suspect higher-ups were also implicated. Most observers agree that the issue of corruption and drug trafficking will likely persist beyond these measures.
translated_content: Prezidan Repiblik Dominikèn, Leonel Fernandez, ap kontinye batay li kont koripsyon nan gouvènman an, pa chanje anpil nan chèf militè ak polis li yo. Apre li te revoke 700 ofisye polis ak fòse retrèt 31 jeneral, Fernandez kontinye retire ak deplase lòt chèf wo grad. Nan sis dènye mwa yo, gouvènman an di plis pase 535 manm nan fòs militè peyi a, ki gen anviwon 24,000 sòlda, te revoke, sitou paske yo sispèk yo te gen afè ak trafik dwòg. Moun ki te afekte yo mete ladan yo ansyen direktè Ajans Nasyonal Kontwòl Dwòg (DNCD). Nan yon diskou nasyonal resan, Fernandez deklare, 'Nan Repiblik Dominikèn -- tande byen -- trafik dwòg pap pase.' Menm ak tout deklarasyon sa yo, anpil sitwayen ak analis kwè trafik dwòg ak koripsyon deja anpil nan peyi a. Tomas Castro Monegro, yon avoka espesyalize nan lit kont koripsyon depi lontan, fè remake ke òganizasyon ki swadizan la pou konbat koripsyon souvan mele yo menm tou. Tobias Friedl, yon analis nan iJET Intelligent Risk Systems, di swa lame a ak polis la gen pwoblèm koripsyon. Anjeneral, se 27 fevriye, jou endepandans la, yo fè retrèt ak promosyon nan fòs militè yo. Men, jan sa fèt ane sa a, se pa janm rive konsa anvan. Dapre istwa, pa t janm gen tèlman de revokasyon konsa. Chèf polis nasyonal la, Rafael Guzman, ankouraje polisye yo pou yo pa tonbe nan tantasyon, epi fè konnen enstitisyon an dwe kanpe ak peyi a kont trafik dwòg. Gen obsèvatè tankou Castro ki panse koripsyon egziste depi lontan, sa w wè nan jan kèk ofisyèl ap viv plis pase sa salè ofisyèl yo bay. Dapre Castro, ofisyèl koripsyon yo pito chèche travay nan ladwàn, ayewopò, bò fwontyè, ak inite kont dwòg; yo pran lajan anba tab epi benefisye nan sezi byen. Castro deja defann moun ki akize pou trafik dwòg epi li konn plede devan Tribinal Siprèm lan. Tobias Friedl di ke menm si Repiblik Dominikèn pa prodwi anpil dwòg, li sèvi kòm pwen transpò pou kokaèn, zèb, elatriye sou wout pou Etazini ak Ewòp. Wout prensipal yo se lanmè ki soti Amerik di Sid al pase lòt zile Karayib yo. Rechèch Jane's Sentinel ak indexmundi montre peyi a enplike nan blanchiman lajan epi sèvi kòm pwen transpò pou ekstazi. Sitiyasyon ki ap vin pi mal ann Ayiti fè kèk trafik dwòg deplase pou Repiblik Dominikèn. Jounalis Ramon Cruz Benzan rapòte ke, pa tankou anvan, gen dwòg ki rantre epi kounye a li rete pou konsomasyon lokal, sitou akòz touris ak lyen ak dyaspora. Otorite Ameriken deja mete Dominiken anba arestasyon depi plizyè ane pou ka trafik dwòg. Gen moun ki wè aksyon Fernandez yo kòm yon veritab efò pou konbat koripsyon, men lòt kwè li te oblije aji aprè reyaksyon piblik apre zak ki mennen lanmò plizyè Kolonbyen nan yon dosye trafik dwòg. Yon komisyon espesyal di ajan ba grad te patisipe, men anpil moun panse gwo tèt te mele tou. Anpil obsèvatè dakò pwoblèm koripsyon ak trafik dwòg yo pral kontinye malgre mezi sa yo.

article_content: NEW DELHI: The Election Commission has issued a show-cause notice to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi regarding his comments referring to Prime Minister Narendra Modi as 'panauti' and 'pickpocket', as well as comments about loan waivers. Gandhi has been asked to respond by Saturday evening.  The poll body reminded Gandhi that the Model Code of Conduct prohibits leaders from making unverified allegations against political opponents. According to the EC, the use of the term 'panauti' may fall under the prohibition outlined in Section 123 of the Representation of the People Act, which addresses corrupt practices.  This action follows a complaint from the BJP, which requested the EC take action against Rahul Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge for their comments against the Prime Minister. In its submission, the BJP stated that the remarks made by Kharge and Gandhi were unfounded, accused them of spreading misinformation, and called for criminal proceedings, citing a lack of respect for electoral laws and the Model Code of Conduct.  The BJP also argued that the claim of Rs 14,00,000 crore in loan waivers for industrialists over the past nine years is not supported by facts.  Rahul Gandhi, at a recent rally, said 'Panauti Modi', suggesting the Indian cricket team lost the World Cup final against Australia because Prime Minister Modi was present in the stadium. BJP leaders responded by criticizing Gandhi’s remarks.  At another rally, Gandhi compared political opponents to pickpockets working in groups of three, describing Narendra Modi as the distractor, Adani as the pickpocket, and Amit Shah as the person who threatens the victim.  Separately, West Bengal Chief Minister and Trinamool Congress chief Mamata Banerjee alleged attempts to 'saffronise' the cricket team, claiming India would have won the World Cup if the final were played in Kolkata or Mumbai. She also noted that players resisted wearing saffron jerseys.  Banerjee further criticized the BJP, saying that 'wherever sinners go, they take along their sins', and commented that the Indian team won all matches except the one attended by 'the sinners', without naming anyone. article_content: The wife of Sir David Amess, the long-serving Conservative MP who was murdered two years ago, has unveiled a memorial plaque in his honor inside the House of Commons. The shield is placed just a few seats away from where the Essex MP sat in the chamber. Family members, Commons Speaker Sir Lindsay Hoyle, and Home Secretary Suella Braverman attended a small ceremony for the unveiling. Lady Julia Amess said: "We are hugely honored that his legacy lives on in the Commons." She added: "Like so many of his friends, we miss his ready smile, unique sense of humor, and his lifelong mission to lift spirits in difficult times." Sir David served as MP for Basildon in Essex from 1983 to 1997 and for Southend West from 1997 until his murder at a constituency surgery in Leigh-on-Sea on 15 October 2021. The shield includes a coat of arms featuring five red roses representing his children and love of gardening, two talbot dogs for his support of animal rescue, and the emblem of Bournemouth University, his alma mater. Lady Amess reflected that "the Commons meant everything to David," noting his love of people and tireless work to help others. She said he rarely accepted 'no' if he believed more could be done. Sir Lindsay Hoyle commented: "Sir David was one of the nicest, kindest people I have ever known, and I was fortunate to call him a friend. We miss his cheerful contributions, especially his advocacy for Southend West, which has now achieved city status. I am pleased we could honor him in the chamber he loved." The memorial joins plaques dedicated to other MPs killed while serving, including Sir Anthony Berry, Airey Neave, and Jo Cox. For more East of England news, follow us on social media. Have a story? Email eastofenglandnews@bbc.co.uk or WhatsApp 0800 169 1830.

Manm fanmi, Prezidan Palman an Sir Lindsay Hoyle, ak Sekretè Deta Suella Braverman te patisipe nan yon ti seremoni pou inogirasyon an. Madam Julia Amess te di: "Nou vrèman onore paske eritaj li ap kontinye viv nan Palman an." Li ajoute: "Tankou anpil zanmi li, nou manke souri li a, sans imè espesyal li a, ak misyon li te genyen pou bay kouraj menm nan moman difisil yo." Plak la genyen yon kòt zam ak senk woz wouj pou pitit li yo ak lanmou li pou jadinaj; de chen talbot pou pasyon li pou sekou bèt yo; ak logo Bournemouth University kote li te etidye. Nou manke entèvansyon pozitif li yo, sitou fason li te defann Southend West, ki kounye a se yon vil. Mwen kontan nou te kapab onore li nan chanm li te renmen an." article_content: NEW DELHI: Spiritual leader Sadhguru and renowned psychologist and author Steven Pinker recently shared the stage at Harvard Medical School’s Sanders Theatre in Cambridge, Massachusetts, to discuss the mysteries of consciousness. This event was a highlight of Day 1 at the two-day conference on 'Consciousness: Science, Spirituality & Social Impact,' organized by the Sadhguru Centre for a Conscious Planet in partnership with Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), a major teaching affiliate of Harvard Medical School. The session was moderated by Dr. Balachundar Subramaniam, a professor of Anesthesiology at Harvard Medical School. During the discussion, Sadhguru explained, 'Consciousness doesn’t merely represent intellect at work within us. In yogic philosophy, consciousness, referred to as Chitt, is the fundamental force driving us—it is intelligence without intent.' Steven Pinker opened by stating that consciousness is not a miracle, but the outcome of brain activity and factors like chemicals and electrical impulses. Sadhguru elaborated, clarifying that 'miracle' should not be seen as deception, but as something that escapes easy, logical explanation within human experience. 'If you plant a seed and it becomes a flower, that’s a miracle. If you eat bread and it becomes part of your body, that’s a miracle. While we can explain parts of these processes, their full occurrence is still awe-inspiring. Calling something miraculous doesn’t mean it can’t be explained—everything in life is a miracle,' he said. He added, 'The brain was created by the human body—it isn’t something separate. So, it’s essentially just a uniquely complex part of our body. Still, the brain can’t completely account for all human experiences—many aspects of life remain unexplored.' Sadhguru clarified the difference between consciousness and awareness: 'Awareness relates to brain activity, a result of mental processes, whereas consciousness is intent-free.' He emphasized that science should remain open to the existence of things not yet understood. The panel also discussed deep states of meditation. Pinker challenged common ideas about meditation relating to intuition and clarity, while Sadhguru argued that 'meditation' is a broad English term encompassing various practices such as Japa, Tapa, and Samyama. They briefly addressed mental health, with Sadhguru observing, 'We live in the most comfortable era in history, especially for women and children. Before, survival was a constant challenge; now that survival is more assured, struggles shift to our minds, hence more mental health issues. Although we create advanced machines, we don’t focus enough on refining ourselves.' Earlier, Sadhguru joined a panel with Christof Koch, Rudolph Tanzi, Deepak Chopra, and Bernard Carr to explore the bridge between spirituality and science and to shed light on enduring questions about human existence. The Sadhguru Center at BIDMC aims to advance health and well-being by integrating medical and contemplative sciences, conducting research that uses clinical and mindfulness-based interventions to enhance brain health and help patients recover from surgery and critical illness.

Pi bonè nan jounen an, Sadhguru te chita ak Christof Koch, Rudolph Tanzi, Deepak Chopra ak Bernard Carr pou diskite kijan syans ak espirityalite ka mache ansanm. Sadhguru Center nan BIDMC ap amelyore sante moun ak rechèch klinik ak meditasyon pou pi bon retablisman ak sante mantal.

Ford and Pacific Gas and Electric (PG&E) are launching a California pilot program to explore how electric vehicles can support home and grid energy management. Bill Crider, Ford’s Head of Global Charging and Energy Services, announced this project, which centers on the Ford F-150 Lightning all-electric pickup. The pilot will test bi-directional charging, which enables the truck to provide backup power to homes during outages and assist the grid during peak demand periods. This Vehicle-to-Home (V2H) concept is being developed further by PG&E into a broader Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) system, integrating vehicles, homes, and the grid. Up to 1,000 residential customers can participate, each receiving $2,500 for enrollment and up to $2,175 in incentive payments.

Bi-directional charging effectively turns EVs into mobile batteries. In emergencies, the truck’s stored energy can power a home using the same connection as charging. Similar technology is already used in China, especially in rural areas, and was demonstrated in Texas when F-150 hybrid owners used their trucks to supply home power during a winter storm.

This approach is comparable to home battery systems like Tesla’s Powerwall, often coupled with solar panels, which can provide uninterrupted electricity during outages. By combining EVs, home batteries, and solar generation, homes may run on renewable and stored energy for extended periods—sometimes indefinitely if supply and demand are balanced.

If successful, the Ford/PG&E pilot could become a template for future residential energy systems. Experts expect more homes will adopt solar arrays and large-scale batteries, with grids designed for seamless integration with electric vehicles and home energy storage. This signals a shift from current on-demand electricity models to distributed, storage-based systems, where EVs and home batteries help ensure reliable power.

article_content: A recent pay rise for teachers in England will not provide any additional funds for teachers' salaries in Northern Ireland, according to the Department of Education (DE). Usually, devolved administrations receive extra money through the Barnett formula when a spending decision is made for England—a process known as receiving Barnett consequentials. However, the 6.5% pay increase for teachers in England for 2023/24 was funded from existing Westminster budgets, the DE noted, meaning there is no extra funding for Stormont to resolve the ongoing dispute about teachers' pay. Official figures, published on Wednesday, show that the average full-time public sector worker in Northern Ireland has seen their real wages fall by over 7% in the past year. Teachers in Northern Ireland have not received a pay increase in almost three years. Many teachers in England, Scotland, and Wales now earn thousands more than those in Northern Ireland at the same career stage. For instance, starting in September, new teachers in England will earn £30,000 annually, probation-year teachers in Scotland over £32,000, and new teachers in Wales just under £31,000, compared to just over £24,000 for newly qualified teachers in Northern Ireland. Teaching unions in Northern Ireland held a one-day strike in April to protest pay and workload issues and have been taking further industrial action short of a full strike. Unions representing non-teaching staff such as school bus drivers, classroom assistants, and catering staff are also involved in industrial action. According to BBC News NI, teaching unions continue to negotiate pay increases with educational bodies including the DE and Education Authority (EA). However, the department has previously stated that increasing teacher pay is 'simply unaffordable' within the 2023/24 education budget, which has been reduced from the previous year. When asked by BBC News NI about the 6.5% pay rise in England, a DE spokesperson clarified that 3.5% of the increase would be covered by existing school budgets, with the remainder funded through departmental savings and efficiencies. No additional government funding was provided, so there is no Barnett consequential for Northern Ireland to support a pay deal for teachers.
translated_content: Yon ogmantasyon salè pou pwofesè ann Angletè p ap pote okenn lajan anplis pou peye pwofesè yo nan Northern Ireland, dapre Depatman Edikasyon (DE). Anjeneral, administrasyon dezantrale yo resevwa plis lajan gras ak fòmil Barnett lè yon desizyon depans fèt pou Angletè — pwosesis sa rele Barnett consequentials. Sepandan, ogmantasyon 6.5% sou salè pwofesè ann Angletè pou 2023/24 lan te finanse ak bidjè Westminster ki egziste deja, se sa DE fè konnen, sa vle di pa gen lajan anplis pou Stormont regle konfli sou salè pwofesè yo. Chif ofisyèl, ki pibliye mèkredi, montre anplwaye sektè piblik ki travay a plen tan nan Northern Ireland wè salè yo diminye an reyalite pa plis pase 7% pandan ane ki sot pase a. Pwofesè nan Northern Ireland pa resevwa okenn ogmantasyon salè depi prèske twa ane. Anpil pwofesè ann Angletè, Scotland, ak Wales kounye a touche mil liv plis pase sa yo nan Northern Ireland ki menm nivo ak yo. Pa egzanp, apati mwa septanm nan, nouvo pwofesè ann Angletè ap touche £30,000 pa ane, pwofesè anba prebasaj an Scotland plis pase £32,000, ak nouvo pwofesè an Wales prèske £31,000, pami tan ke yon nouvo pwofesè nan Northern Ireland ap touche jis apeprè £24,000 pa ane. Sendika pwofesè nan Northern Ireland te fè yon grèv yon sèl jou an avril pou denonse pwoblèm salè ak chay travay, epi yo kontinye pran aksyon sendikal ki pa rive nan grèv jeneral. Sendika ki reprezante lòt anplwaye lekòl tankou chofè bis, asistan salklas, ak anplwaye kwizin ap fè aksyon sendikal tou. Daprè BBC News NI, sendika pwofesè yo kontinye negosye ogmantasyon salè ak òganis edikasyon tankou DE ak Education Authority (EA). Men, depatman an te deja di ogmante salè pwofesè yo 'senpleman pa posib' nan kad bidjè pou edikasyon 2023/24 la, ki te diminye konpare ak lane pase. Lè BBC News NI poze kesyon sou ogmantasyon 6.5% salè ann Angletè a, yon pòtpawòl DE eksplike 3.5% ogmantasyon an ap soti nan bidjè lekòl ki egziste deja, rès la ap kouvri ak ekonomi ak efikasite nan depatman an. Pa te gen okenn finansman gouvènman anplis, kidonk pa gen alokasyon Barnett pou Northern Ireland pou sipòte okenn kontra ogmantasyon salè pou pwofesè yo.

While there are still reservations about artificial intelligence, especially generative AI that creates content from prompts, technology firms continue to incorporate these tools into daily software and devices. Microsoft has taken significant steps in this direction, having released AI chat features in its Bing search engine and now previewing its Copilot AI assistant in Windows 11. Built to help users be more creative and productive, Copilot's features are similar to Bing's chatbot—it can offer travel tips, write short poems, and more.

To access Copilot on Windows 11, users must update to the latest version of the operating system via Windows Update in Settings. After updating, the Copilot icon will display on the taskbar, though its presence can be managed in Personalization and Taskbar settings. It’s also easy to open Copilot using the Win+C keyboard shortcut or from the Start menu.

Even those new to generative AI can try Copilot to write poetry, draft cover letter introductions, or create email messages for coworkers. Users have the option to pick between More Creative, More Balanced, and More Precise conversation styles, which adjust how imaginative or focused Copilot’s replies are. Beyond generating text, Copilot can answer questions using information from Bing and around the web, such as popular travel destinations, recipe advice, or solutions for home projects. Importantly, Copilot’s responses include links to the original online sources of the information.
translated_content:
Malgre anpil eskèptis sou entèlijans atifisyèl—sitou generative AI ki fabrike tèks ak imaj a pati pwent—konpayi teknoloji yo pa sispann enstale zouti sa yo nan aparèy ak lojisyèl nou itilize chak jou. Microsoft fè gwo avanse nan domèn lan; li te mete fonksyon chat AI sou Bing epi kounye a ap lanse vèsyon esè asistan entèlijan Copilot sou Windows 11. Copilot fèt pou rann itilizatè yo pi kreyatif ak plis efikas, epi li bay sèvis ki sanble ak Bing chatbot—li ka bay konsèy vwayaj, ekri powèm oswa ede ekri imèl.

Pou w itilize Copilot sou Windows 11, ou oblije mete dènye vèsyon sistèm lan atravè Windows Update nan Anviwònman. Apre ou fin mete ajou, ikon Copilot la ap parèt sou ba travay la; ou kapab jere sa nan meni Personalizasyon ak Taskbar. Ou ka louvri Copilot fasilman ak konbinezon kle Win+C oswa atravè meni Start la tou.

Menm si ou pa abitye ak generative AI, ou ka eseye Copilot pou ekri powèm, entwodiksyon lèt motivasyon oswa mesaj pou kolèg. Itilizatè yo ka chwazi ant plizyè stil konvèsasyon: More Creative, More Balanced, oswa More Precise, ki pèmèt Copilot adapte repons li yo. Anplis kreye tèks, Copilot ka bay repons ak kesyon sou entènèt atravè Bing ak lòt resous—kit se kote pou vizite, ide resèt, oswa konsèy pou brikole lakay. Anplis, Copilot mete lyen sou sous enfòmasyon yo dirèkteman nan repons li yo pou transparans.

article_content: Vitali Klitschko, the newly elected mayor of Kiev and former boxing champion, has asked protesters at Maidan (Independence Square) to dismantle their camps and leave. At a large gathering, he addressed demonstrators and self-defense groups, promising to form a Maidan representative group within the city council. Klitschko also said his mayoral oath would be taken at the square. He emphasized that the protest camp, which contributed to ousting the pro-Russian leader, now causes significant issues for city residents, including traffic disruptions, and should be removed. Even after the presidential election on May 25, which saw Petro Poroshenko elected, and the earlier interim leadership of Oleksandr Turchynov, distrust of the government remains among many Ukrainians. Hundreds of protesters still hold the Maidan, demanding substantial reforms against corruption before leaving. Anna Chaikovska, a protester from western Ukraine, said, 'Personally, I have no plans to leave. They need to show the people that the new laws are working—they’re where they are thanks to us.' Russia has repeatedly condemned the Ukrainian authorities for not clearing protest encampments or occupied buildings, referencing an April agreement with Ukraine, the US, and the EU. In eastern Ukraine, skepticism toward Kiev is widespread, with separatists declaring independence in two provinces and fighting government forces. Recent weeks have seen intensified violence in the east, such as a failed rebel attempt to seize Donetsk airport and the shooting down of a Ukrainian helicopter that killed twelve, including a general. The OSCE has faced difficulties, with several monitoring teams either missing or detained, prompting safety concerns. Despite ongoing violence, Russia insists on maintaining an international observer presence, as confrontations between government troops and pro-Russian rebels continue. The two sides accuse each other of causing civilian casualties. In Kiev, images of ongoing barricades and fires highlight the continuing tension and determination among protestors.
translated_content: Vitali Klitschko, nouvo majè vil Kiev la ak ansyen chanpyon boks mondyal la, mande manifestan k ap okipe Maidan (Kare Endepandans lan) pou demantle kan yo epi retounen lakay yo. Pandan yon gwo rasanbleman, li te pale ak manifestan yo ak gwoup otodefans yo, li pwomèt tou pou l mete yon gwoup reprezantan Maidan ladan konsèy vil la. Klitschko di li pral prete sèman majè a dirèkteman sou Maidan. Li fè konnen kan protestasyon an, ki te jwe gwo wòl nan retire ansyen lidè pwò-Ris la, kounye a ap bay abitan vil la anpil pwoblèm, espesyalman konsènan sikilasyon, e li panse kan an ta dwe retire. Malgre eleksyon prezidansyèl 25 me kote Petro Poroshenko te eli, ak peryòd entèmedyè kote Oleksandr Turchynov te okipe tèt leta, anpil Ukrainyen toujou pa fè gwo konfyans ak nouvèl gouvènman an. Plizyè santèn manifestan toujou sou Maidan epi di y ap rete jouk gouvènman an fè chanjman solid kont koripsyon. Anna Chaikovska, manifestan ki soti lwès Ikrèn, di: 'Mwen pèsonèlman pa gen okenn plan pou m kite. Yo dwe pwouve pèp la ke nouvo lwa yo ap mache—se nou ki te mete yo kote yo ye a.' Larisi ap toujou kritike otorite Ikrèn paske yo poko retire manifestan ak degrade katye yo, e li souliye yon akò mas  avèk Ikrèn, Etazini ak Inyon Ewòp la. Nan lès Ikrèn, gen anpil dout kont gouvènman Kiev la; separatis yo deklare endepandans nan de rejyon e y ap goumen ak fòs gouvènman an. Nan dènye semèn yo, vyolans ogmante nan lès la, sitou ak eseye pran èpòt Donetsk ak bal tire ki abate yon elikoptè militè kote 12 moun, tankou yon jeneral, mouri. OSCE ap fè fas ak difikilte serye, kote ekip obsèvatè yo disparèt oswa kenbe, ki lakoz enkyetid sekirite. Malgre tout sa yo, Larisi ensiste sou nesesite prezans entènasyonal obsèvatè yo. Gouvènman ak rebèl pwò-Ris yo kontinye ap konfwonte, chak bò ap akize lòt la sou afè viktim sivil yo. Nan Kiev, barikad ak bal ak dife toujou montre tansyon ak detèminasyon manifestan yo.

article_content: Many Americans are experiencing financial strain as higher interest rates and persistent inflation make it harder to buy homes, cars, and even afford groceries. Amearah Elsamadicy, a law student and mother in St. Louis, shared that money troubles have led to tension in her household. The family has cut back on activities and travel to avoid taking on more debt. Elsamadicy’s challenges mirror those of many across the country affected by the Federal Reserve’s attempts to tame inflation. After inflation spiked above 9 percent last June, the Fed raised its main interest rate to 5.25-5.55 percent. Though rate hikes paused in September, officials believe rates will stay high for the foreseeable future. Concerns about international tensions and possible U.S. government shutdowns have fueled speculation about potential future rate hikes. Nonetheless, the unemployment rate remains low at 3.8%, and wage growth has recently started to outpace inflation, helping to support consumer spending. Retail sales in August rose 2.5% from last year. Dean Baker, economist at the Centre for Economic and Policy Research, notes a dual reality: high borrowing costs are weighing on consumers, but the job market remains resilient and spending strong. U.S. consumer debt rose to a record $17.06 trillion in Q2 2023—up $2.9 trillion since 2019—driven mostly by housing-related loans, while home prices continue to stay elevated. Higher interest rates mean larger debt burdens. Fed rate hikes make borrowing across the board more expensive, including credit cards, auto loans, and mortgages, as well as existing variable-rate debts. People with lower incomes, retirees, and first-time homebuyers are finding it especially tough. Many worry about the future: prolonged high rates could increase the risk of recession, although policymakers hope to avoid triggering widespread bankruptcies. Owning a home remains a key part of the American dream, with 66% of Americans owning property. The pandemic caused home prices to surge—median home values rose over $52,000 in just one year—as buyers sought more space outside cities. Mortgage rates have since doubled to nearly 7.8% for 30-year loans, while most Americans with mortgages locked in low rates during the pandemic. Because so many homeowners secured low-rate mortgages recently, few are willing to sell, reducing the supply of homes by 40% since before the pandemic and sending prices higher. Harvard reports that 2.4 million potential buyers were priced out of the housing market last year. Giulio del Bufalo of Brooklyn says higher mortgage rates dashed his family's hope of buying a bigger home after their second child was born. With monthly costs now double, they’re forced to wait. Meanwhile, homeowners are building wealth: their typical net worth is 40 times higher than renters'. The auto market is facing similar pressures. Average new car payments hit a record $730 per month, amounting to about 10% of an average family's income. The pandemic boosted prices by 30% over three years due to shortages. Financing a new car now might take nearly a year’s salary to pay off. Angelique Spencer, retired in Washington State, wants to help her elderly mother in Texas buy a car, since public transport is limited. But a $40,000 vehicle would mean $600 monthly payments—impossible for her mom to manage alone—forcing Spencer to consider cutting her own spending on food or medicine. Auto loan delinquencies have risen, especially among younger adults. With student loan payment breaks now expired, many expect pressures on borrowers to worsen. Many Americans use credit cards—84% have at least one—with balances rising 16% from last year. Cards now carry average rates above 20%, and delinquencies are up compared to before the pandemic. During COVID-19, credit card debt dropped as government support and payment holidays boosted savings. But, with that help gone and inflation rising, people have turned back to debt. In February, 37% of adults reported using credit cards for basic living expenses. Total credit card debt now exceeds $1 trillion. Elsamadicy says she carefully weighs each grocery purchase, deciding what she can afford on credit. Even after lowering her balances, high rates cause debts to climb fast. Like many, her family is cutting back on restaurants and vacations to focus on paying the bills.
translated_content: Anpil Ameriken ap sibi presyon finansye akoz chaj to enterè ki wo ak enflasyon ki pa fasil bese, sa ki rann li pi difisil pou yo achte kay, machin, e menm manje. Amearah Elsamadicy, yon etidyan lalwa ak manman nan St. Louis, di difikilte sa lakoz konfli lakay li. Fanmi an oblije diminye vwayaj ak aktivite pou evite plis dèt. Sa Amearah ap rankontre a se menm jan pou anpil Ameriken k ap viv konsekans efò Rezèv Federal la pou frennen enflasyon. Apre enflasyon depase 9% an jen pase a, Fed la ogmante to enterè prensipal li sou 5.25-5.55%. Menmsi yo pa t monte l ankò an septanm, otorite yo prevwa li pap desann byento. Sitiyasyon entènasyonal ki chaje ak menas blokaj gouvènman pouse moun panse to enterè yo ka monte ankò. Men chomaj rete ba (3.8%) epi salè ap ogmante pi vit pase enflasyon, sa ki pèmèt moun kontinye depanse; vant an detay te monte 2.5% an out konpare ak ane pase. Ekonomis Dean Baker nan Centre for Economic and Policy Research eksplike ekonomi ameriken an ap viv yon parado: malgre to enterè yo wo, mache travay la kenbe, e konsomatè yo toujou depanse. Dèt konsomatè ameriken monte nan $17.06 trilyon (Q2 2023) – prensipalman prè kay – tandiske pri lojman pa desann. To enterè ki wo lakoz plis dèt. Chak fwa Fed la ogmante to baz li a, sa fè prè, kat kredi, machin, ak ipotèk koute plis, menm prè ak to chanje. Sa pi difisil pou moun ki gen ti revni, retrete, ak premye fwa achtè kay. Gen anpil kè sote pou lavni; si to enterè wo yo dire, risk resesyon ogmante, men bank santral la pa vle kreye vag fayit. Achte kay se toujou rèv anpil Ameriken: 66% gen pwòp kay yo. Pandemi a fè pri kay monte anpil — plis pase $52,000 nan valè medyàn nan yon ane. To ipotèk pou prè 30 an prèske double pou atenn 7.8%, malgre plis moun te bloke to ki te ba pandan pandemi an. Paske anpil moun gen prè ak ti to, pifò pa vle vann kay yo, sa ki bese kantite kay sou mache a pa 40% depi avan pandemi, e sa leve pri a. Selon Harvard, 2.4 milyon moun pa te ka achte kay ane pase. Giulio del Bufalo nan Brooklyn di to ipotèk ki ogmante a kraze rèv li pou achte kay pi gwo pou dezyèm pitit li. Kounye a, pri yo double, yo oblije tann. Pandanstan, mwayèn richès propriétaires depase lwe; rasyoyon an se 40 fwa. Mache machin nan anba presyon tou. Peman mwayèn pou nouvo machin se $730 pa mwa — anviwon 10% revni fanmi an. Pandemi a te lakoz mank machin ak pri yo monte 30% sou twa ane. Jodi a, fin peye yon nouvo machin ka mande prèske yon ane salè. Angelique Spencer, yon retrete Washington, vle ede manman l (kap viv Texas kote transport piblik limite) achte yon machin. Men, yon machin $40,000 ap fè $600 pa mwa, twò anpil pou manman l pou kont li; Angelique ap reflechi pou li bese sou manje ou medikaman pou l ede l. To dèt machin ki pa peye ogmante, plis pami jèn yo. Avèk repriz peman prè etid, anpil atann ke sitiyasyon finansye ap vin pi difisil. Anpil Ameriken depann de kat kredi; 84% gen omwen youn, e balans kat yo ogmante 16% ane pase. Enterè mwayèn depase 20%, ak deli dèt pi wo pase nivo avan pandemi. Pandan pandemi a, dèt kat kredi bese gras a asistans leta ak dispans repit; men kounye a ak enflasyon ak disparisyon èd sa yo, moun retounen nan dèt. Nan fevriye, 37% granmoun itilize kat kredi pou depans esansyèl yo. Dèt kat kredi total depase $1 trilyon kounye a. Elsamadicy di li kalkile chak acha manje sou kredi; menm lè li dekouvri, to enterè wo refè dèt li rapid. Fanmi li, tankou anpil lòt, limite restoran ak vakans pou kapab peye bòdwo chak mwa yo.

article_content: Havana's stunning buildings, energetic atmosphere, and sunny climate are attracting more tourists who want to see the city before it undergoes major changes. Interest has skyrocketed, especially since the U.S. signaled possible easing of travel restrictions for its citizens—a move that reportedly caused a 95% jump in travel searches. The U.S. now allows Americans to visit Cuba for reasons like family visits or educational and religious activities without getting a special license. General tourism is still not permitted, but eligible travelers can now bring back limited quantities of Cuba's famous cigars. Eased regulations are also making it simpler for American businesses to sell technology in Cuba and for airlines to increase flights. Diplomatic relations between the U.S. and Cuba are improving, with plans to reopen embassies and start new official exchanges. Old Havana, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, has become even more popular with tourists enjoying its lively culture. Visitors can see everything from street artists and colorful flower sellers to vintage American cars cruising the streets. Travel expert Bob Atkinson recommends visiting Cuba soon, suggesting the culture may change as more Americans arrive. He stresses the island’s unique vibe and the possibility that increased tourism could impact Havana’s heritage. Cuba is both affordable and rich in culture, although many residents still deal with poverty and limited internet access. Daily life includes shopping at ration stores and limited choices for goods—conditions that could change as U.S. relations normalize. The U.S. has raised the limit for money sent to Cuban families and is reviewing Cuba's terror sponsor status. While the trade embargo remains until Congress lifts it, President Obama and Secretary of State Kerry are taking steps toward better relations. Throughout Havana, iconic touches such as murals of Che Guevara, scenes of classic car owners, lively musicians, and bustling markets define the city’s unique spirit, enjoyed by both locals and tourists.

Relasyon diplomatik ap amelyore, ak reouvèti anbasad epi vizit ofisyèl ki planifye. Vye Havana, patrimwàn mondyal UNESCO, ap atire plis touris ki vle jwi kilti li. Vizitè yo ka wè atis lari, flèch machann an kolè, ak machin klasik Ameriken sou lari yo. article_content:
James Brettell, 26, became the first person to complete the 'Gigantwich' challenge at Mangetout Bistro in Southend-on-Sea, Essex. The Gigantwich is a colossal sandwich weighing 5.5 pounds and containing 8,000 calories. It is made with six thick slices of bread, topped with three large onion rings, and filled with a variety of meats—including sausage, bacon, ham, beef, turkey, lamb, a steak burger, pulled BBQ pork, and hash browns—along with various cheeses, stuffing, a cheese omelette, vegetables, and multiple sauces. The meal also comes with a large portion of chips and a side of coleslaw.

Before Brettell's achievement, 116 people—including a UK strongman and competitive eaters—had attempted the challenge without success within the 45-minute time limit. Brettell finished in just 36 minutes. His reward included a special 'Gigantwich' t-shirt and £116 pooled from previous failed challengers.

Brettell, a chartered surveyor from Hadleigh, Essex, who works in London, said he was inspired to take on the challenge after seeing a photo of the sandwich online. Although normally trim and athletic, he was surprised to finish the meal and felt unwell afterward. He credited the motivational song 'Eye of the Tiger,' which the restaurant owner played during his final moments of the challenge, for helping him complete it.

Restaurant owner Will Fishenden stated that the challenge was inspired by the TV show 'Man vs Food' and expressed amazement at Brettell's success. Out of 117 attempts, Brettell is the only person to have completed the meal. To make the challenge tougher, the restaurant has since added another layer to the Gigantwich.

Li fèt ak sis tranch pen epè, twa gwo bag zonyon sou tèt, tout kalite vyann ladan—sosis, bekonn, janbon, vyann bèf, kodenn, mouton, steak burger, kochon BBQ rache, ak hash browns—ansanm ak plizyè kalite fwomaj, stuffing, yon omelet ak fwomaj, legim ak plizyè sòs. Anvan viktwa Brettell la, 116 moun—tankou yon strongman UK ak moun ki konpetisyon manje—te eseye men yo pa t’ ka fini defi a anvan 45 minit la. Brettell te fini an sèlman 36 minit. Li te resevwa yon t-shirt 'Gigantwich' espesyal ak £116 rasanble nan men tout moun ki te echwe anvan li yo.

article_content: Wallace and Gromit, the iconic British animated duo, are featured in a special exhibition at Bristol’s M Shed museum. On display for the first time are rare sketches by creator Nick Park, which chart the evolution of the characters from their origins in the late 1980s through to their first full-length film, 'The Curse of the Were-Rabbit' (2005). The exhibition launches as Nick Park contemplates the future of the franchise, influenced by the declining health of Peter Sallis, the original voice of Wallace. The collection showcases early pencil drawings, storyboards, original sets, props, and other Aardman Animation creations, including Preston the robot dog and Shaun the Sheep. Visitors can explore models, sets, and a display of the Oscars and BAFTA awards won by the series. The event is both a celebration of Bristol’s vibrant creative community and an invitation for visitors to participate in hands-on drawing activities inspired by the franchise. The display delves into Nick Park’s background, from his upbringing in Lancashire making home movies, through his studies at Sheffield Polytechnic and the National Film and Television School, where he started work on 'A Grand Day Out.' Park’s association with Aardman Animations began in 1985, and he contributed to iconic projects such as Peter Gabriel’s 'Sledgehammer' music video before earning global recognition with Wallace and Gromit. Acknowledging a major setback, the exhibition notes the 2005 fire at Aardman Animations that destroyed many original models and sets, though some survived. As well as honoring Wallace and Gromit’s legacy and widespread appeal, the exhibition may also mark one of their final public showcases, with the franchise’s future still uncertain.

Pou premye fwa, vizitè yo ap ka admire desen orijinal pa Nick Park, kreyatè pèsonaj yo, ki montre evolisyon yo depi fen ane 1980 yo rive premye fim long la, 'The Curse of the Were-Rabbit' (2005). Ekspozisyon an sòti menm lè Nick Park ap reflechi si l'ap kontinye franchiz la, sitou akòz sante aktris vwa Wallace la, Peter Sallis, ki ap degrade. Koleksyon an gen desen an premye, tablo istwa, dekor, ak akseswa orijinal, ladan yo Preston chen wobot la ak Shaun mouton an. Vizitè yo ap gen chans wè modèl, dekor ak prim yo, tankou gwo pri Oscar ak BAFTA yo, ke Wallace ak Gromit te genyen. Evènman an se yon bèl okazyon pou montre jan Bristol gen anpil kreyativite epi ankouraje vizitè yo patisipe ak ti desen pa yo tou. Ekspozisyon an detaye lavi Nick Park depi li te piti nan Lancashire, kote li t ap fè sinema kay ak manman li, rive lekòl Sheffield Polytechnic ak National Film and Television School kote li te kòmanse travay sou 'A Grand Day Out.' Li rantre Aardman Animations an 1985, te travay sou videyo 'Sledgehammer' Peter Gabriel, epi vin popilè mondyal ak Wallace ak Gromit. Ekspozisyon an sonje tou ensidan dife ki te brile anpil modèl ak dekor orijinal Aardman Animations an 2005, men kèk te sove. Ekspozisyon an onore eritaj Wallace ak Gromit e ta ka make youn nan dènye aparisyon piblik yo, paske pa gen anpil klarte sou avni franchiz la.

article_content: Imagine trying to plan a vacation but being forced to go through a travel agent who bundles everything into one price—no picking your hotel, no clear breakdown of costs, and hidden fees baked in. If you swap 'vacation' for 'prescription drugs,' that’s a lot like how the U.S. pharmacy system operates: a complex web where patients rarely know what they actually pay for. Most American adults take at least one prescription medication yearly, and over a third use three or more. In 2021, Americans spent more than $600 billion on prescription drugs. While this benefits some in the healthcare industry, patients often struggle with confusing, unaffordable, and opaque prices as a result of missing transparency and accountability. Policymakers and governments are trying to fix these issues, but it’s complicated by industry players who gain from high prices and resist change. Steps like California’s partnership with Civica to make $30 insulin, new Medicare drug price negotiations, and Congressional efforts to improve transparency and rein in pharmacy benefit manager pricing are underway. However, the pharmacy supply chain needs a complete overhaul, not just tweaks. Achieving affordable medicines means health organizations must rethink their entire approach—using value-based contracts, technology partnerships, and close cooperation among providers. This work demands honest conversations, shared vision, and mutual accountability. Ultimately, the industry can’t wait for policy changes alone. Affordable, accessible prescription drugs require innovation and cooperation from everyone involved right now.
translated_content: Imajine w ap eseye òganize yon vakans epi fò ou pase pa yon ajan vwayaj ki mete tout bagay nan yon sèl pri—ou pa ka chwazi otèl ou, pa gen detay sou pri yo, epi gen frè kache ladan li. Si ou ranplase 'vakans' ak 'medikaman sou preskripsyon', se sa menm k ap fèt nan sistèm famasi Etazini an: yon rezo konplike kote pasyan raman konnen sa yo peye vrèman. Pifò granmoun Ameriken pran omwen yon medikaman sou preskripsyon chak ane, epi plis pase yon tyè itilize twa oswa plis. An 2021, Ameriken depanse plis pase $600 milya pou medikaman sou preskripsyon. Gen moun nan endistri swen sante a ki benefisye, men pasyan ap lite ak pri chè ak konfizyon paske pa gen ase transparans ak responsabilite. Gouvènman ak aktè politik ap eseye fè chanjman, men sa difisil paske gen enteresi ki kont chanjman. Kalifòni ap travay ak Civica pou kreye ensilin $30 la, Medicare kòmanse negosye pri medikaman, epi Kongrè a ap eseye mete plis transparans ak kontwole pri PBM yo. Men, sistèm famasi a bezwen yon revizyon total, pa sèlman ajisteman. Pou medikaman vin plis abordab, òganizasyon sante yo ta dwe chanje fason yo ap fè bagay yo nèt—sèvi ak kontra sou valè, teknoloji, epi kolabore avèk tout patnè. Sa mande konvèsasyon kle, vizyon pataje, ak responsabilite ansanm. Anfinal, endistri a pa ka tann sèlman sou lalwa. Fòk tout moun mete tèt yo ansanm epi inove kounye a pou medikaman vin fasil jwenn ak pi abordab pou tout moun.
post_content: Prescription drug prices in the US are out of control—patients can’t see costs, and big companies keep it confusing. Real change needs teamwork, tech, and open talk, not just laws! 💊🤝 #AffordableMeds #HealthcareFix

article_content: Luke Shaw has finally started to feel at home at Manchester United, with home comforts playing an important role in his adaptation. United supporters named Shaw man of the match after his energetic and uplifting performance in the team's 1-0 victory over Crystal Palace on Saturday. The 19-year-old left-back impressed throughout the game and nearly scored his first career goal after a surging 50-yard run from his own half. Shaw previously faced a challenging start at Old Trafford. He arrived at pre-season training out of shape, leading some to question the club's decision to let long-serving left-back Patrice Evra leave. However, four months later, Shaw has grown in confidence and happiness. 'I feel at home now,' the England international told Press Association Sport. 'Everyone has been really good with me, not just the players but the staff as well. They've made me feel welcome and now I just want to keep improving, work hard in training, and get the best out of myself.' A key factor in Shaw's improvement appears to be the relocation of his parents from Surrey to Manchester. 'It's a new environment for me, but having my family move with me has been the best thing,' said Shaw, who lived with fellow young Southampton players before his transfer. 'My mum and dad are here now, so I'm not just a 19-year-old living alone. I have a good support system at home, and good people around me. It helps me feel comfortable. Even though I didn't live with them in Southampton, it's great to spend time with my family now.' Shaw openly admitted during United's U.S. tour that he had underestimated the challenge of joining a club of Manchester United's stature. That contributed to his lack of fitness when he first arrived. Now, after participating in several commercial events—including one for United's global noodle partner Nissin on Saturday—he's become more accustomed to these responsibilities. 'I'm getting used to it now; it's part of my job. There are lots of commercial activities and expectations on the field to manage,' he said. Earlier on Saturday, Shaw excited the Old Trafford crowd with a long run and a shot that Crystal Palace goalkeeper Julian Speroni managed to tip wide. Former United full-back Phil Neville compared Shaw's performance to that of Gareth Bale. Shaw believes he'll have more moments like this in the future. 'It's something I can do and want to do more often,' said Shaw. 'When chances like that come, I try to drive forward. That time, it was a good save, but hopefully I'll score soon.' Historically, left-backs like Patrice Evra and Denis Irwin inspired the Old Trafford crowd with similar energetic plays. Shaw has ambitious goals to match their achievements. 'Evra and Irwin were top-quality left-backs, and I want to prove I can reach their level,' he said. Shaw hopes the win over Crystal Palace, secured by a second-half goal from Juan Mata, will help United gain momentum after a slow start to the season. 'Hopefully that win will kick-start our season,' said Shaw. 'We haven't had the best run recently, so this was a big win.' Luke Shaw spoke at a screening of 'HUNGRY TO WIN,' a Japanese animated project by Nissin, Manchester United's Official Global Noodle Partner.
translated_content: Luke Shaw finalman kòmanse santi l alèz nan Manchester United, kote konfor kay la ede l byen adapte. Sipòtè United yo te vote li kòm pi bon jwè apre viktwa 1-0 kont Crystal Palace. Defansè goch ki gen 19 an te fè anpil enpresyon tou mach la epi li te prèske make premye gòl li aprè yon gwo kous 50 yad. Shaw te gen difikilte nan kòmansman li Old Trafford. Li te vini pre-sezon san bon fòm, epi sa te mete anpil kesyon sou sa ki te fè klèb la lage Patrice Evra. Men, apre kat mwa, li vin gen plis konfyans ak satisfaksyon. 'Mwen santi mwen lakay mwen,' li te di bay Press Association Sport. 'Tout moun aji byen avè m, pa sèlman jwè yo, men tout pèsonèl la tou. Yo akeyi m e kounye a mwen vle kontinye amelyore m ak travay pi di.' Yon gwo chanjman pou Shaw se sa kote paran li, ki soti Surrey, kounye a ap viv avè l nan Manchester. 'Se yon nouvo kote pou mwen, men pi bèl bagay la se famni m la ak mwen,' li te di. 'Manman ak papa m la, donk mwen pa yon 19-zan ki pou kont li. Mwen gen bon sipò lakay epi bon moun bò kote m. Sa rann mwen pi konfòtab. Menm si mwen pa t viv ak yo o Southampton, se bèl bagay kounye a pou nou ansanm ankò.' Pandan toune Manchester United Ozetazini, Shaw admèt li te panse li pa t ap tèlman difisil pou jwe nan yon gwo klèb konsa. Se konsa li te vini san bon fòm. Kounye a, aprè plizyè evènman komèsyal, tankou ak patnè nouy mondyal la Nissin, li vin abitye ak tout obligasyon sa yo. 'Mwen abitye ak sa kounye a, paske li fè pati travay la. Gen anpil bagay pou jere komèsyalman epi tou sou teren an,' li te di. Samdi, Shaw te soulve sipòtè Old Trafford apre yon long kous epi tire balon, men gadyen Speroni te sove l. Ansiyen defansè United Phil Neville konpare sa ak Gareth Bale. Shaw fè konnen li pral kontinye eseye sa. 'Sa se nan kapasite mwen e mwen vle fè l plis. Chak fwa gen chans, mwen pouse devan. Fwa sa a gadyen an te sove, men byento m ap make,' Shaw te di. Defansè goch tankou Evra ak Irwin te konn bay sipòtè stad la kouraj ak kous konsa. Shaw motive pou atenn nivo yo. 'Evra ak Irwin te defansè eksepsyonèl, mwen vle montre m ka rive menm ak yo,' li te di. Shaw swete viktwa Crystal Palace la, ak gòl Juan Mata, ap pèmèt United relanse sezon an aprè yon kòmansman pa twò bon. 'Mwen swete viktwa sa a lanse sezon nou,' li di. 'Rezilta yo pa t bon dènye tan an, donk sa se yon gwo viktwa.' Luke Shaw te pale pandan siveyans 'HUNGRY TO WIN', yon animasyon Japonè soti Nissin, Patnè Ofisyèl Nouy Manchester United.

article_content: Unity Small Finance Bank, promoted by Centrum Financial Services, posted a net profit of Rs 186 crore for the first half of the fiscal year. The bank reported a net interest margin of 11%. Its net income reached Rs 515 crore, up 115% year-on-year, supported by increased customer outreach across products and regions. Pre-provision operating profit doubled to Rs 137 crore. Net advances rose 89% year-on-year to Rs 5,947 crore, while the net non-performing assets ratio stood at 0.4% at September-end. Provision coverage was at 99%. The bank’s deposit base expanded 147% year-on-year to Rs 3,918 crore, with about 75% from new-to-bank customers. Unity Bank operates 137 branches and has plans to open 54 more in state capitals like Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, and Punjab. Elsewhere in the industry, a group representing India’s largest telecom operators has accused tech giants such as Microsoft and Amazon of allegedly bypassing regulations by sending enterprise messages over platforms like WhatsApp, possibly leading to an estimated Rs 3,000 crore annual loss to the government and telecom providers. Additionally, the Indian government asked Apple to participate in a probe into alleged state-sponsored hacking attempts on iPhones belonging to prominent Indians, including opposition parliament members. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation told the Delhi High Court that leasing firms can preregister and repossess aircraft and engines from the bankrupt airline Go First, impacting its chances of revival.
translated_content: Unity Small Finance Bank, ki sipòte pa Centrum Financial Services, reyalize yon benefis nèt 186 crore rupi pou premye mwatye ane fiskal la. Labank lan rapòte yon maj enterè nèt de 11%. Revni nèt labank lan rive 515 crore rupi, ogmante 115% ane sou ane, gras ak pi bon akse kliyan atravè pwodwi ak rejyon diferan. Benefis opere anvan pwovizyon an double pou rive 137 crore rupi. Prè nèt yo te ogmante 89% ane sou ane pou rive 5,947 crore rupi, pandan rapò move prè nèt yo te 0.4% nan fen septanm. Pwoteksyon pwovizyon an te 99%. Baz depo labank lan grandi 147% ane sou ane pou rive 3,918 crore rupi, kote anviwon 75% soti nan nouvo kliyan. Unity Bank gen 137 branch epi l ap planifye ouvè 54 lòt nan kapital eta yo tankou Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, ak Punjab. Nan lòt nouvèl endistri a, yon gwoup ki reprezante pi gwo operatè telecom nan peyi End akize gwo konpayi teknoloji tankou Microsoft ak Amazon de kontoune règleman lè yo voye mesaj antrepriz sou platfòm tankou WhatsApp, sa ki kapab lakoz pèt estimen a 3,000 crore rupi pa ane pou gouvènman ak operatè telecom yo. Anplis, gouvènman End mande Apple patisipe nan yon ankèt sou swadizan tantativ feyzan hacking sou iPhone ki pou pèsonalite enpòtan, tankou manm opozisyon nan Palman. Direksyon Jeneral Aviyasyon Sivil lan di Tribinal Siperyè Delhi ke konpayi lwe yo ka pre-anrejistre epi rekipere avyon ak motè nan men Go First, ki kouche, sa ki afekte chans konpayi sa a pou l reprann aktivite.
post_content: Unity Small Finance Bank saw massive growth, with profits hitting Rs 186 crore and exploding deposits! 🚀 Plus, they're adding more branches across India. #BankingNews #IndiaFinance

article_content: Ryan Moore delivered a commanding front-running ride on Integral to secure victory in the Group One Sun Chariot Stakes at Newmarket. The Sir Michael Stoute-trained mare, who is a progeny of 2003 Arc champion Dalakhani, added this win to her earlier Group One Falmouth Stakes triumph at the same venue in July. On Saturday, Integral finished ahead of Miss France, Andre Fabre’s 1,000 Guineas winner, with Fabre’s other entry, Fintry, taking third place. There is now speculation that Integral could compete in the Queen Elizabeth II Stakes at Ascot’s Champion Day in two weeks. Trainer Michael Stoute said the team would assess how she recovers before making a decision, noting, ‘She put in a very good piece of work with Ryan about ten days ago, and we were quite pleased with her. She showed her class in the Falmouth and is a truly versatile horse. You can ride her in any style, but I particularly like her when she has a lead. She has a fantastic finishing kick.’
translated_content: Ryan Moore te dirije Integral ak konfyans depi kòmansman kous la pou l' ranpòte viktwa nan Group One Sun Chariot Stakes nan Newmarket. Chwal sa a, ki antrene pa Sir Michael Stoute, se pitit champyon Arc 2003 la, Dalakhani, epi li ajoute sa sou lis viktwa li apre li te deja ranpòte Group One Falmouth Stakes la nan Newmarket an Jiyè. Samdi, Integral te fini devan Miss France, chwal Andre Fabre ki te genyen 1,000 Guineas la, epi lòt chwal Fabre a, Fintry, te pran twazyèm plas. Kounye a, gen sigjesyon Integral ka patisipe nan Queen Elizabeth II Stakes la pandan Champion Day nan Ascot nan de semèn. Antrenè Michael Stoute di ekip la ap evalye kijan li refè anvan yo pran desizyon, e li di: ‘Li te fè yon bèl egzèsis ak Ryan anviwon diz jou de sa, e nou te vrèman satisfè ak li. Li montre klas li nan Falmouth epi se yon chwal vrèman fleksib. Ou ka monte li nenpòt fason, men mwen plis prefere li ak yon avantaj devan; li gen yon akselerasyon final ekstraòdinè.’
post_content: Ryan Moore and Integral stormed to another big win at Newmarket’s Sun Chariot Stakes, beating tough rivals! Trainer Stoute’s horse might hit Ascot’s QEII Stakes next. 🏇🔥 #HorseRacing #Integral #ChampionDay
translated_post: Ryan Moore ak Integral mete dife nan Sun Chariot Stakes nan Newmarket—anba men Sir Michael Stoute! Yo ka parèt nan Queen Elizabeth II Stakes byento. 🏇🏆 #KousChwal #ChampionDay #Integral

article_content: A 20-year-old shop worker, Ben Chaney, claims he has faced discrimination at the 99p Stores branch in Witham, Essex, because he is English. Chaney alleges that his manager treats him harshly, calling English staff 'lazy,' reprimanding him in a language he cannot understand, and shouting at him on the shop floor. He reports that non-English staff receive preferential treatment—such as being allowed breaks and conversations at the tills—while he faces strict discipline for minor issues. Chaney also says he is labeled lazy for refusing shifts he cannot work and has been threatened with dismissal, with his work hours reduced after a back injury was marked as unauthorised absence. This is the second recent discrimination allegation at the store; last month, 21-year-old Toni Sargeant said she was denied a job because the manager considered English applicants unreliable, although he later said there was a misunderstanding. A spokesperson for 99p Stores has unequivocally denied these allegations, stating that the company is committed to equal opportunity employment and is carrying out an ongoing investigation.

Li di jere a trete li rèd, rele anplwaye angle yo 'parese,' mele l’ nan yon lang li pa konprann, epi li toujou ap rele sou li an piblik. Ben di anplwaye pa angle yo pi fasil jwenn avantaj tankou pran poz ak pale kote yo vle, men li menm yo toujou rekonèt l pou ti bagay. Li di yo rele l parese si li pa ka fè orè travay yo mande l, epi menase pou revoke l epi koupe lè li, menm lè li te absan pou yon blesi do. Se dezyèm fwa magazen sa a resevwa plent pou diskriminasyon; mwa pase, Toni Sargeant, 21 lane, di yo te refize l travay paske jere a kwè Angle yo pa serye, men jere a di se te yon konfizyon. Yon pòtpawòl 99p Stores di yo pa dakò ditou ak akizasyon sa yo, epi konpayi an fè konnen yo respekte lajistis ak egalite opòtinite, ankèt ap fèt toujou.

article_content: The Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA) is set to install updated speed limit signage across Gurgaon to enhance road safety. Speed limits on 156 main roads, covering about 292 kilometers, have been set between 20 and 60 kmph, according to the Times of India. Based on District Road Safety Committee recommendations, roads wider than 75 meters will have a maximum speed limit of 60 kmph, 60-meter-wide roads at 50 kmph, 30-meter-wide roads at 40 kmph, 24-meter-wide roads at 30 kmph, and roads narrower than 10 meters at 20 kmph. The speed limit for 55 roads in older parts of Gurgaon has increased from 10–20 kmph to 30–40 kmph, while around 101 sections, including the Southern Peripheral Road (SPR), Faridabad-Gurgaon Road, and Sector 64-65, have seen speed limits reduced from 60–90 kmph to 50–60 kmph. GMDA will replace outdated signage on major roads. The district administration and the Regional Transport Authority (RTA) decide these limits. In July, authorities instructed civic and police departments to enforce the new restrictions. The limits were set after analyzing each road's features, traffic patterns, infrastructure, and accident data. Traffic police state that approximately 30% of accidents in Gurgaon are due to speeding. To address this, GMDA invited bids for updating city speed signage with an estimated cost of Rs 1.8 crore. Signboards will be placed about every 300 meters for clear visibility, with project completion expected within six months of allotment. RD Singhal, General Manager of GMDA's mobility division, told TOI, 'The District Road Safety Committee has set speed limits for all road infrastructure, including highways and internal roads. GMDA will provide speed limit signs on all main city roads to increase safety.' Work will follow guidelines from the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRT&H), the Public Works Department (PWD), and Indian Road Congress codes. Experts note that correct speed signage influences driving behavior and can lower accident and fatality rates. Sewa Ram, associate professor at the School of Planning and Architecture in New Delhi, said, 'Enforcement of consistent speed limits is important. Sudden changes in limits within one corridor may confuse drivers. Signage works best when enforcement backs it.' GMDA has also installed thermoplastic rumble strips in some underpasses to curb speeding.

Daprè rekòmandasyon Komite Sekirite Wout Distri a, wout ki pi laj pase 75 mèt ap gen yon limit vitès maksimòm 60 km/h; pou wout 60 mèt, limit la se 50 km/h; wout 30 mèt, 40 km/h; wout 24 mèt, 30 km/h; epi wout ki mwens pase 10 mèt, 20 km/h. Gen 55 wout ansyen nan Gurugram kote limit vitès ogmante soti 10–20 km/h pou 30–40 km/h, pandan lòt 101 seksyon (ki gen ladan Southern Peripheral Road (SPR), wout Faridabad-Gurgaon, ak Seksyon 64-65) vin gen limit ki depase soti 60–90 km/h pou 50–60 km/h. An jiyè, otorite yo te mande sektè sivik ak lapolis pou enpoze nouvo restriksyon sa yo. Limit sa yo te fikse apre yo te analize chak wout, sikilasyon, enfrastrikti ak done aksidan. RD Singhal, Manadjè Jeneral divizyon mobilite GMDA a, eksplike TOI: 'Komite Sekirite Wout la te fikse limit vitès pou tout enfrastrikti, ki gen ladan gran wout nasyonal ak leta ak wout entèn. GMDA ap mete panèl limit vitès sou tout gran wout nan vil la pou asire sekirite.' Travay la ap fèt dapre règ Ministè Transpòtasyon Wout ak Oto (MoRT&H), Depatman Travay Piblik (PWD), ak kòd Kongrè Wout Endyen. Ekspè yo di bon panèl vitès ede chofè respekte règ epi ka anpeche aksidan ak lanmò. Sewa Ram, pwofesè asistan School of Planning and Architecture nan New Delhi, di: 'Li enpòtan pou gen limit vitès ki konsistan, paske chanjman bridsoukou ka fè chofè yo konfonn. Panèl yo pi efikas lè gen kontwòl ak pinisyon reyèl.' GMDA ap mete tou bann vibrasyon plastik sou kèk pasaj anba tè pou anpeche machin roule twò vit.

article_content:
Tom and Nicole Lamb, a grieving couple from Midland, Michigan, found themselves at the heart of a nationwide 'pay-it-forward' movement after losing their eight-year-old son Jayden to a rare form of cancer. Seeking solace in their community, the Lambs decided to honor Jayden's memory by paying for the customer behind them in a drive-through line—a simple act of kindness meant as a thank you for the community’s support after Jayden's passing on November 27, 2012.

After sharing their gesture on Facebook, the Lambs were overwhelmed by stories from people across the country performing their own acts of kindness, from Minneapolis to Seattle and throughout the Midwest. Over 30,000 people joined the 'Keep On Truckin' Team Jayden' Facebook page, posting about paying for others’ meals, donating children’s toys, and giving to charity. In one notable case, an anonymous donor gave a diamond engagement ring worth $2,000 to the Salvation Army in Midland, accompanied by a note reading: 'Paying it Forward Jayden Style. God Bless.'

Jayden, a third grader at Pine River Elementary School, battled cancer for two and a half years. His last words to his father reflected the depth of his struggle and faith: 'I’m never going to get married, daddy,' he said. 'God needs me more.'

After Jayden's funeral on December 1, the Lamb family performed more acts of kindness, paying off strangers’ layaway bills and encouraging others to share their stories online. Posts flooded in, such as one from Carrie Fike, who recounted receiving a gift card and a note in a checkout line: 'Pay it forward, keep on trucking team Jayden.' Others described buying meals for strangers or tipping generously in Jayden’s honor. Businesses organized bake sales and toy drives, and the Messiah Lutheran Church named their Christmas tree ‘Jayden’s Tree’ in his memory.

On what would have been Jayden’s ninth birthday, December 12, 2,000 people gathered to release Chinese lanterns in a touching tribute. The movement has helped the Lamb family cope with their grief and has inspired hope and a sense of unity even beyond their Michigan community.

Tom Lamb believes that Jayden, remembered as loving and always eager to help others, would have been proud of the kindness his story inspired. 'Knowing that this movement has started allows us to know that his name and who he is will not be forgotten. It has restored hope for us, and many people along the way,' he said.
translated_content:
Tom ak Nicole Lamb, yon koup ki ap soufri aprè lanmò pitit gason yo Jayden, ki te gen uit an epi ki te mouri akòz yon kansè ra, te jwenn tèt yo nan kè yon mouvman 'paye pou pwochen an' ki gaye tout atravè peyi a. Pou onore Jayden epi remèsye kominote a pou soutyen li apre li te mouri 27 Novanm 2012, yo te deside peye pou kliyan ki te dèyè yo nan liy drive-through la, yon jès jantiyès senp.

Apre yo te pataje jès la sou Facebook, fanmi Lamb lan te sezi wè plizyè dizèn milye moun soti Minneapolis rive Seattle ki te kòmanse fè pwòp jantiyès pa yo. Plis pase 30,000 moun te suiv paj 'Keep On Truckin' Team Jayden', kote yo rakonte eksperyans peye manje moun, bay jwèt pou timoun ak ede òganizasyon charitab. Youn nan pi gwo jès yo te se lè yon moun bay Salvation Army nan Midland yon bag fiyanse ki vo $2,000 ak yon ti nòt: 'Paying it Forward Jayden Style. God Bless.'

Jayden, ki te elèv nan Pine River Elementary School, te konbat kansè pandan prèske twa ane. Dènye pawòl li te di papa l te touche tout moun: 'M pa janm pral marye, papa,' li di. 'Bondye bezwen mwen plis.'

Apre antèman Jayden 1ye desanm, fanmi Lamb lan te kontinye fè jès jantiyès, tankou peye dèt layaway pou moun yo pa konnen epi ankouraje lòt moun pataje istwa yo sou entènèt la. Moun kontinye pataje sou paj Facebook la, tankou Carrie Fike ki resevwa yon kado ak yon nòt: 'Pay it forward, keep on trucking team Jayden.' Gen lòt ki achte manje oubyen bay tip jenere an onè Jayden. Biznis lokal yo fè van gato, ranmase jwèt, epi pyebwa Nwèl 'Jayden’s Tree' te plante nan Messiah Lutheran Church pou sonje Jayden.

Sou sa ki ta dwe 9yèm anivèsè Jayden, 12 Desanm, 2,000 moun te reyini pou lage lanp Chinwa nan syèl la kòm omaj pou li. Mouvman pa sèlman ede fanmi Lamb la jere doulè yo, men li pote espwa ak inite pi lwen pase kominote yo.

Tom Lamb kwè Jayden, timoun ki toujou te renmen ede epi ki bay lanmou, t ap fyè dèske istwa li enspire tout bèl jès sa yo. 'Lè nou wè mouvman sa a kòmanse, nou sèten non ak memwa li pap janm efase. Sa rann nou gen espwa epi touche anpil moun sou chemen an,' Tom eksplike.
post_content: A simple act of kindness by grieving parents in Michigan has sparked a nationwide wave of paying-it-forward! Thousands across the U.S. are honoring little Jayden's memory by spreading good deeds. 💙 #PayItForward #TeamJayden #KindnessMatters
translated_post: Yon jès jantiyès pa paran Jayden te fè tout peyi a ap bay lanmou! Milye moun ap 'paye pou pwochen an' pou sonje Jayden epi simaye bon kè. 💙 #PayItForward #TeamJayden #JantiyèsAnAksyon

article_content: Police have announced that MI6 officer Gareth Williams likely locked himself in the bag where his body was discovered in August 2010. The investigation could not definitively explain his death, though the police concluded it was probably accidental and found no evidence of involvement by others. This conclusion differs from an earlier coroner's verdict, which stated Williams was probably killed by another person. Police emphasized there was no evidence of anyone else present in the flat, no indication of a cover-up, and no link between Williams' death and his work. Unidentified DNA from 10-15 people was found, but none were matched to possible suspects. Williams' family disagrees with the police conclusion and continues to believe he was unlawfully killed. Police admitted that MI6 did not fully cooperate with the investigation, but said there was no deliberate deception. Williams was described as a private and conscientious person with an interest in escapology. He had previously needed help in situations involving self-restraint. Several alternative theories—including foreign agent involvement, foul play, and accidental death during escapology practice—remain unproven. A review of the evidence found no clear indication of homicide; police concluded the death was probably a tragic accident. Unanswered questions remain, such as the origin of unidentified DNA, the lack of Gareth's DNA on the bag's padlock, and the delayed reporting of his disappearance by MI6. Williams' family maintains disappointment in how MI6 handled the situation and believes more should have been done to clarify the cause of death.
translated_content: Lapolis anonse ajan MI6 Gareth Williams pwobableman te fèmen tèt li nan valiz kote yo te jwenn kadav li an Out 2010. Ankèt la pa t kapab eksplike lanmò li klèman, men lapolis konkli li te petèt yon aksidan epi pa gen prèv ki montre lòt moun te enplike. Konklizyon sa a diferan ak sa korònè a ki te di Williams te pwobableman viktim yon lòt moun. Lapolis mete aksan sou absans prèv pou nenpòt lòt moun nan apatman an, pa gen siy ke yo te kache tras, epi pa gen okenn koneksyon ant lanmò Williams ak travay li. Yo dekouvri ADN 10-15 moun yo pa t ka idantifye, san okenn sispèk. Fanmi Williams pa dakò ak konklizyon lapolis la epi yo kontinye kwè li te asasinen. Lapolis admèt MI6 pa t kolabore nèt, men selon yo pa t gen volonte pou kache laverite. Williams te yon moun prive ak serye, ak enterè pou eskapoloji. Li te deja bezwen èd pou soti nan sitiyasyon kote li te mare tèt li. Plizyè lòt teyori tankou enplikasyon ajan etranje, krim, oswa aksidan pandan eksapoloji, poko pwouve. Revizyon prèv yo pa montre siy asasinay; lapolis konkli lanmò a te petèt yon aksidan trajik. Kesyon toujou san repons, tankou orijin ADN yo, absans ADN Gareth sou kadna valiz la, ak reta MI6 nan rapòte disparisyon li.
